nodes.signature: public sealed class Commands
nodes.body_text: public sealed class Commands { private readonly World.World _w; public Commands(World.World w) { _w = w; } public static readonly string[] Names = { "help", "time", "gamemode", "tp", "teleport", "give", "kill", "summon", "setblock", "fill", "difficulty", "gamerule", "clear", "seed", "spawnpoint", "setworldspawn", "say", "me", "xp", "list", "weather", "heal", "feed", "effect", "locate" }; private static readonly CultureInfo Inv = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture; public bool Execute(Player p, string line) { line = line.Trim(); if (line.StartsWith("/")) line = line[1..]; if (line.Length == 0) return false; var a = line.Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries); string cmd = a[0].ToLowerInvariant(); bool needsCheats = cmd is not ("help" or "me" or "say" or "list" or "seed"); if (needsCheats && !_w.AllowCheats && !p.IsLocalOp) { p.SendMessage("§cNie masz uprawnień do użycia tej komendy (komendy wyłączone)."); return false; } try { switch (cmd) { case "help": Help(p); return true; case "time": return Time(p, a); case "gamemode": case "gm": return GameMode(p, a); case "tp": case "teleport": return Tp(p, a); case "give": return Give(p, a); case "kill": return Kill(p, a); case "summon": return Summon(p, a); case "setblock": return SetBlock(p, a); case "fill": return Fill(p, a); case "difficulty": return DifficultyCmd(p, a); case "gamerule": return GameRule(p, a); case "clear": return Clear(p, a); case "seed": p.SendMessage("Ziarno: [§a" + _w.Seed + "§r]"); return true; case "spawnpoint": return SpawnPoint(p, a); case "setworldspawn": _w.SpawnX = MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.X); _w.SpawnY = MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.Y); _w.SpawnZ = MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.Z); p.SendMessage($"Ustawiono punkt odrodzenia świata na {_w.SpawnX}, {_w.SpawnY}, {_w.SpawnZ}"); return true; case "say": _w.BroadcastMessage($"§d[{p.Name}] " + string.Join(' ', a.Skip(1))); return true; case "me": _w.BroadcastMessage($"* {p.Name} " + string.Join(' ', a.Skip(1))); return true; case "xp": return Xp(p, a); case "list": p.SendMessage($"Graczy online: {_w.Players.Count}: " + string.Join(", ", _w.Players.Select(x => x.Name))); return true; case "weather": p.SendMessage("W tym świecie zawsze świeci słońce :) (pogoda nieobsługiwana)"); return true; case "heal": p.Health = p.MaxHealth; p.SendMessage("Uleczono."); return true; case "feed": p.FoodLevel = 20; p.Saturation = 20; p.SendMessage("Najedzono."); return true; case "locate": p.SendMessage("Brak struktur do zlokalizowania."); return true; default: p.SendMessage("§cNieznana komenda. Wpisz /help aby zobaczyć listę komend."); return false; } } catch (Exception ex) { p.SendMessage("§cBłąd składni: " + ex.Message); return false; } } private void Help(Player p) { p.SendMessage("§e--- Komendy ---"); p.SendMessage("/time set <day|night|noon|midnight|liczba>, /time add <n>"); p.SendMessage("/gamemode <survival|creative|spectator|0|1|3>"); p.SendMessage("/tp [gracz] <x> <y> <z> (~ = względnie)"); p.SendMessage("/give <gracz> <przedmiot> [ilość] [meta]"); p.SendMessage("/summon <zombie|skeleton|creeper|spider|enderman|cow|pig|sheep|chicken> [x y z]"); p.SendMessage("/setblock, /fill, /kill [@e|@a|gracz], /clear, /xp <n>[L]"); p.SendMessage("/difficulty <peaceful|easy|normal|hard>, /gamerule <reguła> <wartość>"); p.SendMessage("/seed, /spawnpoint, /setworldspawn, /say, /me, /list, /heal, /feed"); } private List<Player> Players(Player self, string sel) { if (sel == "@p" || sel == "@s") return new() { self }; if (sel == "@a") return _w.Players.ToList(); if (sel == "@r") return _w.Players.Count > 0 ? new() { _w.Players[_w.Rand.Next(_w.Players.Count)] } : new(); var pl = _w.Players.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Name.Equals(sel, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)); return pl != null ? new() { pl } : new(); } private bool Time(Player p, string[] a) { if (a.Length < 2) throw new Exception("/time <set|add|query> <wartość>"); string sub = a[1].ToLowerInvariant(); if (sub == "query") { p.SendMessage($"Czas dnia: {_w.DayTime % 24000}, dzień {_w.DayTime / 24000}"); return true; } if (a.Length < 3) throw new Exception("/time set <wartość>"); long v = a[2].ToLowerInvariant() switch { "day" or "dzien" or "dzień" => 1000, "night" or "noc" => 13000, "noon" or "poludnie" or "południe" => 6000, "midnight" or "polnoc" or "północ" => 18000, "sunrise" => 23000, "sunset" => 12000, _ => long.Parse(a[2], Inv) }; if (sub == "set") { _w.DayTime = (_w.DayTime / 24000) * 24000 + v; p.SendMessage("Ustawiono czas na " + v); } else if (sub == "add") { _w.DayTime += v; p.SendMessage("Dodano do czasu " + v); } else throw new Exception("/time <set|add|query>"); return true; } private bool GameMode(Player p, string[] a) { if (a.Length < 2) throw new Exception("/gamemode <tryb> [gracz]"); int gm = a[1].ToLowerInvariant() switch { "0" or "s" or "survival" or "przetrwanie" => 0, "1" or "c" or "creative" or "kreatywny" => 1, "2" or "a" or "adventure" => 0, "3" or "sp" or "spectator" or "obserwator" => 3, _ => throw new Exception("Nieznany tryb gry: " + a[1]) }; var t

nodes.name: GameMode
nodes.signature: private bool GameMode(Player p, string[] a)
nodes.body_text: private bool GameMode(Player p, string[] a) { if (a.Length < 2) throw new Exception("/gamemode <tryb> [gracz]"); int gm = a[1].ToLowerInvariant() switch { "0" or "s" or "survival" or "przetrwanie" => 0, "1" or "c" or "creative" or "kreatywny" => 1, "2" or "a" or "adventure" => 0, "3" or "sp" or "spectator" or "obserwator" => 3, _ => throw new Exception("Nieznany tryb gry: " + a[1]) }; var targets = a.Length > 2 ? Players(p, a[2]) : new() { p }; foreach (var t in targets) { t.SetGameMode(gm); t.NetGameModeHook?.Invoke(); string name = gm switch { 0 => "Przetrwanie", 1 => "Kreatywny", _ => "Obserwator" }; t.SendMessage("Twój tryb gry został zmieniony na: " + name); } return true; }

nodes.name: Coord
nodes.signature: private static double Coord(string s, double cur)
nodes.body_text: private static double Coord(string s, double cur) { if (s.StartsWith("~")) return cur + (s.Length > 1 ? double.Parse(s[1..], Inv) : 0); double v = double.Parse(s, Inv); return v; }

nodes.name: Tp
nodes.signature: private bool Tp(Player p, string[] a)
nodes.body_text: private bool Tp(Player p, string[] a) { var target = p; int i = 1; if (a.Length == 2 || a.Length == 5) { var t = Players(p, a[1]); if (t.Count == 0) throw new Exception("Nie znaleziono gracza " + a[1]); if (a.Length == 2) { p.SetPositionAndPrev(t[0].X, t[0].Y, t[0].Z); p.NetTeleportHook?.Invoke(); p.SendMessage("Przeteleportowano do " + t[0].Name); return true; } target = t[0]; i = 2; } if (a.Length - i < 3) throw new Exception("/tp [gracz] <x> <y> <z>"); double x = Coord(a[i], target.X), y = Coord(a[i + 1], target.Y), z = Coord(a[i + 2], target.Z); if (!a[i].StartsWith("~") && !a[i].Contains('.')) x += 0.5; if (!a[i + 2].StartsWith("~") && !a[i + 2].Contains('.')) z += 0.5; target.SetPositionAndPrev(x, y, z); target.MotionX = target.MotionY = target.MotionZ = 0; target.FallDistance = 0; target.NetTeleportHook?.Invoke(); p.SendMessage($"Przeteleportowano {target.Name} na {x:F1}, {y:F1}, {z:F1}"); return true; }

nodes.name: Give
nodes.signature: private bool Give(Player p, string[] a)
nodes.body_text: private bool Give(Player p, string[] a) { if (a.Length < 3) throw new Exception("/give <gracz> <przedmiot> [ilość] [meta]"); var targets = Players(p, a[1]); if (targets.Count == 0) throw new Exception("Nie znaleziono gracza " + a[1]); var it = Item.Get(a[2]) ?? throw new Exception("Nieznany przedmiot: " + a[2]); int count = a.Length > 3 ? int.Parse(a[3], Inv) : 1; int meta = a.Length > 4 ? int.Parse(a[4], Inv) : 0; count = Math.Clamp(count, 1, 64 * 36); foreach (var t in targets) { int left = count; while (left > 0) { int n = Math.Min(left, it.MaxStack); var s = new ItemStack(it.Id, n, meta); if (!t.Inventory.Add(s)) _w.DropItem(t.X, t.Y + 0.5, t.Z, s, false); left -= n; } t.Inventory.Dirty = true; p.SendMessage($"Dano {count} x [{it.DisplayName(meta)}] graczowi {t.Name}"); } return true; }

nodes.name: Kill
nodes.signature: private bool Kill(Player p, string[] a)
nodes.body_text: private bool Kill(Player p, string[] a) { if (a.Length > 1 && a[1] == "@e") { int n = 0; foreach (var e in _w.Entities.ToList()) if (e is not Player) { e.Kill(); n++; } p.SendMessage($"Zabito {n} encji"); return true; } var targets = a.Length > 1 ? Players(p, a[1]) : new() { p }; foreach (var t in targets) { t.Health = 0; t.OnDeath(new DamageSource("kill") { BypassArmor = true }); } return true; }

nodes.name: Summon
nodes.signature: private bool Summon(Player p, string[] a)
nodes.body_text: private bool Summon(Player p, string[] a) { if (a.Length < 2) throw new Exception("/summon <mob> [x y z]"); string key = a[1].ToLowerInvariant().Replace("minecraft:", ""); double x = p.X, y = p.Y, z = p.Z; if (a.Length >= 5) { x = Coord(a[2], p.X); y = Coord(a[3], p.Y); z = Coord(a[4], p.Z); } Entity e = MobSpawner.Create(key, _w); if (e == null && (key == "tnt" || key == "primedtnt")) e = new TntEntity(_w, x, y, z, 80); if (e == null) throw new Exception("Nieznana encja: " + a[1]); e.SetPositionAndPrev(x, y, z); _w.SpawnEntity(e); p.SendMessage("Przywołano: " + (e is LivingEntity le ? le.DisplayName : key)); return true; }

nodes.name: ParseBlock
nodes.signature: private static (byte id, int meta) ParseBlock(string s, string metaStr)
nodes.body_text: private static (byte id, int meta) ParseBlock(string s, string metaStr) { var it = Item.Get(s); if (it == null || !it.IsBlock) throw new Exception("Nieznany blok: " + s); return ((byte)it.BlockId, metaStr != null ? int.Parse(metaStr, Inv) : 0); }

nodes.name: SetBlock
nodes.signature: private bool SetBlock(Player p, string[] a)
nodes.body_text: private bool SetBlock(Player p, string[] a) { if (a.Length < 5) throw new Exception("/setblock <x> <y> <z> <blok> [meta]"); int x = MathUtil.FloorToInt(Coord(a[1], p.X)), y = MathUtil.FloorToInt(Coord(a[2], p.Y)), z = MathUtil.FloorToInt(Coord(a[3], p.Z)); var (id, meta) = a[4] == "air" ? ((byte)0, 0) : ParseBlock(a[4], a.Length > 5 ? a[5] : null); _w.SetBlock(x, y, z, id, meta); p.SendMessage("Postawiono blok."); return true; }

nodes.name: Fill
nodes.signature: private bool Fill(Player p, string[] a)
nodes.body_text: private bool Fill(Player p, string[] a) { if (a.Length < 8) throw new Exception("/fill <x1> <y1> <z1> <x2> <y2> <z2> <blok> [meta]"); int x1 = MathUtil.FloorToInt(Coord(a[1], p.X)), y1 = MathUtil.FloorToInt(Coord(a[2], p.Y)), z1 = MathUtil.FloorToInt(Coord(a[3], p.Z)); int x2 = MathUtil.FloorToInt(Coord(a[4], p.X)), y2 = MathUtil.FloorToInt(Coord(a[5], p.Y)), z2 = MathUtil.FloorToInt(Coord(a[6], p.Z)); var (id, meta) = a[7] == "air" ? ((byte)0, 0) : ParseBlock(a[7], a.Length > 8 ? a[8] : null); long vol = (long)(Math.Abs(x2 - x1) + 1) * (Math.Abs(y2 - y1) + 1) * (Math.Abs(z2 - z1) + 1); if (vol > 32768) throw new Exception($"Za duży obszar ({vol} > 32768)"); int n = 0; for (int x = Math.Min(x1, x2); x <= Math.Max(x1, x2); x++) for (int y = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(y1, y2)); y <= Math.Min(Chunk.Height - 1, Math.Max(y1, y2)); y++) for (int z = Math.Min(z1, z2); z <= Math.Max(z1, z2); z++) if (_w.SetBlock(x, y, z, id, meta)) n++; p.SendMessage($"Wypełniono {n} bloków"); return true; }

nodes.name: DifficultyCmd
nodes.signature: private bool DifficultyCmd(Player p, string[] a)
nodes.body_text: private bool DifficultyCmd(Player p, string[] a) { if (a.Length < 2) { p.SendMessage("Poziom trudności: " + _w.Difficulty); return true; } _w.Difficulty = a[1].ToLowerInvariant() switch { "0" or "peaceful" or "p" or "pokojowy" => Difficulty.Peaceful, "1" or "easy" or "e" or "latwy" or "łatwy" => Difficulty.Easy, "2" or "normal" or "n" or "normalny" => Difficulty.Normal, "3" or "hard" or "h" or "trudny" => Difficulty.Hard, _ => throw new Exception("Nieznany poziom: " + a[1]) }; p.SendMessage("Ustawiono poziom trudności na " + _w.Difficulty); return true; }

nodes.name: GameRule
nodes.signature: private bool GameRule(Player p, string[] a)
nodes.body_text: private bool GameRule(Player p, string[] a) { if (a.Length < 2) { p.SendMessage("Reguły: " + string.Join(", ", GameRules.Names)); return true; } if (a.Length < 3) { var r = _w.Rules; bool? v = a[1].ToLowerInvariant() switch { "dodaylightcycle" => r.DoDaylightCycle, "keepinventory" => r.KeepInventory, "domobspawning" => r.DoMobSpawning, "mobgriefing" => r.MobGriefing, "naturalregeneration" => r.NaturalRegeneration, _ => null }; p.SendMessage(v == null ? "Nieznana reguła" : $"{a[1]} = {v.Value.ToString().ToLowerInvariant()}"); return true; } if (!_w.Rules.Set(a[1], a[2], out var err)) throw new Exception(err); p.SendMessage($"Reguła {a[1]} zmieniona na {a[2]}"); return true; }

nodes.name: Clear
nodes.signature: private bool Clear(Player p, string[] a)
nodes.body_text: private bool Clear(Player p, string[] a) { var targets = a.Length > 1 ? Players(p, a[1]) : new() { p }; int? id = a.Length > 2 ? Item.Get(a[2])?.Id : null; foreach (var t in targets) { int n = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) { var s = t.Inventory.Get(i); if (s != null && (id == null || s.Id == id)) { n += s.Count; t.Inventory.Set(i, null); } } p.SendMessage($"Wyczyszczono ekwipunek gracza {t.Name}, usunięto {n} przedmiotów"); } return true; }

nodes.name: SpawnPoint
nodes.signature: private bool SpawnPoint(Player p, string[] a)
nodes.body_text: private bool SpawnPoint(Player p, string[] a) { var t = a.Length > 1 ? Players(p, a[1]).FirstOrDefault() ?? p : p; int x = MathUtil.FloorToInt(t.X), y = MathUtil.FloorToInt(t.Y), z = MathUtil.FloorToInt(t.Z); if (a.Length >= 5) { x = MathUtil.FloorToInt(Coord(a[2], t.X)); y = MathUtil.FloorToInt(Coord(a[3], t.Y)); z = MathUtil.FloorToInt(Coord(a[4], t.Z)); } t.SpawnX = x; t.SpawnY = y; t.SpawnZ = z; t.HasSpawn = true; p.SendMessage($"Ustawiono punkt odrodzenia gracza {t.Name} na {x}, {y}, {z}"); return true; }

nodes.name: Xp
nodes.signature: private bool Xp(Player p, string[] a)
nodes.body_text: private bool Xp(Player p, string[] a) { if (a.Length < 2) throw new Exception("/xp <ilość>[L] [gracz]"); var t = a.Length > 2 ? Players(p, a[2]).FirstOrDefault() ?? p : p; string v = a[1]; if (v.EndsWith("L", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { int lv = int.Parse(v[..^1], Inv); t.XpLevel = Math.Max(0, t.XpLevel + lv); if (t.XpLevel == 0) t.XpProgress = 0; p.SendMessage($"Dano {lv} poziomów graczowi {t.Name}"); } else { int n = int.Parse(v, Inv); t.AddXp(n); p.SendMessage($"Dano {n} doświadczenia graczowi {t.Name}"); } return true; }

nodes.name: Complete
nodes.signature: public static List<string> Complete(string text, World.World w)
nodes.body_text: public static List<string> Complete(string text, World.World w) { var res = new List<string>(); if (!text.StartsWith("/")) return res; var parts = text[1..].Split(' '); if (parts.Length == 1) { foreach (var n in Names) if (n.StartsWith(parts[0], StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) res.Add("/" + n); return res; } string cmd = parts[0].ToLowerInvariant(); string last = parts[^1].ToLowerInvariant(); IEnumerable<string> opts = cmd switch { "time" when parts.Length == 2 => new[] { "set", "add", "query" }, "time" when parts.Length == 3 => new[] { "day", "night", "noon", "midnight" }, "gamemode" when parts.Length == 2 => new[] { "survival", "creative", "spectator" }, "difficulty" when parts.Length == 2 => new[] { "peaceful", "easy", "normal", "hard" }, "summon" when parts.Length == 2 => MobSpawner.MobKeys, "give" when parts.Length == 2 => new[] { "@p", "@a" }.Concat(w.Players.Select(x => x.Name)), "give" when parts.Length == 3 => Item.All.Select(i => i.Key), "setblock" when parts.Length == 5 => Item.All.Where(i => i.IsBlock).Select(i => i.Key), "fill" when parts.Length == 8 => Item.All.Where(i => i.IsBlock).Select(i => i.Key), "gamerule" when parts.Length == 2 => GameRules.Names, "gamerule" when parts.Length == 3 => new[] { "true", "false" }, "kill" when parts.Length == 2 => new[] { "@e", "@a", "@p" }, "tp" when parts.Length == 2 => w.Players.Select(x => x.Name), _ => Array.Empty<string>() }; string prefix = string.Join(' ', parts.Take(parts.Length - 1)) + " "; foreach (var o in opts) if (o.StartsWith(last, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) res.Add("/" + prefix + o); return res; }

nodes.body_text: public sealed class PerlinNoise { private readonly int[] _p = new int[512]; private readonly double _ox, _oy, _oz; public PerlinNoise(Rng r) { _ox = r.NextDouble() * 256; _oy = r.NextDouble() * 256; _oz = r.NextDouble() * 256; for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) _p[i] = i; for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) { int j = r.Next(256 - i) + i; (_p[i], _p[j]) = (_p[j], _p[i]); _p[i + 256] = _p[i]; } } [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)] private static double Fade(double t) => t * t * t * (t * (t * 6 - 15) + 10); [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)] private static double Grad(int h, double x, double y, double z) { h &= 15; double u = h < 8 ? x : y, v = h < 4 ? y : (h == 12 || h == 14 ? x : z); return ((h & 1) == 0 ? u : -u) + ((h & 2) == 0 ? v : -v); } public double Noise(double x, double y, double z) { x += _ox; y += _oy; z += _oz; int X = MathUtil.FloorToInt(x), Y = MathUtil.FloorToInt(y), Z = MathUtil.FloorToInt(z); x -= X; y -= Y; z -= Z; X &= 255; Y &= 255; Z &= 255; double u = Fade(x), v = Fade(y), w = Fade(z); int[] p = _p; int A = p[X] + Y, AA = p[A] + Z, AB = p[A + 1] + Z, B = p[X + 1] + Y, BA = p[B] + Z, BB = p[B + 1] + Z; return Lerp(w, Lerp(v, Lerp(u, Grad(p[AA], x, y, z), Grad(p[BA], x - 1, y, z)), Lerp(u, Grad(p[AB], x, y - 1, z), Grad(p[BB], x - 1, y - 1, z))), Lerp(v, Lerp(u, Grad(p[AA + 1], x, y, z - 1), Grad(p[BA + 1], x - 1, y, z - 1)), Lerp(u, Grad(p[AB + 1], x, y - 1, z - 1), Grad(p[BB + 1], x - 1, y - 1, z - 1)))); } public double Noise(double x, double z) => Noise(x, 0.0, z); [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)] private static double Lerp(double t, double a, double b) => a + t * (b - a); }

nodes.body_text: public struct AABB { public double MinX, MinY, MinZ, MaxX, MaxY, MaxZ; public AABB(double x0, double y0, double z0, double x1, double y1, double z1) { MinX = x0; MinY = y0; MinZ = z0; MaxX = x1; MaxY = y1; MaxZ = z1; } public AABB Offset(double x, double y, double z) => new(MinX + x, MinY + y, MinZ + z, MaxX + x, MaxY + y, MaxZ + z); public AABB Expand(double x, double y, double z) { var b = this; if (x < 0) b.MinX += x; else b.MaxX += x; if (y < 0) b.MinY += y; else b.MaxY += y; if (z < 0) b.MinZ += z; else b.MaxZ += z; return b; } public AABB Grow(double d) => new(MinX - d, MinY - d, MinZ - d, MaxX + d, MaxY + d, MaxZ + d); public AABB Grow(double x, double y, double z) => new(MinX - x, MinY - y, MinZ - z, MaxX + x, MaxY + y, MaxZ + z); public bool Intersects(in AABB o) => o.MaxX > MinX && o.MinX < MaxX && o.MaxY > MinY && o.MinY < MaxY && o.MaxZ > MinZ && o.MinZ < MaxZ; public bool Contains(double x, double y, double z) => x >= MinX && x < MaxX && y >= MinY && y < MaxY && z >= MinZ && z < MaxZ; public double CenterX => (MinX + MaxX) * 0.5; public double CenterY => (MinY + MaxY) * 0.5; public double CenterZ => (MinZ + MaxZ) * 0.5; public double ClipX(in AABB o, double dx) { if (o.MaxY > MinY && o.MinY < MaxY && o.MaxZ > MinZ && o.MinZ < MaxZ) { if (dx > 0 && o.MaxX <= MinX) { double d = MinX - o.MaxX; if (d < dx) dx = d; } else if (dx < 0 && o.MinX >= MaxX) { double d = MaxX - o.MinX; if (d > dx) dx = d; } } return dx; } public double ClipY(in AABB o, double dy) { if (o.MaxX > MinX && o.MinX < MaxX && o.MaxZ > MinZ && o.MinZ < MaxZ) { if (dy > 0 && o.MaxY <= MinY) { double d = MinY - o.MaxY; if (d < dy) dy = d; } else if (dy < 0 && o.MinY >= MaxY) { double d = MaxY - o.MinY; if (d > dy) dy = d; } } return dy; } public double ClipZ(in AABB o, double dz) { if (o.MaxX > MinX && o.MinX < MaxX && o.MaxY > MinY && o.MinY < MaxY) { if (dz > 0 && o.MaxZ <= MinZ) { double d = MinZ - o.MaxZ; if (d < dz) dz = d; } else if (dz < 0 && o.MinZ >= MaxZ) { double d = MaxZ - o.MinZ; if (d > dz) dz = d; } } return dz; } /// <summary>Przecięcie promienia z boxem; zwraca t i ścianę (0..5) lub false.</summary> public bool RayIntersect(double ox, double oy, double oz, double dx, double dy, double dz, out double tHit, out int face) { double tmin = double.NegativeInfinity, tmax = double.PositiveInfinity; face = -1; tHit = 0; int fmin = -1; if (!Slab(ox, dx, MinX, MaxX, ref tmin, ref tmax, ref fmin, 4, 5)) return false; if (!Slab(oy, dy, MinY, MaxY, ref tmin, ref tmax, ref fmin, 0, 1)) return false; if (!Slab(oz, dz, MinZ, MaxZ, ref tmin, ref tmax, ref fmin, 2, 3)) return false; if (tmax < 0 || tmin > tmax) return false; tHit = tmin < 0 ? 0 : tmin; face = fmin; return true; } // face ids: 0=down(-Y),1=up(+Y),2=north(-Z),3=south(+Z),4=west(-X),5=east(+X) private static bool Slab(double o, double d, double mn, double mx, ref double tmin, ref double tmax, ref int fmin, int negFace, int posFace) { if (Math.Abs(d) < 1e-12) return o >= mn && o <= mx; double t1 = (mn - o) / d, t2 = (mx - o) / d; int f1 = negFace; if (t1 > t2) { (t1, t2) = (t2, t1); f1 = posFace; } if (t1 > tmin) { tmin = t1; fmin = f1; } if (t2 < tmax) tmax = t2; return tmin <= tmax; } }

nodes.body_text: public bool RayIntersect(double ox, double oy, double oz, double dx, double dy, double dz, out double tHit, out int face) { double tmin = double.NegativeInfinity, tmax = double.PositiveInfinity; face = -1; tHit = 0; int fmin = -1; if (!Slab(ox, dx, MinX, MaxX, ref tmin, ref tmax, ref fmin, 4, 5)) return false; if (!Slab(oy, dy, MinY, MaxY, ref tmin, ref tmax, ref fmin, 0, 1)) return false; if (!Slab(oz, dz, MinZ, MaxZ, ref tmin, ref tmax, ref fmin, 2, 3)) return false; if (tmax < 0 || tmin > tmax) return false; tHit = tmin < 0 ? 0 : tmin; face = fmin; return true; }

nodes.signature: private static bool Slab(double o, double d, double mn, double mx, ref double tmin, ref double tmax, ref int fmin, int negFace, int posFace)
nodes.body_text: private static bool Slab(double o, double d, double mn, double mx, ref double tmin, ref double tmax, ref int fmin, int negFace, int posFace) { if (Math.Abs(d) < 1e-12) return o >= mn && o <= mx; double t1 = (mn - o) / d, t2 = (mx - o) / d; int f1 = negFace; if (t1 > t2) { (t1, t2) = (t2, t1); f1 = posFace; } if (t1 > tmin) { tmin = t1; fmin = f1; } if (t2 < tmax) tmax = t2; return tmin <= tmax; }

nodes.body_text: public sealed class ArrowEntity : Entity { public Entity Shooter; public bool InGround; public int InGroundTicks; public int Shake; public double Damage = 2.0; public bool Critical, PickupAllowed = true; private int _gx, _gy, _gz; private byte _gid; public ArrowEntity(World.World w) : base(w) { Width = 0.5f; Height = 0.5f; StepHeight = 0; } public ArrowEntity(World.World w, LivingEntity shooter, float velocity) : this(w) { Shooter = shooter; SetPositionAndPrev(shooter.X, shooter.Y + shooter.EyeHeight - 0.1, shooter.Z); Yaw = shooter.Yaw; Pitch = shooter.Pitch; float yr = Yaw * MathUtil.Deg2Rad, pr = Pitch * MathUtil.Deg2Rad; X -= MathF.Cos(yr) * 0.16f; Z -= MathF.Sin(yr) * 0.16f; Y -= 0.1; double mx = -MathF.Sin(yr) * MathF.Cos(pr), my = -MathF.Sin(pr), mz = MathF.Cos(yr) * MathF.Cos(pr); Shoot(mx, my, mz, velocity, 1f); PrevX = X; PrevY = Y; PrevZ = Z; } public void Shoot(double x, double y, double z, float velocity, float inaccuracy) { double len = Math.Sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z); x /= len; y /= len; z /= len; x += World.Rand.NextGaussian() * 0.0075 * inaccuracy; y += World.Rand.NextGaussian() * 0.0075 * inaccuracy; z += World.Rand.NextGaussian() * 0.0075 * inaccuracy; MotionX = x * velocity; MotionY = y * velocity; MotionZ = z * velocity; double h = Math.Sqrt(x * x + z * z); Yaw = PrevYaw = (float)(Math.Atan2(x, z) * MathUtil.Rad2Deg); Pitch = PrevPitch = (float)(Math.Atan2(y, h) * MathUtil.Rad2Deg); } public override string TypeKey => "arrow"; public override bool Persistent => InGround; public override void Tick() { Age++; if (IsRemoteControlled) { NetInterpolate(); return; } if (Shake > 0) Shake--; if (InGround) { if (World.GetBlock(_gx, _gy, _gz) != _gid) { InGround = false; MotionX *= World.Rand.NextFloat() * 0.2f; MotionY *= World.Rand.NextFloat() * 0.2f; MotionZ *= World.Rand.NextFloat() * 0.2f; InGroundTicks = 0; } else { if (++InGroundTicks >= 1200) Kill(); return; } } // promień double len = Math.Sqrt(MotionX * MotionX + MotionY * MotionY + MotionZ * MotionZ); var hit = len > 0 ? World.RayCast(X, Y, Z, MotionX / len, MotionY / len, MotionZ / len, len) : default; double ex = X + MotionX, ey = Y + MotionY, ez = Z + MotionZ; double maxT = hit.Hit ? hit.Distance : len; // encje Entity target = null; double bestT = maxT; if (len > 0) foreach (var e in World.GetEntitiesInBox(BoundingBox.Expand(MotionX, MotionY, MotionZ).Grow(1), this)) { if (!e.CanBeAttacked || (e == Shooter && Age < 5)) continue; var bb = e.BoundingBox.Grow(0.3); if (bb.RayIntersect(X, Y, Z, MotionX / len, MotionY / len, MotionZ / len, out double t, out _) && t <= bestT) { bestT = t; target = e; } } if (target != null && !World.IsRemote) { float speed = (float)len; int dmg = (int)Math.Ceiling(speed * Damage); if (Critical) dmg += World.Rand.Next(dmg / 2 + 2); if (target is LivingEntity le && le.Attack(DamageSource.Arrow(this, Shooter ?? this), dmg)) { double h = Math.Sqrt(MotionX * MotionX + MotionZ * MotionZ); if (h > 0) { le.MotionX += MotionX * 0.6 / h * 0.6; le.MotionY += 0.1; le.MotionZ += MotionZ * 0.6 / h * 0.6; } World.PlaySound("arrow_hit", X, Y, Z, 1f, 1.2f / (World.Rand.NextFloat() * 0.2f + 0.9f)); Kill(); } else { MotionX *= -0.1; MotionY *= -0.1; MotionZ *= -0.1; Yaw += 180; PrevYaw += 180; } return; } if (hit.Hit) { _gx = hit.X; _gy = hit.Y; _gz = hit.Z; _gid = World.GetBlock(hit.X, hit.Y, hit.Z); X = hit.HitX - MotionX / len * 0.05; Y = hit.HitY - MotionY / len * 0.05; Z = hit.HitZ - MotionZ / len * 0.05; InGround = true; Shake = 7; Critical = false; World.PlaySound("arrow_hit", X, Y, Z, 1f, 1.2f / (World.Rand.NextFloat() * 0.2f + 0.9f)); nodes.body_text: public static class Explosion { public static void Explode(World.World w, Entity source, double x, double y, double z, float power, bool breakBlocks) { w.PlaySound("explode", x, y, z, 4f, (1f + (w.Rand.NextFloat() - w.Rand.NextFloat()) * 0.2f) * 0.7f); w.SpawnParticles(power >= 2 ? ParticleKind.Explosion : ParticleKind.LargeSmoke, x, y, z, 1, (int)(power * 10)); var affected = new HashSet<(int, int, int)>(); if (breakBlocks && w.Rules.MobGriefing || breakBlocks && source is TntEntity) { for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) for (int j = 0; j < 16; j++) for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) { if (i != 0 && i != 15 && j != 0 && j != 15 && k != 0 && k != 15) continue; double dx = i / 15.0 * 2 - 1, dy = j / 15.0 * 2 - 1, dz = k / 15.0 * 2 - 1; double len = Math.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz); dx /= len; dy /= len; dz /= len; float f = power * (0.7f + w.Rand.NextFloat() * 0.6f); double px = x, py = y, pz = z; for (; f > 0; f -= 0.225f) { int bx = MathUtil.FloorToInt(px), by = MathUtil.FloorToInt(py), bz = MathUtil.FloorToInt(pz); int id = w.GetBlock(bx, by, bz); if (id != 0) { var b = Block.ById[id]; float res = b.IsLiquid ? 100 : b.BlastResistance; f -= (res + 0.3f) * 0.3f; } if (f > 0 && by >= 0 && by < Chunk.Height) affected.Add((bx, by, bz)); px += dx * 0.3; py += dy * 0.3; pz += dz * 0.3; } } } // encje float r2 = power * 2f; var box = new AABB(x - r2 - 1, y - r2 - 1, z - r2 - 1, x + r2 + 1, y + r2 + 1, z + r2 + 1); foreach (var e in w.GetEntitiesInBox(box)) { double dist = Math.Sqrt(e.DistanceSq(x, y, z)) / r2; if (dist > 1) continue; double ex = e.X - x, ey = e.Y + e.EyeHeight - y, ez = e.Z - z; double d = Math.Sqrt(ex * ex + ey * ey + ez * ez); if (d == 0) continue; ex /= d; ey /= d; ez /= d; double exposure = Exposure(w, x, y, z, e.BoundingBox); double impact = (1 - dist) * exposure; float dmg = (float)((impact * impact + impact) / 2 * 8 * r2 + 1); if (e is LivingEntity le) le.Attack(DamageSource.Explosion(source is TntEntity t ? (t.Igniter ?? source) : source), dmg); else if (e is ItemEntity || e is XpOrbEntity) { e.Kill(); continue; } e.MotionX += ex * impact; e.MotionY += ey * impact; e.MotionZ += ez * impact; } // niszczenie bloków var drops = new List<ItemStack>(); foreach (var (bx, by, bz) in affected) { int id = w.GetBlock(bx, by, bz); if (id == 0) continue; var b = Block.ById[id]; if (id == B.Tnt) { w.SetBlock(bx, by, bz, B.Air); var t = new TntEntity(w, bx + 0.5, by, bz + 0.5, w.Rand.Next(20) + 10); w.SpawnEntity(t); continue; } if (b.IsLiquid) continue; int meta = w.GetMeta(bx, by, bz); if (w.Rand.NextFloat() < 1f / power) { drops.Clear(); b.GetDrops(w, bx, by, bz, meta, w.Rand, null, drops); foreach (var s in drops) w.DropItem(bx + 0.5, by + 0.5, bz + 0.5, s); } w.SetBlock(bx, by, bz, B.Air); } } private static double Exposure(World.World w, double x, double y, double z, AABB bb) { int hit = 0, total = 0; for (double fx = 0; fx <= 1; fx += 0.5) for (double fy = 0; fy <= 1; fy += 0.5) for (double fz = 0; fz <= 1; fz += 0.5) { double tx = bb.MinX + (bb.MaxX - bb.MinX) * fx, ty = bb.MinY + (bb.MaxY - bb.MinY) * fy, tz = bb.MinZ + (bb.MaxZ - bb.MinZ) * fz; double dx = tx - x, dy = ty - y, dz = tz - z; double len = Math.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz); total++; if (len < 0.01) { hit++; continue; } var r = w.RayCast(x, y, z, dx / len, dy / len, dz / len, len); if (!r.Hit || !Block.Get(w.GetBlock(r.X, r.Y, r.Z)).Opaque) hit++; } return (double)hit / total; } }

private static readonly (Func<World.World, Mob> f, int weight)[] Animals = { (w => new Sheep(w), 12), (w => new Pig(w), 10), (w => new Chicken(w), 10), (w => new Cow(w), 8) }; public static Mob Create(string key, World.World w) => key.ToLowerInvariant() switch { "zombie" => new Zombie(w), "skeleton" => new Skeleton(w), "creeper" => new Creeper(w), "spider" => new Spider(w), "enderman" => new Enderman(w), "cow" => new Cow(w), "pig" => new Pig(w), "sheep" => new Sheep(w), "chicken" => new Chicken(w), _ => null }; } return; } } // podążanie za graczem z jedzeniem foreach (var p in World.Players) { if (p.Dead || p.Spectator) continue; if (p.DistanceSq(this) < 100 && IsBreedingItem(p.Inventory.Selected)) { LookTarget = p; nodes.body_text: public override void Tick() { base.Tick(); if (IsRemoteControlled || World.IsRemote) return; if (World.Difficulty == Difficulty.Peaceful) { Removed = true; return; } // despawn Player near = null; double nd = double.MaxValue; foreach (var p in World.Players) { double d = p.DistanceSq(this); if (d < nd) { nd = d; near = p; } } if (near == null || nd > 128 * 128) { Removed = true; return; } if (nd > 32 * 32 && IdleTime > 600 && World.Rand.Next(800) == 0) { Removed = true; return; } if (nd < 32 * 32) IdleTime = 0; }

nodes.name: BurnsInDaylight
nodes.signature: protected bool BurnsInDaylight()
nodes.body_text: protected bool BurnsInDaylight() { if (!World.IsDaytime() || World.IsRemote) return false; float br = World.GetRawLight(MathUtil.FloorToInt(X), MathUtil.FloorToInt(Y + EyeHeight), MathUtil.FloorToInt(Z)) / 15f; if (br > 0.5f && World.Rand.NextFloat() * 30f < (br - 0.4f) * 2f && World.CanSeeSky(MathUtil.FloorToInt(X), MathUtil.FloorToInt(Y + EyeHeight), MathUtil.FloorToInt(Z)) && !InWater) { FireTicks = Math.Max(FireTicks, 160); return true; } return false; }

nodes.name: AcquireTarget
nodes.signature: protected void AcquireTarget()
nodes.body_text: protected void AcquireTarget() { if (Target != null && (Target.Dead || Target is Player p && (p.Creative || p.Spectator) || Target.DistanceSq(this) > FollowRange * FollowRange)) Target = null; if (Target == null && World.Rand.Next(10) == 0) Target = NearestPlayer(16, true); if (LastAttacker is Player lp && !lp.Creative && !lp.Spectator && !lp.Dead) Target = lp; }

nodes.name: MeleeChase
nodes.signature: protected void MeleeChase(double speed)
nodes.body_text: protected void MeleeChase(double speed) { if (Target == null) return; LookTarget = Target; LookTime = 10; double d2 = DistanceSq(Target); if (!Nav.HasPath || World.Rand.Next(10) == 0 || Nav.Target.Item1 != MathUtil.FloorToInt(Target.X) && World.Rand.Next(4) == 0) { if (!Nav.MoveTo(Target.X, Target.Y, Target.Z, speed) && d2 < 16) { FaceTowards(Target.X, Target.Z); SetMoveSpeed((float)speed); if (CollidedH) IsJumping = true; } } if (AttackCooldown > 0) AttackCooldown--; double reach = Width * 2 * Width * 2 + Target.Width; if (d2 <= reach + 0.5 && Math.Abs(Target.Y - Y) < 2 && AttackCooldown <= 0) { AttackCooldown = 20; SwingArm(); if (Target.Attack(DamageSource.Mob(this), ScaledDamage)) { if (FireTicks > 0 && World.Rand.NextFloat() < 0.3f * (int)World.Difficulty) Target.FireTicks = 60; } } }

nodes.name: Enderman
nodes.signature: public sealed class Enderman : Monster
nodes.body_text: public sealed class Enderman : Monster { public bool Angry; private int _stareTicks; private int _teleportDelay; public Enderman(World.World w) : base(w) { Width = 0.6f; Height = 2.9f; MaxHealth = 40; Health = 40; MoveSpeed = 0.3; AttackDamage = 7; FollowRange = 64; StepHeight = 1f; } public override string TypeKey => "enderman"; public override string DisplayName => "Enderman"; public override string LivingSound => Angry ? "endermen_scream" : "endermen_idle"; public override string HurtSound => "endermen_hit"; public override string DeathSound => "endermen_death"; public override float EyeHeight => 2.55f; public override bool IsInvulnerableTo(DamageSource s) => s.Type == "arrow" && TeleportRandomly(); public override void Tick() { base.Tick(); if (IsRemoteControlled || Dead) return; if (World.Rand.Next(4) == 0) World.SpawnParticles(ParticleKind.Portal, X, Y + World.Rand.NextDouble() * Height, Z, 1); if (World.IsRemote) return; if (InWater) { Attack(DamageSource.Drown, 1f); TeleportRandomly(); } if (World.IsDaytime() && World.Rand.NextFloat() * 30 < (World.GetRawLight(MathUtil.FloorToInt(X), MathUtil.FloorToInt(Y + EyeHeight), MathUtil.FloorToInt(Z)) / 15f - 0.4f) * 2f && World.CanSeeSky(MathUtil.FloorToInt(X), MathUtil.FloorToInt(Y + EyeHeight), MathUtil.FloorToInt(Z)) && !Angry) { if (World.Rand.Next(30) == 0) TeleportRandomly(); } } private bool IsLookedAtBy(Player p) { var (lx, ly, lz) = p.Look(); double dx = X - p.X, dy = Y + EyeHeight - (p.Y + p.EyeHeight), dz = Z - p.Z; double d = Math.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz); double dot = (lx * dx + ly * dy + lz * dz) / d; return dot > 1 - 0.025 / d && p.CanSee(this); } protected override void Think() { if (!Angry) { foreach (var p in World.Players) { if (p.Dead || p.Creative || p.Spectator || p.DistanceSq(this) > 64 * 64) continue; if (IsLookedAtBy(p)) { if (++_stareTicks > 5) { Angry = true; Target = p; World.PlaySound("endermen_stare", X, Y, Z, 1f, 1f); _teleportDelay = 0; } LookTarget = p; LookTime = 20; } } if (LastAttacker is Player lp && !lp.Creative) { Angry = true; Target = lp; } if (World.Rand.Next(400) == 0) TeleportRandomly(); LookAtPlayersRandomly(); Wander(MoveSpeed * 0.8); return; } if (Target == null || Target.Dead || Target is Player pl && (pl.Creative || pl.Spectator)) { Angry = false; Target = null; _stareTicks = 0; return; } if (DistanceSq(Target) > 16 * 16 && ++_teleportDelay > 30 && TeleportTowards(Target)) _teleportDelay = 0; MeleeChase(MoveSpeed * 1.2); } public bool TeleportRandomly() { double tx = X + (World.Rand.NextDouble() - 0.5) * 64, ty = Y + World.Rand.Next(64) - 32, tz = Z + (World.Rand.NextDouble() - 0.5) * 64; return TeleportTo(tx, ty, tz); } private bool TeleportTowards(Entity e) { double dx = X - e.X, dy = Y + Height / 2 - e.Y - e.EyeHeight, dz = Z - e.Z; double d = Math.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz); dx /= d; dy /= d; dz /= d; return TeleportTo(X + (World.Rand.NextDouble() - 0.5) * 8 - dx * 16, Y + World.Rand.Next(16) - 8 - dy * 16, Z + (World.Rand.NextDouble() - 0.5) * 8 - dz * 16); } private bool TeleportTo(double x, double y, double z) { int bx = MathUtil.FloorToInt(x), by = MathUtil.FloorToInt(y), bz = MathUtil.FloorToInt(z); if (!World.IsLoadedAt(bx, bz)) return false; while (by > 1 && !Block.Get(World.GetBlock(bx, by - 1, bz)).Solid) by--; if (by <= 1) return false; for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) if (Block.Get(World.GetBlock(bx, by + i, bz)).Solid || World.GetBlock(bx, by + i, bz) == B.Water) return false; World.SpawnParticles(ParticleKind.Portal, X, Y + 1, Z, 64); SetPositionAndPrev(bx + 0.5, by, bz + 0.5); Nav.Stop(); World.PlaySound("endermen_portal", X, Y, Z, 1f, 1f); World.SpawnParticles(ParticleKind.Portal, X, Y + 1, Z, 64); return true; } protected override void OnHurt(DamageSource src) { base.OnHurt(src); if (src.Attacker is Player p && !p.Creative) { Angry = true; Target = p; } if (World.Rand.Next(10) != 0) TeleportRandomly(); } protected override void DropLoot(bool byPlayer, bool burning) => Drop(I.EnderPearl, World.Rand.Next(2)); public override int NetData => Angry ? 1 : 0; public override void SetNetData(int d) => Angry = d != 0; public override int XpValue => 5; }

nodes.signature: public override void Tick()
nodes.body_text: public override void Tick() { base.Tick(); if (IsRemoteControlled || Dead) return; if (World.Rand.Next(4) == 0) World.SpawnParticles(ParticleKind.Portal, X, Y + World.Rand.NextDouble() * Height, Z, 1); if (World.IsRemote) return; if (InWater) { Attack(DamageSource.Drown, 1f); TeleportRandomly(); } if (World.IsDaytime() && World.Rand.NextFloat() * 30 < (World.GetRawLight(MathUtil.FloorToInt(X), MathUtil.FloorToInt(Y + EyeHeight), MathUtil.FloorToInt(Z)) / 15f - 0.4f) * 2f && World.CanSeeSky(MathUtil.FloorToInt(X), MathUtil.FloorToInt(Y + EyeHeight), MathUtil.FloorToInt(Z)) && !Angry) { if (World.Rand.Next(30) == 0) TeleportRandomly(); } }

nodes.name: IsLookedAtBy
nodes.signature: private bool IsLookedAtBy(Player p)
nodes.body_text: private bool IsLookedAtBy(Player p) { var (lx, ly, lz) = p.Look(); double dx = X - p.X, dy = Y + EyeHeight - (p.Y + p.EyeHeight), dz = Z - p.Z; double d = Math.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz); double dot = (lx * dx + ly * dy + lz * dz) / d; return dot > 1 - 0.025 / d && p.CanSee(this); }

nodes.name: Think
nodes.signature: protected override void Think()
nodes.body_text: protected override void Think() { if (!Angry) { foreach (var p in World.Players) { if (p.Dead || p.Creative || p.Spectator || p.DistanceSq(this) > 64 * 64) continue; if (IsLookedAtBy(p)) { if (++_stareTicks > 5) { Angry = true; Target = p; World.PlaySound("endermen_stare", X, Y, Z, 1f, 1f); _teleportDelay = 0; } LookTarget = p; LookTime = 20; } } if (LastAttacker is Player lp && !lp.Creative) { Angry = true; Target = lp; } if (World.Rand.Next(400) == 0) TeleportRandomly(); LookAtPlayersRandomly(); Wander(MoveSpeed * 0.8); return; } if (Target == null || Target.Dead || Target is Player pl && (pl.Creative || pl.Spectator)) { Angry = false; Target = null; _stareTicks = 0; return; } if (DistanceSq(Target) > 16 * 16 && ++_teleportDelay > 30 && TeleportTowards(Target)) _teleportDelay = 0; MeleeChase(MoveSpeed * 1.2); }

nodes.body_text: public bool TeleportRandomly() { double tx = X + (World.Rand.NextDouble() - 0.5) * 64, ty = Y + World.Rand.Next(64) - 32, tz = Z + (World.Rand.NextDouble() - 0.5) * 64; return TeleportTo(tx, ty, tz); }

nodes.name: TeleportTowards
nodes.signature: private bool TeleportTowards(Entity e)
nodes.body_text: private bool TeleportTowards(Entity e) { double dx = X - e.X, dy = Y + Height / 2 - e.Y - e.EyeHeight, dz = Z - e.Z; double d = Math.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz); dx /= d; dy /= d; dz /= d; return TeleportTo(X + (World.Rand.NextDouble() - 0.5) * 8 - dx * 16, Y + World.Rand.Next(16) - 8 - dy * 16, Z + (World.Rand.NextDouble() - 0.5) * 8 - dz * 16); }

nodes.name: TeleportTo
nodes.signature: private bool TeleportTo(double x, double y, double z)
nodes.body_text: private bool TeleportTo(double x, double y, double z) { int bx = MathUtil.FloorToInt(x), by = MathUtil.FloorToInt(y), bz = MathUtil.FloorToInt(z); if (!World.IsLoadedAt(bx, bz)) return false; while (by > 1 && !Block.Get(World.GetBlock(bx, by - 1, bz)).Solid) by--; if (by <= 1) return false; for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) if (Block.Get(World.GetBlock(bx, by + i, bz)).Solid || World.GetBlock(bx, by + i, bz) == B.Water) return false; World.SpawnParticles(ParticleKind.Portal, X, Y + 1, Z, 64); SetPositionAndPrev(bx + 0.5, by, bz + 0.5); Nav.Stop(); World.PlaySound("endermen_portal", X, Y, Z, 1f, 1f); World.SpawnParticles(ParticleKind.Portal, X, Y + 1, Z, 64); return true; }

nodes.name: PathFinder
nodes.signature: public static class PathFinder
nodes.body_text: public static class PathFinder { private sealed class Node { public int X, Y, Z; public float G, F; public Node Parent; } private static readonly List<AABB> Tmp = new(); public static bool IsPassable(World.World w, int x, int y, int z) { int id = w.GetBlock(x, y, z); if (id == 0) return true; var b = Block.ById[id]; if (id == B.OakDoor) return (w.GetMeta(x, y, z) & 4) != 0 || (w.GetMeta(x, y - 1, z) & 4) != 0; if (b.IsLiquid) return id == B.Water; if (id == B.Cactus || id == B.Fence || id == B.FenceGate) return false; return !b.Solid; } private static bool IsDanger(World.World w, int x, int y, int z) { int id = w.GetBlock(x, y, z); return id == B.Lava || id == B.Cactus; } /// <summary>Czy mob może stać w (x,y,z): miejsce wolne na height bloków i grunt pod spodem.</summary> private static bool CanStand(World.World w, int x, int y, int z, int h, bool allowWater) { for (int i = 0; i < h; i++) if (!IsPassable(w, x, y + i, z) || IsDanger(w, x, y + i, z)) return false; int below = w.GetBlock(x, y - 1, z); if (below == B.Water) return allowWater; var bb = Block.Get(below); if (below == B.Fence || below == B.Lava || below == B.Cactus) return false; if (w.GetBlock(x, y, z) == B.Water) return allowWater; return bb.Solid; } public static List<(int x, int y, int z)> Find(World.World w, Entity e, int tx, int ty, int tz, int maxNodes = 600, float maxDist = 32) { int sx = MathUtil.FloorToInt(e.X), sy = MathUtil.FloorToInt(e.Y + 0.01), sz = MathUtil.FloorToInt(e.Z); int h = (int)Math.Ceiling(e.Height); if (!w.IsLoadedAt(tx, tz)) return null; var open = new PriorityQueue<Node, float>(); var all = new Dictionary<long, Node>(); var start = new Node { X = sx, Y = sy, Z = sz, G = 0 }; start.F = H(sx, sy, sz, tx, ty, tz); open.Enqueue(start, start.F); all[Key(sx, sy, sz)] = start; Node best = start; float bestH = start.F; int processed = 0; var closed = new HashSet<long>(); while (open.Count > 0 && processed < maxNodes) { var n = open.Dequeue(); long nk = Key(n.X, n.Y, n.Z); if (!closed.Add(nk)) continue; processed++; float hh = H(n.X, n.Y, n.Z, tx, ty, tz); if (hh < bestH) { bestH = hh; best = n; } if (n.X == tx && n.Z == tz && Math.Abs(n.Y - ty) <= 1) { best = n; break; } for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) { int nx = n.X + Dir.HorizX[d], nz = n.Z + Dir.HorizZ[d]; int ny = -999; if (CanStand(w, nx, n.Y, nz, h, true)) ny = n.Y; else if (CanStand(w, nx, n.Y + 1, nz, h, true) && IsPassable(w, n.X, n.Y + h, n.Z)) ny = n.Y + 1; else { for (int dy = 1; dy <= 3; dy++) { bool free = true; for (int i = 0; i < h; i++) if (!IsPassable(w, nx, n.Y - dy + 1 + i, nz)) { free = false; break; } if (!free) break; if (CanStand(w, nx, n.Y - dy, nz, h, true)) { ny = n.Y - dy; break; } } } if (ny == -999) continue; long k = Key(nx, ny, nz); if (closed.Contains(k)) continue; float cost = 1f + (ny != n.Y ? 0.5f : 0f) + (w.GetBlock(nx, ny, nz) == B.Water ? 2f : 0f); float g = n.G + cost; if (all.TryGetValue(k, out var ex) && ex.G <= g) continue; if (Math.Abs(nx - sx) > maxDist || Math.Abs(nz - sz) > maxDist) continue; var nn = new Node { X = nx, Y = ny, Z = nz, G = g, Parent = n }; nn.F = g + H(nx, ny, nz, tx, ty, tz) * 1.2f; all[k] = nn; open.Enqueue(nn, nn.F); } } if (best == start) return null; var path = new List<(int, int, int)>(); for (var p = best; p != null && p != start; p = p.Parent) path.Add((p.X, p.Y, p.Z)); path.Reverse(); return path; } private static float H(int x, int y, int z, int tx, int ty, int tz) => MathF.Sqrt((x - tx) * (x - tx) + (y - ty) * (y - ty) * 1.5f + (z - tz) * (z - tz)); private static long Key(int x, int y, int z) => ((long)(x & 0xFFFFFF) << 32) | ((long)(z & 0xFFFFFF) << 8) | (uint)(y & 0xFF); }

0.5f : 0f) + (w.GetBlock(nx, ny, nz) == B.Water ? 2f : 0f); float g = n.G + cost; if (all.TryGetValue(k, out var ex) && ex.G <= g) continue; if (Math.Abs(nx - sx) > maxDist || Math.Abs(nz - sz) > maxDist) continue; var nn = new Node { X = nx, Y = ny, Z = nz, G = g, Parent = n }; nn.F = g + H(nx, ny, nz, tx, ty, tz) * 1.2f; all[k] = nn; open.Enqueue(nn, nn.F); } } if (best == start) return null; var path = new List<(int, int, int)>(); for (var p = best; p != null && p != start; p = p.Parent) path.Add((p.X, p.Y, p.Z)); path.Reverse(); return path; }

nodes.name: Navigator
nodes.signature: public sealed class Navigator
nodes.body_text: public sealed class Navigator { private readonly Mob _m; private List<(int x, int y, int z)> _path; private int _idx; private double _speed; private int _stuckTicks; private double _lastDist = double.MaxValue; public bool HasPath => _path != null && _idx < _path.Count; public (int x, int y, int z) Target => _path != null && _path.Count > 0 ? _path[^1] : default; public Navigator(Mob m) { _m = m; } public bool MoveTo(double x, double y, double z, double speed) { var p = PathFinder.Find(_m.World, _m, MathUtil.FloorToInt(x), MathUtil.FloorToInt(y), MathUtil.FloorToInt(z), 500, 40); if (p == null || p.Count == 0) { _path = null; return false; } _path = p; _idx = 0; _speed = speed; _stuckTicks = 0; _lastDist = double.MaxValue; return true; } public void SetSpeed(double s) => _speed = s; public void Stop() { _path = null; _m.MoveForward = 0; } public void Tick() { if (!HasPath) return; var (x, y, z) = _path[_idx]; double tx = x + 0.5, tz = z + 0.5; double dx = tx - _m.X, dz = tz - _m.Z; double dist = Math.Sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz); double reach = Math.Max(0.35, _m.Width / 2); if (dist < reach && Math.Abs(_m.Y - y) < 1.5) { _idx++; _stuckTicks = 0; _lastDist = double.MaxValue; if (_idx >= _path.Count) { Stop(); return; } (x, y, z) = _path[_idx]; tx = x + 0.5; tz = z + 0.5; dx = tx - _m.X; dz = tz - _m.Z; dist = Math.Sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz); } if (dist < _lastDist - 0.01) { _lastDist = dist; _stuckTicks = 0; } else if (++_stuckTicks > 60) { Stop(); return; } float targetYaw = (float)(Math.Atan2(dz, dx) * MathUtil.Rad2Deg) - 90f; _m.Yaw = _m.Yaw + Math.Clamp(MathUtil.WrapDegrees(targetYaw - _m.Yaw), -30f, 30f); _m.SetMoveSpeed((float)_speed); if ((y > _m.Y + 0.5 && dist < 1.5) || (_m.CollidedH && _m.OnGround)) _m.IsJumping = true; else if (!_m.InWater) _m.IsJumping = false; if (_m.InWater) _m.IsJumping = _m.World.Rand.NextFloat() < 0.8f; } }

"fall_big" : "fall_small", X, Y, Z); Attack(DamageSource.Fall, dmg); } } // deptanie pola int bx = MathUtil.FloorToInt(X), by = MathUtil.FloorToInt(Y - 0.2), bz = MathUtil.FloorToInt(Z); if (World.GetBlock(bx, by, bz) == B.Farmland && distance > 0.5f && World.Rand.NextFloat() < distance - 0.5f && !World.IsRemote) World.SetBlock(bx, by, bz, B.Dirt); }

nodes.name: FoodTick
nodes.signature: private void FoodTick()
nodes.body_text: private void FoodTick() { if (Creative || Spectator) { FoodLevel = 20; return; } if (HungerEffect > 0) { HungerEffect--; AddExhaustion(0.025f); } if (RegenEffect > 0) { RegenEffect--; if (RegenEffect % 25 == 0) Heal(1); } var diff = World.Difficulty; if (Exhaustion > 4f) { Exhaustion -= 4f; if (Saturation > 0) Saturation = Math.Max(Saturation - 1f, 0); else if (diff != Difficulty.Peaceful) FoodLevel = Math.Max(FoodLevel - 1, 0); } if (diff == Difficulty.Peaceful) { if (Health < MaxHealth && World.TotalTime % 20 == 0) Heal(1); if (FoodLevel < 20 && World.TotalTime % 10 == 0) FoodLevel++; } if (World.Rules.NaturalRegeneration && FoodLevel >= 18 && Health > 0 && Health < MaxHealth) { FoodTimer++; if (FoodTimer >= 80) { Heal(1); AddExhaustion(3f); FoodTimer = 0; } } else if (FoodLevel <= 0) { FoodTimer++; if (FoodTimer >= 80) { if (Health > 10 || diff == Difficulty.Hard || Health > 1 && diff == Difficulty.Normal) Attack(DamageSource.Starve, 1); FoodTimer = 0; } } else FoodTimer = 0; }

nodes.name: Eat
nodes.signature: public void Eat(Item food)
nodes.body_text: public void Eat(Item food) { FoodLevel = Math.Min(20, FoodLevel + food.Hunger); Saturation = Math.Min(FoodLevel, Saturation + food.Hunger * food.SaturationMod * 2f); if (food.Id == I.RawChicken && World.Rand.NextFloat() < 0.3f) HungerEffect = 600; if (food.Id == I.RottenFlesh && World.Rand.NextFloat() < 0.8f) HungerEffect = 600; if (food.Id == I.GoldenApple) RegenEffect = 100; if (food.Id == I.SpiderEye) HungerEffect = 100; }

nodes.signature: public void StopUsing()
nodes.body_text: public void StopUsing() { if (ItemInUse != null && ItemInUse.Id == I.Bow) ReleaseBow(); ItemInUse = null; ItemInUseCount = 0; }

nodes.name: UseItemTick
nodes.signature: private void UseItemTick()
nodes.body_text: private void UseItemTick() { if (ItemInUse == null) return; var held = Inventory.Selected; if (held != ItemInUse) { ItemInUse = null; ItemInUseCount = 0; return; } var act = ItemInUse.Item.Action; if (act == UseAction.Eat || act == UseAction.Drink) { if (ItemInUseCount <= 25 && ItemInUseCount % 4 == 0) { World.PlaySound(act == UseAction.Eat ? "eat" : "drink", X, Y, Z, 0.5f, 0.9f + World.Rand.NextFloat() * 0.2f); if (act == UseAction.Eat) World.SpawnParticles(ParticleKind.BlockBreak, X, Y + EyeHeight - 0.1, Z, 5, -ItemInUse.Id); } if (--ItemInUseCount <= 0) FinishUsing(); } else if (act == UseAction.Bow) ItemInUseCount--; }

nodes.name: FinishUsing
nodes.signature: private void FinishUsing()
nodes.body_text: private void FinishUsing() { var s = ItemInUse; ItemInUse = null; ItemInUseCount = 0; if (s == null) return; var it = s.Item; if (it.IsFood) { Eat(it); World.PlaySound("burp", X, Y, Z, 0.5f, 0.9f + World.Rand.NextFloat() * 0.1f); if (!Creative) { s.Count--; if (it.Id == I.MushroomStew) Inventory.Selected = new ItemStack(I.Bowl); else if (s.Count <= 0) Inventory.Selected = null; } } else if (it.Id == I.MilkBucket) { HungerEffect = 0; RegenEffect = 0; if (!Creative) Inventory.Selected = new ItemStack(I.Bucket); } Inventory.Dirty = true; }

nodes.name: BowCharge
nodes.signature: public float BowCharge
nodes.body_text: public float BowCharge { get { if (ItemInUse == null || ItemInUse.Id != I.Bow) return 0; int used = 72000 - ItemInUseCount; float f = used / 20f; f = (f * f + f * 2f) / 3f; return Math.Min(1f, f); } }

nodes.name: ReleaseBow
nodes.signature: private void ReleaseBow()
nodes.body_text: private void ReleaseBow() { float f = BowCharge; if (f < 0.1f) return; bool hasArrow = Creative || Inventory.CountOf(I.Arrow) > 0; if (!hasArrow) return; var arrow = new ArrowEntity(World, this, f * 3f) { Critical = f >= 1f, PickupAllowed = !Creative }; if (NetShootHook != null) NetShootHook(f); else World.SpawnEntity(arrow); World.PlaySound("bow", X, Y, Z, 1f, 1f / (World.Rand.NextFloat() * 0.4f + 1.2f) + f * 0.5f); if (!Creative) { Inventory.Consume(I.Arrow); DamageHeld(1); } }

nodes.name: DamageHeld
nodes.signature: public void DamageHeld(int amount)
nodes.body_text: public void DamageHeld(int amount) { if (Creative) return; var s = Inventory.Selected; if (s == null) return; if (s.DamageItem(amount) || s.Count <= 0) { Inventory.Selected = null; World.PlaySound("break", X, Y, Z, 0.8f, 0.8f + World.Rand.NextFloat() * 0.4f); } Inventory.Dirty = true; }

nodes.name: XpBarCap
nodes.signature: public int XpBarCap => XpLevel >= 30 ? 112 + (XpLevel - 30) * 9 : XpLevel >= 15 ? 37 + (XpLevel - 15) * 5 : 7 + XpLevel * 2;
nodes.body_text: public int XpBarCap => XpLevel >= 30 ? 112 + (XpLevel - 30) * 9 : XpLevel >= 15 ? 37 + (XpLevel - 15) * 5 : 7 + XpLevel * 2;

nodes.name: AddXp
nodes.signature: public void AddXp(int amount)
nodes.body_text: public void AddXp(int amount) { XpTotal += amount; XpProgress += (float)amount / XpBarCap; while (XpProgress >= 1f) { XpProgress = (XpProgress - 1f) * XpBarCap; XpLevel++; XpProgress /= XpBarCap; if (XpLevel % 5 == 0) World.PlaySound("levelup", X, Y, Z, 0.75f, 1f); } }

nodes.name: DropStack
nodes.signature: public void DropStack(ItemStack s, bool fromCursor)
nodes.body_text: public void DropStack(ItemStack s, bool fromCursor) { if (s == null || s.Count <= 0) return; if (World.IsRemote) { NetDropHook?.Invoke(s); return; } var e = new ItemEntity(World, X, Y + EyeHeight - 0.3, Z, s.Copy()); e.PickupDelay = 40; float yr = Yaw * MathUtil.Deg2Rad, pr = Pitch * MathUtil.Deg2Rad; float f = 0.3f; e.MotionX = -MathF.Sin(yr) * MathF.Cos(pr) * f; e.MotionZ = MathF.Cos(yr) * MathF.Cos(pr) * f; e.MotionY = -MathF.Sin(pr) * f + 0.1f; float ang = World.Rand.NextFloat() * MathF.PI * 2f, sp = 0.02f * World.Rand.NextFloat(); e.MotionX += MathF.Cos(ang) * sp; e.MotionY += (World.Rand.NextFloat() - World.Rand.NextFloat()) * 0.1f; e.MotionZ += MathF.Sin(ang) * sp; World.SpawnEntity(e); }

nodes.name: StartSleeping
nodes.signature: public void StartSleeping(int x, int y, int z)
nodes.body_text: public void StartSleeping(int x, int y, int z) { Sleeping = true; SleepTimer = 0; BedX = x; BedY = y; BedZ = z; SetPositionAndPrev(x + 0.5, y + 0.5625, z + 0.5); MotionX = MotionY = MotionZ = 0; }

nodes.name: WakeUp
nodes.signature: public void WakeUp()
nodes.body_text: public void WakeUp() { if (!Sleeping) return; Sleeping = false; SleepTimer = 0; SetPositionAndPrev(BedX + 0.5, BedY + 1.0, BedZ + 0.5); // znajdź wolne miejsce obok łóżka for (int r = 0; r <= 2; r++) for (int dx = -r; dx <= r; dx++) for (int dz = -r; dz <= r; dz++) { int x = BedX + dx, z = BedZ + dz; if (Block.Get(World.GetBlock(x, BedY, z)).Solid && World.GetBlock(x, BedY, z) != B.Bed) continue; if (World.GetBlock(x, BedY, z) == B.Bed) continue; if (!Block.Get(World.GetBlock(x, BedY + 1, z)).Solid && Block.Get(World.GetBlock(x, BedY - 1, z)).Solid) { SetPositionAndPrev(x + 0.5, BedY, z + 0.5); return; } } }

nodes.name: OnDeath
nodes.signature: public override void OnDeath(DamageSource src)
nodes.body_text: public override void OnDeath(DamageSource src) { if (Dead) return; base.OnDeath(src); DeathMessage = src.DeathMessage(Name); if (!World.IsRemote) { if (!World.Rules.KeepInventory) { for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) { var s = Inventory.Get(i); if (s == null) continue; var e = new ItemEntity(World, X, Y + 1, Z, s); float f = World.Rand.NextFloat() * 0.5f, a = World.Rand.NextFloat() * MathF.PI * 2; e.MotionX = -MathF.Sin(a) * f; e.MotionZ = MathF.Cos(a) * f; e.MotionY = 0.2; e.PickupDelay = 40; World.SpawnEntity(e); } Inventory.Clear(); if (Cursor != null) { DropStack(Cursor, false); Cursor = null; } int xp = Math.Min(XpLevel * 7, 100); if (xp > 0) World.SpawnXp(X, Y + 0.5, Z, xp); XpLevel = 0; XpProgress = 0; XpTotal = 0; } World.BroadcastMessage(DeathMessage); } Handler?.OnDeath(DeathMessage); }

nodes.name: Respawn
nodes.signature: public void Respawn()
nodes.body_text: public void Respawn() { Dead = false; DeathTime = 0; Health = MaxHealth; FoodLevel = 20; Saturation = 5; Exhaustion = 0; Air = 300; FireTicks = 0; HungerEffect = 0; RegenEffect = 0; HurtTime = 0; FallDistance = 0; MotionX = MotionY = MotionZ = 0; int sx = HasSpawn ? SpawnX : World.SpawnX, sy = HasSpawn ? SpawnY : World.SpawnY, sz = HasSpawn ? SpawnZ : World.SpawnZ; if (HasSpawn && World.GetBlock(SpawnX, SpawnY - 1, SpawnZ) != B.Bed && false) HasSpawn = false; SetPositionAndPrev(sx + 0.5, sy, sz + 0.5); Removed = false; }

nodes.name: AttackEntity
nodes.signature: public void AttackEntity(Entity target)
nodes.body_text: public void AttackEntity(Entity target) { if (target is not LivingEntity le || le.Dead) return; var held = Inventory.Selected; float dmg = held?.Item?.AttackDamage ?? 1f; bool crit = FallDistance > 0 && !OnGround && !IsOnLadder() && !InWater && MotionY < 0 && !Sprinting; if (crit) dmg *= 1.5f; int kb = Sprinting ? 1 : 0; if (le.Attack(DamageSource.PlayerAttack(this), dmg)) { if (kb > 0) { float yr = Yaw * MathUtil.Deg2Rad; le.MotionX += -MathF.Sin(yr) * kb * 0.5f; le.MotionY += 0.1; le.MotionZ += MathF.Cos(yr) * kb * 0.5f; MotionX *= 0.6; MotionZ *= 0.6; Sprinting = false; } if (crit) World.SpawnParticles(ParticleKind.Crit, le.X, le.Y + le.Height / 2, le.Z, 10); if (held != null && held.Item?.IsTool == true) DamageHeld(held.Item.Tool == ToolType.Sword ? 1 : 2); AddExhaustion(0.3f); } }

nodes.name: ToData
nodes.signature: public PlayerData ToData()
nodes.body_text: public PlayerData ToData() { var d = new PlayerData { Name = Name, X = X, Y = Y, Z = Z, Yaw = Yaw, Pitch = Pitch, Health = Health, Food = FoodLevel, Saturation = Saturation, Exhaustion = Exhaustion, GameMode = GameMode, Flying = Flying, XpLevel = XpLevel, XpProgress = XpProgress, XpTotal = XpTotal, Selected = Inventory.SelectedSlot, Air = Air, HasSpawn = HasSpawn, SpawnX = SpawnX, SpawnY = SpawnY, SpawnZ = SpawnZ, Dead = Dead }; for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) { var s = Inventory.Get(i); if (s != null) d.Inventory.Add(new SlotData { Slot = i, Id = s.Id, Count = s.Count, Damage = s.Damage }); } return d; }

nodes.name: FromData
nodes.signature: public void FromData(PlayerData d)

nodes.body_text: public sealed partial class Game : GameWindow, IPlayerHandler { public Settings Settings; public SpriteBatch Sb; public GuiTextures Gui; public WorldRenderer Renderer; public IconAtlas Icons; public World.World World; public Player Player; public PlayerController Ctrl; public Commands Cmds; private WorldStorage _storage; private LevelData _level; private Screen _screen; public int GuiW, GuiH; public float GuiScale = 2; public int MouseGuiX, MouseGuiY; public bool IsShiftDown => KeyboardState.IsKeyDown(Keys.LeftShift) || KeyboardState.IsKeyDown(Keys.RightShift); public bool ShowDebug, HideGui; public int CameraMode; private readonly List<(string text, long time)> _chat = new(); private double _acc; private long _frames; private readonly Stopwatch _clock = Stopwatch.StartNew(); private double _lastTime; private int _fps, _fpsCount; private double _fpsTimer; private bool _leftDown, _rightDown, _middlePressed; private bool _leftPressed, _rightPressed; private int _lastFwdTap = -100, _lastJumpTap = -100; private long _tickCount; private bool _prevFwd, _prevJump; private float _equip = 1, _prevEquip = 1; private ItemStack _equipped; private int _equippedSlot; private int _itemNameTicks; private string _itemName = ""; private float _fovMod = 1f, _prevFovMod = 1f; private World.World _menuWorld; private ChunkManager _menuCm; private float _menuYaw; public bool HasMenuWorld => _menuWorld != null && Renderer.RenderedSections > 20; public int CurrentDifficulty { get => World != null ? (int)World.Difficulty : Settings.Difficulty; set { if (World != null) World.Difficulty = (Difficulty)value; Settings.Difficulty = value; } } private readonly bool _autotest; private readonly string[] _args; public Game(string[] args) : base(new GameWindowSettings { UpdateFrequency = 0 }, new NativeWindowSettings { ClientSize = new Vector2i(1280, 720), Title = "BlockCraft", APIVersion = new Version(3, 3), Profile = ContextProfile.Core, Flags = ContextFlags.ForwardCompatible, StartVisible = true }) { _args = args; _autotest = args.Contains("--autotest"); _showcase = args.Contains("--showcase"); Settings = Settings.Load(); VSync = Settings.VSync ? VSyncMode.On : VSyncMode.Off; } protected override void OnLoad() { base.OnLoad(); Log.Info("Start BlockCraft, GL: " + GL.GetString(StringName.Renderer) + " / " + GL.GetString(StringName.Version)); SharedQuadIndices.Init(); ItemRegistry.Init(); Recipes.Init(); Sb = new SpriteBatch(); Gui = new GuiTextures(); Renderer = new WorldRenderer(); Icons = new IconAtlas(Renderer.Entities, Renderer.Terrain); Renderer.SoundHook = (n, x, y, z, v, p) => Sound.Play(n, x, y, z, v, p, Player); UpdateGuiScale(); ApplySettings(); StartMenuWorld(); SetScreen(new TitleScreen()); _lastTime = _clock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds; if (_autotest) SetupAutotest(); else if (_showcase) SetupShowcase(); } // ================= ustawienia / GUI ================= public void ApplySettings() { VSync = Settings.VSync ? VSyncMode.On : VSyncMode.Off; ChunkMesher.SmoothLighting = Settings.SmoothLighting; bool fancyChanged = ChunkMesher.FancyLeaves != Settings.FancyGraphics; ChunkMesher.FancyLeaves = Settings.FancyGraphics; int rdOld = Renderer.RenderDistance; Renderer.RenderDistance = Settings.RenderDistance; Renderer.CloudsEnabled = Settings.Clouds; Renderer.Gamma = Settings.Brightness; if (World?.ChunkManager != null) World.ChunkManager.Radius = Settings.RenderDistance; if (World != null) World.Difficulty = (Difficulty)Settings.Difficulty; if (fancyChanged || _lastSmooth != Settings.SmoothLighting) MarkAllDirty(); _lastSmooth = Settings.SmoothLighting; UpdateGuiScale(); } private bool _lastSmooth = true; private void MarkAllDirty() { var w = World ?? _menuWorld; if (w == null) return; foreach (var c in w.Chunks.Values) c.MarkAllDirty(); } private void UpdateGuiScale() { int fw = Math.Max(1, FramebufferSize.X), fh = Math.Max(1, FramebufferSize.Y); int max = 1; while (max < 6 && fw / (max + 1) >= 320 && fh / (max + 1) >= 240) max++; int s = Settings.GuiScale == 0 ? max : Math.Min(Settings.GuiScale, max); GuiScale = s; GuiW = (int)Math.Ceiling(fw / GuiScale); GuiH = (int)Math.Ceiling(fh / GuiScale); if (_screen != null) _screen.Open(this, GuiW, GuiH); } protected override void OnResize(ResizeEventArgs e) { base.OnResize(e); UpdateGuiScale(); } public void SetScreen(Screen s) { var old = _screen; _screen = null; old?.OnClose(); if (s == null && World == null) s = new TitleScreen(); _screen = s; s?.Open(this, GuiW, GuiH); UpdateCursor(); _leftDown = _rightDown = false; if (Ctrl != null) Ctrl.ResetBreak(); } public Screen CurrentScreen => _screen; private void UpdateCursor() { bool grab = _screen == null && World != null && IsFocused; CursorState = grab ? CursorState.Grabbed : CursorState.Normal; } public void PlayUiClick() => Sound.Play("click", 0, 0, 0, 0.25f, 1f, null); public string GetClipboard() { try { return ClipboardString; } catch { return null; } } public void Quit() => Close(); // ================= świat menu ================= private

nodes.name: StartSession
nodes.signature: private void StartSession(WorldStorage storage, LevelData level, bool isNew)
nodes.body_text: private void StartSession(WorldStorage storage, LevelData level, bool isNew) { StopMenuWorld(); _storage = storage; _level = level; var w = new World.World(level.Seed, (WorldType)level.Type, false) { Name = level.Name, AllowCheats = level.AllowCheats, Hardcore = level.Hardcore, DayTime = level.DayTime, TotalTime = level.Time, Difficulty = (Difficulty)level.Difficulty, Storage = storage }; foreach (var kv in level.Rules) w.Rules.Set(kv.Key, kv.Value.ToString(), out _); if (isNew || (level.SpawnX == 0 && level.SpawnY == 0 && level.SpawnZ == 0)) { var sp = w.Generator.FindSpawn(); w.SpawnX = sp.x; w.SpawnY = sp.y; w.SpawnZ = sp.z; } else { w.SpawnX = level.SpawnX; w.SpawnY = level.SpawnY; w.SpawnZ = level.SpawnZ; } var p = new Player(w) { Name = Settings.PlayerName, Handler = this, IsLocal = true, IsLocalOp = level.AllowCheats }; if (level.Player != null) p.FromData(level.Player); else { p.SetGameMode(level.GameMode); p.SetPositionAndPrev(w.SpawnX + 0.5, w.SpawnY + 0.1, w.SpawnZ + 0.5); } w.ChunkManager = new ChunkManager(w) { Radius = Settings.RenderDistance }; World = w; Player = p; Ctrl = new PlayerController(this); Cmds = new Commands(w); Renderer.SetWorld(w); _chat.Clear(); _loading = new LoadingScreen { Title = "Wczytywanie świata", Sub = "Generowanie terenu..." }; _loadTicks = 0; SetScreen(_loading); _sessionStarted = false; }

nodes.name: FinishLoading
nodes.signature: private void FinishLoading()
nodes.body_text: private void FinishLoading() { var w = World; var p = Player; // znajdź bezpieczną wysokość jeśli nowy gracz if (_level.Player == null) { int x = MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.X), z = MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.Z); int y = Chunk.Height - 1; while (y > 0 && !Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x, y, z)).Solid && !Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x, y, z)).IsLiquid) y--; p.SetPositionAndPrev(x + 0.5, y + 1, z + 0.5); w.SpawnY = y + 1; } w.AddEntityNow(p); _sessionStarted = true; if (p.Health <= 0) { p.Dead = true; OnDeath(p.DeathMessage ?? ""); return; } SetScreen(null); AddChat("§eWitaj w świecie " + w.Name + "! Wpisz /help aby zobaczyć komendy."); }

nodes.name: SaveWorld
nodes.signature: public void SaveWorld()
nodes.body_text: public void SaveWorld() { if (World == null || _storage == null || !_sessionStarted) return; try { _level.DayTime = World.DayTime; _level.Time = World.TotalTime; _level.SpawnX = World.SpawnX; _level.SpawnY = World.SpawnY; _level.SpawnZ = World.SpawnZ; _level.Difficulty = (int)World.Difficulty; _level.GameMode = Player.GameMode; _level.Player = Player.ToData(); _level.Rules = new Dictionary<string, bool> { ["doDaylightCycle"] = World.Rules.DoDaylightCycle, ["keepInventory"] = World.Rules.KeepInventory, ["doMobSpawning"] = World.Rules.DoMobSpawning, ["mobGriefing"] = World.Rules.MobGriefing, ["naturalRegeneration"] = World.Rules.NaturalRegeneration }; _storage.SaveLevel(_level); World.ChunkManager.SaveAll(); } catch (Exception ex) { Log.Error("Zapis świata: " + ex); } }

nodes.body_text: protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e) { base.OnMouseDown(e); int btn = e.Button == MouseButton.Left ? 0 : e.Button == MouseButton.Right ? 1 : e.Button == MouseButton.Middle ? 2 : -1; if (btn < 0) return; if (_screen != null) { _screen.MouseDown(MouseGuiX, MouseGuiY, btn); return; } if (btn == 0) { _leftDown = true; _leftPressed = true; } if (btn == 1) { _rightDown = true; _rightPressed = true; } if (btn == 2) _middlePressed = true; }

nodes.name: OnMouseWheel
nodes.signature: protected override void OnMouseWheel(MouseWheelEventArgs e)
nodes.body_text: protected override void OnMouseWheel(MouseWheelEventArgs e) { base.OnMouseWheel(e); if (_screen != null) { _screen.Scroll(MouseGuiX, MouseGuiY, e.OffsetY); return; } if (Player == null) return; int d = e.OffsetY > 0 ? -1 : e.OffsetY < 0 ? 1 : 0; if (Player.Spectator) { Player.FlySpeed = Math.Clamp(Player.FlySpeed - d * 0.005f, 0.01f, 0.2f); return; } Player.Inventory.SelectedSlot = (Player.Inventory.SelectedSlot + d + 9) % 9; }

nodes.name: OnTextInput
nodes.signature: protected override void OnTextInput(TextInputEventArgs e)
nodes.body_text: protected override void OnTextInput(TextInputEventArgs e) { base.OnTextInput(e); if (_ignoreNextChar) { _ignoreNextChar = false; return; } foreach (char c in char.ConvertFromUtf32(e.Unicode)) _screen?.CharTyped(c); }

nodes.name: OnKeyDown
nodes.signature: protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyboardKeyEventArgs e)
nodes.body_text: protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyboardKeyEventArgs e) { base.OnKeyDown(e); bool ctrl = e.Control; if (e.Key == Keys.F11) { WindowState = WindowState == WindowState.Fullscreen ? WindowState.Normal : WindowState.Fullscreen; return; } if (e.Key == Keys.F2) { _screenshotRequested = true; return; } if (_screen != null) { _screen.KeyDown(e.Key, ctrl, e.Shift); return; } if (World == null || Player == null) return; var p = Player; switch (e.Key) { case Keys.Escape: SetScreen(new PauseScreen()); break; case Keys.E: if (p.Spectator) break; if (p.Creative) SetScreen(new CreativeScreen(p)); else SetScreen(new ContainerScreen(p, p.InventoryContainer)); break; case Keys.T: _ignoreNextChar = true; SetScreen(new ChatScreen("")); break; case Keys.Slash: _ignoreNextChar = true; SetScreen(new ChatScreen("/")); break; case Keys.F1: HideGui = !HideGui; break; case Keys.F3: ShowDebug = !ShowDebug; break; case Keys.F5: CameraMode = (CameraMode + 1) % 3; break; case Keys.Q: { var s = p.Inventory.Selected; if (s != null && !p.Spectator) { var drop = ctrl ? s.Copy() : s.CopyWith(1); s.Count -= drop.Count; if (s.Count <= 0) p.Inventory.Selected = null; p.DropStack(drop, false); p.SwingArm(); } break; } default: if (e.Key >= Keys.D1 && e.Key <= Keys.D9) p.Inventory.SelectedSlot = e.Key - Keys.D1; break; } }

nodes.name: OnClosing
nodes.signature: protected override void OnClosing(System.ComponentModel.CancelEventArgs e)
nodes.body_text: protected override void OnClosing(System.ComponentModel.CancelEventArgs e) { try { SaveWorld(); World?.ChunkManager?.Dispose(); _menuCm?.Dispose(); Settings.Save(); } catch (Exception ex) { Log.Error(ex.ToString()); } base.OnClosing(e); }

nodes.name: OnRenderFrame
nodes.signature: protected override void OnRenderFrame(FrameEventArgs args)
nodes.body_text: protected override void OnRenderFrame(FrameEventArgs args) { base.OnRenderFrame(args); double now = _clock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds; double dt = Math.Min(0.25, now - _lastTime); _lastTime = now; _fpsTimer += dt; _fpsCount++; if (_fpsTimer >= 1) { _fps = _fpsCount; _fpsCount = 0; _fpsTimer -= 1; } _acc += dt; int n = 0; while (_acc >= 0.05 && n < 10) { _acc -= 0.05; n++; try { Tick(); } catch (Exception ex) { Log.Error("Tick: " + ex); } } if (n >= 10) _acc = 0; float pt = (float)(_acc / 0.05); if (World != null && _screen != null && _screen.PausesGame && _sessionStarted) pt = 1f; MouseLook(); try { RenderFrame(pt); } catch (Exception ex) { Log.Error("Render: " + ex); } _frames++; if (_autotest) AutotestStep(); else if (_showcase) ShowcaseFrame(); if (_screenshotRequested) { _screenshotRequested = false; TakeScreenshot(null); } SwapBuffers(); if (!Settings.VSync && Settings.MaxFps < 1000) { double target = 1.0 / Settings.MaxFps; double spent = _clock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds - now; if (spent < target) Thread.Sleep((int)((target - spent) * 1000)); } }

nodes.name: MouseLook
nodes.signature: private void MouseLook()
nodes.body_text: private void MouseLook() { if (Player == null || _screen != null || !IsFocused || CursorState != CursorState.Grabbed) return; var d = MouseState.Delta; if (_skipMouse > 0) { _skipMouse--; return; } float f = Settings.Sensitivity * 0.6f + 0.2f; float f1 = f * f * f * 8f; float dx = d.X * f1 * 0.15f, dy = d.Y * f1 * 0.15f * (Settings.InvertMouse ? -1 : 1); if (Player.Sleeping) return; Player.Yaw += dx; Player.Pitch = Math.Clamp(Player.Pitch + dy, -90f, 90f); }

nodes.name: Tick
nodes.signature: private void Tick()
nodes.body_text: private void Tick() { _tickCount++; _screen?.Tick(); if (_menuWorld != null) { _menuWorld.DayTime = 3000 + (long)(_tickCount * 0.5) % 24000 * 0; _menuCm.Update(new[] { (_menuWorld.SpawnX >> 4, _menuWorld.SpawnZ >> 4) }, 6); Renderer.TickAnimations(); return; } if (World == null) return; var w = World; var p = Player; if (!_sessionStarted) { w.ChunkManager.Update(new[] { (MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.X) >> 4, MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.Z) >> 4) }, 12); Renderer.Update(new Vector3d(p.X, p.Y, p.Z)); _loadTicks++; int pcx = MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.X) >> 4, pcz = MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.Z) >> 4; int need = 2; int ready = 0, total = (2 * need + 1) * (2 * need + 1); for (int dx = -need; dx <= need; dx++) for (int dz = -need; dz <= need; dz++) { var c = w.GetChunk(pcx + dx, pcz + dz); if (c != null && c.Merged) ready++; } _loading.Progress = ready / (float)total; _loading.Sub = $"Przygotowywanie obszaru: {(int)(_loading.Progress * 100)}%"; if (ready == total && (Renderer.PendingMeshes < 8 || _loadTicks > 200)) FinishLoading(); return; } bool paused = _screen != null && _screen.PausesGame; if (paused) { Renderer.Update(new Vector3d(p.X, p.Y, p.Z)); return; } ControlTick(); w.Tick(); if (!p.Dead && p.Removed) { } w.ChunkManager.Update(new[] { (MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.X) >> 4, MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.Z) >> 4) }, 5); Renderer.TickAnimations(); Renderer.TickParticles(); // ekwipowanie _prevEquip = _equip; var held = p.Inventory.Selected; bool same = held == _equipped || (held != null && _equipped != null && held.Id == _equipped.Id && held.Damage == _equipped.Damage) ; if (_equippedSlot != p.Inventory.SelectedSlot) same = false; float target = same ? 1f : 0f; _equip += Math.Clamp(target - _equip, -0.4f, 0.4f); if (_equip < 0.1f) { _equipped = held; _equippedSlot = p.Inventory.SelectedSlot; } if (held != null && (_lastNameItem == null || _lastNameItem.Id != held.Id || _lastNameSlot != p.Inventory.SelectedSlot)) { _itemName = held.Name; _itemNameTicks = 40; } _lastNameItem = held; _lastNameSlot = p.Inventory.SelectedSlot; if (_itemNameTicks > 0) _itemNameTicks--; // FOV _prevFovMod = _fovMod; float fovT = 1f; if (p.Flying) fovT *= 1.1f; if (p.Sprinting) fovT *= 1.15f; if (p.ItemInUse?.Id == I.Bow) { float bc = p.BowCharge; fovT *= 1f - bc * bc * 0.15f; } _fovMod += (fovT - _fovMod) * 0.5f; // autozapis co 5 minut if (w.TotalTime % 6000 == 0) SaveWorld(); if (p.Dead && _screen is not DeathScreen) OnDeath(p.DeathMessage); if (p.Y < -100 && p.Spectator) p.SetPositionAndPrev(p.X, 100, p.Z); }

nodes.name: ControlTick
nodes.signature: private void ControlTick()
nodes.body_text: private void ControlTick() { var p = Player; var kb = KeyboardState; bool inGame = _screen == null && IsFocused || Scripted && _screen == null; if (p.Dead) { p.MoveForward = p.MoveStrafe = 0; p.IsJumping = false; return; } bool fwd = inGame && kb.IsKeyDown(Keys.W), back = inGame && kb.IsKeyDown(Keys.S); bool left = inGame && kb.IsKeyDown(Keys.A), right = inGame && kb.IsKeyDown(Keys.D); bool jump = inGame && kb.IsKeyDown(Keys.Space), sneak = inGame && (kb.IsKeyDown(Keys.LeftShift) || kb.IsKeyDown(Keys.RightShift)); bool sprintKey = inGame && (kb.IsKeyDown(Keys.LeftControl) || kb.IsKeyDown(Keys.RightControl)); if (_autoInput.HasValue) { (fwd, jump, sneak, sprintKey) = _autoInput.Value; } if (p.Sleeping) { if (sneak) p.WakeUp(); fwd = back = left = right = jump = false; } p.MoveForward = (fwd ? 1 : 0) - (back ? 1 : 0); p.MoveStrafe = (left ? 1 : 0) - (right ? 1 : 0); p.IsJumping = jump; p.Sneaking = sneak; bool canSprint = p.FoodLevel > 6 || p.AllowFlying; // sprint: Ctrl lub podwójne W if (fwd && !_prevFwd) { if (_tickCount - _lastFwdTap <= 7 && canSprint && !sneak) p.Sprinting = true; _lastFwdTap = (int)_tickCount; } if (sprintKey && fwd && canSprint && !sneak && p.ItemInUse == null) p.Sprinting = true; if (!fwd) p.Sprinting = false; _prevFwd = fwd; // latanie: podwójna spacja if (jump && !_prevJump && p.AllowFlying && !p.Spectator) { if (_tickCount - _lastJumpTap <= 7) { p.Flying = !p.Flying; _lastJumpTap = -100; } else _lastJumpTap = (int)_tickCount; } _prevJump = jump; if (p.Flying && p.OnGround && !p.Spectator && p.MotionY <= 0 && !jump) p.Flying = false; // interakcje Ctrl.UpdateTarget(1f); if (inGame) { if (_leftDown || _leftPressed) Ctrl.TickLeft(_leftPressed); else Ctrl.ResetBreak(); if (_rightDown || _rightPressed) Ctrl.TickRight(_rightPressed); else if (p.ItemInUse != null) p.StopUsing(); if (_middlePressed) Ctrl.PickBlock(); } else if (p.ItemInUse != null && p.ItemInUse.Id == I.Bow) p.StopUsing(); _leftPressed = _rightPressed = _middlePressed = false; }

nodes.name: AutotestStep
nodes.signature: private void AutotestStep()
nodes.body_text: private void AutotestStep() { if (_steps.Count == 0) return; if (_waitFrames > 0) { _waitFrames--; return; } var (frames, act) = _steps.Peek(); bool ok; try { ok = act(); } catch (Exception ex) { Log.Error("Autotest step: " + ex); ok = true; } if (ok) { _steps.Dequeue(); if (_steps.Count > 0) _waitFrames = _steps.Peek().frames; } }
