nodes.body_text: private void RenderFrame(float pt) { int fw = FramebufferSize.X, fh = FramebufferSize.Y; GL.Viewport(0, 0, fw, fh); GL.ClearColor(0, 0, 0, 1); GL.DepthMask(true); GL.Clear(ClearBufferMask.ColorBufferBit | ClearBufferMask.DepthBufferBit); bool worldVisible = (_screen == null || _screen.ShowWorld) && Renderer.World != null; if (worldVisible && World != null && Player != null && _sessionStarted) RenderGameWorld(pt, fw, fh); else if (_menuWorld != null && Renderer.World == _menuWorld) RenderMenuWorld(pt, fw, fh); // GUI Sb.Begin(fw, fh, GuiScale); if (World != null && Player != null && _sessionStarted && !HideGui) RenderHud(pt); if (_screen != null) { try { _screen.Render(MouseGuiX, MouseGuiY, pt); } catch (Exception ex) { Log.Error("Screen: " + ex); } } Sb.End(); }

nodes.name: RenderMenuWorld
nodes.signature: private void RenderMenuWorld(float pt, int fw, int fh)
nodes.body_text: private void RenderMenuWorld(float pt, int fw, int fh) { var w = _menuWorld; _menuYaw += 0.03f; int top = 0; for (int dx = -3; dx <= 3; dx++) for (int dz = -3; dz <= 3; dz++) top = Math.Max(top, w.GetHeight(w.SpawnX + dx, w.SpawnZ + dz)); var cam = new Vector3d(w.SpawnX + 0.5, Math.Max(w.SpawnY + 4, top + 2.5), w.SpawnZ + 0.5); Renderer.Update(cam); var gs = new GlStack(); gs.Rotate(12, 1, 0, 0); gs.Rotate(_menuYaw + 180, 0, 1, 0); var view = gs.M; _proj = Matrix4.CreatePerspectiveFieldOfView(MathHelper.DegreesToRadians(85), fw / (float)Math.Max(1, fh), 0.05f, Math.Max(256f, Renderer.RenderDistance * 32f)); var look = -new Vector3(view.M13, view.M23, view.M33); Renderer.ComputeAtmosphere(cam, look, pt, 0); GL.ClearColor(Renderer.FogColor.X, Renderer.FogColor.Y, Renderer.FogColor.Z, 1); GL.Clear(ClearBufferMask.ColorBufferBit | ClearBufferMask.DepthBufferBit); Renderer.Render(cam, view, _proj, pt, null, true, null, -1); }

nodes.name: RenderGameWorld
nodes.signature: private void RenderGameWorld(float pt, int fw, int fh)
nodes.body_text: private void RenderGameWorld(float pt, int fw, int fh) { var p = Player; var w = World; Ctrl.UpdateTarget(pt); double ex = p.IX(pt), ey = p.IY(pt) + p.EyeHeight, ez = p.IZ(pt); if (p.Sleeping) ey = p.IY(pt) + 0.3; float yaw = p.Yaw, pitch = p.Pitch; // macierz efektów kamery (obrażenia, kołysanie) var fx = new GlStack(); HurtAndBob(fx, pt, true); var gs = new GlStack(); HurtAndBob(gs, pt, Settings.ViewBobbing); var cam = new Vector3d(ex, ey, ez); bool third = CameraMode != 0; if (third) { double dist = 4.0; var (lx, ly, lz) = p.Look(1f); double sgn = CameraMode == 1 ? -1 : 1; // kolizja kamery z blokami for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) { double ox = ((i & 1) * 2 - 1) * 0.1, oy = (((i >> 1) & 1) * 2 - 1) * 0.1, oz = (((i >> 2) & 1) * 2 - 1) * 0.1; var h = w.RayCast(ex + ox, ey + oy, ez + oz, lx * sgn, ly * sgn, lz * sgn, dist); if (h.Hit && h.Distance < dist) dist = h.Distance; } dist = Math.Max(0.3, dist - 0.1); cam = new Vector3d(ex + lx * sgn * dist, ey + ly * sgn * dist, ez + lz * sgn * dist); if (CameraMode == 2) { yaw += 180; pitch = -pitch; } } gs.Rotate(pitch, 1, 0, 0); gs.Rotate(yaw + 180, 0, 1, 0); var view = gs.M; float fov = Settings.Fov * MathHelper.Lerp(_prevFovMod, _fovMod, pt); int headFluid = 0; if (!third) { int bx = MathUtil.FloorToInt(ex), by = MathUtil.FloorToInt(ey), bz = MathUtil.FloorToInt(ez); int id = w.GetBlock(bx, by, bz); if (id == B.Water && ey < by + FluidBlock.HeightOf(w.GetMeta(bx, by, bz))) { headFluid = 1; fov *= 60f / 70f; } if (id == B.Lava) headFluid = 2; } _proj = Matrix4.CreatePerspectiveFieldOfView(MathHelper.DegreesToRadians(Math.Clamp(fov, 10, 150)), fw / (float)Math.Max(1, fh), 0.05f, Math.Max(256f, Renderer.RenderDistance * 32f)); Renderer.Update(cam); var look = -new Vector3(view.M13, view.M23, view.M33); Renderer.ComputeAtmosphere(cam, look, pt, headFluid); GL.ClearColor(Renderer.FogColor.X, Renderer.FogColor.Y, Renderer.FogColor.Z, 1); GL.Clear(ClearBufferMask.ColorBufferBit | ClearBufferMask.DepthBufferBit); World.World.HitResult? sel = Ctrl.Hit.Hit && !p.Spectator && !HideGui ? Ctrl.Hit : null; Renderer.Render(cam, view, _proj, pt, p, third, sel, Ctrl.BreakStage); // ręka if (!third && !p.Spectator && !p.Sleeping && !HideGui) { GL.Clear(ClearBufferMask.DepthBufferBit); GL.Enable(EnableCap.DepthTest); GL.Disable(EnableCap.CullFace); GL.Enable(EnableCap.Blend); GL.BlendFunc(BlendingFactor.SrcAlpha, BlendingFactor.OneMinusSrcAlpha); var hp = Matrix4.CreatePerspectiveFieldOfView(MathHelper.DegreesToRadians(70), fw / (float)Math.Max(1, fh), 0.05f, 10f); var er = Renderer.Entities; var hv = new GlStack(); HurtAndBob(hv, pt, Settings.ViewBobbing); er.Shader.Use(); er.Shader.Set("uViewProj", hv.M * hp); er.Shader.Set("uFogMode", 0); er.Shader.Set("uFogStart", 1000f); er.Shader.Set("uFogEnd", 2000f); er.Shader.Set("uSun", Renderer.SunBrightness); er.Shader.Set("uGamma", Settings.Brightness); int bx = MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.X), by = MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.Y + p.EyeHeight), bz = MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.Z); float equip = 1f - MathHelper.Lerp(_prevEquip, _equip, pt); er.RenderFirstPerson(p, pt, equip, _equipped, w.GetSkyLight(bx, by, bz), w.GetBlockLight(bx, by, bz)); er.Flush(er.Skin, er.SkinTex); er.Flush(er.Terrain, Renderer.Terrain); } GL.Disable(EnableCap.DepthTest); }

nodes.name: HurtAndBob
nodes.signature: private void HurtAndBob(GlStack gs, float pt, bool bob)
nodes.body_text: private void HurtAndBob(GlStack gs, float pt, bool bob) { var p = Player; float ht = p.HurtTime - pt; if (p.Health <= 0) { float dt = p.DeathTime + pt; gs.Rotate(40f - 8000f / (dt + 200f), 0, 0, 1); } if (ht > 0) { float f = ht / p.MaxHurtTime; f = MathF.Sin(f * f * f * f * MathF.PI); gs.Rotate(-p.AttackedAtYaw, 0, 1, 0); gs.Rotate(-f * 14f, 0, 0, 1); gs.Rotate(p.AttackedAtYaw, 0, 1, 0); } if (bob && CameraMode == 0) { float f = (float)(p.DistWalked - p.PrevDistWalked); float f1 = -(float)(p.DistWalked + f * pt); float f2 = (float)(p.PrevCameraYawBob + (p.CameraYawBob - p.PrevCameraYawBob) * pt); float f3 = p.PrevCameraPitchBob + (p.CameraPitchBob - p.PrevCameraPitchBob) * pt; gs.Translate(MathF.Sin(f1 * MathF.PI) * f2 * 0.5f, -MathF.Abs(MathF.Cos(f1 * MathF.PI) * f2), 0); gs.Rotate(MathF.Sin(f1 * MathF.PI) * f2 * 3f, 0, 0, 1); gs.Rotate(MathF.Abs(MathF.Cos(f1 * MathF.PI - 0.2f) * f2) * 5f, 1, 0, 0); gs.Rotate(f3, 1, 0, 0); } }

nodes.name: DrawItem
nodes.signature: public void DrawItem(ItemStack s, float x, float y, bool count = true)
nodes.body_text: public void DrawItem(ItemStack s, float x, float y, bool count = true) { if (s == null || s.Item == null) return; if (Icons.TryGet(s, out int layer)) Sb.DrawLayer(Icons.Array, layer, x, y, 16, 16, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0, 1, 1, 0); // FBO ma oś Y od dołu else { var it = s.Item; int sp = it.Sprite > 0 ? it.Sprite : (it.IsBlock ? Block.Get(it.BlockId).Tex[0] : 0); uint col = 0xFFFFFFFF; var b = it.IsBlock ? Block.Get(it.BlockId) : null; if (b != null && b.Tint == TintType.Grass) col = 0xFF5AC079; Sb.DrawLayer(Renderer.Terrain, sp, x, y, 16, 16, col); } if (count && s.Count > 1) { string t = s.Count.ToString(); Sb.Text(t, x + 17 - Sb.Measure(t), y + 9, 0xFFFFFFFF); } var item = s.Item; if (item.MaxDamage > 0 && s.Damage > 0) { float f = 1f - (float)s.Damage / item.MaxDamage; int w = (int)Math.Round(13 * f); int r = (int)(255 * (1 - f)), g = (int)(255 * f); Sb.Fill(x + 2, y + 13, 13, 2, 0xFF000000); Sb.Fill(x + 2, y + 13, w, 1, SpriteBatch.Col(r, g, 0)); } }

nodes.name: DrawPlayerPreview
nodes.signature: public void DrawPlayerPreview(int cx, int cy, float size, float lookX, float lookY)
nodes.body_text: public void DrawPlayerPreview(int cx, int cy, float size, float lookX, float lookY) { var p = Player; if (p == null) return; Sb.Flush(); int fw = FramebufferSize.X, fh = FramebufferSize.Y; var proj = Matrix4.CreateOrthographicOffCenter(0, fw, fh, 0, -500, 500); GL.Clear(ClearBufferMask.DepthBufferBit); GL.Enable(EnableCap.DepthTest); GL.Disable(EnableCap.CullFace); var er = Renderer.Entities; er.Shader.Use(); er.Shader.Set("uViewProj", proj); er.Shader.Set("uFogMode", 0); er.Shader.Set("uFogStart", 1000f); er.Shader.Set("uFogEnd", 2000f); er.Shader.Set("uSun", 1f); er.Shader.Set("uGamma", 0.5f); float yawS = p.Yaw, pyS = p.PrevYaw, by = p.BodyYaw, pby = p.PrevBodyYaw, pi = p.Pitch, ppi = p.PrevPitch; float body = MathF.Atan(lookX / 40f) * 20f, head = MathF.Atan(lookX / 40f) * 40f, pit = -MathF.Atan(lookY / 40f) * 20f; p.BodyYaw = p.PrevBodyYaw = 180 + body; p.Yaw = p.PrevYaw = 180 + head; p.Pitch = p.PrevPitch = pit; float la = p.LimbSwingAmount, pla = p.PrevLimbSwingAmount; p.LimbSwingAmount = p.PrevLimbSwingAmount = 0; int hurt = p.HurtTime; p.HurtTime = 0; er.Skin.Sky = 15; er.Skin.Blk = 15; er.Terrain.Sky = 15; er.Terrain.Blk = 15; er.Skin.Overlay = Vector4.Zero; // budujemy w przestrzeni świata, potem transformujemy do pikseli ekranu int start = er.Skin.Verts, tstart = er.Terrain.Verts; er.RenderLiving(p, 1f, Vector3.Zero); float s = size * GuiScale; var m = Matrix4.CreateScale(s, -s, s) * Matrix4.CreateTranslation(cx * GuiScale, cy * GuiScale, 0); TransformBatch(er.Skin, start, m); TransformBatch(er.Terrain, tstart, m); er.Flush(er.Skin, er.SkinTex); er.Flush(er.Terrain, Renderer.Terrain); p.Yaw = yawS; p.PrevYaw = pyS; p.BodyYaw = by; p.PrevBodyYaw = pby; p.Pitch = pi; p.PrevPitch = ppi; p.LimbSwingAmount = la; p.PrevLimbSwingAmount = pla; p.HurtTime = hurt; GL.Disable(EnableCap.DepthTest); GL.Enable(EnableCap.Blend); GL.BlendFuncSeparate(BlendingFactorSrc.SrcAlpha, BlendingFactorDest.OneMinusSrcAlpha, BlendingFactorSrc.One, BlendingFactorDest.OneMinusSrcAlpha); }

nodes.name: TransformBatch
nodes.signature: private static void TransformBatch(ModelBatch b, int start, Matrix4 m)
nodes.body_text: private static void TransformBatch(ModelBatch b, int start, Matrix4 m) { for (int v = start; v < b.Verts; v++) { int o = v * ModelBatch.F; var p = Vector3.TransformPosition(new Vector3(b.D[o], b.D[o + 1], b.D[o + 2]), m); b.D[o] = p.X; b.D[o + 1] = p.Y; b.D[o + 2] = -p.Z; } }

nodes.name: RenderHud
nodes.signature: private void RenderHud(float pt)
nodes.body_text: private void RenderHud(float pt) { var sb = Sb; var p = Player; var w = World; int W = GuiW, H = GuiH; // pod wodą: niebieska nakładka; w lawie if (CameraMode == 0) { int bx = MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.X), by = MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.Y + p.EyeHeight), bz = MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.Z); if (p.IsHeadInWater()) sb.Fill(0, 0, W, H, 0x40802010); if (w.GetBlock(bx, by, bz) == B.Lava) sb.Fill(0, 0, W, H, 0xA00050FF); if (p.IsInsideOpaqueBlock() && !p.Spectator) sb.Fill(0, 0, W, H, 0xC0101010); } // winieta sb.Gradient(0, 0, W, H / 6f, 0x30000000, 0x00000000); sb.Gradient(0, H - H / 6f, W, H / 6f, 0x00000000, 0x30000000); if (p.SleepTimer > 0) { float a = Math.Min(1f, p.SleepTimer / 100f); if (p.SleepTimer > 100) a = 1f - (p.SleepTimer - 100) / 10f; sb.Fill(0, 0, W, H, SpriteBatch.Col(16, 16, 32, (int)(a * 204))); } if (p.Dead) return; // celownik (odwrócenie kolorów) if (CameraMode == 0 && !p.Spectator) { sb.Flush(); GL.BlendFunc(BlendingFactor.OneMinusDstColor, BlendingFactor.OneMinusSrcColor); sb.DrawPx(Gui.Icons, W / 2 - 7, H / 2 - 7, 0, 0, 15, 15); sb.Flush(); GL.BlendFuncSeparate(BlendingFactorSrc.SrcAlpha, BlendingFactorDest.OneMinusSrcAlpha, BlendingFactorSrc.One, BlendingFactorDest.OneMinusSrcAlpha); } if (ShowDebug) DrawDebug(); if (p.Spectator) { DrawChat(); return; } // hotbar int hx = W / 2 - 91, hy = H - 22; sb.DrawPx(Gui.Widgets, hx, hy, 0, 0, 182, 22); sb.DrawPx(Gui.Widgets, hx - 1 + p.Inventory.SelectedSlot * 20, hy - 1, 0, 22, 24, 24); for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) DrawItem(p.Inventory.Main[i], hx + 3 + i * 20, hy + 3); if (!p.Creative) { // XP int xy = H - 29; sb.DrawPx(Gui.Icons, hx, xy, 0, 64, 182, 5); int fill = (int)(p.XpProgress * 183); if (fill > 0) sb.DrawPx(Gui.Icons, hx, xy, 0, 69, fill, 5); if (p.XpLevel > 0) { string lv = p.XpLevel.ToString(); float lx = W / 2f - sb.Measure(lv) / 2f, ly = xy - 6; sb.Text(lv, lx + 1, ly, 0xFF000000, false); sb.Text(lv, lx - 1, ly, 0xFF000000, false); sb.Text(lv, lx, ly + 1, 0xFF000000, false); sb.Text(lv, lx, ly - 1, 0xFF000000, false); sb.Text(lv, lx, ly, 0xFF20FF80, false); } // serca int hp = (int)Math.Ceiling(p.Health); bool blink = p.HurtResistantTime > 10 && (p.HurtResistantTime / 3) % 2 == 1; var r = new Rng(_tickCount * 312871); int heartY = H - 39; for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) { int x = hx + i * 8, y = heartY; if (hp <= 4) y += r.Next(2); if (p.RegenEffect > 0 && (int)(_tickCount % 25) == i) y -= 2; sb.DrawPx(Gui.Icons, x, y, blink ? GuiTextures.HeartBlinkEmpty : GuiTextures.HeartEmpty, 0, 9, 9); if (i * 2 + 1 < hp) sb.DrawPx(Gui.Icons, x, y, GuiTextures.HeartFull, 0, 9, 9); else if (i * 2 + 1 == hp) sb.DrawPx(Gui.Icons, x, y, GuiTextures.HeartHalf, 0, 9, 9); } // zbroja int armor = p.ArmorValue; if (armor > 0) for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) { int x = hx + i * 8, y = heartY - 10; int u = i * 2 + 1 < armor ? 34 : i * 2 + 1 == armor ? 25 : 16; sb.DrawPx(Gui.Icons, x, y, u, 9, 9, 9); } // głód bool hunger = p.HungerEffect > 0; for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) { int x = W / 2 + 91 - i * 8 - 9, y = heartY; if (p.Saturation <= 0 && _tickCount % (p.FoodLevel * 3 + 1) == 0) y += r.Next(3) - 1; sb.DrawPx(Gui.Icons, x, y, 16, 27, 9, 9); int fu = hunger ? 88 : 52; if (i * 2 + 1 < p.FoodLevel) sb.DrawPx(Gui.Icons, x, y, fu, 27, 9, 9); else if (i * 2 + 1 == p.FoodLevel) sb.DrawPx(Gui.Icons, x, y, fu + 9, 27, 9, 9); } // bąbelki if (p.IsHeadInWater() || p.Air < 300) { int full = (int)Math.Ceiling((p.Air - 2) * 10.0 / 300.0); int pop = (int)Math.Ceiling(p.Air * 10.0 / 300.0) - full; for (int i = 0; i < full + pop; i++) sb.DrawPx(Gui.Icons, W / 2 + 91 - i * 8 - 9, heartY - 10, i < full ? 16 : 25, 18, 9, 9); } } // nazwa przedmiotu if (_itemNameTicks > 0 && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(_itemName)) { float a = Math.Min(1f, _itemNameTicks * 256f / 10f / 255f); sb.TextCentered(_itemName, W / 2f, H - (p.Creative ? 45 : 59), SpriteBatch.Alpha(0xFFFFFFFF, a)); } DrawChat(); if (Settings.ShowFps && !ShowDebug) sb.Text(_fps + " fps", 2, 2, 0xFFFFFFFF); }

nodes.name: DrawChat
nodes.signature: private void DrawChat()
nodes.body_text: private void DrawChat() { bool open = _screen is ChatScreen; int H = GuiH; int y = H - 48; int shown = 0; for (int i = _chat.Count - 1; i >= 0 && shown < (open ? 20 : 10); i--) { var (text, time) = _chat[i]; long age = _tickCount - time; if (!open && age > 200) break; float a = open ? 1f : Math.Clamp((200 - age) / 20f, 0, 1); Sb.Fill(2, y - 1, 320, 10, SpriteBatch.Col(0, 0, 0, (int)(128 * a))); Sb.Text(text, 4, y, SpriteBatch.Alpha(0xFFFFFFFF, a)); y -= 10; shown++; } }

nodes.name: DrawDebug
nodes.signature: private void DrawDebug()
nodes.body_text: private void DrawDebug() { var p = Player; var w = World; int bx = MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.X), by = MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.Y), bz = MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.Z); string[] facing = { "południe (+Z)", "zachód (-X)", "północ (-Z)", "wschód (+X)" }; var lines = new List<string> { $"BlockCraft 1.0 ({_fps} fps, {Renderer.PendingMeshes} oczek. mesh)", $"C: {Renderer.RenderedSections}/{Renderer.TotalSections} sekcji, E: {w.Entities.Count}, P: {Renderer.Particles.Count}", $"Chunki: {w.Chunks.Count} załad., {w.ChunkManager.PendingCount} w kolejce", "", $"XYZ: {p.X:F3} / {p.Y:F5} / {p.Z:F3}", $"Blok: {bx} {by} {bz} Chunk: {bx & 15} {by & 15} {bz & 15} w {bx >> 4} {by >> 4} {bz >> 4}", $"Kierunek: {facing[Dir.HorizFromYaw(p.Yaw)]} ({MathUtil.WrapDegrees(p.Yaw):F1} / {p.Pitch:F1})", $"Biom: {Biome.Name(w.GetBiome(bx, bz))}", $"Światło: {w.GetLight(bx, by, bz)} (niebo: {w.GetSkyLight(bx, by, bz)}, blok: {w.GetBlockLight(bx, by, bz)})", $"Dzień {w.DayTime / 24000}, czas {w.DayTime % 24000}", $"Ziarno: {w.Seed}", }; if (Ctrl.Hit.Hit) { var h = Ctrl.Hit; lines.Add($"Cel: {h.X} {h.Y} {h.Z} {Block.Get(w.GetBlock(h.X, h.Y, h.Z)).Key} [{w.GetMeta(h.X, h.Y, h.Z)}]"); } for (int i = 0; i < lines.Count; i++) { if (lines[i].Length == 0) continue; Sb.Fill(1, 1 + i * 9, Sb.Measure(lines[i]) + 2, 9, 0x90505050); Sb.Text(lines[i], 2, 2 + i * 9, 0xFFE0E0E0, false); } }

nodes.name: TakeScreenshot
nodes.signature: public string TakeScreenshot(string path)
nodes.body_text: public string TakeScreenshot(string path) { int w = FramebufferSize.X, h = FramebufferSize.Y; var px = new byte[w * h * 4]; GL.ReadBuffer(ReadBufferMode.Back); GL.ReadPixels(0, 0, w, h, PixelFormat.Rgba, PixelType.UnsignedByte, px); var flip = new byte[px.Length]; for (int y = 0; y < h; y++) System.Buffer.BlockCopy(px, (h - 1 - y) * w * 4, flip, y * w * 4, w * 4); for (int i = 3; i < flip.Length; i += 4) flip[i] = 255; if (path == null) { var dir = Path.Combine(WorldStorage.Root, "screenshots"); Directory.CreateDirectory(dir); path = Path.Combine(dir, DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd_HH.mm.ss") + ".png"); } Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(path)); using (var fs = File.Create(path)) new StbImageWriteSharp.ImageWriter().WritePng(flip, w, h, StbImageWriteSharp.ColorComponents.RedGreenBlueAlpha, fs); if (World != null) AddChat("Zapisano zrzut ekranu jako " + Path.GetFileName(path)); return path; }

nodes.name: Game
nodes.signature: public sealed partial class Game
nodes.body_text: public sealed partial class Game { private const int ShowcaseFrameWidth = 640; private readonly bool _showcase; private string _recScene; private int _recTicks, _recEvery, _recNext, _recIndex; private long _recStart, _recSeen; private Action<int> _recPerTick; private bool Scripted => _autotest || _showcase; /// <summary>Nagrywa scenę przez <paramref name="ticks"/> ticków, klatka co <paramref name="every"/> ticków.</summary> private void Record(string scene, int ticks, int every, Action start = null, Action<int> perTick = null) { Step(1, () => { start?.Invoke(); _recScene = scene; _recTicks = ticks; _recEvery = every; _recNext = 0; _recIndex = 0; _recStart = _recSeen = _tickCount; _recPerTick = perTick; Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(_shotDir, scene)); }); WaitUntil(() => _recScene == null); } private double? _holdY; private readonly List<(int x, int z)> _usedStages = new(); private void ShowcaseFrame() { if (_holdY is double hy && Player != null) { Player.Y = Player.PrevY = hy; Player.MotionY = 0; Player.Flying = true; } if (_recScene != null) { while (_recSeen < _tickCount && _recSeen - _recStart < _recTicks) { _recSeen++; try { _recPerTick?.Invoke((int)(_recSeen - _recStart)); } catch (Exception ex) { Log.Error("Showcase: " + ex); } } if (_recSeen - _recStart >= _recNext) { CaptureFrame(); _recNext += _recEvery; } if (_recSeen - _recStart >= _recTicks) { Log.Info($"SHOWCASE {_recScene}: {_recIndex} klatek"); _recScene = null; } return; } AutotestStep(); } /// <summary>Zrzut bieżącej klatki pomniejszony (uśrednianie bloków) do szerokości ShowcaseFrameWidth.</summary> private void CaptureFrame() { int w = FramebufferSize.X, h = FramebufferSize.Y; var px = new byte[w * h * 4]; GL.ReadBuffer(ReadBufferMode.Back); GL.ReadPixels(0, 0, w, h, PixelFormat.Rgba, PixelType.UnsignedByte, px); int f = Math.Max(1, w / ShowcaseFrameWidth), ow = w / f, oh = h / f; var outPx = new byte[ow * oh * 4]; for (int y = 0; y < oh; y++) for (int x = 0; x < ow; x++) { int r = 0, g = 0, b = 0; for (int sy = 0; sy < f; sy++) for (int sx = 0; sx < f; sx++) { int i = (((h - 1 - (y * f + sy)) * w) + x * f + sx) * 4; r += px[i]; g += px[i + 1]; b += px[i + 2]; } int n = f * f, o = (y * ow + x) * 4; outPx[o] = (byte)(r / n); outPx[o + 1] = (byte)(g / n); outPx[o + 2] = (byte)(b / n); outPx[o + 3] = 255; } string path = Path.Combine(_shotDir, _recScene, (_recIndex++).ToString("D4") + ".png"); using var fs = File.Create(path); new StbImageWriteSharp.ImageWriter().WritePng(outPx, ow, oh, StbImageWriteSharp.ColorComponents.RedGreenBlueAlpha, fs); } private void Snap(string name) { _chat.Clear(); Shot(name); _chat.Clear(); } private int GroundY(int x, int z) { int y = Chunk.Height - 1; while (y > 0 && !Block.Get(World.GetBlock(x, y, z)).Solid) y--; return y; } private void Summon(string mob, double x, double y, double z) => Cmds.Execute(Player, $"/summon {mob} {x.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} {y.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} {z.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}"); /// <summary>Szuka płaskiego, trawiastego terenu (bez wody) w pobliżu (x0,z0), z dala od wcześniej użytych scen.</summary> private (int x, int z) FindFlat(int x0, int z0, int radius = 8, int search = 48) { (int x, int z) best = (x0, z0); int bestScore = int.MaxValue; for (int dx = -search; dx <= search; dx += 4) for (int dz = -search; dz <= search; dz += 4) { int x = x0 + dx, z = z0 + dz; if (_usedStages.Any(u => Math.Abs(u.x - x) < 28 && Math.Abs(u.z - z) < 28)) continue; if (World.GetChunk(x >> 4, z >> 4) == null) continue; int g = GroundY(x, z); if (World.GetBlock(x, g, z) != B.Grass) continue; int score = 0; for (int ox = -radius; ox <= radius && score < bestScore; ox += 2) for (int oz = -radius; oz <= radius; oz += 2) { int gy = GroundY(x + ox, z + oz); byte top = World.GetBlock(x + ox, gy, z + oz), above = World.GetBlock(x + ox, gy + 1, z + oz); score += Math.Abs(gy - g) * 4 + (Block.Get(top).IsLiquid || Block.Get(above).IsLiquid ? 50 : 0) + (top == B.OakLeaves || top == B.BirchLeaves ? 6 : 0); } score += (Math.Abs(dx) + Math.Abs(dz)) / 8; if (score < bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = (x, z); } } _usedStages.Add(best); return best; } /// <summary>Kierunek "przód" gracza zaokrąglony do osi świata oraz "prawo".</summary> private (int fx, int fz, int rx, int rz) Axes() { var (lx, _, lz) = Player.Look(); int fx = 0, fz = 0; if (Math.Abs(lx) > Math.Abs(lz)) fx = Math.Sign(lx); else fz = Math.Sign(lz); return (fx, fz, -fz, fx); } /// <summary>Ustawia gracza na ziemi w (x,z) patrzącego wzdłuż osi (yaw), z wyczyszczonym terenem przed nim.</summary> private (int x, int y, int z) Stage(int x, int z, float yaw, float pitch, int clear = 0, double lift = 0) { (x, z) = FindFlat(x, z, Math.Max(clear, 6)); int y = GroundY(x, z) + 1; Player.Flying = false; _holdY = lift > 0 ? y + lift : null; foreach (var e in World.Entities.ToList()) if (e is not Entities.Player) e.Kill(); Player.SetPositionAndPrev(x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5); Player.Yaw = Player.PrevYaw = yaw;

nodes.body_text: private void ShowcaseFrame() { if (_holdY is double hy && Player != null) { Player.Y = Player.PrevY = hy; Player.MotionY = 0; Player.Flying = true; } if (_recScene != null) { while (_recSeen < _tickCount && _recSeen - _recStart < _recTicks) { _recSeen++; try { _recPerTick?.Invoke((int)(_recSeen - _recStart)); } catch (Exception ex) { Log.Error("Showcase: " + ex); } } if (_recSeen - _recStart >= _recNext) { CaptureFrame(); _recNext += _recEvery; } if (_recSeen - _recStart >= _recTicks) { Log.Info($"SHOWCASE {_recScene}: {_recIndex} klatek"); _recScene = null; } return; } AutotestStep(); }

nodes.name: CaptureFrame
nodes.signature: private void CaptureFrame()
nodes.body_text: private void CaptureFrame() { int w = FramebufferSize.X, h = FramebufferSize.Y; var px = new byte[w * h * 4]; GL.ReadBuffer(ReadBufferMode.Back); GL.ReadPixels(0, 0, w, h, PixelFormat.Rgba, PixelType.UnsignedByte, px); int f = Math.Max(1, w / ShowcaseFrameWidth), ow = w / f, oh = h / f; var outPx = new byte[ow * oh * 4]; for (int y = 0; y < oh; y++) for (int x = 0; x < ow; x++) { int r = 0, g = 0, b = 0; for (int sy = 0; sy < f; sy++) for (int sx = 0; sx < f; sx++) { int i = (((h - 1 - (y * f + sy)) * w) + x * f + sx) * 4; r += px[i]; g += px[i + 1]; b += px[i + 2]; } int n = f * f, o = (y * ow + x) * 4; outPx[o] = (byte)(r / n); outPx[o + 1] = (byte)(g / n); outPx[o + 2] = (byte)(b / n); outPx[o + 3] = 255; } string path = Path.Combine(_shotDir, _recScene, (_recIndex++).ToString("D4") + ".png"); using var fs = File.Create(path); new StbImageWriteSharp.ImageWriter().WritePng(outPx, ow, oh, StbImageWriteSharp.ColorComponents.RedGreenBlueAlpha, fs); }

nodes.signature: public override void MouseDown(int mx, int my, int btn)
nodes.body_text: public override void MouseDown(int mx, int my, int btn) { int slot = SlotAt(mx, my); bool outside = mx < Left || my < Top || mx >= Left + C.Width || my >= Top + C.Height; bool shift = G.IsShiftDown; if (btn == 2) { if (slot >= 0) C.Click(slot, 2, ClickType.Clone, P); return; } if (slot < 0) { if (outside) C.Click(-999, btn, ClickType.Pickup, P); return; } if (shift) { C.Click(slot, btn, ClickType.QuickMove, P); return; } if (btn == 0 && slot == _lastClickSlot && Environment.TickCount64 - _lastClickTime < 250 && P.Cursor != null) { C.Click(slot, 0, ClickType.PickupAll, P); _lastClickSlot = -1; return; } _lastClickSlot = slot; _lastClickTime = Environment.TickCount64; if (P.Cursor != null && !C.Slots[slot].IsOutput) { _dragging = true; _dragBtn = btn; _drag.Clear(); _drag.Add(slot); return; } C.Click(slot, btn, ClickType.Pickup, P); }

nodes.name: MouseMove
nodes.signature: public override void MouseMove(int mx, int my)
nodes.body_text: public override void MouseMove(int mx, int my) { if (!_dragging) return; int slot = SlotAt(mx, my); if (slot >= 0 && !_drag.Contains(slot) && !C.Slots[slot].IsOutput && P.Cursor != null) { var st = C.Slots[slot].Stack; if (st == null || st.CanStackWith(P.Cursor)) _drag.Add(slot); } }

nodes.name: MouseUp
nodes.signature: public override void MouseUp(int mx, int my, int btn)
nodes.body_text: public override void MouseUp(int mx, int my, int btn) { if (!_dragging || btn != _dragBtn) return; _dragging = false; if (_drag.Count == 1) C.Click(_drag[0], btn, ClickType.Pickup, P); else if (_drag.Count > 1) C.Distribute(_drag.ToList(), btn, P); _drag.Clear(); }

nodes.name: KeyDown
nodes.signature: public override void KeyDown(Keys k, bool ctrl, bool shift)
nodes.body_text: public override void KeyDown(Keys k, bool ctrl, bool shift) { if (k == Keys.Escape || k == Keys.E) { G.SetScreen(null); return; } int slot = SlotAt(G.MouseGuiX, G.MouseGuiY); if (k >= Keys.D1 && k <= Keys.D9 && slot >= 0) { C.Click(slot, k - Keys.D1, ClickType.Swap, P); return; } if (k == Keys.Q && slot >= 0) { C.Click(slot, ctrl ? 1 : 0, ClickType.Throw, P); return; } }

nodes.signature: public override void Tick()
nodes.body_text: public override void Tick() { if (C is FurnaceContainer fc && P.World.GetTileEntity(fc.Furnace.X, fc.Furnace.Y, fc.Furnace.Z) != fc.Furnace) G.SetScreen(null); if (C is WorkbenchContainer wb && P.World.GetBlock(wb.Bx, wb.By, wb.Bz) != B.CraftingTable) G.SetScreen(null); if (C is ChestContainer ch && ch.Chest is TileEntity te && P.World.GetTileEntity(te.X, te.Y, te.Z) != te) G.SetScreen(null); }

nodes.signature: private static Texture2D MakeLogo()
nodes.body_text: private static Texture2D MakeLogo() { const string text = "BLOCKCRAFT"; const int px = 6, depth = 4; int cols = text.Length * 6 - 1; int w = cols * px + depth + 2, h = 6 * px + depth + 2; LogoW = w; LogoH = h; var grid = new bool[cols, 6]; for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++) { var L = BigLetters[text[i]]; for (int y = 0; y < 6; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 5; x++) if (L[y][x] == '#') grid[i * 6 + x, y] = true; } var p = new uint[w * h]; var stone = TextureGen.Get("stone"); var r = new Rng(4); // ekstruzja (cień 3D) for (int gy = 0; gy < 6; gy++) for (int gx = 0; gx < cols; gx++) { if (!grid[gx, gy]) continue; for (int d = 1; d <= depth; d++) for (int y = 0; y < px; y++) for (int x = 0; x < px; x++) { int X = gx * px + x + d, Y = gy * px + y + d; float shade = 0.28f - d * 0.02f; p[Y * w + X] = TextureGen.Mul(stone[((Y) & 15) * 16 + (X & 15)], shade); } } // przód for (int gy = 0; gy < 6; gy++) for (int gx = 0; gx < cols; gx++) { if (!grid[gx, gy]) continue; for (int y = 0; y < px; y++) for (int x = 0; x < px; x++) { int X = gx * px + x, Y = gy * px + y; uint c = stone[(Y & 15) * 16 + (X & 15)]; float f = 1.15f; if (y == 0 && (gy == 0 || !grid[gx, gy - 1])) f = 1.45f; if (x == 0 && (gx == 0 || !grid[gx - 1, gy])) f = 1.3f; if (y == px - 1 && (gy == 5 || !grid[gx, gy + 1])) f = 0.75f; if (x == px - 1 && (gx == cols - 1 || !grid[gx + 1, gy])) f = 0.85f; p[Y * w + X] = TextureGen.Mul(c, f); } } // czarny kontur var outP = (uint[])p.Clone(); for (int y = 0; y < h; y++) for (int x = 0; x < w; x++) { if (p[y * w + x] != 0) continue; bool n = false; for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1 && !n; dy++) for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) { int xx = x + dx, yy = y + dy; if (xx >= 0 && yy >= 0 && xx < w && yy < h && p[yy * w + xx] != 0) { n = true; break; } } if (n) outP[y * w + x] = C(0x000000, 220); } return new Texture2D(w, h, outP); }

"Nowy świat", oldSeed = _seed?.Text ?? "Domyślny" : "Superpłaski"), () => _type = 1 - _type)); Add(new Button(W / 2 - 155, 148, 150, 20, () => "Komendy: " + (_cheats ? "TAK" : "NIE"), () => _cheats = !_cheats) ); Add(new Button(W / 2 - 155, H - 28, 150, 20, "Stwórz nowy świat", Create)); Add(new Button(W / 2 + 5, H - 28, 150, 20, "Anuluj", () => G.SetScreen(_parent))); _name.OnEnter = Create; } protected override void Escape() => G.SetScreen(_parent); private void Create() { long seed; string s = _seed.Text.Trim(); if (s.Length == 0) seed = Random.Shared.NextInt64(); else if (!long.TryParse(s, out seed)) { seed = 0; foreach (char c in s) seed = seed * 31 + c; } G.CreateWorld(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_name.Text) ? nodes.body_text: public sealed class Button : Widget { public Func<string> Text; public Action OnClick; public Button(int x, int y, int w, int h, string text, Action click) { X = x; Y = y; W = w; H = h; Text = () => text; OnClick = click; } public Button(int x, int y, int w, int h, Func<string> text, Action click) { X = x; Y = y; W = w; H = h; Text = text; OnClick = click; } public static void DrawButton(Game g, int x, int y, int w, int h, int state) { var sb = g.Sb; var t = g.Gui.Widgets; int ty = GuiTextures.BtnY + state * 20; int half = w / 2; sb.DrawPx(t, x, y, 0, ty, half, h / 2); sb.DrawPx(t, x + half, y, 200 - (w - half), ty, w - half, h / 2); sb.DrawPx(t, x, y + h / 2, 0, ty + 20 - (h - h / 2), half, h - h / 2); sb.DrawPx(t, x + half, y + h / 2, 200 - (w - half), ty + 20 - (h - h / 2), w - half, h - h / 2); } public override void Draw(Game g, int mx, int my) { if (!Visible) return; int st = !Enabled ? 0 : Hover(mx, my) ? 2 : 1; DrawButton(g, X, Y, W, H, st); uint col = !Enabled ? 0xFFA0A0A0 : Hover(mx, my) ? 0xFFA0FFFF : 0xFFE0E0E0; g.Sb.TextCentered(Text(), X + W / 2f, Y + (H - 8) / 2f, col); } public override bool MouseDown(Game g, int mx, int my, int btn) { if (btn != 0 || !Enabled || !Hover(mx, my)) return false; g.PlayUiClick(); OnClick?.Invoke(); return true; } }

nodes.body_text: public sealed class TextField : Widget { public string Text = ""; public bool Focused; public int MaxLength = 64; public string Placeholder = ""; private int _cursorBlink; public Action OnEnter; public TextField(int x, int y, int w, int h) { X = x; Y = y; W = w; H = h; } public override void Draw(Game g, int mx, int my) { var sb = g.Sb; sb.Fill(X - 1, Y - 1, W + 2, H + 2, Focused ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFFA0A0A0); sb.Fill(X, Y, W, H, 0xFF000000); string t = Text; while (sb.Measure(t) > W - 8 && t.Length > 0) t = t[1..]; if (Text.Length == 0 && !Focused) sb.Text(Placeholder, X + 4, Y + (H - 8) / 2f, 0xFF707070, false); sb.Text(t, X + 4, Y + (H - 8) / 2f, 0xFFE0E0E0); _cursorBlink++; if (Focused && (_cursorBlink / 30) % 2 == 0) sb.Text("_", X + 4 + sb.Measure(t), Y + (H - 8) / 2f, 0xFFE0E0E0); } public override bool MouseDown(Game g, int mx, int my, int btn) { Focused = Hover(mx, my); return Focused; } public override bool Char(Game g, char c) { if (!Focused || Text.Length >= MaxLength || c < 32) return false; Text += c; return true; } public override bool Key(Game g, Keys k, bool ctrl, bool shift) { if (!Focused) return false; if (k == Keys.Backspace && Text.Length > 0) { Text = ctrl ? "" : Text[..^1]; return true; } if (k == Keys.V && ctrl) { var c = g.GetClipboard(); if (c != null) Text = (Text + c.Replace("\n", "").Replace("\r", "")); if (Text.Length > MaxLength) Text = Text[..MaxLength]; return true; } if (k is Keys.Enter or Keys.KeyPadEnter) { OnEnter?.Invoke(); return true; } return false; } }

nodes.signature: public abstract class Screen
nodes.body_text: public abstract class Screen { public Game G; public int W, H; protected readonly List<Widget> Widgets = new(); public virtual bool PausesGame => true; public virtual bool ShowWorld => true; public void Open(Game g, int w, int h) { G = g; W = w; H = h; Widgets.Clear(); Init(); } protected virtual void Init() { } public virtual void Tick() { } public virtual void OnClose() { } protected T Add<T>(T w) where T : Widget { Widgets.Add(w); return w; } public virtual void Render(int mx, int my, float pt) { foreach (var w in Widgets) if (w.Visible) w.Draw(G, mx, my); } public virtual void MouseDown(int mx, int my, int btn) { foreach (var w in Widgets.ToArray()) if (w.Visible && w.MouseDown(G, mx, my, btn)) { if (w is not TextField) foreach (var o in Widgets) if (o is TextField tf && o != w) tf.Focused = false; return; } foreach (var o in Widgets) if (o is TextField tf && !tf.Hover(mx, my)) tf.Focused = false; } public virtual void MouseUp(int mx, int my, int btn) { foreach (var w in Widgets) w.MouseUp(G, mx, my, btn); } public virtual void MouseMove(int mx, int my) { foreach (var w in Widgets) w.MouseDrag(G, mx, my); } public virtual void Scroll(int mx, int my, float delta) { } public virtual void KeyDown(Keys k, bool ctrl, bool shift) { foreach (var w in Widgets) if (w.Key(G, k, ctrl, shift)) return; if (k == Keys.Escape) Escape(); if (k == Keys.Tab) { var fields = Widgets.OfType<TextField>().ToList(); if (fields.Count > 1) { int i = fields.FindIndex(f => f.Focused); foreach (var f in fields) f.Focused = false; fields[(i + 1) % fields.Count].Focused = true; } } } public virtual void CharTyped(char c) { foreach (var w in Widgets) if (w.Char(G, c)) return; } protected virtual void Escape() => G.SetScreen(null); protected void DrawDirtBackground() { var sb = G.Sb; float s = 32; sb.Draw(G.Gui.Dirt, 0, 0, W, H, 0, 0, W / s, H / s, 0xFF404040); } protected void DrawDim() { G.Sb.Gradient(0, 0, W, H, 0xC0101010, 0xD0101010); } }

nodes.signature: public sealed class PlayerInventory : IInventory
nodes.body_text: public sealed class PlayerInventory : IInventory { public readonly ItemStack[] Main = new ItemStack[36]; public readonly ItemStack[] Armor = new ItemStack[4]; // 0 hełm .. 3 buty public int SelectedSlot; public bool Dirty = true; public int Size => 40; public ItemStack Get(int i) => i < 36 ? Main[i] : Armor[i - 36]; public void Set(int i, ItemStack s) { if (s != null && s.Count <= 0) s = null; if (i < 36) Main[i] = s; else Armor[i - 36] = s; Dirty = true; } public void Changed() { Dirty = true; } public ItemStack Selected { get => Main[SelectedSlot]; set { Main[SelectedSlot] = value != null && value.Count <= 0 ? null : value; Dirty = true; } } /// <summary>Dodaje przedmiot; zmniejsza s.Count o dodaną ilość. Zwraca true gdy wszystko dodano.</summary> public bool Add(ItemStack s) { if (s == null || s.Count <= 0) return true; // dokładanie do istniejących stosów for (int pass = 0; pass < 2 && s.Count > 0; pass++) for (int i = 0; i < 36 && s.Count > 0; i++) { int idx = pass == 0 ? i : i; // hotbar najpierw (0-8 to hotbar) var m = Main[idx]; if (pass == 0 && m != null && m.CanStackWith(s) && m.Count < m.MaxStack) { int n = Math.Min(s.Count, m.MaxStack - m.Count); m.Count += n; s.Count -= n; Dirty = true; } else if (pass == 1 && m == null) { int n = Math.Min(s.Count, s.MaxStack); Main[idx] = s.CopyWith(n); s.Count -= n; Dirty = true; } } return s.Count <= 0; } public int CountOf(int id) { int c = 0; foreach (var s in Main) if (s != null && s.Id == id) c += s.Count; return c; } public bool Consume(int id, int count = 1) { if (CountOf(id) < count) return false; for (int i = 0; i < 36 && count > 0; i++) { var s = Main[i]; if (s == null || s.Id != id) continue; int n = Math.Min(count, s.Count); s.Count -= n; count -= n; if (s.Count <= 0) Main[i] = null; } Dirty = true; return true; } public int ArmorValue { get { int a = 0; foreach (var s in Armor) if (s?.Item != null) a += s.Item.ArmorPoints; return a; } } public void DamageArmor(float damage) { int d = Math.Max(1, (int)(damage / 4)); for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) if (Armor[i] != null && Armor[i].Item?.ArmorSlot >= 0) if (Armor[i].DamageItem(d) || Armor[i].Count <= 0) Armor[i] = null; Dirty = true; } public void Clear() { Array.Clear(Main); Array.Clear(Armor); Dirty = true; } public int FindSlot(int id, int meta = -1) { for (int i = 0; i < 36; i++) if (Main[i] != null && Main[i].Id == id && (meta < 0 || Main[i].Damage == meta)) return i; return -1; } public int FirstEmptyHotbar() { for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) if (Main[i] == null) return i; return -1; } }

nodes.name: Container
nodes.signature: public abstract class Container
nodes.body_text: public abstract class Container { public readonly List<Slot> Slots = new(); public SimpleInventory CraftGrid; public SimpleInventory CraftResult; public int GridW, GridH; public int Width = 176, Height = 166; public string Title = ""; protected PlayerInventory PInv; public int FirstPlayerSlot; // pierwszy slot ekwipunku gracza (27 głównych + 9 hotbar) protected void AddPlayerSlots(PlayerInventory inv, int y0, int hotbarY) { PInv = inv; FirstPlayerSlot = Slots.Count; for (int r = 0; r < 3; r++) for (int c = 0; c < 9; c++) Slots.Add(new Slot(inv, 9 + r * 9 + c, 8 + c * 18, y0 + r * 18)); for (int c = 0; c < 9; c++) Slots.Add(new Slot(inv, c, 8 + c * 18, hotbarY)); } public void UpdateCrafting() { if (CraftGrid == null) return; var res = Recipes.Find(CraftGrid.Slots, GridW, GridH); CraftResult.Set(0, res); } /// <summary>Kliknięcie w slot (logika jak MC). slot = -999 poza oknem.</summary> public void Click(int slotIdx, int button, ClickType type, Player p) { if (type == ClickType.QuickMove && slotIdx >= 0) { var slot = Slots[slotIdx]; if (slot.IsOutput && slot is CraftResultSlot) { // craftuj ile się da var first = slot.Stack; if (first == null) return; for (int guard = 0; guard < 64; guard++) { var s = slot.Stack; if (s == null || s.Id != first.Id) break; var copy = s.Copy(); if (!MergeIntoPlayer(copy, true)) break; MergeIntoPlayer(s.Copy(), false); slot.Inv.Set(0, null); slot.OnTake(p, copy); } } else TransferStack(p, slotIdx); return; } if (type == ClickType.Throw) { if (slotIdx < 0) return; var slot = Slots[slotIdx]; var s = slot.Stack; if (s == null || p.Cursor != null) return; var taken = slot.Take(button == 1 ? s.Count : 1); p.DropStack(taken, false); slot.OnTake(p, taken); return; } if (type == ClickType.Swap) { if (slotIdx < 0) return; var slot = Slots[slotIdx]; var hot = PInv.Main[button]; var s = slot.Stack; if (slot.IsOutput) { if (s != null && hot == null) { PInv.Main[button] = s.Copy(); slot.Inv.Set(slot.Index, null); slot.OnTake(p, s); PInv.Dirty = true; } return; } if (hot != null && !slot.CanPlace(hot)) return; PInv.Main[button] = s; slot.Stack = hot; PInv.Dirty = true; OnSlotChanged(slot); return; } if (type == ClickType.PickupAll) { var cur = p.Cursor; if (cur == null) return; for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) foreach (var sl in Slots) { if (cur.Count >= cur.MaxStack) break; var s = sl.Stack; if (s == null || !s.CanStackWith(cur) || sl.IsOutput) continue; if (pass == 0 && s.Count == s.MaxStack) continue; int n = Math.Min(s.Count, cur.MaxStack - cur.Count); sl.Take(n); cur.Count += n; OnSlotChanged(sl); } return; } if (type == ClickType.Clone) { if (slotIdx < 0 || !p.Creative || p.Cursor != null) return; var s = Slots[slotIdx].Stack; if (s != null) p.Cursor = s.CopyWith(s.MaxStack); return; } // Pickup if (slotIdx == -999) { if (p.Cursor != null) { if (button == 0) { p.DropStack(p.Cursor, true); p.Cursor = null; } else { p.DropStack(p.Cursor.CopyWith(1), true); p.Cursor.Count--; if (p.Cursor.Count <= 0) p.Cursor = null; } } return; } if (slotIdx < 0) return; { var slot = Slots[slotIdx]; var s = slot.Stack; var cur = p.Cursor; if (s == null) { if (cur != null && slot.CanPlace(cur)) { int n = button == 0 ? cur.Count : 1; n = Math.Min(n, slot.MaxStack(cur)); slot.Stack = cur.CopyWith(n); cur.Count -= n; if (cur.Count <= 0) p.Cursor = null; } } else if (cur == null) { int n = button == 0 ? s.Count : (s.Count + 1) / 2; var taken = slot.Take(n); p.Cursor = taken; slot.OnTake(p, taken); } else if (slot.CanPlace(cur)) { if (s.CanStackWith(cur)) { int n = button == 0 ? cur.Count : 1; n = Math.Min(n, Math.Min(slot.MaxStack(cur), s.MaxStack) - s.Count); if (n > 0) { s.Count += n; cur.Count -= n; slot.Stack = s; if (cur.Count <= 0) p.Cursor = null; } } else if (cur.Count <= slot.MaxStack(cur)) { slot.Stack = cur; p.Cursor = s; } } else if (slot.IsOutput && s.CanStackWith(cur)) { if (s.Count + cur.Count <= cur.MaxStack) { cur.Count += s.Count; var taken = s.Copy(); slot.Inv.Set(slot.Index, null); slot.OnTake(p, taken); } } OnSlotChanged(slot); } } /// <summary>Rozkładanie przeciąganiem (lewy: równo, prawy: po 1).</summary> public void Distribute(List<int> slotIdxs, int button, Player p) { var cur = p.Cursor; if (cur == null || slotIdxs.Count == 0) return; var valid = slotIdxs.Where(i => { var sl = Slots[i]; var s = sl.Stack; return sl.CanPlace(cur) && (s == null || s.CanStackWith(cur)); }).ToList(); if (valid.Count == 0) return; int per = button == 0 ? Math.Max(1, cur.Count / valid.Count) : 1; foreach (var i in valid) { if (cur.Count <= 0) break; var sl = Slots[i]; var s = sl.Stack; int have = s?.Count ?? 0; int n = Math.Min(per, Math.Min(cur.Count, Math.Min(sl.MaxStack(cur), cur.MaxStack) - have)); if (n <= 0) continue; if (s == null) sl.Stack = cur.CopyWith(n); else { s.Count += n; sl.Stack = s; } cur.Count -= n; OnSlotChanged(sl); } if (cur.Count <= 0) p.Cursor = null; } protected virtual void OnSlotChanged(Slot s) { if (CraftGrid != null && s.Inv == CraftGrid) UpdateCrafting(); } /// <summary>Scal

nodes.name: MergeIntoPlayer
nodes.signature: protected bool MergeIntoPlayer(ItemStack s, bool simulate)
nodes.body_text: protected bool MergeIntoPlayer(ItemStack s, bool simulate) { int need = s.Count; var tmpCounts = new int[36]; for (int i = 0; i < 36; i++) tmpCounts[i] = PInv.Main[i]?.Count ?? 0; int[] order = Enumerable.Range(0, 9).Reverse().Concat(Enumerable.Range(9, 27)).ToArray(); foreach (var i in order) { var m = PInv.Main[i]; if (m != null && m.CanStackWith(s)) { int n = Math.Min(need, m.MaxStack - tmpCounts[i]); if (n > 0) { need -= n; if (!simulate) m.Count += n; } } if (need <= 0) break; } if (need > 0) foreach (var i in order) if (PInv.Main[i] == null) { if (!simulate) PInv.Main[i] = s.CopyWith(need); need = 0; break; } PInv.Dirty = true; return need <= 0; }

nodes.name: MergeStack
nodes.signature: protected bool MergeStack(ItemStack s, int from, int to, bool reverse)
nodes.body_text: protected bool MergeStack(ItemStack s, int from, int to, bool reverse) { bool moved = false; if (s.MaxStack > 1) { for (int k = 0; k < to - from && s.Count > 0; k++) { int i = reverse ? to - 1 - k : from + k; var sl = Slots[i]; var t = sl.Stack; if (t != null && t.CanStackWith(s) && sl.CanPlace(s)) { int n = Math.Min(s.Count, Math.Min(t.MaxStack, sl.MaxStack(s)) - t.Count); if (n > 0) { t.Count += n; s.Count -= n; sl.Stack = t; moved = true; } } } } for (int k = 0; k < to - from && s.Count > 0; k++) { int i = reverse ? to - 1 - k : from + k; var sl = Slots[i]; if (sl.Stack == null && sl.CanPlace(s)) { int n = Math.Min(s.Count, sl.MaxStack(s)); sl.Stack = s.CopyWith(n); s.Count -= n; moved = true; } } return moved; }

nodes.name: TransferStack
nodes.signature: public virtual void TransferStack(Player p, int idx)
nodes.body_text: public virtual void TransferStack(Player p, int idx) { var slot = Slots[idx]; var s = slot.Stack; if (s == null) return; int ps = FirstPlayerSlot, pe = FirstPlayerSlot + 36; var copy = s.Copy(); if (idx >= ps) { // z gracza do kontenera, albo między główny/hotbar if (!TransferFromPlayer(copy)) { if (idx < ps + 27) MergeStack(copy, ps + 27, pe, false); else MergeStack(copy, ps, ps + 27, false); } } else MergeStack(copy, ps, pe, true); if (copy.Count != s.Count) { int taken = s.Count - copy.Count; var t = slot.Take(taken); slot.OnTake(p, t); OnSlotChanged(slot); } }

UseAction.Eat : Id == I.MilkBucket ? UseAction.Drink : Id == I.Bow ? UseAction.Bow : UseAction.None; public int UseDuration => IsFood || Id == I.MilkBucket ? 32 : Id == I.Bow ? 72000 : 0; public string DisplayName(int meta) => IsBlock && Block.ById[BlockId] != null ? nodes.body_text: public sealed class ItemStack { public int Id; public int Count; public int Damage; public ItemStack(int id, int count = 1, int damage = 0) { Id = id; Count = count; Damage = damage; } public Item Item => Item.ById[Id]; public int MaxStack => Item?.MaxStack ?? 64; public ItemStack Copy() => new(Id, Count, Damage); public ItemStack CopyWith(int count) => new(Id, count, Damage); public bool SameItem(ItemStack o) => o != null && o.Id == Id && (Item?.MaxDamage > 0 || o.Damage == Damage); public bool CanStackWith(ItemStack o) => o != null && o.Id == Id && o.Damage == Damage && (Item?.MaxDamage ?? 0) == 0 && MaxStack > 1; public string Name => Item?.DisplayName(Damage) ?? "?"; public override string ToString() => $"{Count}x {Name}"; /// <summary>Zwraca true gdy przedmiot się zepsuł.</summary> public bool DamageItem(int amount) { var it = Item; if (it == null || it.MaxDamage <= 0) return false; Damage += amount; if (Damage >= it.MaxDamage) { Count--; Damage = 0; return true; } return false; } }

nodes.body_text: public static class Recipes { public static readonly List<Recipe> All = new(); public const int AnyPlanks = -1, AnyLog = -2, AnyCoal = -3; private static bool Matches(int want, int wantMeta, ItemStack s) { if (want == 0) return s == null; if (s == null) return false; if (want == AnyPlanks) return s.Id == B.OakPlanks || s.Id == B.BirchPlanks; if (want == AnyLog) return s.Id == B.OakLog || s.Id == B.BirchLog; if (want == AnyCoal) return s.Id == I.Coal || s.Id == I.Charcoal; return s.Id == want && (wantMeta < 0 || s.Damage == wantMeta); } public static void Shaped(ItemStack result, params object[] def) { var rows = new List<string>(); int i = 0; while (i < def.Length && def[i] is string s) { rows.Add(s); i++; } var key = new Dictionary<char, (int, int)>(); for (; i + 1 < def.Length; i += 2) { char c = (char)def[i]; if (def[i + 1] is ValueTuple<int, int> t) key[c] = t; else key[c] = (Convert.ToInt32(def[i + 1]), -1); } int w = rows.Max(r => r.Length), h = rows.Count; var r = new Recipe { Width = w, Height = h, Pattern = new int[w * h], PatternMeta = new int[w * h], Result = result }; for (int y = 0; y < h; y++) for (int x = 0; x < w; x++) { char c = x < rows[y].Length ? rows[y][x] : ' '; if (c == ' ') { r.Pattern[y * w + x] = 0; r.PatternMeta[y * w + x] = -1; } else { var (id, m) = key[c]; r.Pattern[y * w + x] = id; r.PatternMeta[y * w + x] = m; } } All.Add(r); } public static void Shapeless(ItemStack result, params int[] ids) { All.Add(new Recipe { Shapeless = true, Ingredients = ids.Select(i => (i, -1)).ToList(), Result = result }); } /// <summary>Znajdź wynik dla siatki (grid w x h).</summary> public static ItemStack Find(ItemStack[] grid, int gw, int gh) { // obszar zajęty int minX = gw, minY = gh, maxX = -1, maxY = -1, count = 0; for (int y = 0; y < gh; y++) for (int x = 0; x < gw; x++) if (grid[y * gw + x] != null) { minX = Math.Min(minX, x); maxX = Math.Max(maxX, x); minY = Math.Min(minY, y); maxY = Math.Max(maxY, y); count++; } if (count == 0) return null; int w = maxX - minX + 1, h = maxY - minY + 1; // naprawa narzędzi: dwa takie same uszkodzone narzędzia if (count == 2) { ItemStack a = null, b = null; foreach (var s in grid) if (s != null) { if (a == null) a = s; else b = s; } if (a.Id == b.Id && a.Item?.MaxDamage > 0 && a.Count == 1 && b.Count == 1) { int max = a.Item.MaxDamage; int dur = (max - a.Damage) + (max - b.Damage) + max * 5 / 100; return new ItemStack(a.Id, 1, Math.Max(0, max - dur)); } } foreach (var r in All) { if (r.Shapeless) { if (r.Ingredients.Count != count) continue; var used = new bool[grid.Length]; bool ok = true; foreach (var (id, m) in r.Ingredients) { bool found = false; for (int i = 0; i < grid.Length; i++) if (!used[i] && grid[i] != null && Matches(id, m, grid[i])) { used[i] = true; found = true; break; } if (!found) { ok = false; break; } } if (ok) return r.Result.Copy(); continue; } if (r.Width != w || r.Height != h) continue; for (int mirror = 0; mirror < 2; mirror++) { bool ok = true; for (int y = 0; y < h && ok; y++) for (int x = 0; x < w && ok; x++) { int px = mirror == 1 ? w - 1 - x : x; if (!Matches(r.Pattern[y * w + px], r.PatternMeta[y * w + px], grid[(minY + y) * gw + minX + x])) ok = false; } if (ok) return r.Result.Copy(); } } return null; } private static ItemStack S(int id, int c = 1, int m = 0) => new(id, c, m); public static void Init() { if (All.Count > 0) return; // drewno Shaped(S(B.OakPlanks, 4), "#", '#', B.OakLog); Shaped(S(B.BirchPlanks, 4), "#", '#', B.BirchLog); Shaped(S(I.Stick, 4), "#", "#", '#', AnyPlanks); Shaped(S(B.CraftingTable), "##", "##", '#', AnyPlanks); Shaped(S(B.Furnace), "###", "# #", "###", '#', B.Cobblestone); Shaped(S(B.Chest), "###", "# #", "###", '#', AnyPlanks); Shaped(S(B.Torch, 4), "C", "S", 'C', AnyCoal, 'S', I.Stick); Shaped(S(B.Ladder, 3), "S S", "SSS", "S S", 'S', I.Stick); Shaped(S(B.Fence, 3), "PSP", "PSP", 'P', AnyPlanks, 'S', I.Stick); Shaped(S(B.FenceGate), "SPS", "SPS", 'P', AnyPlanks, 'S', I.Stick); Shaped(S(I.Door, 3), "PP", "PP", "PP", 'P', AnyPlanks); Shaped(S(I.Bed), "WWW", "PPP", 'W', B.Wool, 'P', AnyPlanks); Shaped(S(I.Bowl, 4), "P P", " P ", 'P', AnyPlanks); Shaped(S(B.OakSlab, 6), "PPP", 'P', AnyPlanks); Shaped(S(B.OakStairs, 4), "P ", "PP ", "PPP", 'P', AnyPlanks); Shaped(S(B.Bookshelf), "PPP", "BBB", "PPP", 'P', AnyPlanks, 'B', I.Book); // narzędzia int[] mats = { AnyPlanks, B.Cobblestone, I.IronIngot, I.GoldIngot, I.Diamond }; int[] first = { I.WoodPickaxe, I.StonePickaxe, I.IronPickaxe, I.GoldPickaxe, I.DiamondPickaxe }; for (int m = 0; m < 5; m++) { int X = mats[m], f = first[m]; Shaped(S(f + 0), "XXX", " S ", " S ", 'X', X, 'S', I.Stick); Shaped(S(f + 1), "XX", "XS", " S", 'X', X, 'S', I.Stick); Shaped(S(f + 2), "X", "S", "S", 'X', X, 'S', I.Stick); Shaped(S(f + 3), "X", "X", "S", 'X', X, 'S', I.Stick); Shaped(S(f + 4), "XX", " S", " S", 'X', X, 'S', I.Stick); } Shaped(S(I.Shears), " #", "# ", '#', I.IronIngot); Shaped(S(I.Bucket), "# #", " # ", '#', I.IronIngot); Shapeless(S(I.FlintAndSteel), I.IronIn

nodes.body_text: public static class Smelting { public static readonly Dictionary<int, (ItemStack result, float xp)> Table = new(); public static void Init() { if (Table.Count > 0) return; void Add(int input, int output, float xp, int count = 1) => Table[input] = (new ItemStack(output, count), xp); Add(B.IronOre, I.IronIngot, 0.7f); Add(B.GoldOre, I.GoldIngot, 1f); Add(B.DiamondOre, I.Diamond, 1f); Add(B.CoalOre, I.Coal, 0.1f); Add(B.RedstoneOre, I.Redstone, 0.7f, 4); Add(B.LapisOre, I.Lapis, 0.2f, 4); Add(B.Sand, B.Glass, 0.1f); Add(B.Cobblestone, B.Stone, 0.1f); Add(B.OakLog, I.Charcoal, 0.15f); Add(B.BirchLog, I.Charcoal, 0.15f); Add(I.RawPorkchop, I.CookedPorkchop, 0.35f); Add(I.RawBeef, I.Steak, 0.35f); Add(I.RawChicken, I.CookedChicken, 0.35f); Add(I.RawMutton, I.CookedMutton, 0.35f); Add(I.ClayBall, I.Brick, 0.3f); Add(B.Clay, B.Bricks, 0.3f); Add(B.Cactus, B.Wool, 0.2f); // brak barwników – kaktus zamiast zielonego barwnika nieużywany Table.Remove(B.Cactus); } public static ItemStack Result(ItemStack input) => input != null && Table.TryGetValue(input.Id, out var r) ? r.result : null; public static float Xp(ItemStack input) => input != null && Table.TryGetValue(input.Id, out var r) ? r.xp : 0; public static int BurnTime(ItemStack s) { if (s == null) return 0; int id = s.Id; if (id == I.Coal || id == I.Charcoal) return 1600; if (id == B.CoalBlock) return 16000; if (id == I.LavaBucket) return 20000; if (id == I.Stick) return 100; if (id == B.OakPlanks || id == B.BirchPlanks || id == B.OakLog || id == B.BirchLog || id == B.CraftingTable || id == B.Chest || id == B.Fence || id == B.FenceGate || id == B.OakStairs || id == B.Bookshelf || id == B.Ladder) return 300; if (id == B.OakSlab) return 150; if (id == B.OakSapling || id == B.BirchSapling) return 100; if (id == B.Wool) return 100; var it = s.Item; if (it != null && it.IsTool && it.ToolLevel == 0 && it.MaxDamage == 59) return 200; // drewniane narzędzia if (id == I.Bow) return 300; return 0; } }

nodes.body_text: public sealed class FurnaceTileEntity : TileEntity, IInventory { public static bool Swapping; public readonly ItemStack[] Slots = new ItemStack[3]; public int BurnTime, CurrentItemBurnTime, CookTime; public float StoredXp; public const int CookTotal = 200; public override int TypeId => 1; public int Size => 3; public ItemStack Get(int i) => Slots[i]; public void Set(int i, ItemStack s) { Slots[i] = s != null && s.Count <= 0 ? null : s; } public void Changed() { Dirty = true; } public bool Dirty; public bool IsBurning => BurnTime > 0; private bool CanSmelt() { var input = Slots[0]; if (input == null) return false; var res = Smelting.Result(input); if (res == null) return false; var o = Slots[2]; if (o == null) return true; if (!o.CanStackWith(res)) return false; return o.Count + res.Count <= o.MaxStack; } public override void Tick(World.World w) { bool was = BurnTime > 0; bool changed = false; if (BurnTime > 0) BurnTime--; if (w.IsRemote) return; if (BurnTime == 0 && CanSmelt()) { CurrentItemBurnTime = BurnTime = Smelting.BurnTime(Slots[1]); if (BurnTime > 0) { changed = true; if (Slots[1].Id == I.LavaBucket) Slots[1] = new ItemStack(I.Bucket); else { Slots[1].Count--; if (Slots[1].Count <= 0) Slots[1] = null; } } } if (BurnTime > 0 && CanSmelt()) { CookTime++; if (CookTime >= CookTotal) { CookTime = 0; var res = Smelting.Result(Slots[0]); StoredXp += Smelting.Xp(Slots[0]); if (Slots[2] == null) Slots[2] = res.Copy(); else Slots[2].Count += res.Count; Slots[0].Count--; if (Slots[0].Count <= 0) Slots[0] = null; changed = true; } } else if (CookTime > 0) CookTime = Math.Max(0, CookTime - 2); if (was != BurnTime > 0) { changed = true; int meta = w.GetMeta(X, Y, Z); Swapping = true; try { w.SetBlock(X, Y, Z, BurnTime > 0 ? B.FurnaceLit : B.Furnace, meta); } finally { Swapping = false; } w.SetTileEntity(X, Y, Z, this); } if (changed) { Dirty = true; var c = w.GetChunk(X >> 4, Z >> 4); if (c != null) c.Modified = true; } } public override void Save(BinaryWriter bw) { foreach (var s in Slots) bw.WriteStack(s); bw.Write(BurnTime); bw.Write(CurrentItemBurnTime); bw.Write(CookTime); bw.Write(StoredXp); } public override void Load(BinaryReader br) { for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) Slots[i] = br.ReadStack(); BurnTime = br.ReadInt32(); CurrentItemBurnTime = br.ReadInt32(); CookTime = br.ReadInt32(); StoredXp = br.ReadSingle(); } }

nodes.body_text: public sealed class PlayerController { private readonly Game _g; public World.World W => _g.World; public Player P => _g.Player; public float BreakProgress; public int BreakX, BreakY, BreakZ = int.MinValue; private int _breakSoundTicks; public int BlockHitDelay, RightClickDelay; public World.World.HitResult Hit; public Entity HitEntity; public bool LeftWasDown; public PlayerController(Game g) { _g = g; } public double Reach => P.Creative ? 5.0 : 4.5; public void UpdateTarget(float pt) { var p = P; double ex = p.IX(pt), ey = p.IY(pt) + p.EyeHeight, ez = p.IZ(pt); var (lx, ly, lz) = p.Look(pt); Hit = W.RayCast(ex, ey, ez, lx, ly, lz, Reach); HitEntity = null; double best = Hit.Hit ? Hit.Distance : Reach; double er = p.Creative ? 5 : 3; if (best > er) best = er; foreach (var e in W.Entities) { if (e == p || !e.CanBeAttacked || e.Removed) continue; if (e.DistanceSq(ex, ey, ez) > 64) continue; var bb = e.BoundingBox.Grow(0.1); if (bb.Contains(ex, ey, ez)) { HitEntity = e; best = 0; continue; } if (bb.RayIntersect(ex, ey, ez, lx, ly, lz, out double t, out _) && t < best) { best = t; HitEntity = e; } } if (HitEntity != null) Hit.Hit = false; } public int BreakStage => BreakProgress > 0 && BreakX != int.MinValue ? (int)(BreakProgress * 10) - 1 : -1; public static float BreakDelta(Player p, Block b, ItemStack tool) { if (b.Hardness < 0) return 0; if (b.Hardness == 0) return 1; float f = b.GetDigSpeed(tool); if (p.IsHeadInWater()) f /= 5f; if (!p.OnGround && !p.Flying) f /= 5f; return b.CanHarvest(tool) ? f / b.Hardness / 30f : f / b.Hardness / 100f; } public void ResetBreak() { BreakProgress = 0; BreakX = int.MinValue; } /// <summary>Wywoływane co tick, gdy LPM jest wciśnięty.</summary> public void TickLeft(bool pressedNow) { var p = P; if (p.Spectator) return; if (pressedNow) { p.SwingArm(); if (HitEntity != null) { p.AttackEntity(HitEntity); ResetBreak(); return; } } if (!Hit.Hit) { ResetBreak(); if (!pressedNow) { } return; } if (BlockHitDelay > 0) { BlockHitDelay--; return; } int x = Hit.X, y = Hit.Y, z = Hit.Z; var b = Block.Get(W.GetBlock(x, y, z)); if (b.Id == 0) return; var tool = p.Inventory.Selected; if (p.Creative) { if (tool?.Item?.Tool == ToolType.Sword) return; if (!pressedNow && BlockHitDelay > 0) return; DestroyBlock(x, y, z, false); BlockHitDelay = 5; p.SwingArm(); return; } if (x != BreakX || y != BreakY || z != BreakZ) { BreakX = x; BreakY = y; BreakZ = z; BreakProgress = 0; b.OnClicked(W, x, y, z, p); } BreakProgress += BreakDelta(p, b, tool); p.SwingArm(); if (_breakSoundTicks++ % 4 == 0) { W.PlaySound("step_" + b.Sound.ToString().ToLowerInvariant(), x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5, 0.25f, 0.5f); _g.Renderer.BlockCrackParticle(x, y, z, Hit.Face); } if (BreakProgress >= 1f) { bool harvest = b.CanHarvest(tool); DestroyBlock(x, y, z, harvest); ResetBreak(); BlockHitDelay = 5; if (tool?.Item != null && tool.Item.IsTool && b.Hardness > 0) p.DamageHeld(tool.Item.Tool == ToolType.Sword ? 2 : 1); p.AddExhaustion(0.025f); } } private void DestroyBlock(int x, int y, int z, bool drop) { var b = Block.Get(W.GetBlock(x, y, z)); int meta = W.GetMeta(x, y, z); var tool = P.Inventory.Selected; if (!P.Creative) b.OnDestroyedByPlayer(W, x, y, z, meta, P); // liście: ścinanie sąsiadów przyspiesza zanik if (b.Id == B.OakLog || b.Id == B.BirchLog) for (int dx = -4; dx <= 4; dx++) for (int dy = -4; dy <= 4; dy++) for (int dz = -4; dz <= 4; dz++) { int id = W.GetBlock(x + dx, y + dy, z + dz); if ((id == B.OakLeaves || id == B.BirchLeaves) && W.Rand.Next(3) == 0) W.ScheduleTick(x + dx, y + dy, z + dz, (byte)id, 20 + W.Rand.Next(200)); } W.BreakBlock(x, y, z, drop && !P.Creative, P, tool); } /// <summary>PPM: co 4 ticki gdy trzymany.</summary> public void TickRight(bool pressedNow) { var p = P; if (p.Spectator) return; if (RightClickDelay > 0 && !pressedNow) { RightClickDelay--; return; } if (p.ItemInUse != null) return; RightClickDelay = 4; var held = p.Inventory.Selected; if (HitEntity != null) { if (HitEntity.Interact(p)) { p.SwingArm(); return; } } if (Hit.Hit) { int x = Hit.X, y = Hit.Y, z = Hit.Z; var b = Block.Get(W.GetBlock(x, y, z)); if (!p.Sneaking || held == null) if (b.OnActivated(W, x, y, z, p)) { p.SwingArm(); return; } if (held != null && UseOnBlock(held, x, y, z, Hit.Face, Hit.HitX - x, Hit.HitY - y, Hit.HitZ - z)) { p.SwingArm(); p.Inventory.Dirty = true; return; } } if (held != null) UseInAir(held); } private bool UseInAir(ItemStack held) { var p = P; var it = held.Item; if (it.IsFood) { if (p.CanEat(it.Id == I.GoldenApple)) p.StartUsing(held); return true; } if (it.Id == I.MilkBucket) { p.StartUsing(held); return true; } if (it.Id == I.Bow) { if (p.Creative || p.Inventory.CountOf(I.Arrow) > 0) p.StartUsing(held); return true; } if (it.Id == I.EnderPearl || it.Id == I.Egg) { W.SpawnEntity(new ThrownEntity(W, it.Id == I.EnderPearl ? 0 : 1, p)); W.PlaySound("bow", p.X, p.Y, p.Z, 0.5f, 0.4f); if (!p.Creative) Consume(held); p.SwingArm(); return true; } if (it.ArmorSlot >= 0 && p.Inventory.Armor[it.ArmorSlot] ==

nodes.name: UseInAir
nodes.signature: private bool UseInAir(ItemStack held)
nodes.body_text: private bool UseInAir(ItemStack held) { var p = P; var it = held.Item; if (it.IsFood) { if (p.CanEat(it.Id == I.GoldenApple)) p.StartUsing(held); return true; } if (it.Id == I.MilkBucket) { p.StartUsing(held); return true; } if (it.Id == I.Bow) { if (p.Creative || p.Inventory.CountOf(I.Arrow) > 0) p.StartUsing(held); return true; } if (it.Id == I.EnderPearl || it.Id == I.Egg) { W.SpawnEntity(new ThrownEntity(W, it.Id == I.EnderPearl ? 0 : 1, p)); W.PlaySound("bow", p.X, p.Y, p.Z, 0.5f, 0.4f); if (!p.Creative) Consume(held); p.SwingArm(); return true; } if (it.ArmorSlot >= 0 && p.Inventory.Armor[it.ArmorSlot] == null) { p.Inventory.Armor[it.ArmorSlot] = held.CopyWith(1); Consume(held, true); return true; } if (it.Id == I.Bucket || it.Id == I.WaterBucket || it.Id == I.LavaBucket) return UseBucket(held); return false; }

nodes.signature: private void Consume(ItemStack held, bool force = false)
nodes.body_text: private void Consume(ItemStack held, bool force = false) { if (P.Creative && !force) return; held.Count--; if (held.Count <= 0) P.Inventory.Selected = null; P.Inventory.Dirty = true; }

nodes.name: UseBucket
nodes.signature: private bool UseBucket(ItemStack held)
nodes.body_text: private bool UseBucket(ItemStack held) { var p = P; double ex = p.X, ey = p.Y + p.EyeHeight, ez = p.Z; var (lx, ly, lz) = p.Look(); var h = W.RayCast(ex, ey, ez, lx, ly, lz, 5, true); if (!h.Hit) return false; int id = W.GetBlock(h.X, h.Y, h.Z); if (held.Id == I.Bucket) { if ((id == B.Water || id == B.Lava) && W.GetMeta(h.X, h.Y, h.Z) == 0) { W.SetBlock(h.X, h.Y, h.Z, B.Air); W.PlaySound("bucket_fill", h.X, h.Y, h.Z); if (p.Creative) return true; var full = new ItemStack(id == B.Water ? I.WaterBucket : I.LavaBucket); if (held.Count == 1) p.Inventory.Selected = full; else { held.Count--; if (!p.Inventory.Add(full)) p.DropStack(full, false); } return true; } return false; } int tx = h.X, ty = h.Y, tz = h.Z; var tb = Block.Get(id); if (!tb.Replaceable || tb.IsLiquid && W.GetMeta(tx, ty, tz) == 0) { tx += Dir.X[h.Face]; ty += Dir.Y[h.Face]; tz += Dir.Z[h.Face]; } var at = Block.Get(W.GetBlock(tx, ty, tz)); if (!at.Replaceable && at.Id != 0) return false; if (at.Id != 0 && !at.IsLiquid) W.BreakBlock(tx, ty, tz, true); W.SetBlock(tx, ty, tz, held.Id == I.WaterBucket ? B.Water : B.Lava, 0); W.PlaySound("bucket_empty", tx, ty, tz); if (!p.Creative) p.Inventory.Selected = new ItemStack(I.Bucket); return true; }

nodes.name: UseOnBlock
nodes.signature: private bool UseOnBlock(ItemStack held, int x, int y, int z, int face, double hx, double hy, double hz)
nodes.body_text: private bool UseOnBlock(ItemStack held, int x, int y, int z, int face, double hx, double hy, double hz) { var p = P; var it = held.Item; int id = W.GetBlock(x, y, z); // motyka if (it.Tool == ToolType.Hoe && face != Dir.Down && (id == B.Grass || id == B.Dirt) && W.GetBlock(x, y + 1, z) == B.Air) { W.SetBlock(x, y, z, B.Farmland, 0); W.PlaySound("step_gravel", x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5); p.DamageHeld(1); return true; } if (it.Id == I.Seeds) { if (face == Dir.Up && id == B.Farmland && W.GetBlock(x, y + 1, z) == B.Air) { W.SetBlock(x, y + 1, z, B.Wheat, 0); Consume(held); W.PlaySound("step_grass", x, y, z); return true; } return false; } if (it.Id == I.BoneMeal) return BoneMeal(held, x, y, z); if (it.Id == I.Bucket || it.Id == I.WaterBucket || it.Id == I.LavaBucket) return UseBucket(held); if (it.Id == I.FlintAndSteel) { if (id == B.Tnt) { TntBlock.Ignite(W, x, y, z, 80); p.DamageHeld(1); return true; } return false; } if (it.IsFood || it.Id == I.MilkBucket || it.Id == I.Bow || it.Id == I.EnderPearl || it.Id == I.Egg || it.ArmorSlot >= 0) return UseInAir(held); if (!it.IsBlock) return false; return PlaceBlock(held, x, y, z, face, hx, hy, hz); }

nodes.signature: private bool BoneMeal(ItemStack held, int x, int y, int z)
nodes.body_text: private bool BoneMeal(ItemStack held, int x, int y, int z) { int id = W.GetBlock(x, y, z); bool used = false; if (id == B.Wheat && W.GetMeta(x, y, z) < 7) { W.SetMeta(x, y, z, Math.Min(7, W.GetMeta(x, y, z) + 2 + W.Rand.Next(4))); used = true; } else if (id == B.OakSapling || id == B.BirchSapling) { if (W.Rand.NextFloat() < 0.45f) ((SaplingBlock)Block.Get(id)).Grow(W, x, y, z, W.Rand); used = true; } else if (id == B.Grass) { for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) { int tx = x + W.Rand.Next(7) - 3, tz = z + W.Rand.Next(7) - 3, ty = y + W.Rand.Next(3) - 1; if (W.GetBlock(tx, ty, tz) == B.Grass && W.GetBlock(tx, ty + 1, tz) == B.Air) W.SetBlock(tx, ty + 1, tz, W.Rand.Next(10) == 0 ? (W.Rand.NextBool() ? B.Dandelion : B.Poppy) : B.TallGrass); } used = true; } if (used) { Consume(held); W.SpawnParticles(ParticleKind.Heart, x + 0.5, y + 1, z + 0.5, 3); } return used; }

nodes.name: PlaceBlock
nodes.signature: private bool PlaceBlock(ItemStack held, int x, int y, int z, int face, double hx, double hy, double hz)
nodes.body_text: private bool PlaceBlock(ItemStack held, int x, int y, int z, int face, double hx, double hy, double hz) { var p = P; var it = held.Item; byte bid = (byte)it.BlockId; var nb = Block.Get(bid); // płyty łączą się if (nb is SlabBlock slab && W.GetBlock(x, y, z) == bid) { int m = W.GetMeta(x, y, z); if (face == Dir.Up && m == 0 || face == Dir.Down && m == 1) { W.SetBlock(x, y, z, (byte)slab.DoubleId, 0); Consume(held); PlaceSound(nb, x, y, z); return true; } } var target = Block.Get(W.GetBlock(x, y, z)); int tx = x, ty = y, tz = z; if (!target.Replaceable || target.IsLiquid && false) { tx += Dir.X[face]; ty += Dir.Y[face]; tz += Dir.Z[face]; } else face = Dir.Up; if (ty < 0 || ty >= Chunk.Height) return false; var at = Block.Get(W.GetBlock(tx, ty, tz)); if (nb is SlabBlock slab2 && at.Id == bid) { int m = W.GetMeta(tx, ty, tz); W.SetBlock(tx, ty, tz, (byte)slab2.DoubleId, 0); Consume(held); PlaceSound(nb, tx, ty, tz); return true; } if (!at.Replaceable && at.Id != 0) return false; if (!nb.CanPlaceAt(W, tx, ty, tz)) return false; int meta = nb.GetPlacementMeta(W, tx, ty, tz, face, hx, hy, hz, p, held.Damage); if (meta < 0) return false; // kolizja z encjami if (nb.Solid) { var boxes = new List<AABB>(); nb.GetCollisionBoxes(W, tx, ty, tz, meta, boxes); foreach (var b in boxes) { var wb = b.Offset(tx, ty, tz); foreach (var e in W.GetEntitiesInBox(wb)) if (e is LivingEntity && !e.Dead && !(e is Player pl && pl.Spectator)) return false; } } if (bid == B.OakDoor) { if (ty + 1 >= Chunk.Height || !Block.Get(W.GetBlock(tx, ty + 1, tz)).Replaceable || !Block.Get(W.GetBlock(tx, ty - 1, tz)).Opaque) return false; int d = (Dir.HorizFromYaw(p.Yaw) + 3) & 3; // zawias: zależnie od sąsiadów int lx = tx - Dir.HorizX[(d + 1) & 3], lz = tz - Dir.HorizZ[(d + 1) & 3]; bool hinge = W.GetBlock(lx, ty, lz) == B.OakDoor; W.SetBlock(tx, ty, tz, B.OakDoor, d, false); W.SetBlock(tx, ty + 1, tz, B.OakDoor, 8 | (hinge ? 1 : 0), true); W.NotifyNeighbors(tx, ty, tz, B.OakDoor); Consume(held); PlaceSound(nb, tx, ty, tz); return true; } if (bid == B.Bed) { int d = Dir.HorizFromYaw(p.Yaw); int hx2 = tx + Dir.HorizX[d], hz2 = tz + Dir.HorizZ[d]; if (!Block.Get(W.GetBlock(hx2, ty, hz2)).Replaceable || !Block.Get(W.GetBlock(tx, ty - 1, tz)).Opaque || !Block.Get(W.GetBlock(hx2, ty - 1, hz2)).Opaque) return false; W.SetBlock(tx, ty, tz, B.Bed, d, false); W.SetBlock(hx2, ty, hz2, B.Bed, d | 8, true); Consume(held); PlaceSound(nb, tx, ty, tz); return true; } if (at.Id != 0 && !at.IsLiquid) W.BreakBlock(tx, ty, tz, false); W.SetBlock(tx, ty, tz, bid, meta); nb.OnPlaced(W, tx, ty, tz, p); PlaceSound(nb, tx, ty, tz); Consume(held); return true; }

nodes.body_text: public void PickBlock() { if (!Hit.Hit) return; var b = Block.Get(W.GetBlock(Hit.X, Hit.Y, Hit.Z)); var s = b.PickStack(W.GetMeta(Hit.X, Hit.Y, Hit.Z)); if (s == null || s.Item == null) return; var inv = P.Inventory; int slot = inv.FindSlot(s.Id, s.Item.MaxDamage > 0 ? -1 : s.Damage); if (slot >= 0 && slot < 9) { inv.SelectedSlot = slot; return; } if (!P.Creative) { if (slot >= 9) { var tmp = inv.Main[inv.SelectedSlot]; inv.Main[inv.SelectedSlot] = inv.Main[slot]; inv.Main[slot] = tmp; inv.Dirty = true; } return; } int empty = inv.FirstEmptyHotbar(); if (empty >= 0) inv.SelectedSlot = empty; inv.Main[inv.SelectedSlot] = s.CopyWith(s.MaxStack); inv.Dirty = true; }

i : 0; } private static bool _init; public static void Ensure() { if (_init) return; _init = true; Steve(); Zombie(); Skeleton(); Creeper(); Spider(); Enderman(); Cow(); Pig(); Sheep(); SheepFur(); Chicken(); } private static uint V(Rng r, long c, float a = 0.12f) => TextureGen.Mul(Hx((uint)c), 1 - a / 2 + r.NextFloat() * a); // ---------- humanoidy ---------- private static void Humanoid(Canvas c, Func<int, int, int, int, int, uint> head, Func<int, int, int, int, int, uint> body, Func<int, int, int, int, int, uint> arm, Func<int, int, int, int, int, uint> leg, int armW = 4, int armD = 4) { c.Box(0, 0, 8, 8, 8, head); c.Box(16, 16, 8, 12, 4, body); c.Box(40, 16, armW, 12, armD, arm); c.Box(0, 16, armW, 12, armD, leg); } private static void Steve() { var c = new Canvas(1); var r = c.R; uint skin = 0xB4846D, skinD = 0x9C6E57, hair = 0x3B2213, hairD = 0x2B1A0D; Humanoid(c, (f, x, y, w, h) => { if (f == 0) return V(r, hair, 0.15f); if (f == 1) return V(r, skin); if (f == 5) return V(r, y < 6 ? hair : hairD, 0.15f); if (f == 3) { if (y < 2) return V(r, hair, 0.15f); if (y == 2 && (x == 0 || x == 7)) return V(r, hair); if (y == 4 && (x == 1 || x == 6)) return Hx(0xFFFFFF); if (y == 4 && (x == 2 || x == 5)) return Hx(0x523D89); if (y == 3 && (x >= 1 && x <= 2 || x >= 5 && x <= 6)) return Hx(0x2B1A0D); if (y == 5 && (x == 3 || x == 4)) return Hx(0x8D5E4B); if (y == 6 && x >= 2 && x <= 5) return Hx(0x6A3E30); return V(r, skin, 0.08f); } return V(r, y < 3 ? hair : (y < 4 && (x == 0 || x == 7) ? hair : skin), 0.1f); }, (f, x, y, w, h) => f == 0 || f == 1 ? V(r, 0x00AFAF) : V(r, y >= 10 ? 0x3C3C9B : (y < 1 && f == 3 && x >= 3 && x <= 4 ? skin : 0x00AFAF), 0.12f), (f, x, y, w, h) => V(r, (f == 0 || y < 4) && f != 1 ? 0x00AFAF : (f == 1 ? skinD : skin), 0.1f), (f, x, y, w, h) => V(r, y >= 9 ? 0x535353 : 0x3C3C9B, 0.12f)); Add("steve", c); } private static void Zombie() { var c = new Canvas(2); var r = c.R; uint skin = 0x4A7A3A, skinD = 0x3C6630; Humanoid(c, (f, x, y, w, h) => { if (f == 3) { if (y == 3 && (x == 1 || x == 2 || x == 5 || x == 6)) return Hx(0x111F11); if (y == 4 && (x == 1 || x == 2 || x == 5 || x == 6)) return Hx(0x1E3A1E); if (y == 6 && x >= 2 && x <= 5) return Hx(0x2A4A22); if (y == 5 && (x == 3 || x == 4)) return Hx(0x355E2A); } if (f == 0 || f == 5 && y < 3) return V(r, skinD, 0.2f); return V(r, skin, 0.18f); }, (f, x, y, w, h) => V(r, y >= 10 ? 0x46469A : 0x00A0A0, 0.15f), (f, x, y, w, h) => V(r, y < 4 && f != 1 ? 0x00A0A0 : skin, 0.15f), (f, x, y, w, h) => V(r, y >= 10 ? 0x3A3A3A : 0x46469A, 0.15f)); Add("zombie", c); } private static void Skeleton() { var c = new Canvas(3); var r = c.R; uint bone = 0xC8C8C8, dark = 0x7A7A7A; c.Box(0, 0, 8, 8, 8, (f, x, y, w, h) => { if (f == 3) { if (y >= 3 && y <= 4 && (x == 1 || x == 2 || x == 5 || x == 6)) return Hx(0x141414); if (y == 5 && (x == 3 || x == 4)) return Hx(0x303030); if (y == 6 && x >= 1 && x <= 6) return (x % 2 == 0) ? V(r, bone) : 0; }); c.Box(40, 16, 2, 12, 2, (f, x, y, w, h) => V(r, bone, 0.15f)); c.Box(0, 16, 2, 12, 2, (f, x, y, w, h) => V(r, bone, 0.15f)); Add("skeleton",

nodes.name: ModelBatch
nodes.signature: public sealed class ModelBatch
nodes.body_text: public sealed class ModelBatch { public const int F = 17; public float[] D = new float[F * 4 * 4096]; public int Verts; public float Sky = 15, Blk = 15; public Vector4 Color = Vector4.One, Overlay = Vector4.Zero; public int Layer; private static readonly Vector3 L0 = Vector3.Normalize(new Vector3(0.2f, 1f, -0.7f)), L1 = Vector3.Normalize(new Vector3(-0.2f, 1f, 0.7f)); public bool FlatShade; public void Clear() => Verts = 0; public void V(Vector3 p, float u, float v, float shade) { int o = Verts * F; if (o + F > D.Length) Array.Resize(ref D, D.Length * 2); D[o] = p.X; D[o + 1] = p.Y; D[o + 2] = p.Z; D[o + 3] = u; D[o + 4] = v; D[o + 5] = Layer; D[o + 6] = shade; D[o + 7] = Sky; D[o + 8] = Blk; D[o + 9] = Color.X; D[o + 10] = Color.Y; D[o + 11] = Color.Z; D[o + 12] = Color.W; D[o + 13] = Overlay.X; D[o + 14] = Overlay.Y; D[o + 15] = Overlay.Z; D[o + 16] = Overlay.W; Verts++; } public float ShadeFor(Vector3 n) { if (FlatShade) return 1f; float s = 0.4f + 0.6f * (Math.Max(0, Vector3.Dot(n, L0)) + Math.Max(0, Vector3.Dot(n, L1))); return Math.Min(1f, s); } /// <summary>Czworokąt (a,b,c,d) w kolejności CCW, uv (u0,v0)-(u1,v1).</summary> public void Quad(Vector3 a, Vector3 b, Vector3 c, Vector3 d, float u0, float v0, float u1, float v1, float shade) { V(a, u0, v0, shade); V(b, u0, v1, shade); V(c, u1, v1, shade); V(d, u1, v0, shade); } }

} vec3 lightmap(float sky, float blk){ float f = uSun; float f1 = f*0.95+0.05; float f2 = tbl(sky)*f1; float f3 = tbl(blk)*1.5; vec3 c = vec3(f2*(f*0.65+0.35), f2*(f*0.65+0.35), f2) + vec3(f3, f3*((f3*0.6+0.4)*0.6+0.4), f3*(f3*f3*0.6+0.4)); c = clamp(c*0.96+0.03, 0.0, 1.0); vec3 g = 1.0 - pow(1.0 - c, vec3(4.0)); c = mix(c, g, uGamma); return clamp(c*0.96+0.03, 0.0, 1.0); }"; private const string Vert = @"#version 330 core layout(location=0) in vec3 aPos; layout(location=1) in vec2 aUV; layout(location=2) in float aLayer; layout(location=3) in float aShade; layout(location=4) in vec2 aLight; layout(location=5) in vec4 aCol; layout(location=6) in vec4 aOver; uniform mat4 uViewProj; out vec3 vUV; out float vShade; out vec2 vLight; out vec4 vCol; out vec4 vOver; out float vDist; void main(){ gl_Position = uViewProj*vec4(aPos,1.0); vUV=vec3(aUV,aLayer); vShade=aShade; vLight=aLight; vCol=aCol; vOver=aOver; vDist=length(aPos.xz); }"; private static readonly string Frag = @"#version 330 core in vec3 vUV; in float vShade; in vec2 vLight; in vec4 vCol; in vec4 vOver; in float vDist; uniform sampler2DArray uTex; uniform vec3 uFogColor; uniform float uFogStart; uniform float uFogEnd; uniform float uFogDensity; uniform int uFogMode; out vec4 o;" + LightmapGlsl + @" void main(){ vec4 t = texture(uTex, vUV); if(t.a < 0.1) discard; t *= vCol; vec3 c = t.rgb * vShade * lightmap(vLight.x, vLight.y); c = mix(c, vOver.rgb, vOver.a); float fog = uFogMode==1 ? 1.0-exp(-uFogDensity*vDist) : clamp((vDist-uFogStart)/(uFogEnd-uFogStart),0.0,1.0); o = vec4(mix(c, uFogColor, fog), t.a); }"; public EntityRenderer() { Shader = new Shader(Vert, Frag, "entity"); _mesh = new Mesh(ModelBatch.F * 4, () => { int s = ModelBatch.F * 4; GL.EnableVertexAttribArray(0); GL.VertexAttribPointer(0, 3, VertexAttribPointerType.Float, false, s, 0); GL.EnableVertexAttribArray(1); GL.VertexAttribPointer(1, 2, VertexAttribPointerType.Float, false, s, 12); GL.EnableVertexAttribArray(2); GL.VertexAttribPointer(2, 1, VertexAttribPointerType.Float, false, s, 20); GL.EnableVertexAttribArray(3); GL.VertexAttribPointer(3, 1, VertexAttribPointerType.Float, false, s, 24); GL.EnableVertexAttribArray(4); GL.VertexAttribPointer(4, 2, VertexAttribPointerType.Float, false, s, 28); GL.EnableVertexAttribArray(5); GL.VertexAttribPointer(5, 4, VertexAttribPointerType.Float, false, s, 36); GL.EnableVertexAttribArray(6); GL.VertexAttribPointer(6, 4, VertexAttribPointerType.Float, false, s, 52); }); SkinGen.Ensure(); SkinTex = new TextureArray(64, SkinGen.Skins, false); } public void Flush(ModelBatch b, TextureArray tex) { if (b.Verts == 0) return; _mesh.Upload(b.D, b.Verts * ModelBatch.F); tex.Bind(0); Shader.Set("uTex", 0); _mesh.DrawQuads(); b.Clear(); } // ================= modele ================= private static ModelPart P(float x, float y, float z) => new(x, y, z); private readonly ModelPart _head = P(0, 0, 0).Box(0, 0, -4, -8, -4, 8, 8, 8), _body = P(0, 0, 0).Box(16, 16, -4, 0, -2, 8, 12, 4); private readonly ModelPart _rArm = P(-5, 2, 0).Box(40, 16, -3, -2, -2, 4, 12, 4), _lArm = P(5, 2, 0).Box(40, 16, -1, -2, -2, 4, 12, 4, 0, true); nodes.name: PartMatrix
nodes.signature: private static Matrix4 PartMatrix(ModelPart p, Matrix4 parent)
nodes.body_text: private static Matrix4 PartMatrix(ModelPart p, Matrix4 parent) { var m = Matrix4.Identity; if (p.RX != 0) m *= Matrix4.CreateRotationX(p.RX); if (p.RY != 0) m *= Matrix4.CreateRotationY(p.RY); if (p.RZ != 0) m *= Matrix4.CreateRotationZ(p.RZ); m *= Matrix4.CreateTranslation(p.PX / 16f, p.PY / 16f, p.PZ / 16f); return m * parent; }

nodes.signature: public void RenderPart(ModelBatch b, ModelPart p, Matrix4 parent, int texW = 64, int texH = 64)
nodes.body_text: public void RenderPart(ModelBatch b, ModelPart p, Matrix4 parent, int texW = 64, int texH = 64) { if (!p.Visible) return; var m = PartMatrix(p, parent); foreach (var box in p.Boxes) RenderBox(b, box, m, texW, texH); foreach (var c in p.Children) RenderPart(b, c, m, texW, texH); }
