nodes.body_text: private void RenderBox(ModelBatch b, BoxDef bx, Matrix4 m, int tw, int th) { float i = bx.Inflate; float x0 = (bx.X - i) / 16f, y0 = (bx.Y - i) / 16f, z0 = (bx.Z - i) / 16f; float x1 = (bx.X + bx.W + i) / 16f, y1 = (bx.Y + bx.H + i) / 16f, z1 = (bx.Z + bx.D + i) / 16f; if (bx.Mirror) (x0, x1) = (x1, x0); int u = bx.U, v = bx.V; float w = bx.W, h = bx.H, d = bx.D; Vector3 p000 = T(m, x0, y0, z0), p100 = T(m, x1, y0, z0), p010 = T(m, x0, y1, z0), p110 = T(m, x1, y1, z0); Vector3 p001 = T(m, x0, y0, z1), p101 = T(m, x1, y0, z1), p011 = T(m, x0, y1, z1), p111 = T(m, x1, y1, z1); float U(float px) => px / tw; float Vv(float py) => py / th; void Face(Vector3 a, Vector3 bb, Vector3 c, Vector3 dd, float fu, float fv, float fw, float fh) { var n = Vector3.Cross(bb - a, dd - a); if (n.LengthSquared > 1e-12f) n.Normalize(); float s = b.ShadeFor(n); float u0 = U(fu), v0 = Vv(fv), u1 = U(fu + fw), v1 = Vv(fv + fh); if (bx.Mirror) (u0, u1) = (u1, u0); // a: (u0,v0) b: (u0,v1) c: (u1,v1) d: (u1,v0) b.V(a, u0, v0, s); b.V(bb, u0, v1, s); b.V(c, u1, v1, s); b.V(dd, u1, v0, s); } // y w dół w modelu: y0 = góra Face(p000, p010, p110, p100, u + d, v + d, w, h); // przód (-Z) Face(p101, p111, p011, p001, u + d + w + d, v + d, w, h); // tył (+Z) Face(p001, p011, p010, p000, u, v + d, d, h); // prawa (-X) Face(p100, p110, p111, p101, u + d + w, v + d, d, h); // lewa (+X) Face(p001, p000, p100, p101, u + d, v, w, d); // góra (y0) Face(p010, p011, p111, p110, u + d + w, v, w, d); // dół (y1) }

nodes.name: EntityRoot
nodes.signature: public static Matrix4 EntityRoot(Vector3 pos, float bodyYaw, float scale = 1f)
nodes.body_text: public static Matrix4 EntityRoot(Vector3 pos, float bodyYaw, float scale = 1f) => Matrix4.CreateTranslation(0, -1.5078125f, 0) * Matrix4.CreateScale(-scale, -scale, scale) * Matrix4.CreateRotationY(MathHelper.DegreesToRadians(180f - bodyYaw)) * Matrix4.CreateTranslation(pos);

nodes.name: RenderEntity
nodes.signature: public void RenderEntity(Entity e, float pt, Vector3 cam, World.World w, bool firstPersonSelf)
nodes.body_text: public void RenderEntity(Entity e, float pt, Vector3 cam, World.World w, bool firstPersonSelf) { var pos = new Vector3((float)(e.IX(pt) - cam.X), (float)(e.IY(pt) - cam.Y), (float)(e.IZ(pt) - cam.Z)); int bx = MathUtil.FloorToInt(e.IX(pt)), by = MathUtil.FloorToInt(e.IY(pt) + e.Height * 0.5), bz = MathUtil.FloorToInt(e.IZ(pt)); float sky = w.GetSkyLight(bx, by, bz), blk = w.GetBlockLight(bx, by, bz); if (e.FireTicks > 0) blk = 15; Skin.Sky = Terrain.Sky = sky; Skin.Blk = Terrain.Blk = blk; Skin.Color = Terrain.Color = Vector4.One; Skin.Overlay = Terrain.Overlay = Vector4.Zero; switch (e) { case LivingEntity le: RenderLiving(le, pt, pos); break; case ItemEntity ie: RenderItemEntity(ie, pt, pos); break; case XpOrbEntity xp: RenderBillboardSprite(TextureGen.Layer("particle_crit"), pos + new Vector3(0, 0.25f, 0), 0.3f, new Vector4(0.6f, 1f, 0.3f, 1f), cam); break; case FallingBlockEntity fb: RenderBlockAt(fb.BlockId, fb.Meta, Matrix4.CreateTranslation(pos + new Vector3(0, 0.5f, 0))); break; case TntEntity tnt: { float f = 1f; if (tnt.Fuse < 10) { f = 1f + (1f - Math.Max(0, tnt.Fuse - pt + 1) / 10f) * 0.3f; } if ((tnt.Fuse / 5) % 2 == 0) Terrain.Overlay = new Vector4(1, 1, 1, 0.6f); Terrain.Blk = 15; RenderBlockAt(B.Tnt, 0, Matrix4.CreateScale(f) * Matrix4.CreateTranslation(pos + new Vector3(0, 0.5f, 0))); Terrain.Overlay = Vector4.Zero; break; } case ArrowEntity ar: RenderArrow(ar, pt, pos); break; case ThrownEntity th: RenderBillboardSprite(TextureGen.Layer(th.Kind == 0 ? "item_ender_pearl" : "item_egg"), pos + new Vector3(0, 0.1f, 0), 0.25f, Vector4.One, cam); break; } }

nodes.name: RenderBillboardSprite
nodes.signature: public void RenderBillboardSprite(int layer, Vector3 center, float size, Vector4 color, Vector3 cam)
nodes.body_text: public void RenderBillboardSprite(int layer, Vector3 center, float size, Vector4 color, Vector3 cam) { Terrain.Layer = layer; Terrain.Color = color; var r = _camRight * size * 0.5f; var u = _camUp * size * 0.5f; Terrain.Quad(center - r + u, center - r - u, center + r - u, center + r + u, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1f); Terrain.Color = Vector4.One; }

nodes.name: RenderArrow
nodes.signature: private void RenderArrow(ArrowEntity a, float pt, Vector3 pos)
nodes.body_text: private void RenderArrow(ArrowEntity a, float pt, Vector3 pos) { float yaw = MathUtil.LerpAngle(a.PrevYaw, a.Yaw, pt), pitch = MathHelper.Lerp(a.PrevPitch, a.Pitch, pt); var m = Matrix4.CreateRotationY(MathHelper.DegreesToRadians(-90)) * Matrix4.CreateRotationZ(MathHelper.DegreesToRadians(-45)) * Matrix4.CreateScale(0.7f) * Matrix4.CreateRotationX(MathHelper.DegreesToRadians(-pitch)) * Matrix4.CreateRotationY(MathHelper.DegreesToRadians(yaw)) * Matrix4.CreateTranslation(pos); // strzała: płaski sprite w dwóch płaszczyznach Terrain.Layer = TextureGen.Layer("item_arrow"); var m2 = Matrix4.CreateRotationX(MathHelper.PiOver2) * m; foreach (var mm in new[] { m, m2 }) { Vector3 a0 = T(mm, -0.5f, 0.5f, 0), b0 = T(mm, -0.5f, -0.5f, 0), c0 = T(mm, 0.5f, -0.5f, 0), d0 = T(mm, 0.5f, 0.5f, 0); Terrain.Quad(a0, b0, c0, d0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 0.9f); Terrain.Quad(d0, c0, b0, a0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0.9f); } }

nodes.name: RenderItemEntity
nodes.signature: private void RenderItemEntity(ItemEntity ie, float pt, Vector3 pos)
nodes.body_text: private void RenderItemEntity(ItemEntity ie, float pt, Vector3 pos) { float age = ie.Age + pt; float bob = MathF.Sin(age / 10f + ie.Bob) * 0.1f + 0.1f; float rot = (age / 20f + ie.Bob) * MathHelper.RadiansToDegrees(1); var it = ie.Stack.Item; if (it == null) return; bool block = IsBlockModel(it); float scale = block ? 0.25f : 0.5f; int copies = ie.Stack.Count > 20 ? 3 : ie.Stack.Count > 1 ? 2 : 1; for (int c = 0; c < copies; c++) { var off = c == 0 ? Vector3.Zero : new Vector3((c * 0.37f % 0.2f) - 0.1f, c * 0.06f, ((c * 0.71f) % 0.2f) - 0.1f); var m = Matrix4.CreateScale(scale) * Matrix4.CreateRotationY(MathHelper.DegreesToRadians(rot)) * Matrix4.CreateTranslation(pos + off + new Vector3(0, bob + scale * 0.5f, 0)); RenderItem(ie.Stack, m); } }

nodes.name: IsBlockModel
nodes.signature: public static bool IsBlockModel(Item it)
nodes.body_text: public static bool IsBlockModel(Item it) { if (it.Id >= 256 || it.Sprite > 0) return false; var b = Block.ById[it.BlockId]; return b.Render is RenderType.Cube or RenderType.Model or RenderType.Cactus; }

nodes.name: RenderItem
nodes.signature: public void RenderItem(ItemStack s, Matrix4 m)
nodes.body_text: public void RenderItem(ItemStack s, Matrix4 m) { var it = s.Item; if (it == null) return; if (IsBlockModel(it)) RenderBlockAt(it.BlockId, s.Damage, m); else RenderSpriteExtruded(it.IsBlock && it.Sprite < 0 ? Block.ById[it.BlockId].Tex[0] : it.Sprite, m); }

nodes.name: RenderBlockAt
nodes.signature: public void RenderBlockAt(int id, int meta, Matrix4 m)
nodes.body_text: public void RenderBlockAt(int id, int meta, Matrix4 m) { var b = Block.Get(id); _mb.Clear(); if (b.Render == RenderType.Model) { int mm = id == B.Chest || id == B.Furnace ? 0 : meta; if (b is DoorBlock) mm = 0; b.GetModel(Null, 0, 0, 0, mm, _mb); if (b is LadderBlock) { _mb.Clear(); } } if (_mb.Count == 0) { var t = new int[6]; int fm = id == B.Furnace || id == B.FurnaceLit || id == B.Chest ? 0 : meta; for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) t[f] = b.GetTexture(f, fm); if (id == B.Grass) { t[1] = TextureGen.Layer("grass_top_item"); for (int f = 2; f < 6; f++) t[f] = TextureGen.Layer("grass_side_item"); } if (b.Render == RenderType.Cactus) { _mb.Add(new ModelBox(1 / 16f, 0, 1 / 16f, 15 / 16f, 1, 15 / 16f, t) { Uv = Full() }); } else _mb.Add(new ModelBox(0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, t)); } var col = Terrain.Color; if (b.Tint == TintType.Foliage) Terrain.Color = HexColor(0x59AE30); else if (b.Tint == TintType.Birch) Terrain.Color = HexColor(0x80A755); var off = Matrix4.CreateTranslation(-0.5f, -0.5f, -0.5f) * m; foreach (var box in _mb) EmitModelBox(box, off); Terrain.Color = col; }

nodes.name: EmitModelBox
nodes.signature: private void EmitModelBox(ModelBox mb, Matrix4 m)
nodes.body_text: private void EmitModelBox(ModelBox mb, Matrix4 m) { float x0 = mb.X0, y0 = mb.Y0, z0 = mb.Z0, x1 = mb.X1, y1 = mb.Y1, z1 = mb.Z1; void Face(int f, Vector3 a, Vector3 b, Vector3 c, Vector3 d, float u0, float v0, float u1, float v1) { if (mb.Uv != null) { u0 = mb.Uv[f * 4]; v0 = mb.Uv[f * 4 + 1]; u1 = mb.Uv[f * 4 + 2]; v1 = mb.Uv[f * 4 + 3]; } Terrain.Layer = mb.Tex[f]; var pa = T(m, a.X, a.Y, a.Z); var pb = T(m, b.X, b.Y, b.Z); var pc = T(m, c.X, c.Y, c.Z); var pd = T(m, d.X, d.Y, d.Z); var n = Vector3.Cross(pb - pa, pd - pa); if (n.LengthSquared > 1e-12f) n.Normalize(); float s = Terrain.ShadeFor(n); Terrain.Quad(pa, pb, pc, pd, u0, v0, u1, v1, s); } // patrząc z zewnątrz CCW: a(lewy-góra) b(lewy-dół) c(prawy-dół) d(prawy-góra) Face(2, new(x1, y1, z0), new(x1, y0, z0), new(x0, y0, z0), new(x0, y1, z0), 1 - x1, 1 - y1, 1 - x0, 1 - y0); // N Face(3, new(x0, y1, z1), new(x0, y0, z1), new(x1, y0, z1), new(x1, y1, z1), x0, 1 - y1, x1, 1 - y0); // S Face(4, new(x0, y1, z0), new(x0, y0, z0), new(x0, y0, z1), new(x0, y1, z1), z0, 1 - y1, z1, 1 - y0); // W Face(5, new(x1, y1, z1), new(x1, y0, z1), new(x1, y0, z0), new(x1, y1, z0), 1 - z1, 1 - y1, 1 - z0, 1 - y0); // E Face(1, new(x0, y1, z0), new(x0, y1, z1), new(x1, y1, z1), new(x1, y1, z0), x0, z0, x1, z1); // góra Face(0, new(x0, y0, z1), new(x0, y0, z0), new(x1, y0, z0), new(x1, y0, z1), x0, 1 - z1, x1, 1 - z0); // dół }

nodes.name: Edges
nodes.signature: private List<(int x, int y, int dir)> Edges(int layer)
nodes.body_text: private List<(int x, int y, int dir)> Edges(int layer) { if (_edges.TryGetValue(layer, out var l)) return l; l = new(); var px = TextureGen.Textures[Math.Clamp(layer, 0, TextureGen.Count - 1)]; bool Op(int x, int y) => x >= 0 && x < 16 && y >= 0 && y < 16 && (px[y * 16 + x] >> 24) > 25; for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { if (!Op(x, y)) continue; if (!Op(x - 1, y)) l.Add((x, y, 0)); if (!Op(x + 1, y)) l.Add((x, y, 1)); if (!Op(x, y - 1)) l.Add((x, y, 2)); if (!Op(x, y + 1)) l.Add((x, y, 3)); } _edges[layer] = l; return l; }

nodes.name: RenderSpriteExtruded
nodes.signature: public void RenderSpriteExtruded(int layer, Matrix4 m)
nodes.body_text: public void RenderSpriteExtruded(int layer, Matrix4 m) { Terrain.Layer = layer; const float t = 1 / 32f; Vector3 P(float x, float y, float z) => T(m, x, y, z); // przód i tył var n1 = Vector3.TransformNormal(Vector3.UnitZ, m); n1.Normalize(); float sf = Terrain.ShadeFor(n1), sb = Terrain.ShadeFor(-n1); Terrain.Quad(P(-0.5f, 0.5f, t), P(-0.5f, -0.5f, t), P(0.5f, -0.5f, t), P(0.5f, 0.5f, t), 0, 0, 1, 1, sf); Terrain.Quad(P(0.5f, 0.5f, -t), P(0.5f, -0.5f, -t), P(-0.5f, -0.5f, -t), P(-0.5f, 0.5f, -t), 1, 0, 0, 1, sb); var nx = Vector3.TransformNormal(Vector3.UnitX, m); nx.Normalize(); var ny = Vector3.TransformNormal(Vector3.UnitY, m); ny.Normalize(); foreach (var (x, y, dir) in Edges(layer)) { float x0 = x / 16f - 0.5f, x1 = (x + 1) / 16f - 0.5f, y0 = 0.5f - (y + 1) / 16f, y1 = 0.5f - y / 16f; float u0 = (x + 0.1f) / 16f, u1 = (x + 0.9f) / 16f, v0 = (y + 0.1f) / 16f, v1 = (y + 0.9f) / 16f; switch (dir) { case 0: Terrain.Quad(P(x0, y1, -t), P(x0, y0, -t), P(x0, y0, t), P(x0, y1, t), u0, v0, u1, v1, Terrain.ShadeFor(-nx)); break; case 1: Terrain.Quad(P(x1, y1, t), P(x1, y0, t), P(x1, y0, -t), P(x1, y1, -t), u0, v0, u1, v1, Terrain.ShadeFor(nx)); break; case 2: Terrain.Quad(P(x0, y1, -t), P(x0, y1, t), P(x1, y1, t), P(x1, y1, -t), u0, v0, u1, v1, Terrain.ShadeFor(ny)); break; default: Terrain.Quad(P(x0, y0, t), P(x0, y0, -t), P(x1, y0, -t), P(x1, y0, t), u0, v0, u1, v1, Terrain.ShadeFor(-ny)); break; } } }

nodes.name: Biped
nodes.signature: private void Biped(LivingEntity e, float pt, float limb, float amt, float age, float headYaw, float headPitch, ModelPart head, ModelPart body, ModelPart ra, ModelPart la, ModelPart rl, ModelPart ll, bool zombieArms, float armW)
nodes.body_text: private void Biped(LivingEntity e, float pt, float limb, float amt, float age, float headYaw, float headPitch, ModelPart head, ModelPart body, ModelPart ra, ModelPart la, ModelPart rl, ModelPart ll, bool zombieArms, float armW) { head.Reset(0, 0, 0); body.Reset(0, 0, 0); ra.Reset(-5, 2, 0); la.Reset(5, 2, 0); rl.Reset(armW < 4 ? -2 : -1.9f, 12, 0); ll.Reset(armW < 4 ? 2 : 1.9f, 12, 0); head.RY = MathHelper.DegreesToRadians(headYaw); head.RX = MathHelper.DegreesToRadians(headPitch); ra.RX = MathF.Cos(limb * 0.6662f + MathF.PI) * 2f * amt * 0.5f; la.RX = MathF.Cos(limb * 0.6662f) * 2f * amt * 0.5f; rl.RX = MathF.Cos(limb * 0.6662f) * 1.4f * amt; ll.RX = MathF.Cos(limb * 0.6662f + MathF.PI) * 1.4f * amt; if (e.HeldItem != null || e is Player p && p.Inventory.Selected != null) ra.RX = ra.RX * 0.5f - MathF.PI / 10f; float swing = e.PrevSwingProgress + (e.SwingProgress - e.PrevSwingProgress) * pt; if (swing > 0) { body.RY = MathF.Sin(MathF.Sqrt(swing) * MathF.PI * 2f) * 0.2f; ra.PZ = MathF.Sin(body.RY) * 5f; ra.PX = -MathF.Cos(body.RY) * 5f; la.PZ = -MathF.Sin(body.RY) * 5f; la.PX = MathF.Cos(body.RY) * 5f; ra.RY += body.RY; la.RY += body.RY; la.RX += body.RY; float f = 1f - swing; f *= f; f *= f; f = 1f - f; float f2 = MathF.Sin(f * MathF.PI), f3 = MathF.Sin(swing * MathF.PI) * -(head.RX - 0.7f) * 0.75f; ra.RX -= f2 * 1.2f + f3; ra.RY += body.RY * 2f; ra.RZ += MathF.Sin(swing * MathF.PI) * -0.4f; } if (e.Sneaking) { body.RX = 0.5f; ra.RX += 0.4f; la.RX += 0.4f; rl.PZ = 4f; ll.PZ = 4f; rl.PY = 9f; ll.PY = 9f; head.PY = 1f; } ra.RZ += MathF.Cos(age * 0.09f) * 0.05f + 0.05f; la.RZ -= MathF.Cos(age * 0.09f) * 0.05f + 0.05f; ra.RX += MathF.Sin(age * 0.067f) * 0.05f; la.RX -= MathF.Sin(age * 0.067f) * 0.05f; if (zombieArms) { ra.RY = -(0.1f - (1 - MathF.Sin(swing * MathF.PI)) * 0.6f) * 0; la.RY = 0; ra.RX = -MathF.PI / 2f - MathF.Sin(swing * MathF.PI) * 1.2f; la.RX = -MathF.PI / 2f; ra.RZ = MathF.Cos(age * 0.09f) * 0.05f + 0.05f; la.RZ = -ra.RZ; } }

nodes.name: Quad4
nodes.signature: private static void Quad4(ModelPart[] legs, float limb, float amt)
nodes.body_text: private static void Quad4(ModelPart[] legs, float limb, float amt) { legs[0].RX = MathF.Cos(limb * 0.6662f) * 1.4f * amt; legs[1].RX = MathF.Cos(limb * 0.6662f + MathF.PI) * 1.4f * amt; legs[2].RX = MathF.Cos(limb * 0.6662f + MathF.PI) * 1.4f * amt; legs[3].RX = MathF.Cos(limb * 0.6662f) * 1.4f * amt; }

nodes.name: RenderLiving
nodes.signature: public void RenderLiving(LivingEntity e, float pt, Vector3 pos, bool forGui = false)
nodes.body_text: public void RenderLiving(LivingEntity e, float pt, Vector3 pos, bool forGui = false) { float bodyYaw = MathUtil.LerpAngle(e.PrevBodyYaw, e.BodyYaw, pt); float headYawAbs = MathUtil.LerpAngle(e.PrevYaw, e.Yaw, pt); float headYaw = MathUtil.WrapDegrees(headYawAbs - bodyYaw); float pitch = MathHelper.Lerp(e.PrevPitch, e.Pitch, pt); float amt = MathHelper.Lerp(e.PrevLimbSwingAmount, e.LimbSwingAmount, pt); float limb = e.LimbSwing - e.LimbSwingAmount * (1 - pt); if (amt > 1) amt = 1; float age = e.Age + pt; Skin.Overlay = Vector4.Zero; if (e.HurtTime > 0 || e.DeathTime > 0) Skin.Overlay = new Vector4(1f, 0f, 0f, 0.3f); var root = EntityRoot(pos, bodyYaw, 1f); if (e.DeathTime > 0) { float f = ((e.DeathTime + pt - 1) / 20f * 1.6f); f = MathF.Sqrt(Math.Max(0, f)); if (f > 1) f = 1; // obrót na bok root = Matrix4.CreateTranslation(0, -1.5078125f, 0) * Matrix4.CreateScale(-1, -1, 1) * Matrix4.CreateRotationZ(MathHelper.DegreesToRadians(f * 90f)) * Matrix4.CreateRotationY(MathHelper.DegreesToRadians(180 - bodyYaw)) * Matrix4.CreateTranslation(pos); } switch (e) { case Player pl: { if (pl.Sleeping) { root = Matrix4.CreateTranslation(0, -1.5078125f, 0) * Matrix4.CreateScale(-1, -1, 1) * Matrix4.CreateRotationX(-MathHelper.PiOver2) * Matrix4.CreateTranslation(0, 0.2f, 0) * Matrix4.CreateTranslation(pos); } else root = Matrix4.CreateScale(0.9375f) * root; Skin.Layer = SkinGen.Get("steve"); Biped(e, pt, limb, amt, age, headYaw, pitch, _head, _body, _rArm, _lArm, _rLeg, _lLeg, false, 4); if (pl.ItemInUse?.Id == I.Bow) { _rArm.RY = -0.1f + _head.RY; _lArm.RY = 0.1f + _head.RY + 0.4f; _rArm.RX = -MathF.PI / 2f + _head.RX; _lArm.RX = -MathF.PI / 2f + _head.RX; } foreach (var part in new[] { _head, _body, _rArm, _lArm, _rLeg, _lLeg }) RenderPart(Skin, part, root); var held = pl.Inventory.Selected; if (held != null) RenderHeld(held, _rArm, root); break; } case Zombie: Skin.Layer = SkinGen.Get("zombie"); Biped(e, pt, limb, amt, age, headYaw, pitch, _head, _body, _rArm, _lArm, _rLeg, _lLeg, true, 4); foreach (var part in new[] { _head, _body, _rArm, _lArm, _rLeg, _lLeg }) RenderPart(Skin, part, root); break; case Skeleton sk: Skin.Layer = SkinGen.Get("skeleton"); Biped(e, pt, limb, amt, age, headYaw, pitch, _head, _body, _sRArm, _sLArm, _sRLeg, _sLLeg, false, 2); nodes.body_text: private void RenderHeld(ItemStack s, ModelPart arm, Matrix4 root) { // pozycja dłoni: koniec ramienia var m = Matrix4.Identity; if (arm.RX != 0) m *= Matrix4.CreateRotationX(arm.RX); if (arm.RY != 0) m *= Matrix4.CreateRotationY(arm.RY); if (arm.RZ != 0) m *= Matrix4.CreateRotationZ(arm.RZ); m *= Matrix4.CreateTranslation(arm.PX / 16f, arm.PY / 16f, arm.PZ / 16f); var handM = Matrix4.CreateTranslation(-1f / 16f, 10f / 16f, -1f / 16f) * m * root; var it = s.Item; if (it == null) return; Matrix4 im; if (IsBlockModel(it)) im = Matrix4.CreateScale(0.375f) * Matrix4.CreateRotationY(MathHelper.DegreesToRadians(45)) * Matrix4.CreateRotationX(MathHelper.DegreesToRadians(-20)) * Matrix4.CreateTranslation(0, 0.1f, -0.1f) * handM; else im = Matrix4.CreateRotationZ(MathHelper.DegreesToRadians(180)) * Matrix4.CreateRotationY(MathHelper.DegreesToRadians(-90)) * Matrix4.CreateRotationZ(MathHelper.DegreesToRadians(-60)) * Matrix4.CreateScale(0.7f) * Matrix4.CreateTranslation(0, 0.25f, -0.15f) * handM; var c = Terrain.Sky; Terrain.Sky = Skin.Sky; Terrain.Blk = Skin.Blk; RenderItem(s, im); }

nodes.body_text: public void RenderFirstPerson(Player p, float pt, float equip, ItemStack held, float sky, float blk) { float swing = p.PrevSwingProgress + (p.SwingProgress - p.PrevSwingProgress) * pt; Skin.Sky = Terrain.Sky = sky; Skin.Blk = Terrain.Blk = blk; Skin.Overlay = Terrain.Overlay = Vector4.Zero; Skin.Color = Terrain.Color = Vector4.One; var gs = new GlStack(); if (held == null) { float f = -0.3f * MathF.Sin(MathF.Sqrt(swing) * MathF.PI); float f1 = 0.4f * MathF.Sin(MathF.Sqrt(swing) * MathF.PI * 2f); float f2 = -0.4f * MathF.Sin(swing * MathF.PI); gs.Translate(f, f1, f2); gs.Translate(0.64000005f, -0.6f, -0.71999997f); gs.Translate(0, equip * -0.6f, 0); gs.Rotate(45, 0, 1, 0); float f3 = MathF.Sin(swing * swing * MathF.PI), f4 = MathF.Sin(MathF.Sqrt(swing) * MathF.PI); gs.Rotate(f4 * 70f, 0, 1, 0); gs.Rotate(f3 * -20f, 0, 0, 1); gs.Translate(-1f, 3.6f, 3.5f); gs.Rotate(120f, 0, 0, 1); gs.Rotate(200f, 1, 0, 0); gs.Rotate(-135f, 0, 1, 0); gs.Translate(5.6f, 0, 0); Skin.Layer = SkinGen.Get("steve"); _rArm.Reset(-5, 2, 0); RenderPart(Skin, _rArm, gs.M); return; } var it = held.Item; bool using_ = p.ItemInUse != null && p.ItemInUse == held; if (using_ && (it.Action == UseAction.Eat || it.Action == UseAction.Drink)) { float left = p.ItemInUseCount - pt + 1f; float f1 = left / it.UseDuration; float f2 = MathF.Abs(MathF.Cos(left / 4f * MathF.PI) * 0.1f); if (f1 >= 0.8f) f2 = 0; gs.Translate(0, f2, 0); float f3 = 1f - MathF.Pow(f1, 27f); gs.Translate(f3 * 0.6f, f3 * -0.5f, 0); gs.Rotate(f3 * 90f, 0, 1, 0); gs.Rotate(f3 * 10f, 1, 0, 0); gs.Rotate(f3 * 30f, 0, 0, 1); swing = 0; } else { float f = -0.4f * MathF.Sin(MathF.Sqrt(swing) * MathF.PI); float f1 = 0.2f * MathF.Sin(MathF.Sqrt(swing) * MathF.PI * 2f); float f2 = -0.2f * MathF.Sin(swing * MathF.PI); gs.Translate(f, f1, f2); } // transformFirstPersonItem gs.Translate(0.56f, -0.52f, -0.71999997f); gs.Translate(0, equip * -0.6f, 0); gs.Rotate(45, 0, 1, 0); float s1 = MathF.Sin(swing * swing * MathF.PI), s2 = MathF.Sin(MathF.Sqrt(swing) * MathF.PI); gs.Rotate(s1 * -20f, 0, 1, 0); gs.Rotate(s2 * -20f, 0, 0, 1); gs.Rotate(s2 * -80f, 1, 0, 0); gs.Scale(0.4f, 0.4f, 0.4f); if (using_ && it.Id == I.Bow) { gs.Rotate(-18f, 0, 0, 1); gs.Rotate(-12f, 0, 1, 0); gs.Rotate(-8f, 1, 0, 0); gs.Translate(-0.9f, 0.2f, 0.0f); float pull = p.BowCharge; gs.Translate(0, 0, -pull * 0.1f); } if (IsBlockModel(it)) { gs.Translate(0.1f, 0.1f, 0); gs.Rotate(45f, 0, 1, 0); gs.Scale(0.55f, 0.55f, 0.55f); RenderBlockAt(it.BlockId, held.Damage, gs.M); } else { gs.Translate(0, 4 / 16f, 2 / 16f); gs.Rotate(-135f, 0, 1, 0); gs.Rotate(25f, 0, 0, 1); gs.Scale(1.05f, 1.05f, 1.05f); RenderSpriteExtruded(it.IsBlock && it.Sprite < 0 ? Block.ById[it.BlockId].Tex[0] : it.Sprite, gs.M); } }

nodes.body_text: public sealed class Shader : IDisposable { public readonly int Handle; private readonly Dictionary<string, int> _loc = new(); public Shader(string vert, string frag, string name = "") { int v = Compile(ShaderType.VertexShader, vert, name); int f = Compile(ShaderType.FragmentShader, frag, name); Handle = GL.CreateProgram(); GL.AttachShader(Handle, v); GL.AttachShader(Handle, f); GL.LinkProgram(Handle); GL.GetProgram(Handle, GetProgramParameterName.LinkStatus, out int ok); if (ok == 0) throw new Exception($"Shader link ({name}): " + GL.GetProgramInfoLog(Handle)); GL.DeleteShader(v); GL.DeleteShader(f); } private static int Compile(ShaderType t, string src, string name) { int s = GL.CreateShader(t); GL.ShaderSource(s, src); GL.CompileShader(s); GL.GetShader(s, ShaderParameter.CompileStatus, out int ok); if (ok == 0) throw new Exception($"Shader compile ({name} {t}): " + GL.GetShaderInfoLog(s)); return s; } public void Use() => GL.UseProgram(Handle); public int Loc(string n) { if (!_loc.TryGetValue(n, out int l)) { l = GL.GetUniformLocation(Handle, n); _loc[n] = l; } return l; } public void Set(string n, float v) => GL.Uniform1(Loc(n), v); public void Set(string n, int v) => GL.Uniform1(Loc(n), v); public void Set(string n, Vector2 v) => GL.Uniform2(Loc(n), v); public void Set(string n, Vector3 v) => GL.Uniform3(Loc(n), v); public void Set(string n, Vector4 v) => GL.Uniform4(Loc(n), v); public void Set(string n, Matrix4 m) => GL.UniformMatrix4(Loc(n), false, ref m); public void Dispose() => GL.DeleteProgram(Handle); }

nodes.body_text: public sealed class TextureArray : IDisposable { public readonly int Handle, Size, Layers; private readonly bool _mips; public TextureArray(int size, IReadOnlyList<uint[]> layers, bool mipmaps, int levels = 4) { Size = size; Layers = layers.Count; _mips = mipmaps; Handle = GL.GenTexture(); GL.BindTexture(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, Handle); int lv = mipmaps ? levels + 1 : 1; GL.TexStorage3D(TextureTarget3d.Texture2DArray, lv, SizedInternalFormat.Rgba8, size, size, Math.Max(1, layers.Count)); for (int i = 0; i < layers.Count; i++) GL.TexSubImage3D(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, 0, 0, 0, i, size, size, 1, PixelFormat.Rgba, PixelType.UnsignedByte, layers[i]); if (mipmaps) { // własne mipmapy z zachowaniem przezroczystości (jak MC) for (int i = 0; i < layers.Count; i++) { var cur = layers[i]; int s = size; for (int l = 1; l < lv; l++) { var next = Downsample(cur, s); s /= 2; GL.TexSubImage3D(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, l, 0, 0, i, s, s, 1, PixelFormat.Rgba, PixelType.UnsignedByte, next); cur = next; } } GL.TexParameter(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, TextureParameterName.TextureMinFilter, (int)TextureMinFilter.NearestMipmapLinear); GL.TexParameter(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, TextureParameterName.TextureMaxLevel, levels); } else GL.TexParameter(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, TextureParameterName.TextureMinFilter, (int)TextureMinFilter.Nearest); GL.TexParameter(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, TextureParameterName.TextureMagFilter, (int)TextureMagFilter.Nearest); GL.TexParameter(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, TextureParameterName.TextureWrapS, (int)TextureWrapMode.Repeat); GL.TexParameter(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, TextureParameterName.TextureWrapT, (int)TextureWrapMode.Repeat); } private static uint[] Downsample(uint[] src, int s) { int h = s / 2; var dst = new uint[h * h]; for (int y = 0; y < h; y++) for (int x = 0; x < h; x++) { int r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0, n = 0, amax = 0; for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) { uint c = src[(y * 2 + (k >> 1)) * s + x * 2 + (k & 1)]; int ca = (int)(c >> 24); amax = Math.Max(amax, ca); if (ca == 0) continue; r += (int)(c & 255); g += (int)((c >> 8) & 255); b += (int)((c >> 16) & 255); a += ca; n++; } if (n == 0) { dst[y * h + x] = 0; continue; } int aa = a / 4; // zachowaj krycie dla wycięć (liście) – zaokrąglenie jak MC if (amax == 255 && n >= 2) aa = 255; if (amax < 255) aa = a / n; dst[y * h + x] = (uint)((r / n) | ((g / n) << 8) | ((b / n) << 16) | (aa << 24)); } return dst; } public void UpdateLayer(int layer, uint[] px) { GL.BindTexture(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, Handle); GL.TexSubImage3D(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, 0, 0, 0, layer, Size, Size, 1, PixelFormat.Rgba, PixelType.UnsignedByte, px); if (_mips) { var cur = px; int s = Size; for (int l = 1; s > 1 && l <= 4; l++) { var next = Downsample(cur, s); s /= 2; GL.TexSubImage3D(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, l, 0, 0, layer, s, s, 1, PixelFormat.Rgba, PixelType.UnsignedByte, next); cur = next; } } } public void Bind(int unit = 0) { GL.ActiveTexture(TextureUnit.Texture0 + unit); GL.BindTexture(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, Handle); } public void Dispose() => GL.DeleteTexture(Handle); }

nodes.signature: public TextureArray(int size, IReadOnlyList<uint[]> layers, bool mipmaps, int levels = 4)
nodes.body_text: public TextureArray(int size, IReadOnlyList<uint[]> layers, bool mipmaps, int levels = 4) { Size = size; Layers = layers.Count; _mips = mipmaps; Handle = GL.GenTexture(); GL.BindTexture(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, Handle); int lv = mipmaps ? levels + 1 : 1; GL.TexStorage3D(TextureTarget3d.Texture2DArray, lv, SizedInternalFormat.Rgba8, size, size, Math.Max(1, layers.Count)); for (int i = 0; i < layers.Count; i++) GL.TexSubImage3D(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, 0, 0, 0, i, size, size, 1, PixelFormat.Rgba, PixelType.UnsignedByte, layers[i]); if (mipmaps) { // własne mipmapy z zachowaniem przezroczystości (jak MC) for (int i = 0; i < layers.Count; i++) { var cur = layers[i]; int s = size; for (int l = 1; l < lv; l++) { var next = Downsample(cur, s); s /= 2; GL.TexSubImage3D(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, l, 0, 0, i, s, s, 1, PixelFormat.Rgba, PixelType.UnsignedByte, next); cur = next; } } GL.TexParameter(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, TextureParameterName.TextureMinFilter, (int)TextureMinFilter.NearestMipmapLinear); GL.TexParameter(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, TextureParameterName.TextureMaxLevel, levels); } else GL.TexParameter(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, TextureParameterName.TextureMinFilter, (int)TextureMinFilter.Nearest); GL.TexParameter(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, TextureParameterName.TextureMagFilter, (int)TextureMagFilter.Nearest); GL.TexParameter(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, TextureParameterName.TextureWrapS, (int)TextureWrapMode.Repeat); GL.TexParameter(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, TextureParameterName.TextureWrapT, (int)TextureWrapMode.Repeat); }

nodes.name: Downsample
nodes.signature: private static uint[] Downsample(uint[] src, int s)
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] Downsample(uint[] src, int s) { int h = s / 2; var dst = new uint[h * h]; for (int y = 0; y < h; y++) for (int x = 0; x < h; x++) { int r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0, n = 0, amax = 0; for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) { uint c = src[(y * 2 + (k >> 1)) * s + x * 2 + (k & 1)]; int ca = (int)(c >> 24); amax = Math.Max(amax, ca); if (ca == 0) continue; r += (int)(c & 255); g += (int)((c >> 8) & 255); b += (int)((c >> 16) & 255); a += ca; n++; } if (n == 0) { dst[y * h + x] = 0; continue; } int aa = a / 4; // zachowaj krycie dla wycięć (liście) – zaokrąglenie jak MC if (amax == 255 && n >= 2) aa = 255; if (amax < 255) aa = a / n; dst[y * h + x] = (uint)((r / n) | ((g / n) << 8) | ((b / n) << 16) | (aa << 24)); } return dst; }

nodes.name: UpdateLayer
nodes.signature: public void UpdateLayer(int layer, uint[] px)
nodes.body_text: public void UpdateLayer(int layer, uint[] px) { GL.BindTexture(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, Handle); GL.TexSubImage3D(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, 0, 0, 0, layer, Size, Size, 1, PixelFormat.Rgba, PixelType.UnsignedByte, px); if (_mips) { var cur = px; int s = Size; for (int l = 1; s > 1 && l <= 4; l++) { var next = Downsample(cur, s); s /= 2; GL.TexSubImage3D(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, l, 0, 0, layer, s, s, 1, PixelFormat.Rgba, PixelType.UnsignedByte, next); cur = next; } } }

nodes.signature: public sealed class Mesh : IDisposable
nodes.body_text: public sealed class Mesh : IDisposable { public readonly int Vao, Vbo, Ebo; public int IndexCount, VertexCount; public readonly int Stride; public Mesh(int stride, Action setupAttribs, bool indexed = true) { Stride = stride; Vao = GL.GenVertexArray(); Vbo = GL.GenBuffer(); GL.BindVertexArray(Vao); GL.BindBuffer(BufferTarget.ArrayBuffer, Vbo); setupAttribs(); if (indexed) { Ebo = SharedQuadIndices.Ebo; GL.BindBuffer(BufferTarget.ElementArrayBuffer, Ebo); } GL.BindVertexArray(0); } public unsafe void Upload(byte[] data, int bytes, BufferUsageHint hint = BufferUsageHint.StaticDraw) { GL.BindBuffer(BufferTarget.ArrayBuffer, Vbo); fixed (byte* p = data) GL.BufferData(BufferTarget.ArrayBuffer, bytes, (IntPtr)p, hint); VertexCount = bytes / Stride; IndexCount = VertexCount / 4 * 6; SharedQuadIndices.Ensure(VertexCount / 4); } public unsafe void Upload(float[] data, int floats, BufferUsageHint hint = BufferUsageHint.StreamDraw) { GL.BindBuffer(BufferTarget.ArrayBuffer, Vbo); fixed (float* p = data) GL.BufferData(BufferTarget.ArrayBuffer, floats * 4, (IntPtr)p, hint); VertexCount = floats * 4 / Stride; IndexCount = VertexCount / 4 * 6; SharedQuadIndices.Ensure(VertexCount / 4); } public void DrawQuads() { if (IndexCount == 0) return; GL.BindVertexArray(Vao); GL.DrawElements(PrimitiveType.Triangles, IndexCount, DrawElementsType.UnsignedInt, 0); } public void DrawArrays(PrimitiveType t) { if (VertexCount == 0) return; GL.BindVertexArray(Vao); GL.DrawArrays(t, 0, VertexCount); } public void Dispose() { GL.DeleteBuffer(Vbo); GL.DeleteVertexArray(Vao); } }

nodes.body_text: public static class SharedQuadIndices { public static int Ebo; private static int _quads; public static void Init() { Ebo = GL.GenBuffer(); Ensure(65536); } public static void Ensure(int quads) { if (quads <= _quads) return; int n = Math.Max(quads, _quads * 2); var idx = new uint[n * 6]; for (uint q = 0; q < n; q++) { uint v = q * 4; int i = (int)q * 6; idx[i] = v; idx[i + 1] = v + 1; idx[i + 2] = v + 2; idx[i + 3] = v + 2; idx[i + 4] = v + 3; idx[i + 5] = v; } GL.BindBuffer(BufferTarget.ElementArrayBuffer, Ebo); GL.BufferData(BufferTarget.ElementArrayBuffer, idx.Length * 4, idx, BufferUsageHint.StaticDraw); _quads = n; } }

nodes.name: Framebuffer
nodes.signature: public sealed class Framebuffer : IDisposable
nodes.body_text: public sealed class Framebuffer : IDisposable { public int Fbo, ColorTex, DepthRb, Width, Height; public Framebuffer(int w, int h) { Resize(w, h); } public void Resize(int w, int h) { Dispose(); Width = w; Height = h; Fbo = GL.GenFramebuffer(); GL.BindFramebuffer(FramebufferTarget.Framebuffer, Fbo); ColorTex = GL.GenTexture(); GL.BindTexture(TextureTarget.Texture2D, ColorTex); GL.TexImage2D(TextureTarget.Texture2D, 0, PixelInternalFormat.Rgba8, w, h, 0, PixelFormat.Rgba, PixelType.UnsignedByte, IntPtr.Zero); GL.TexParameter(TextureTarget.Texture2D, TextureParameterName.TextureMinFilter, (int)TextureMinFilter.Linear); GL.TexParameter(TextureTarget.Texture2D, TextureParameterName.TextureMagFilter, (int)TextureMagFilter.Linear); GL.FramebufferTexture2D(FramebufferTarget.Framebuffer, FramebufferAttachment.ColorAttachment0, TextureTarget.Texture2D, ColorTex, 0); DepthRb = GL.GenRenderbuffer(); GL.BindRenderbuffer(RenderbufferTarget.Renderbuffer, DepthRb); GL.RenderbufferStorage(RenderbufferTarget.Renderbuffer, RenderbufferStorage.Depth24Stencil8, w, h); GL.FramebufferRenderbuffer(FramebufferTarget.Framebuffer, FramebufferAttachment.DepthStencilAttachment, RenderbufferTarget.Renderbuffer, DepthRb); GL.BindFramebuffer(FramebufferTarget.Framebuffer, 0); } public void Dispose() { if (Fbo != 0) { GL.DeleteFramebuffer(Fbo); GL.DeleteTexture(ColorTex); GL.DeleteRenderbuffer(DepthRb); Fbo = 0; } } }

nodes.name: IconAtlas
nodes.signature: public sealed class IconAtlas : IDisposable
nodes.body_text: public sealed class IconAtlas : IDisposable { public const int Size = 64; public TextureArray Array; private readonly Dictionary<int, int> _layer = new(); // klucz: id | meta<<16 public bool TryGet(ItemStack s, out int layer) { int key = s.Id | ((s.Id == World.B.Wool ? s.Damage : 0) << 16); return _layer.TryGetValue(key, out layer); } public IconAtlas(EntityRenderer er, TextureArray terrain) { var keys = new List<(int id, int meta)>(); foreach (var it in Item.All) { if (!EntityRenderer.IsBlockModel(it)) continue; if (it.Id == World.B.Wool) { for (int m = 0; m < 6; m++) keys.Add((it.Id, m)); } else keys.Add((it.Id, 0)); } var empty = new List<uint[]>(); for (int i = 0; i < Math.Max(1, keys.Count); i++) empty.Add(new uint[Size * Size]); Array = new TextureArray(Size, empty, false); var fbo = new Framebuffer(Size, Size); GL.BindFramebuffer(FramebufferTarget.Framebuffer, fbo.Fbo); GL.Viewport(0, 0, Size, Size); GL.Enable(EnableCap.DepthTest); GL.DepthFunc(DepthFunction.Lequal); GL.Disable(EnableCap.CullFace); GL.Disable(EnableCap.Blend); var proj = Matrix4.CreateOrthographicOffCenter(-1, 1, -1, 1, -10, 10); er.Shader.Use(); er.Shader.Set("uViewProj", proj); er.Shader.Set("uFogColor", Vector3.Zero); er.Shader.Set("uFogStart", 1000f); er.Shader.Set("uFogEnd", 2000f); er.Shader.Set("uFogMode", 0); er.Shader.Set("uSun", 1f); er.Shader.Set("uGamma", 0f); var b = er.Terrain; b.Sky = 15; b.Blk = 0; b.Color = Vector4.One; b.Overlay = Vector4.Zero; for (int i = 0; i < keys.Count; i++) { GL.ClearColor(0, 0, 0, 0); GL.Clear(ClearBufferMask.ColorBufferBit | ClearBufferMask.DepthBufferBit); // MC: rotate X 30, Y 225(45), skala ~0.625 var m = Matrix4.CreateRotationY(MathHelper.DegreesToRadians(45)) * Matrix4.CreateRotationX(MathHelper.DegreesToRadians(30)) * Matrix4.CreateScale(1.12f); b.FlatShade = true; er.RenderBlockAt(keys[i].id, keys[i].meta, m); // ręczne cieniowanie ścian: góra jasna, boki ciemniejsze (jak GUI MC) ShadeFaces(b); b.FlatShade = false; er.Flush(b, terrain); Array.Bind(0); GL.CopyTexSubImage3D(TextureTarget.Texture2DArray, 0, 0, 0, i, 0, 0, Size, Size); _layer[keys[i].id | (keys[i].id == World.B.Wool ? keys[i].meta << 16 : 0)] = i; } GL.BindFramebuffer(FramebufferTarget.Framebuffer, 0); fbo.Dispose(); } /// <summary>Ustawia jasność wg normalnej (obliczonej z pozycji wierzchołków).</summary> private static void ShadeFaces(ModelBatch b) { for (int q = 0; q < b.Verts / 4; q++) { int o = q * 4 * ModelBatch.F; var a = new Vector3(b.D[o], b.D[o + 1], b.D[o + 2]); var bb = new Vector3(b.D[o + ModelBatch.F], b.D[o + ModelBatch.F + 1], b.D[o + ModelBatch.F + 2]); var d = new Vector3(b.D[o + 3 * ModelBatch.F], b.D[o + 3 * ModelBatch.F + 1], b.D[o + 3 * ModelBatch.F + 2]); var n = Vector3.Cross(bb - a, d - a); if (n.LengthSquared < 1e-12f) continue; n.Normalize(); float s = n.Y > 0.5f ? 1f : n.X > 0.1f ? 0.8f : n.X < -0.1f ? 0.6f : 0.7f; if (n.Y < -0.5f) s = 0.5f; for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) b.D[o + k * ModelBatch.F + 6] = s; } } public void Dispose() => Array.Dispose(); }

nodes.signature: public static partial class TextureGen
nodes.body_text: public static partial class TextureGen { private static Dictionary<char, uint> Pal(params (char c, uint hex)[] e) { var d = new Dictionary<char, uint>(); foreach (var (c, h) in e) d[c] = Hex(h); return d; } private static uint[] Sprite(string[] rows, Dictionary<char, uint> pal) { var p = New(); Stamp(p, rows, pal); return p; } private static readonly (uint o, uint d, uint m, uint l)[] ToolMats = { (0x3D2C14, 0x6B5331, 0x9C7F4E, 0xBC9862), // drewno (0x2A2A2A, 0x555555, 0x7F7F7F, 0xA0A0A0), // kamień (0x353535, 0x8C8C8C, 0xC6C6C6, 0xEFEFEF), // żelazo (0x5E4A0E, 0xC79F21, 0xF2D33A, 0xFFFBA0), // złoto (0x0E3D3A, 0x1BA59D, 0x4AEDD9, 0xC6FFF6), // diament }; private static void StickDiag(uint[] p, int fromRow, int toRow) { uint k = Hex(0x28190A), s = Hex(0x8F6A3B), t = Hex(0x5E4426); for (int r = fromRow; r <= toRow; r++) { int c = 14 - r; void Set(int x, uint col) { if (x >= 0 && x < 16) p[r * 16 + x] = col; } Set(c - 1, k); Set(c, s); Set(c + 1, t); Set(c + 2, k); } if (toRow >= 13) { p[14 * 16 + 0] = k; p[14 * 16 + 1] = t; p[14 * 16 + 2] = k; p[15 * 16 + 1] = k; } } private static uint[] Tool(string[] head, int stickFrom, (uint o, uint d, uint m, uint l) mat, bool stickFirst = true) { var p = New(); StickDiag(p, stickFrom, 13); Stamp(p, head, new() { ['o'] = Hex(mat.o), ['d'] = Hex(mat.d), ['m'] = Hex(mat.m), ['l'] = Hex(mat.l) }); return p; } private static readonly string[] PickHead = { "................", ".....ooooo......", "...oolllllmoo...", "..olmmmmmmmmdo..", "...ooooommmddmo.", "..........oddmo.", "...........odmo.", "...........odmo.", "...........odmo.", "...........odo..", "...........odo..", "............o...", }; private static readonly string[] AxeHead = { "................", "......ooo.......", ".....olmmo......", "....olmmmmo.....", "...olmmmmdo.....", "...olmmmddo.....", "....ooddo.......", "......oo........", }; private static readonly string[] ShovelHead = { "...........ooo..", "..........olllo.", ".........olmmmdo", ".........ommmddo", "..........omddo.", "...........ooo..", }; private static readonly string[] HoeHead = { "................", "......ooooooo...", ".....olllmmmdo..", "......oooooddo..", "..........oodo..", }; private static readonly string[] SwordFull = { "..............oo", ".............olo", "............olmo", "...........olmo.", "..........olmo..", ".........olmo...", "........olmo....", ".......olmo.....", "..oo..olmo......", "..odoolmo.......", "...odmmo........", "...oddo.........", "..o.ooo.........", "................", "................", "................", }; private static uint[] Sword((uint o, uint d, uint m, uint l) mat) { var p = New(); uint k = Hex(0x28190A), s = Hex(0x8F6A3B), t = Hex(0x5E4426); // rękojeść int[,] h = { { 1, 14 }, { 2, 13 }, { 3, 12 } }; p[15 * 16 + 0] = k; p[14 * 16 + 0] = k; p[15 * 16 + 1] = k; for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) { int x = h[i, 0], y = h[i, 1]; p[y * 16 + x] = i == 1 ? t : s; p[y * 16 + x - 1] = k; p[(y + 1) * 16 + x] = k; } p[12 * 16 + 2] = k; Stamp(p, SwordFull, new() { ['o'] = Hex(mat.o), ['d'] = Hex(mat.d), ['m'] = Hex(mat.m), ['l'] = Hex(mat.l) }); return p; } private static void GenerateItems() { string[] mats = { "wooden", "stone", "iron", "golden", "diamond" }; for (int m = 0; m < 5; m++) { var mat = ToolMats[m]; Add($"item_{mats[m]}_pickaxe", Tool(PickHead, 5, mat)); Add($"item_{mats[m]}_axe", Tool(AxeHead, 4, mat)); Add($"item_{mats[m]}_shovel", Tool(ShovelHead, 4, mat)); vUV=aUV; vCol=aCol; vLayer=aLayer; }"; private const string Frag = @"#version 330 core in vec2 vUV; in vec4 vCol; in float vLayer; uniform sampler2D uTex; uniform sampler2DArray uArr; uniform int uMode; out vec4 o; void main(){ vec4 t = uMode==1 ? texture(uArr, vec3(vUV, vLayer)) : texture(uTex, vUV); o = t*vCol; if(o.a<0.004) discard; }"; public SpriteBatch() { _shader = new Shader(Vert, Frag, "sprite"); var px = new uint[w * h]; for (int i = 0; i < chars.Count; i++) { var (g, start) = FontData.Glyphs[chars[i]]; int cx = (i % cols) * FontData.CellW, cy = (i / cols) * FontData.CellH; int gw = g.Max(r => r.Length); for (int r = 0; r < g.Length; r++) for (int c = 0; c < g[r].Length; c++) if (g[r][c] == '#') { int yy = cy + FontData.Top + start + r; if (yy >= cy && yy < cy + FontData.CellH) px[yy * w + cx + c] = 0xFFFFFFFF; } _glyphs[chars[i]] = (cx, cy, gw, start); } FontTex = new Texture2D(w, h, px); } public void Begin(int width, int height, float scale) { _proj = Matrix4.CreateOrthographicOffCenter(0, width / scale, height / scale, 0, -1, 1); nodes.body_text: private void TextRaw(string s, float x, float y, uint color, bool isShadow, float scale) { SetTex(FontTex.Handle, false); float cx = x; uint col = color; float a = (color >> 24) / 255f; if (isShadow) col = Shadow(color); float tw = FontTex.Width, th = FontTex.Height; for (int i = 0; i < s.Length; i++) { char c = s[i]; if (c == '§' && i + 1 < s.Length) { char k = char.ToLowerInvariant(s[++i]); int idx = "0123456789abcdef".IndexOf(k); uint nc = idx >= 0 ? (Hex(Codes[idx], (int)(a * 255))) : color; col = isShadow ? Shadow(nc) : nc; continue; } if (c == '\n') { cx = x; y += 10 * scale; continue; } if (!_glyphs.TryGetValue(c, out var g) && !_glyphs.TryGetValue(char.ToLowerInvariant(c), out g)) { g = _glyphs['?']; } if (c != ' ') Quad(cx, y - FontData.Top * scale, FontData.CellW * scale, FontData.CellH * scale, g.x / tw, g.y / th, (g.x + FontData.CellW) / tw, (g.y + FontData.CellH) / th, col, col, 0); cx += (CharW(c) + 1) * scale; } }

nodes.signature: public static float[] TileNoise(int seed, int cells)

nodes.name: Cobble
nodes.signature: private static uint[] Cobble(int seed, bool mossy)
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] Cobble(int seed, bool mossy) { var r = new Rng(seed); int n = 10; var pts = new (float x, float y, float shade)[n]; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) pts[i] = (r.NextFloat() * 16, r.NextFloat() * 16, 0.8f + r.NextFloat() * 0.35f); var p = New(); var moss = Fbm(seed + 3, 0.3f); for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { float d1 = 999, d2 = 999; int best = 0; float bdx = 0, bdy = 0; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int ox = -16; ox <= 16; ox += 16) for (int oy = -16; oy <= 16; oy += 16) { float dx = x + 0.5f - (pts[i].x + ox), dy = y + 0.5f - (pts[i].y + oy); float d = MathF.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy); if (d < d1) { d2 = d1; d1 = d; best = i; bdx = dx; bdy = dy; } else if (d < d2) d2 = d; } uint c; if (d2 - d1 < 1.1f) c = (d2 - d1 < 0.5f) ? Hex(0x3C3C3C) : Hex(0x525252); else { float shade = pts[best].shade; float hl = -(bdx + bdy) * 0.03f; float v = Math.Clamp(shade + hl + (r.NextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.12f, 0.55f, 1.25f); c = Mul(Hex(0x8A8A8A), v); } if (mossy && moss[y * 16 + x] > 0.58f) c = (d2 - d1 < 1.1f) ? Hex(0x3E5A2A) : Lerp(Hex(0x5C7F3A), Hex(0x4A6A2E), r.NextFloat()); p[y * 16 + x] = c; } return p; }

nodes.name: Planks
nodes.signature: private static uint[] Planks(uint[] pal, uint seam, int seed)
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] Planks(uint[] pal, uint seam, int seed) { // pal: jasny, średni, ciemny, bardzo jasny var p = New(); var r = new Rng(seed); var grain = TileNoise(seed, 16); int[] seams = { 3, 12, 7, 15 }; for (int b = 0; b < 4; b++) { int sx = (seams[b] + r.Next(2)) & 15; for (int y = b * 4; y < b * 4 + 4; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { float g = grain[(y / 2 * 16 + x) & 255] + (r.NextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.25f; uint c = g < 0.3f ? pal[2] : g < 0.62f ? pal[1] : g < 0.9f ? pal[0] : pal[3]; if (y == b * 4 + 3) c = seam; else if (x == sx) c = Mul(seam, 1.15f); p[y * 16 + x] = c; } } return p; }

nodes.name: LogSide
nodes.signature: private static uint[] LogSide(uint[] pal, int seed)
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] LogSide(uint[] pal, int seed) { var p = New(); var r = new Rng(seed); var col = new float[16]; for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) col[x] = r.NextFloat(); for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { float v = col[x] * 0.6f + r.NextFloat() * 0.25f + (MathF.Sin((y + x * 3) * 0.7f) * 0.5f + 0.5f) * 0.15f; if (r.Next(14) == 0) col[x] = r.NextFloat(); p[y * 16 + x] = Pick(pal, v); } return p; }

nodes.name: LogTop
nodes.signature: private static uint[] LogTop(uint bark, uint[] rings, int seed)
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] LogTop(uint bark, uint[] rings, int seed) { var p = New(); var r = new Rng(seed); for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { float dx = x - 7.5f, dy = y - 7.5f; float d = MathF.Max(MathF.Abs(dx), MathF.Abs(dy)) * 0.75f + MathF.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) * 0.25f; uint c; if (x == 0 || y == 0 || x == 15 || y == 15) c = Mul(bark, 0.85f + r.NextFloat() * 0.3f); else { int ring = (int)(d * 0.9f + r.NextFloat() * 0.4f); c = rings[ring % rings.Length]; c = Mul(c, 0.94f + r.NextFloat() * 0.1f); } p[y * 16 + x] = c; } return p; }

nodes.name: Leaves
nodes.signature: private static uint[] Leaves(int seed, bool transparent)
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] Leaves(int seed, bool transparent) { var n = Fbm(seed, 0.5f); var r = new Rng(seed + 3); var holes = TileNoise(seed + 9, 8); var p = New(); float[] lv = { 0.36f, 0.45f, 0.53f, 0.62f, 0.72f }; for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) { bool hole = holes[i] + r.NextFloat() * 0.35f > 0.92f; uint c = Gray(lv[(int)(Math.Clamp((n[i] - 0.5f) * 1.7f + 0.5f, 0, 0.999f) * lv.Length)]); if (hole) c = transparent ? 0 : Gray(0.22f); p[i] = c; } return p; }

nodes.name: Ore
nodes.signature: private static uint[] Ore(int seed, uint light, uint mid, uint dark, int clusters = 5)
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] Ore(int seed, uint light, uint mid, uint dark, int clusters = 5) { var p = Stone(seed); var r = new Rng(seed * 13 + 1); for (int k = 0; k < clusters; k++) { int cx = r.Next(14) + 1, cy = r.Next(14) + 1; int shape = r.Next(3); var pts = new List<(int, int)>(); pts.Add((cx, cy)); pts.Add((cx + 1, cy)); pts.Add((cx, cy + 1)); if (shape >= 1) pts.Add((cx + 1, cy + 1)); if (shape == 2) { pts.Add((cx - 1, cy)); pts.Add((cx, cy - 1)); } foreach (var (x, y) in pts) { int sx = (x + 1) & 15, sy = (y + 1) & 15; if (!pts.Contains((x + 1, y + 1))) p[sy * 16 + sx] = Mul(dark, 0.8f); } foreach (var (x, y) in pts) p[(y & 15) * 16 + (x & 15)] = mid; p[(cy & 15) * 16 + (cx & 15)] = light; if (r.NextBool()) p[((cy + 1) & 15) * 16 + ((cx + 1) & 15)] = dark; } return p; }

nodes.name: StorageBlock
nodes.signature: private static uint[] StorageBlock(uint baseC, uint light, uint dark, int seed, bool pattern)
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] StorageBlock(uint baseC, uint light, uint dark, int seed, bool pattern) { var p = New(baseC); var r = new Rng(seed); for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { uint c = Mul(baseC, 0.95f + r.NextFloat() * 0.1f); if (x == 0 || y == 0) c = light; if (x == 15 || y == 15) c = dark; if (pattern) { if ((x == 1 || y == 1) && x < 15 && y < 15) c = Lerp(light, baseC, 0.5f); if ((x == 14 || y == 14) && x > 0 && y > 0) c = Lerp(dark, baseC, 0.5f); if ((x + y) % 7 == 0 && x > 2 && y > 2 && x < 13 && y < 13 && r.Next(3) == 0) c = light; } p[y * 16 + x] = c; } return p; }

nodes.name: Wool
nodes.signature: private static uint[] Wool(uint c, int seed)
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] Wool(uint c, int seed) { var p = New(); var r = new Rng(seed); var n = TileNoise(seed, 8); for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { float v = 0.88f + n[y * 16 + x] * 0.12f + (((x + y * 2) % 4 == 0) ? -0.05f : 0) + (r.NextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.06f; p[y * 16 + x] = Mul(c, v); } return p; }

nodes.name: Gravel
nodes.signature: private static uint[] Gravel()
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] Gravel() { var r = new Rng(43); int n = 22; var pts = new (float x, float y, uint c)[n]; var cols = Palette(0xA9A5A4, 0x6E6967, 0x8E7E78, 0x5D5856, 0x9A9594, 0x7F7C7B, 0xB5B0AE); for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) pts[i] = (r.NextFloat() * 16, r.NextFloat() * 16, cols[r.Next(cols.Length)]); var p = New(); for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { float d1 = 999, d2 = 999; int best = 0; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int ox = -16; ox <= 16; ox += 16) for (int oy = -16; oy <= 16; oy += 16) { float dx = x + 0.5f - (pts[i].x + ox), dy = y + 0.5f - (pts[i].y + oy); float d = dx * dx + dy * dy; if (d < d1) { d2 = d1; d1 = d; best = i; } else if (d < d2) d2 = d; } uint c = pts[best].c; if (MathF.Sqrt(d2) - MathF.Sqrt(d1) < 0.6f) c = Mul(c, 0.7f); p[y * 16 + x] = Mul(c, 0.93f + r.NextFloat() * 0.12f); } return p; }

Hex(0x4A4A48) : Hex(0x1E1E1E); for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) p[y * 16 + ((x + i) & 15)] = c; if (r.NextBool()) p[((y + 1) & 15) * 16 + ((x + 1) & 15)] = Hex(0x5A5A56); } return p; }

nodes.signature: private static uint[] Glass()
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] Glass() { var p = New(); uint edge = Hex(0xDAEEF0), edgeD = Hex(0xA7C9D1), hl = Hex(0xFFFFFF, 220); for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) { p[i] = edge; p[i * 16] = edge; p[15 * 16 + i] = edgeD; p[i * 16 + 15] = edgeD; } int[][] streaks = { new[] { 3, 4 }, new[] { 4, 3 }, new[] { 5, 2 }, new[] { 10, 9 }, new[] { 11, 8 }, new[] { 12, 7 }, new[] { 4, 5 } }; foreach (var s in streaks) p[s[1] * 16 + s[0]] = hl; return p; }

nodes.body_text: private static uint[] SandstoneSide() { var p = New(); var r = new Rng(92); var n = TileNoise(93, 8); for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { uint c; if (y < 3) c = y == 2 ? Hex(0xCFC48C) : Lerp(Hex(0xE0D7A6), Hex(0xD8CF9C), r.NextFloat()); else if (y > 12) c = y == 13 ? Hex(0xB8AA70) : Lerp(Hex(0xC9BC82), Hex(0xBFB179), r.NextFloat()); else { float band = MathF.Sin(y * 1.3f + n[y * 16 + x] * 3f) * 0.5f + 0.5f; c = Lerp(Hex(0xCBBE84), Hex(0xDDD4A2), band * 0.8f + r.NextFloat() * 0.2f); } p[y * 16 + x] = c; } return p; }

nodes.body_text: private static uint[] Poppy() { var p = New(); uint st = Hex(0x337A1A), st2 = Hex(0x4A9A28), r1 = Hex(0xED302C), r2 = Hex(0xBE1C1C), r3 = Hex(0xFF6F5E), c = Hex(0x2B0A0A); for (int y = 9; y < 16; y++) p[y * 16 + 7] = st; p[12 * 16 + 6] = st2; p[11 * 16 + 5] = st2; p[13 * 16 + 8] = st2; p[12 * 16 + 9] = st2; for (int y = 4; y < 9; y++) for (int x = 5; x < 10; x++) { if ((x == 5 || x == 9) && (y == 4 || y == 8)) continue; p[y * 16 + x] = (x + y) % 3 == 0 ? r2 : r1; } p[5 * 16 + 6] = r3; p[4 * 16 + 7] = r3; p[6 * 16 + 7] = c; p[6 * 16 + 8] = Hex(0x5A1010); return p; }

nodes.name: TallGrass
nodes.signature: private static uint[] TallGrass()
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] TallGrass() { var p = New(); var r = new Rng(201); int[] xs = { 1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 9, 10, 12, 13, 14 }; foreach (int bx in xs) { int h = 5 + r.Next(10); int x = bx; float drift = (r.NextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.4f; float fx = bx; for (int y = 15; y > 15 - h && y >= 0; y--) { fx += drift; x = Math.Clamp((int)MathF.Round(fx), 0, 15); p[y * 16 + x] = Gray(0.55f + r.NextFloat() * 0.3f + (15 - y) * 0.01f); } } return p; }

nodes.name: DeadBush
nodes.signature: private static uint[] DeadBush()
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] DeadBush() { var p = New(); uint a = Hex(0x6B4E2A), b = Hex(0x8A6436), c = Hex(0x4F391D); void L(int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1, uint col) { int n = Math.Max(Math.Abs(x1 - x0), Math.Abs(y1 - y0)); for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) { int x = x0 + (x1 - x0) * i / Math.Max(1, n), y = y0 + (y1 - y0) * i / Math.Max(1, n); p[y * 16 + x] = col; } } L(8, 15, 8, 9, a); L(8, 11, 4, 6, b); L(8, 10, 12, 5, a); L(5, 8, 2, 7, c); L(11, 7, 14, 8, c); L(8, 9, 7, 3, b); L(6, 7, 5, 3, c); L(10, 6, 11, 2, b); return p; }

nodes.name: CactusSide
nodes.signature: private static uint[] CactusSide()
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] CactusSide() { var p = New(); var r = new Rng(211); uint d = Hex(0x0D6418), m = Hex(0x107A1C), l = Hex(0x15921F); for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { uint c = (x % 4 == 1) ? l : (x % 4 == 3 ? d : m); c = Mul(c, 0.92f + r.NextFloat() * 0.12f); p[y * 16 + x] = c; } for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++) { int x = (r.Next(4) * 4 + 1) & 15, y = r.Next(16); p[y * 16 + x] = Hex(0xDADAB0); p[((y + 1) & 15) * 16 + x] = Hex(0x1B1B1B); } for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) { p[y * 16] = Mul(p[y * 16], 0.8f); p[y * 16 + 15] = Mul(p[y * 16 + 15], 0.8f); } return p; }

nodes.name: CactusTop
nodes.signature: private static uint[] CactusTop(bool bottom)
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] CactusTop(bool bottom) { var p = New(); var r = new Rng(bottom ? 213 : 212); for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { float d = MathF.Max(MathF.Abs(x - 7.5f), MathF.Abs(y - 7.5f)); uint c = d > 6.5f ? Hex(0x0D6418) : ((int)d % 2 == 0 ? Hex(0x15921F) : Hex(0x107A1C)); if (!bottom && d < 1.5f) c = Hex(0x2DA537); p[y * 16 + x] = Mul(c, 0.92f + r.NextFloat() * 0.12f); } return p; }

Hex(0x6B8F3D) : Hex(0x94C065); p[y * 16 + cx + 1] = node ? Hex(0x5E7F34) : Hex(0xAACC77); if (node && r.NextBool()) p[y * 16 + cx + 2] = Hex(0x7FA855); } } return p; }

nodes.name: Sapling
nodes.signature: private static uint[] Sapling(uint leaf, uint dark, uint light)
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] Sapling(uint leaf, uint dark, uint light) { var p = New(); var r = new Rng((int)leaf); for (int y = 9; y < 16; y++) p[y * 16 + 7] = Hex(0x5E4A26); p[12 * 16 + 8] = Hex(0x6B5126); for (int y = 1; y < 11; y++) for (int x = 2; x < 14; x++) { float dx = x - 7.5f, dy = (y - 5.5f) * 1.2f; if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 22 + r.Next(10) - 5) { float v = r.NextFloat(); p[y * 16 + x] = v < 0.3f ? dark : v < 0.8f ? leaf : light; } } return p; }

nodes.body_text: private static uint[] StoneBrick() { var p = Stone(131); for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) p[i] = Mul(p[i], 0.98f); uint mort = Hex(0x4F4F4F), hl = Hex(0x9A9A9A); for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { p[7 * 16 + x] = mort; p[15 * 16 + x] = mort; p[0 * 16 + x] = hl; p[8 * 16 + x] = hl; } for (int y = 0; y < 8; y++) { p[y * 16 + 15] = mort; if (y > 0 && y < 7) p[y * 16 + 0] = hl; } for (int y = 8; y < 16; y++) { p[y * 16 + 7] = mort; if (y > 8 && y < 15) p[y * 16 + 8] = hl; } return p; }

nodes.signature: private static uint[] Bricks()
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] Bricks() { var p = New(); var r = new Rng(132); uint mort = Hex(0xA49A8D); for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { int row = y / 4; int off = (row % 2) * 4; bool m = y % 4 == 3 || (x + off) % 8 == 7; uint c = m ? Mul(mort, 0.9f + r.NextFloat() * 0.15f) : Mul(Hex(0x96604B), 0.85f + r.NextFloat() * 0.25f); if (!m && y % 4 == 0) c = Mul(c, 1.1f); p[y * 16 + x] = c; } return p; }

nodes.name: CraftingSide
nodes.signature: private static uint[] CraftingSide(bool front)
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] CraftingSide(bool front) { var p = Planks(Palette(0xA8865A, 0x94774C, 0x7E623C, 0xB4905E), Hex(0x5E4A2C), front ? 143 : 142); uint dark = Hex(0x4F3A1C); for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) { p[i] = dark; p[16 + i] = Hex(0x6B5331); p[2 * 16 + i] = Hex(0xB08F5A); } uint metal = Hex(0x8A8A8A), metalD = Hex(0x5A5A5A), handle = Hex(0x6B4E2A); if (!front) { // młotek for (int y = 5; y < 13; y++) p[y * 16 + 4] = handle; for (int x = 2; x < 7; x++) { p[4 * 16 + x] = metal; p[5 * 16 + x] = metalD; } // piła for (int y = 4; y < 13; y++) { p[y * 16 + 10] = metal; p[y * 16 + 11] = metal; if (y % 2 == 0) p[y * 16 + 12] = metalD; } for (int y = 12; y < 15; y++) { p[y * 16 + 10] = handle; p[y * 16 + 11] = handle; } } else { // nożyce/obcęgi for (int y = 5; y < 13; y++) { p[y * 16 + 5] = metal; p[y * 16 + 10] = metal; } for (int x = 5; x < 11; x++) p[8 * 16 + x] = metalD; for (int y = 11; y < 14; y++) { p[y * 16 + 4] = handle; p[y * 16 + 11] = handle; } p[4 * 16 + 6] = metal; p[4 * 16 + 9] = metal; } return p; }

Hex(0xFF9C1A) : Hex(0xFFD23A); } p[y * 16 + x] = c; } if (!lit) for (int x = 4; x < 12; x += 2) p[12 * 16 + x] = Hex(0x333333); return p; }

(y % 4 == 3) : (y % 5 == 4 && y < 14)) col = Mul(col, 0.85f); if (x == 0 || y == 0 || x == 15 || y == 15) col = dark; if (kind > 0 && y == 5) col = dark; p[y * 16 + x] = col; } if (kind == 2) { for (int y = 3; y < 8; y++) for (int x = 7; x < 9; x++) p[y * 16 + x] = Hex(0xC7C7C7); p[3 * 16 + 7] = Hex(0xEDEDED); p[7 * 16 + 8] = Hex(0x7A7A7A); p[7 * 16 + 7] = Hex(0x8F8F8F); } return p; }

nodes.name: Farmland

nodes.body_text: private static uint[] Farmland(bool wet) { var p = Dirt(171); for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { float f = wet ? 0.62f : 0.95f; if (y % 4 == 0 || y % 4 == 3) f *= 0.82f; if (x == 0 || x == 15 || y == 0 || y == 15) f *= 0.85f; p[y * 16 + x] = Mul(p[y * 16 + x], f); } return p; }

nodes.name: Wheat
nodes.signature: private static uint[] Wheat(int stage)
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] Wheat(int stage) { var p = New(); var r = new Rng(180 + stage); float t = stage / 7f; uint stalk = Lerp(Hex(0x2C8F1E), Hex(0xB89A3A), t * t); uint stalkL = Lerp(Hex(0x4CB43A), Hex(0xD8C062), t * t); int h = 2 + stage * 2; int[] xs = { 1, 4, 6, 9, 11, 14 }; foreach (var x in xs) { int hh = Math.Min(15, h + r.Next(2)); for (int y = 15; y > 15 - hh; y--) p[y * 16 + x] = r.NextBool() ? stalk : stalkL; if (stage == 7) for (int y = 15 - hh; y < 15 - hh + 5 && y >= 0; y++) { if (y < 0) continue; p[y * 16 + x] = Hex(0xD8C062); if (x + 1 < 16) p[y * 16 + x + 1] = (y % 2 == 0) ? Hex(0x9C7F2A) : Hex(0xC9AC4E); } } return p; }

nodes.name: Door
nodes.signature: private static uint[] Door(bool upper)
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] Door(bool upper) { var p = New(); var r = new Rng(upper ? 191 : 190); uint frame = Hex(0x6B5331), panel = Hex(0x9C7F4E), panelL = Hex(0xB08F5A), panelD = Hex(0x86683E); for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { uint c = r.NextFloat() < 0.5f ? panel : (r.NextBool() ? panelL : panelD); if (x == 0 || x == 15 || (upper && y == 0) || (!upper && y == 15)) c = frame; if (x == 7 || x == 8) c = Mul(c, 0.9f); p[y * 16 + x] = c; } if (upper) { for (int y = 2; y < 8; y++) for (int x = 2; x < 6; x++) p[y * 16 + x] = 0; for (int y = 2; y < 8; y++) for (int x = 10; x < 14; x++) p[y * 16 + x] = 0; for (int y = 10; y < 15; y++) { p[y * 16 + 2] = frame; p[y * 16 + 13] = frame; } } else { for (int y = 2; y < 14; y++) { p[y * 16 + 3] = frame; p[y * 16 + 12] = frame; } for (int x = 3; x < 13; x++) { p[2 * 16 + x] = frame; p[13 * 16 + x] = frame; p[8 * 16 + x] = frame; } p[1 * 16 + 12] = Hex(0x5A5A5A); p[1 * 16 + 13] = Hex(0x3A3A3A); } return p; }

Hex(0xA3311B) : Mul(Hex(0xDB441A), 0.92f + r.NextFloat() * 0.1f); p[y * 16 + x] = c; } // "TNT" string[] txt = { "###.#..#.###", ".#..##.#..#.", ".#..#.##..#.", ".#..#..#..#." }; for (int y = 0; y < 4; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 12; x++) if (txt[y][x] == '#') p[(6 + y) * 16 + 2 + x] = Hex(0x111111); return p; }

nodes.name: TntTop

nodes.body_text: private static uint[] TntTop(bool top) { var p = New(); var r = new Rng(top ? 202 : 203); for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { int cx = x % 4, cy = y % 4; bool ring = cx == 0 || cy == 0; p[y * 16 + x] = ring ? Hex(0x7A2012) : Mul(Hex(0xDB441A), 0.9f + r.NextFloat() * 0.15f); } if (top) { p[7 * 16 + 7] = Hex(0x404040); p[7 * 16 + 8] = Hex(0x505050); p[8 * 16 + 7] = Hex(0x303030); p[8 * 16 + 8] = Hex(0x404040); } return p; }

nodes.name: RedDust
nodes.signature: private static uint[] RedDust(bool cross)
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] RedDust(bool cross) { var p = New(); var r = new Rng(cross ? 211 : 212); for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { bool on; if (cross) on = (Math.Abs(x - 7.5f) < 2.5f) || (Math.Abs(y - 7.5f) < 2.5f) || (Math.Abs(x - 7.5f) < 4 && Math.Abs(y - 7.5f) < 4); else on = Math.Abs(x - 7.5f) < 2.5f; if (on && r.Next(5) != 0) p[y * 16 + x] = Gray(0.7f + r.NextFloat() * 0.3f); } return p; }

(frame ? Hex(0xB46F33) : Lerp(Hex(0xF0C27A), Hex(0xFFE7A8), r.NextFloat())) : (frame ? Hex(0x3A2412) : Lerp(Hex(0x4A2E19), Hex(0x6B4A2A), r.NextFloat())); p[y * 16 + x] = c; } return p; }

nodes.name: AddBed
nodes.signature: private static void AddBed()
nodes.body_text: private static void AddBed() { uint red = Hex(0x9E2626), redL = Hex(0xB83333), redD = Hex(0x7A1A1A), white = Hex(0xE6E6E6), whiteD = Hex(0xC4C4C4), wood = Hex(0x8F6A3B), woodD = Hex(0x5E4A26); var r = new Rng(250); uint[] Top(bool head) { var p = New(); for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { uint c = (r.Next(4) == 0) ? redL : red; if (x == 0 || x == 15) c = redD; if (head && y < 7 && x > 1 && x < 14) c = (y == 0 || y == 6) ? whiteD : white; p[y * 16 + x] = c; } return p; } uint[] Side(bool head) { var p = New(); for (int y = 7; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { uint c = y < 10 ? ((r.Next(4) == 0) ? redL : red) : y < 13 ? wood : 0; if (y >= 13 && ((head && x < 3) || (!head && x > 12))) c = woodD; if (y == 9) c = redD; p[y * 16 + x] = c; } if (head) for (int x = 10; x < 16; x++) { p[7 * 16 + x] = white; p[8 * 16 + x] = whiteD; } return p; } uint[] End(bool head) { var p = New(); for (int y = 7; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { uint c = y < 10 ? red : y < 13 ? wood : ((x < 3 || x > 12) ? woodD : 0); if (head && y < 9 && x > 1 && x < 14) c = white; p[y * 16 + x] = c; } return p; } Add("bed_head_top", Top(true)); Add("bed_feet_top", Top(false)); Add("bed_head_side", Side(true)); Add("bed_feet_side", Side(false)); Add("bed_head_end", End(true)); Add("bed_feet_end", End(false)); }

nodes.name: Bookshelf
nodes.signature: private static uint[] Bookshelf()
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] Bookshelf() { var p = Planks(Palette(0xB08F5A, 0x9C7F4E, 0x86683E, 0xBC9862), Hex(0x6B5331), 261); var r = new Rng(262); uint[] cols = Palette(0x7A2222, 0x2E4A7A, 0x2E6A2E, 0x8A6A2A, 0x5A2A6A, 0x6A3A1A, 0xA8A8A8); for (int shelf = 0; shelf < 2; shelf++) { int y0 = shelf == 0 ? 1 : 9; int x = 1; while (x < 15) { int w = 1 + r.Next(2); uint c = cols[r.Next(cols.Length)]; int h = 5 + r.Next(2); for (int dx = 0; dx < w && x + dx < 15; dx++) for (int y = y0 + (6 - h); y < y0 + 6; y++) p[y * 16 + x + dx] = Mul(c, dx == 0 ? 1.1f : 0.9f); x += w; } for (int xx = 0; xx < 16; xx++) p[(y0 + 6) * 16 + xx] = Hex(0x6B5331); } return p; }

nodes.name: Destroy
nodes.signature: private static uint[] Destroy(int stage)
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] Destroy(int stage) { var p = New(); var r = new Rng(300); int segs = (stage + 1) * 5; var heads = new List<(float x, float y, float a)>(); for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) heads.Add((7.5f, 7.5f, i * 1.25f + r.NextFloat())); int drawn = 0; while (drawn < segs) { for (int h = 0; h < heads.Count && drawn < segs; h++) { var (x, y, a) = heads[h]; a += (r.NextFloat() - 0.5f) * 1.2f; x += MathF.Cos(a) * 1.1f; y += MathF.Sin(a) * 1.1f; int ix = ((int)x % 16 + 16) % 16, iy = ((int)y % 16 + 16) % 16; p[iy * 16 + ix] = Rgba(0, 0, 0, 170); heads[h] = (x, y, a); drawn++; if (r.Next(8) == 0 && heads.Count < 12) heads.Add((x, y, a + 1.2f)); } } return p; }

nodes.name: WaterFrame
nodes.signature: private static uint[] WaterFrame(int f)
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] WaterFrame(int f) { var p = New(); float t = f / 32f * MathF.PI * 2; var n1 = TileNoise(401, 4); var n2 = TileNoise(402, 8); for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { int sx = (x + (int)(f * 0.5f)) & 15, sy = (y + f / 4) & 15; float v = n1[sy * 16 + sx] * 0.6f + n2[((y - f / 2) & 15) * 16 + ((x + f / 3) & 15)] * 0.4f; v += MathF.Sin(t + (x + y) * 0.4f) * 0.08f; uint c = Lerp(Hex(0x2A4CC8), Hex(0x4A7EEA), Math.Clamp(v, 0, 1)); p[y * 16 + x] = WithA(c, 175); } return p; }

nodes.name: LavaFrame
nodes.signature: private static uint[] LavaFrame(int f)
nodes.body_text: private static uint[] LavaFrame(int f) { var p = New(); var n1 = TileNoise(411, 4); var n2 = TileNoise(412, 8); float t = f / 32f * MathF.PI * 2; for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { int sx = (x + f / 3) & 15, sy = (y + f / 5) & 15; float v = n1[sy * 16 + sx] * 0.55f + n2[((y + f / 2) & 15) * 16 + ((x - f / 4) & 15)] * 0.45f + MathF.Sin(t + x * 0.5f) * 0.07f; uint c = v < 0.35f ? Hex(0xB8340B) : v < 0.5f ? Hex(0xD45A12) : v < 0.68f ? Hex(0xFC9B1E) : Hex(0xFFD25F); p[y * 16 + x] = c; } return p; }

nodes.name: GenerateParticles
nodes.signature: private static void GenerateParticles()
nodes.body_text: private static void GenerateParticles() { for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) { var p = New(); float rad = 7.5f - i * 0.8f; var r = new Rng(500 + i); for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { float dx = x - 7.5f, dy = y - 7.5f; if (dx * dx + dy * dy < rad * rad && r.Next(6) != 0) p[y * 16 + x] = Gray(0.75f + r.NextFloat() * 0.25f); } Add("particle_smoke_" + i, p); } { var p = New(); string[] heart = { "................", "................", "...####..####...", "..#aaaa##aaaa#..", ".#aaabaaaaaaaa#.", ".#aabaaaaaaaaa#.", ".#aaaaaaaaaaaa#.", ".#aaaaaaaaaaaa#.", "..#aaaaaaaaaa#..", "...#aaaaaaaa#...", "....#aaaaaa#....", ".....#aaaa#.....", "......#aa#......", ".......##.......", "................", "................" }; Stamp(p, heart, new() { ['#'] = Hex(0x5A0000), ['a'] = Hex(0xE81E1E), ['b'] = Hex(0xFFA0A0) }); Add("particle_heart", p); } { var p = New(); for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { float d = MathF.Sqrt((x - 7.5f) * (x - 7.5f) + (y - 7.5f) * (y - 7.5f)); if (d < 7 && d > 5) p[y * 16 + x] = Hex(0xB0D8FF); else if (d <= 5) p[y * 16 + x] = Hex(0x5080FF, 90); } p[4 * 16 + 5] = Hex(0xFFFFFF); p[5 * 16 + 4] = Hex(0xFFFFFF); Add("particle_bubble", p); } { var p = New(); for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) { p[7 * 16 + i] = Hex(0xFFFFFF); p[i * 16 + 7] = Hex(0xFFFFFF); } for (int i = 3; i < 13; i++) { p[i * 16 + i] = Hex(0xCCCCCC); p[i * 16 + 15 - i] = Hex(0xCCCCCC); } Add("particle_crit", p); } { var p = New(); var r = new Rng(510); for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { float d = MathF.Sqrt((x - 7.5f) * (x - 7.5f) + (y - 7.5f) * (y - 7.5f)); if (d < 6) p[y * 16 + x] = d < 3 ? Hex(0xFFF4B0) : Lerp(Hex(0xFFB030), Hex(0xFF6010), (d - 3) / 3f); } Add("particle_flame", p); } { var p = New(); var r = new Rng(511); for (int k = 0; k < 30; k++) p[r.Next(256)] = Lerp(Hex(0xB040FF), Hex(0xE0A0FF), r.NextFloat()); for (int y = 5; y < 11; y++) for (int x = 5; x < 11; x++) p[y * 16 + x] = Hex(0xC060FF); Add("particle_portal", p); } { var p = New(); for (int y = 4; y < 12; y++) for (int x = 4; x < 12; x++) p[y * 16 + x] = Hex(0xFFFFFF); Add("particle_white", p); } for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) { var p = New(); var r = new Rng(520 + i); for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { float d = MathF.Sqrt((x - 7.5f) * (x - 7.5f) + (y - 7.5f) * (y - 7.5f)); if (d < 7.5f - i && r.Next(4) != 0) p[y * 16 + x] = Gray(0.55f + r.NextFloat() * 0.4f); } Add("particle_explosion_" + i, p); } { var p = New(); for (int y = 6; y < 10; y++) for (int x = 6; x < 10; x++) p[y * 16 + x] = Hex(0x8FB8FF); p[6 * 16 + 6] = Hex(0xFFFFFF); Add("particle_splash", p); } { var p = New(); string[] cloud = { "................", "......##........", ".....#aa#.###...", "....#aaaa#aaa#..", "..##aaaaaaaaaa#.", ".#aaaaaaaaaaaa#.", ".#aaaaaaaaaaaa#.", "..##aaaaaaaa##..", "....########....", "....#a#..#a#....", ".....#....#.....", "................", "................", "................", "................", "................" }; Stamp(p, cloud, new() { ['#'] = Hex(0x202020), ['a'] = Hex(0x4A4A4A) }); Add("particle_angry", p); } }

nodes.body_text: public static void Stamp(uint[] p, string[] rows, Dictionary<char, uint> pal, int ox = 0, int oy = 0) { for (int y = 0; y < rows.Length; y++) for (int x = 0; x < rows[y].Length; x++) { char ch = rows[y][x]; if (ch == '.' || ch == ' ') continue; if (!pal.TryGetValue(ch, out uint c)) continue; int px = x + ox, py = y + oy; if (px < 0 || px > 15 || py < 0 || py > 15) continue; p[py * 16 + px] = c; } }

nodes.body_text: public sealed class WorldRenderer : IWorldListener, IDisposable { public World.World World; public TextureArray Terrain; private readonly Shader _chunk, _sky, _cloudSh, _line; public readonly EntityRenderer Entities; private readonly Dictionary<long, ChunkRender> _renders = new(); private readonly object _jobLock = new(); private readonly List<(int cx, int sy, int cz, int ver)> _jobs = new(); private readonly HashSet<(int, int, int)> _jobSet = new(); private readonly System.Collections.Concurrent.ConcurrentQueue<(int cx, int sy, int cz, int ver, byte[] solid, int sb, byte[] trans, int tb)> _done = new(); private readonly Thread[] _workers; private volatile bool _running = true; private readonly ChunkMesher _mainMesher = new(); private Vector3d _camPos; private volatile int _camCx, _camCz; private readonly Mesh _skyQuad, _sunMesh, _starMesh, _lineMesh; private Mesh _cloudMesh; private Texture2D _sunTex, _moonTex; public readonly List<Particle> Particles = new(); public Action<string, double, double, double, float, float> SoundHook; public int RenderedSections, TotalSections; public int RenderDistance = 8; public bool CloudsEnabled = true; public float Gamma = 0.5f; private int _waterLayer, _lavaLayer; public WorldRenderer() { ItemRegistry.Init(); Terrain = new TextureArray(16, TextureGen.Textures, true, 4); Entities = new EntityRenderer { TerrainTex = Terrain }; _waterLayer = TextureGen.Layer("water_still"); _lavaLayer = TextureGen.Layer("lava_still"); _chunk = new Shader(ChunkVert, ChunkFrag, "chunk"); _sky = new Shader(SkyVert, SkyFrag, "sky"); _cloudSh = new Shader(CloudVert, CloudFrag, "cloud"); _line = new Shader(LineVert, LineFrag, "line"); _skyQuad = new Mesh(8, () => { GL.EnableVertexAttribArray(0); GL.VertexAttribPointer(0, 2, VertexAttribPointerType.Float, false, 8, 0); }); _skyQuad.Upload(new float[] { -1, 1, -1, -1, 1, -1, 1, 1 }, 8, BufferUsageHint.StaticDraw); _sunMesh = new Mesh(20, () => { GL.EnableVertexAttribArray(0); GL.VertexAttribPointer(0, 3, VertexAttribPointerType.Float, false, 20, 0); GL.EnableVertexAttribArray(1); GL.VertexAttribPointer(1, 2, VertexAttribPointerType.Float, false, 20, 12); }); _starMesh = new Mesh(12, () => { GL.EnableVertexAttribArray(0); GL.VertexAttribPointer(0, 3, VertexAttribPointerType.Float, false, 12, 0); }); _lineMesh = new Mesh(12, () => { GL.EnableVertexAttribArray(0); GL.VertexAttribPointer(0, 3, VertexAttribPointerType.Float, false, 12, 0); }, false); BuildStars(); BuildCelestialTextures(); BuildClouds(); int n = Math.Clamp(Environment.ProcessorCount / 2, 1, 3); _workers = new Thread[n]; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { _workers[i] = new Thread(WorkerLoop) { IsBackground = true, Name = "Mesher" + i, Priority = ThreadPriority.BelowNormal }; _workers[i].Start(); } } public void SetWorld(World.World w) { if (World != null) World.Listeners.Remove(this); World = w; lock (_jobLock) { _jobs.Clear(); _jobSet.Clear(); } while (_done.TryDequeue(out _)) { } foreach (var r in _renders.Values) foreach (var s in r.S) { s.Solid?.Dispose(); s.Trans?.Dispose(); } _renders.Clear(); Particles.Clear(); if (w != null) w.Listeners.Add(this); } // ================= shadery ================= private const string ChunkVert = @"#version 330 core layout(location=0) in vec3 aPos; layout(location=1) in vec2 aUV; layout(location=2) in float aLayer; layout(location=3) in vec2 aFS; layout(location=4) in vec2 aLight; layout(location=5) in vec4 aTint; uniform mat4 uViewProj; uniform vec3 uOffset; out vec3 vUV; out vec2 vLight; out float vShade; out vec4 vTint; out float vMask; out float vDist; void main(){ vec3 p = aPos + uOffset; gl_Position = uViewProj*vec4(p,1.0); vUV = vec3((aUV - 32768.0) / 4096.0, aLayer); vLight = aLight*15.0; vShade = aFS.y/255.0; vTint = aTint; vMask = mod(aFS.x, 2.0); vDist = length(p.xz); }"; private static readonly string ChunkFrag = @"#version 330 core in vec3 vUV; in vec2 vLight; in float vShade; in vec4 vTint; in float vMask; in float vDist; uniform sampler2DArray uTex; uniform float uAlphaCut; uniform vec3 uFogColor; uniform float uFogStart; uniform float uFogEnd; uniform float uFogDensity; uniform int uFogMode; out vec4 o;" + EntityRenderer.LightmapGlsl + @" void main(){ vec4 t = texture(uTex, vUV); if (t.a < uAlphaCut) discard; vec3 tint = vTint.rgb; if (vMask > 0.5) tint = t.a < 0.99 ? vTint.rgb : vec3(1.0); vec3 c = t.rgb * tint * vShade * lightmap(vLight.x, vLight.y); float fog = uFogMode==1 ? 1.0-exp(-uFogDensity*vDist) : clamp((vDist-uFogStart)/(uFogEnd-uFogStart),0.0,1.0); float a = uAlphaCut > 0.01 ? 1.0 : t.a; o = vec4(mix(c, uFogColor, fog), a); }"; private const string SkyVert = @"#version 330 core layout(location=0) in vec2 aPos; uniform mat4 uInvViewProj; out vec3 vDir; void main(){ gl_Position = vec4(aPos, 0.999, 1.0); vec4 p = uInvViewProj * vec4(aPos, 1.0, 1.0); vDir = p.xyz / p.w; }"; private const string SkyFrag = @"#version 330 core in vec3 vDir; uniform vec3 uSky; uniform vec3 uFog; uniform vec4 uSunset; uniform vec3 uSunDir; out vec4 o;

nodes.name: BuildStars
nodes.signature: private void BuildStars()
nodes.body_text: private void BuildStars() { var r = new Rng(10842); var v = new List<float>(); for (int i = 0; i < 1500; i++) { double x = r.NextFloat() * 2 - 1, y = r.NextFloat() * 2 - 1, z = r.NextFloat() * 2 - 1; double s = 0.15 + r.NextFloat() * 0.1; double d = x * x + y * y + z * z; if (d >= 1 || d <= 0.01) continue; d = 1 / Math.Sqrt(d); x *= d; y *= d; z *= d; var c = new Vector3((float)x, (float)y, (float)z) * 100; var n = Vector3.Normalize(c); var t1 = Vector3.Normalize(Vector3.Cross(n, Math.Abs(n.Y) < 0.9f ? Vector3.UnitY : Vector3.UnitX)); var t2 = Vector3.Cross(n, t1); float ang = r.NextFloat() * MathF.PI * 2; var a1 = (t1 * MathF.Cos(ang) + t2 * MathF.Sin(ang)) * (float)s * 1.4f; var a2 = Vector3.Cross(n, a1); foreach (var p in new[] { c - a1 - a2, c - a1 + a2, c + a1 + a2, c + a1 - a2 }) { v.Add(p.X); v.Add(p.Y); v.Add(p.Z); } } _starMesh.Upload(v.ToArray(), v.Count, BufferUsageHint.StaticDraw); }

nodes.name: BuildCelestialTextures
nodes.signature: private void BuildCelestialTextures()
nodes.body_text: private void BuildCelestialTextures() { var sun = new uint[32 * 32]; for (int y = 0; y < 32; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 32; x++) { int dx = Math.Max(Math.Abs(x - 16) - 0, 0), dy = Math.Abs(y - 16); int d = Math.Max(Math.Abs(x * 2 - 31), Math.Abs(y * 2 - 31)); uint c = 0; if (d < 16) c = TextureGen.Rgba(255, 255, 220); else if (d < 20) c = TextureGen.Rgba(255, 240, 140); else if (d < 26) c = TextureGen.Rgba(200, 160, 60, 90); sun[y * 32 + x] = c; } _sunTex = new Texture2D(32, 32, sun); var moon = new uint[32 * 32]; var r = new Rng(3); for (int y = 0; y < 32; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 32; x++) { int d = Math.Max(Math.Abs(x * 2 - 31), Math.Abs(y * 2 - 31)); if (d < 18) { int g = 200 + r.Next(30); if ((x - 12) * (x - 12) + (y - 13) * (y - 13) < 10 || (x - 19) * (x - 19) + (y - 20) * (y - 20) < 6 || (x - 18) * (x - 18) + (y - 11) * (y - 11) < 4) g -= 50; moon[y * 32 + x] = TextureGen.Rgba(g, g, g + 10); } } _moonTex = new Texture2D(32, 32, moon); _sunSh = new Shader(SunVert, SunFrag, "sun"); }

nodes.name: BuildClouds
nodes.signature: private void BuildClouds()
nodes.body_text: private void BuildClouds() { // wzór chmur 128x128 komórek, kafelkowalny var r = new Rng(1234); var grid = new bool[CloudCells * CloudCells]; var n1 = new float[CloudCells * CloudCells]; var octs = new[] { (16, 0.6f), (8, 0.3f), (4, 0.1f) }; foreach (var (cells, w) in octs) { var g = new float[cells * cells]; for (int i = 0; i < g.Length; i++) g[i] = r.NextFloat(); float cs = (float)CloudCells / cells; for (int y = 0; y < CloudCells; y++) for (int x = 0; x < CloudCells; x++) { float fx = x / cs, fy = y / cs; int x0 = (int)fx, y0 = (int)fy; float tx = fx - x0, ty = fy - y0; tx = tx * tx * (3 - 2 * tx); ty = ty * ty * (3 - 2 * ty); int x1 = (x0 + 1) % cells, y1 = (y0 + 1) % cells; x0 %= cells; y0 %= cells; float a = g[y0 * cells + x0], b = g[y0 * cells + x1], c = g[y1 * cells + x0], d = g[y1 * cells + x1]; n1[y * CloudCells + x] += ((a + (b - a) * tx) * (1 - ty) + (c + (d - c) * tx) * ty) * w; } } for (int i = 0; i < grid.Length; i++) grid[i] = n1[i] + r.NextFloat() * 0.08f > 0.6f; bool G(int x, int y) => grid[((y % CloudCells + CloudCells) % CloudCells) * CloudCells + ((x % CloudCells + CloudCells) % CloudCells)]; var v = new List<float>(); void Q(Vector3 a, Vector3 b, Vector3 c, Vector3 d, float s) { foreach (var p in new[] { a, b, c, d }) { v.Add(p.X); v.Add(p.Y); v.Add(p.Z); v.Add(s); } } const float h = 4; for (int cy = 0; cy < CloudCells; cy++) for (int cx = 0; cx < CloudCells; cx++) { if (!G(cx, cy)) continue; float x0 = cx * CloudCell, z0 = cy * CloudCell, x1 = x0 + CloudCell, z1 = z0 + CloudCell; Q(new(x0, h, z0), new(x0, h, z1), new(x1, h, z1), new(x1, h, z0), 1f); Q(new(x0, 0, z1), new(x0, 0, z0), new(x1, 0, z0), new(x1, 0, z1), 0.7f); if (!G(cx, cy - 1)) Q(new(x1, h, z0), new(x1, 0, z0), new(x0, 0, z0), new(x0, h, z0), 0.85f); if (!G(cx, cy + 1)) Q(new(x0, h, z1), new(x0, 0, z1), new(x1, 0, z1), new(x1, h, z1), 0.85f); if (!G(cx - 1, cy)) Q(new(x0, h, z0), new(x0, 0, z0), new(x0, 0, z1), new(x0, h, z1), 0.9f); if (!G(cx + 1, cy)) Q(new(x1, h, z1), new(x1, 0, z1), new(x1, 0, z0), new(x1, h, z0), 0.9f); } _cloudMesh = new Mesh(16, () => { GL.EnableVertexAttribArray(0); GL.VertexAttribPointer(0, 3, VertexAttribPointerType.Float, false, 16, 0); GL.EnableVertexAttribArray(1); GL.VertexAttribPointer(1, 1, VertexAttribPointerType.Float, false, 16, 12); }); _cloudMesh.Upload(v.ToArray(), v.Count, BufferUsageHint.StaticDraw); }

nodes.name: WorkerLoop
nodes.signature: private void WorkerLoop()
nodes.body_text: private void WorkerLoop() { var mesher = new ChunkMesher(); while (_running) { (int cx, int sy, int cz, int ver) job = default; bool got = false; lock (_jobLock) { if (_jobs.Count > 0) { int best = -1; long bd = long.MaxValue; int ccx = _camCx, ccz = _camCz; for (int i = 0; i < _jobs.Count; i++) { long d = (long)(_jobs[i].cx - ccx) * (_jobs[i].cx - ccx) + (long)(_jobs[i].cz - ccz) * (_jobs[i].cz - ccz); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = i; } } job = _jobs[best]; _jobs[best] = _jobs[^1]; _jobs.RemoveAt(_jobs.Count - 1); _jobSet.Remove((job.cx, job.sy, job.cz)); got = true; } } if (!got) { Thread.Sleep(3); continue; } var w = World; if (w == null) continue; try { mesher.Build(w, job.cx, job.sy, job.cz); var s = mesher.Solid.Count > 0 ? mesher.Solid.Data[..mesher.Solid.Bytes] : null; var t = mesher.Translucent.Count > 0 ? mesher.Translucent.Data[..mesher.Translucent.Bytes] : null; _done.Enqueue((job.cx, job.sy, job.cz, job.ver, s, s?.Length ?? 0, t, t?.Length ?? 0)); } catch (Exception ex) { Log.Error("Mesher: " + ex.Message); } } }
