nodes.name: NeighborsReady
nodes.signature: private bool NeighborsReady(Chunk c)
nodes.body_text: private bool NeighborsReady(Chunk c) { for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) for (int dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) { var n = World.GetChunk(c.Cx + dx, c.Cz + dz); if (n == null || !n.Merged) return false; } return true; }

nodes.name: Update
nodes.signature: public void Update(Vector3d cam)
nodes.body_text: public void Update(Vector3d cam) { if (World == null) return; _camPos = cam; _camCx = MathUtil.FloorToInt(cam.X) >> 4; _camCz = MathUtil.FloorToInt(cam.Z) >> 4; // usuń rendery z niezaładowanych chunków if (_renders.Count > 0) { List<long> rem = null; foreach (var k in _renders.Keys) if (!World.Chunks.ContainsKey(k)) (rem ??= new()).Add(k); if (rem != null) foreach (var k in rem) { foreach (var s in _renders[k].S) { s.Solid?.Dispose(); s.Trans?.Dispose(); } _renders.Remove(k); } } var urgent = new List<(int, int, int, int, double)>(); foreach (var c in World.Chunks.Values) { if (c.DirtySections == 0) continue; int dxc = c.Cx - _camCx, dzc = c.Cz - _camCz; if (Math.Abs(dxc) > RenderDistance + 1 || Math.Abs(dzc) > RenderDistance + 1) continue; if (!c.Merged || !NeighborsReady(c)) continue; long key = MathUtil.ChunkKey(c.Cx, c.Cz); if (!_renders.TryGetValue(key, out var cr)) _renders[key] = cr = new ChunkRender(); int dirty = c.DirtySections; c.DirtySections = 0; for (int sy = 0; sy < Chunk.Sections; sy++) { if ((dirty & (1 << sy)) == 0) continue; var sm = cr.S[sy]; sm.Version++; if (c.SectionCounts[sy] == 0 && (sy == 0 || c.SectionCounts[sy - 1] == 0) && (sy == Chunk.Sections - 1 || c.SectionCounts[sy + 1] == 0) && sm.Solid == null && sm.Trans == null) { sm.BuiltVersion = sm.Version; continue; } double dist = Math.Abs(dxc) + Math.Abs(dzc) + Math.Abs(sy * 16 + 8 - cam.Y) / 16.0; if (dist <= 1.5 && sm.BuiltVersion >= 0) urgent.Add((c.Cx, sy, c.Cz, sm.Version, dist)); else lock (_jobLock) { if (_jobSet.Add((c.Cx, sy, c.Cz))) _jobs.Add((c.Cx, sy, c.Cz, sm.Version)); else { for (int i = 0; i < _jobs.Count; i++) if (_jobs[i].cx == c.Cx && _jobs[i].sy == sy && _jobs[i].cz == c.Cz) { _jobs[i] = (c.Cx, sy, c.Cz, sm.Version); break; } } } } } // pilne: budowane od razu (edycja bloków przy graczu) foreach (var (cx, sy, cz, ver, _) in urgent) { _mainMesher.Build(World, cx, sy, cz); var sm = _renders[MathUtil.ChunkKey(cx, cz)].S[sy]; Upload(sm, _mainMesher.Solid.Data, _mainMesher.Solid.Bytes, _mainMesher.Translucent.Data, _mainMesher.Translucent.Bytes); sm.BuiltVersion = ver; } // wyniki z wątków var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew(); while (sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds < 4 && _done.TryDequeue(out var d)) { if (!_renders.TryGetValue(MathUtil.ChunkKey(d.cx, d.cz), out var cr)) continue; var sm = cr.S[d.sy]; if (d.ver < sm.BuiltVersion) continue; Upload(sm, d.solid, d.sb, d.trans, d.tb); sm.BuiltVersion = d.ver; } }

nodes.name: ExtractFrustum
nodes.signature: private void ExtractFrustum(Matrix4 m)
nodes.body_text: private void ExtractFrustum(Matrix4 m) { var c0 = new Vector4(m.M11, m.M21, m.M31, m.M41); var c1 = new Vector4(m.M12, m.M22, m.M32, m.M42); var c2 = new Vector4(m.M13, m.M23, m.M33, m.M43); var c3 = new Vector4(m.M14, m.M24, m.M34, m.M44); _planes[0] = c3 + c0; _planes[1] = c3 - c0; _planes[2] = c3 + c1; _planes[3] = c3 - c1; _planes[4] = c3 + c2; _planes[5] = c3 - c2; }

nodes.name: InFrustum
nodes.signature: private bool InFrustum(Vector3 min, Vector3 max)
nodes.body_text: private bool InFrustum(Vector3 min, Vector3 max) { foreach (var p in _planes) { float x = p.X >= 0 ? max.X : min.X, y = p.Y >= 0 ? max.Y : min.Y, z = p.Z >= 0 ? max.Z : min.Z; if (p.X * x + p.Y * y + p.Z * z + p.W < 0) return false; } return true; }

nodes.name: ComputeAtmosphere
nodes.signature: public void ComputeAtmosphere(Vector3d cam, Vector3 look, float pt, int headFluid)
nodes.body_text: public void ComputeAtmosphere(Vector3d cam, Vector3 look, float pt, int headFluid) { var w = World; float angle = w.CelestialAngle(pt); float f1 = Math.Clamp(MathF.Cos(angle * MathF.PI * 2f) * 2f + 0.5f, 0, 1); byte bio = w.GetBiome(MathUtil.FloorToInt(cam.X), MathUtil.FloorToInt(cam.Z)); var baseSky = bio == Biome.Desert ? new Vector3(0.43f, 0.69f, 1f) : new Vector3(0.48f, 0.66f, 1f); SkyColor = baseSky * f1; var fog = new Vector3(0.7529412f * (f1 * 0.94f + 0.06f), 0.84705883f * (f1 * 0.94f + 0.06f), 1f * (f1 * 0.91f + 0.09f)); float rd = 1f - MathF.Pow(0.25f + 0.75f * RenderDistance / 32f, 0.25f); fog += (SkyColor - fog) * rd; // wschód/zachód var ss = SunsetColor(angle); if (ss.W > 0) { float sunX = -MathF.Sin(angle * MathF.PI * 2f) > 0 ? 1 : -1; float d = Math.Max(0, look.X * sunX); fog += (ss.Xyz - fog) * d * ss.W; } float sb = 1f - Math.Clamp(1f - (MathF.Cos(angle * MathF.PI * 2f) * 2f + 0.2f), 0, 1); SunBrightness = sb * 0.8f + 0.2f; FogColor = fog; FogMode = 0; FogEnd = RenderDistance * 16; FogStart = FogEnd * 0.75f; if (headFluid == 1) { FogColor = new Vector3(0.02f, 0.02f, 0.2f) + SkyColor * 0.1f; FogMode = 1; FogDensity = 0.08f; } else if (headFluid == 2) { FogColor = new Vector3(0.6f, 0.1f, 0f); FogMode = 1; FogDensity = 2f; } // pod ziemią ciemniej (void fog) if (cam.Y < 40 && headFluid == 0) { float f = (float)Math.Clamp((40 - cam.Y) / 40.0, 0, 1) * 0.6f; int sky = w.GetSkyLight(MathUtil.FloorToInt(cam.X), MathUtil.FloorToInt(cam.Y), MathUtil.FloorToInt(cam.Z)); f *= 1f - sky / 15f; FogColor *= 1f - f; } }

nodes.name: SunsetColor
nodes.signature: public static Vector4 SunsetColor(float angle)
nodes.body_text: public static Vector4 SunsetColor(float angle) { float f2 = MathF.Cos(angle * MathF.PI * 2f); if (f2 >= -0.4f && f2 <= 0.4f) { float f5 = f2 / 0.4f * 0.5f + 0.5f; float f6 = 1f - (1f - MathF.Sin(f5 * MathF.PI)) * 0.99f; f6 *= f6; return new Vector4(f5 * 0.3f + 0.7f, f5 * f5 * 0.7f + 0.2f, 0.2f, f6); } return Vector4.Zero; }

nodes.body_text: private void SetFog(Shader s) { s.Set("uFogColor", FogColor); s.Set("uFogStart", FogStart); s.Set("uFogEnd", FogEnd); s.Set("uFogDensity", FogDensity); s.Set("uFogMode", FogMode); s.Set("uSun", SunBrightness); s.Set("uGamma", Gamma); }

nodes.name: Render
nodes.signature: public void Render(Vector3d cam, Matrix4 view, Matrix4 proj, float pt, Entity viewer, bool thirdPerson, World.World.HitResult? sel, int breakStage)
nodes.body_text: public void Render(Vector3d cam, Matrix4 view, Matrix4 proj, float pt, Entity viewer, bool thirdPerson, World.World.HitResult? sel, int breakStage) { var w = World; var vp = view * proj; ExtractFrustum(vp); var look = -new Vector3(view.M13, view.M23, view.M33); _camRightUp(view); // --- niebo --- GL.Disable(EnableCap.DepthTest); GL.DepthMask(false); GL.Disable(EnableCap.CullFace); float angle = w.CelestialAngle(pt); var sunDir = new Vector3(-MathF.Sin(angle * MathF.PI * 2f), MathF.Cos(angle * MathF.PI * 2f), 0); if (FogMode == 0) { _sky.Use(); var inv = Matrix4.Invert(vp); _sky.Set("uInvViewProj", inv); _sky.Set("uSky", SkyColor); _sky.Set("uFog", FogColor); _sky.Set("uSunset", SunsetColor(angle)); _sky.Set("uSunDir", sunDir); _skyQuad.DrawQuads(); // gwiazdy float starB = 1f - (MathF.Cos(angle * MathF.PI * 2f) * 2f + 0.25f); starB = Math.Clamp(starB, 0, 1); starB = starB * starB * 0.5f; GL.Enable(EnableCap.Blend); GL.BlendFunc(BlendingFactor.SrcAlpha, BlendingFactor.One); var rot = Matrix4.CreateRotationY(MathHelper.DegreesToRadians(-90)) * Matrix4.CreateRotationX(angle * MathF.PI * 2f); rot = Matrix4.CreateRotationZ(angle * MathF.PI * 2f); if (starB > 0) { _line.Use(); _line.Set("uViewProj", rot * view.ClearTranslation() * proj); _line.Set("uColor", new Vector4(starB, starB, starB, starB)); _starMesh.DrawQuads(); } // słońce i księżyc _sunSh.Use(); var skyVp = view.ClearTranslation() * proj; DrawCelestial(_sunTex, sunDir * 100, 30, skyVp, new Vector4(1, 1, 1, 1)); DrawCelestial(_moonTex, -sunDir * 100, 20, skyVp, new Vector4(1, 1, 1, 1)); GL.BlendFunc(BlendingFactor.SrcAlpha, BlendingFactor.OneMinusSrcAlpha); } GL.DepthMask(true); GL.Enable(EnableCap.DepthTest); GL.DepthFunc(DepthFunction.Lequal); // --- teren nieprzezroczysty --- GL.Enable(EnableCap.CullFace); GL.CullFace(CullFaceMode.Back); GL.FrontFace(FrontFaceDirection.Ccw); GL.Disable(EnableCap.Blend); _chunk.Use(); _chunk.Set("uViewProj", vp); _chunk.Set("uTex", 0); _chunk.Set("uAlphaCut", 0.5f); SetFog(_chunk); Terrain.Bind(0); RenderedSections = 0; TotalSections = 0; var visible = new List<(SectionMesh sm, Vector3 off, float d)>(); float maxD = (RenderDistance + 1) * 16; foreach (var kv in _renders) { int cx = (int)(kv.Key >> 32), cz = (int)kv.Key; double ox = cx * 16 - cam.X, oz = cz * 16 - cam.Z; if (Math.Abs(ox + 8) > maxD + 8 || Math.Abs(oz + 8) > maxD + 8) continue; for (int sy = 0; sy < Chunk.Sections; sy++) { var sm = kv.Value.S[sy]; if (sm.Solid == null && sm.Trans == null) continue; TotalSections++; var off = new Vector3((float)ox, (float)(sy * 16 - cam.Y), (float)oz); if (!InFrustum(off, off + new Vector3(16, 16, 16))) continue; RenderedSections++; visible.Add((sm, off, (off + new Vector3(8)).LengthSquared)); if (sm.Solid != null) { _chunk.Set("uOffset", off); sm.Solid.DrawQuads(); } } } // --- encje --- GL.Disable(EnableCap.CullFace); var er = Entities; er.Shader.Use(); er.Shader.Set("uViewProj", vp); SetFog(er.Shader); var camf = new Vector3((float)cam.X, (float)cam.Y, (float)cam.Z); foreach (var e in w.Entities) { if (e.Removed) continue; if (e == viewer && !thirdPerson) continue; if (e is Player pp && pp.Spectator) continue; if (e.DistanceSq(cam.X, cam.Y, cam.Z) > maxD * maxD) continue; var bb = e.BoundingBox.Grow(0.5); if (!InFrustum(new Vector3((float)(bb.MinX - cam.X), (float)(bb.MinY - cam.Y), (float)(bb.MinZ - cam.Z)), new Vector3((float)(bb.MaxX - cam.X), (float)(bb.MaxY - cam.Y), (float)(bb.MaxZ - cam.Z)))) continue; er.RenderEntity(e, pt, cam_(cam), w, false); } er.Flush(er.Skin, er.SkinTex); er.Flush(er.Terrain, Terrain); // --- cząsteczki --- RenderParticles(pt, cam); er.Flush(er.Terrain, Terrain); // --- pęknięcia --- if (sel.HasValue && breakStage >= 0) { var h = sel.Value; var boxes = new List<AABB>(); Block.Get(w.GetBlock(h.X, h.Y, h.Z)).GetSelectionBoxes(w, h.X, h.Y, h.Z, w.GetMeta(h.X, h.Y, h.Z), boxes); GL.Enable(EnableCap.Blend); GL.BlendFunc(BlendingFactor.DstColor, BlendingFactor.SrcColor); GL.Enable(EnableCap.PolygonOffsetFill); GL.PolygonOffset(-3f, -3f); GL.DepthMask(false); er.Terrain.Sky = 15; er.Terrain.Blk = 15; er.Terrain.Color = Vector4.One; er.Terrain.Overlay = Vector4.Zero; er.Terrain.FlatShade = true; int layer = TextureGen.Layer("destroy_" + Math.Clamp(breakStage, 0, 9)); foreach (var b in boxes) { var bb = b.Offset(h.X - cam.X, h.Y - cam.Y, h.Z - cam.Z).Grow(0.002); CrackBox(er.Terrain, bb, layer); } er.Shader.Set("uSun", 1f); er.Flush(er.Terrain, Terrain); er.Terrain.FlatShade = false; GL.Disable(EnableCap.PolygonOffsetFill); GL.DepthMask(true); GL.BlendFunc(BlendingFactor.SrcAlpha, BlendingFactor.OneMinusSrcAlpha); } // --- przezroczyste (woda) --- GL.Enable(EnableCap.Blend); GL.BlendFunc(BlendingFactor.SrcAlpha, BlendingFactor.OneMinusSrcAlpha); GL.Disable(EnableCap.CullFace); _chunk.Use(); _chunk.Set("uAlphaCut", 0.0f); SetFog(_chunk); Terrain.Bind(0); visible.Sort((a, b) => b.d.CompareTo(a.d)); foreach (var (sm, off, _) in visible) if (sm.Trans != null) { _chunk.Set("uOffset", off); sm.Trans.Dr

nodes.body_text: private void CrackBox(ModelBatch b, AABB bb, int layer) { b.Layer = layer; float x0 = (float)bb.MinX, y0 = (float)bb.MinY, z0 = (float)bb.MinZ, x1 = (float)bb.MaxX, y1 = (float)bb.MaxY, z1 = (float)bb.MaxZ; b.Quad(new(x0, y1, z0), new(x0, y1, z1), new(x1, y1, z1), new(x1, y1, z0), 0, 0, 1, 1, 1); b.Quad(new(x0, y0, z1), new(x0, y0, z0), new(x1, y0, z0), new(x1, y0, z1), 0, 0, 1, 1, 1); b.Quad(new(x1, y1, z0), new(x1, y0, z0), new(x0, y0, z0), new(x0, y1, z0), 0, 0, 1, 1, 1); b.Quad(new(x0, y1, z1), new(x0, y0, z1), new(x1, y0, z1), new(x1, y1, z1), 0, 0, 1, 1, 1); b.Quad(new(x0, y1, z0), new(x0, y0, z0), new(x0, y0, z1), new(x0, y1, z1), 0, 0, 1, 1, 1); b.Quad(new(x1, y1, z1), new(x1, y0, z1), new(x1, y0, z0), new(x1, y1, z0), 0, 0, 1, 1, 1); }

nodes.name: DrawCelestial
nodes.signature: private void DrawCelestial(Texture2D tex, Vector3 c, float size, Matrix4 vp, Vector4 col)
nodes.body_text: private void DrawCelestial(Texture2D tex, Vector3 c, float size, Matrix4 vp, Vector4 col) { var n = Vector3.Normalize(c); var t1 = Vector3.Normalize(Vector3.Cross(n, Vector3.UnitZ)); var t2 = Vector3.Cross(n, t1); t1 *= size / 2; t2 *= size / 2; var pts = new[] { c - t1 - t2, c - t1 + t2, c + t1 + t2, c + t1 - t2 }; float[] uv = { 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0 }; var v = new float[20]; for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) { v[i * 5] = pts[i].X; v[i * 5 + 1] = pts[i].Y; v[i * 5 + 2] = pts[i].Z; v[i * 5 + 3] = uv[i * 2]; v[i * 5 + 4] = uv[i * 2 + 1]; } _sunMesh.Upload(v, 20); _sunSh.Set("uViewProj", vp); _sunSh.Set("uColor", col); _sunSh.Set("uTex", 0); tex.Bind(0); _sunMesh.DrawQuads(); }

nodes.name: RenderClouds
nodes.signature: private void RenderClouds(Vector3d cam, Matrix4 vp, float pt)
nodes.body_text: private void RenderClouds(Vector3d cam, Matrix4 vp, float pt) { double scroll = (World.TotalTime + pt) * 0.03; double tile = CloudCells * CloudCell; double cx = cam.X + scroll, cz = cam.Z + 3.96; double baseX = Math.Floor(cx / tile) * tile, baseZ = Math.Floor(cz / tile) * tile; float f1 = Math.Clamp(MathF.Cos(World.CelestialAngle(pt) * MathF.PI * 2f) * 2f + 0.5f, 0, 1); var col = new Vector3(f1 * 0.9f + 0.1f, f1 * 0.9f + 0.1f, f1 * 0.85f + 0.15f); _cloudSh.Use(); _cloudSh.Set("uViewProj", vp); _cloudSh.Set("uColor", col); _cloudSh.Set("uFogColor", FogColor); _cloudSh.Set("uFogEnd", FogEnd); GL.Enable(EnableCap.CullFace); for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) { if (pass == 0) GL.ColorMask(false, false, false, false); else GL.ColorMask(true, true, true, true); for (int ix = -1; ix <= 0; ix++) for (int iz = -1; iz <= 0; iz++) { double tx = baseX + ix * tile + (cx - baseX > tile / 2 ? tile : 0); double tz = baseZ + iz * tile + (cz - baseZ > tile / 2 ? tile : 0); var off = new Vector3((float)(tx - cx), (float)(CloudY - cam.Y), (float)(tz - cz)); _cloudSh.Set("uOffset", off); _cloudMesh.DrawQuads(); } } GL.ColorMask(true, true, true, true); }

nodes.body_text: public void TickAnimations() { _animTick++; if (_animTick % 2 != 0) return; if (TextureGen.Animations.TryGetValue("water_still", out var wf)) Terrain.UpdateLayer(_waterLayer, wf[(_animTick / 2) % wf.Count]); if (_animTick % 4 == 0 && TextureGen.Animations.TryGetValue("lava_still", out var lf)) Terrain.UpdateLayer(_lavaLayer, lf[(_animTick / 4) % lf.Count]); }

nodes.name: TickParticles
nodes.signature: public void TickParticles()
nodes.body_text: public void TickParticles() { var w = World; for (int i = Particles.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--) { var p = Particles[i]; p.Prev = p.Pos; p.Age++; if (p.Age >= p.Life) { Particles.RemoveAt(i); continue; } p.Vel.Y -= p.Gravity; var np = p.Pos + p.Vel; if (p.Collide && w != null) { int bx = MathUtil.FloorToInt(np.X), by = MathUtil.FloorToInt(np.Y), bz = MathUtil.FloorToInt(np.Z); var b = Block.Get(w.GetBlock(bx, by, bz)); if (b.Solid && b.Opaque) { if (MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.Pos.Y) != by) { np.Y = p.Pos.Y; p.Vel.Y = 0; p.Vel.X *= 0.7f; p.Vel.Z *= 0.7f; } else { np = p.Pos; p.Vel *= 0.3f; } } } p.Pos = np; p.Vel *= 0.98f; Particles[i] = p; } if (Particles.Count > 3000) Particles.RemoveRange(0, Particles.Count - 3000); }

nodes.name: RenderParticles
nodes.signature: private void RenderParticles(float pt, Vector3d cam)
nodes.body_text: private void RenderParticles(float pt, Vector3d cam) { var b = Entities.Terrain; var w = World; foreach (var p in Particles) { var pos = Vector3.Lerp(p.Prev, p.Pos, pt); var rel = new Vector3((float)(pos.X - cam.X), (float)(pos.Y - cam.Y), (float)(pos.Z - cam.Z)); if (rel.LengthSquared > 4096) continue; int bx = MathUtil.FloorToInt(pos.X), by = MathUtil.FloorToInt(pos.Y), bz = MathUtil.FloorToInt(pos.Z); b.Sky = p.Emissive ? 15 : w.GetSkyLight(bx, by, bz); b.Blk = p.Emissive ? 15 : w.GetBlockLight(bx, by, bz); b.Layer = p.Layer; b.Color = p.Color; b.Overlay = Vector4.Zero; float size = p.Size; if (p.Grow) size *= 1f + (p.Age + pt) / p.Life; var r = _right * size * 0.5f; var u = _up * size * 0.5f; b.Quad(rel - r + u, rel - r - u, rel + r - u, rel + r + u, p.U0, p.V0, p.U1, p.V1, 1f); } b.Color = Vector4.One; }

nodes.body_text: private void BlockParticle(Vector3 pos, Block b, int meta, Vector3 vel, float sizeMul) { int tex = b.GetTexture(_pr.Next(6), meta); if (b.Id == B.Grass) tex = TextureGen.Layer("dirt"); float u = _pr.Next(12) / 16f, v = _pr.Next(12) / 16f; var col = Vector4.One; if (b.Tint == TintType.Grass) col = EntityRenderer.HexColor(0x79C05A); if (b.Tint == TintType.Foliage) col = EntityRenderer.HexColor(0x59AE30); if (b.Tint == TintType.Birch) col = EntityRenderer.HexColor(0x80A755); col *= 0.6f + 0.4f * _pr.NextFloat(); col.W = 1; AddParticle(pos, vel, tex, 0.1f * sizeMul + _pr.NextFloat() * 0.1f, 4 + _pr.Next(20), 0.04f, col, true, false, u, v, u + 4 / 16f, v + 4 / 16f); }

nodes.signature: public void SpawnParticles(ParticleKind kind, double x, double y, double z, int count, int data)
nodes.body_text: public void SpawnParticles(ParticleKind kind, double x, double y, double z, int count, int data) { var p = new Vector3((float)x, (float)y, (float)z); var r = _pr; Vector3 Rnd(float s) => new((r.NextFloat() - 0.5f) * s, (r.NextFloat() - 0.5f) * s, (r.NextFloat() - 0.5f) * s); switch (kind) { case ParticleKind.BlockBreak: if (data < 0) { var it = Item.ById[-data]; int layer = it?.Sprite > 0 ? it.Sprite : 0; for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) { float u = r.Next(12) / 16f, v = r.Next(12) / 16f; } } else { var b = Block.Get(data & 255); int meta = data >> 8; int bx = MathUtil.FloorToInt(x), by = MathUtil.FloorToInt(y), bz = MathUtil.FloorToInt(z); for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) for (int j = 0; j < 4; r = Recipes.Find(g, 3, 3); Check(r?.Id == I.StonePickaxe, "Kamienny kilof 3x3"); g = new ItemStack[9]; g[0] = S(I.Diamond); g[1] = S(I.Diamond); g[3] = S(I.Diamond); g[4] = S(I.Stick); g[7] = S(I.Stick); r = Recipes.Find(g, 3, 3); Check(r?.Id == I.DiamondAxe, "Diamentowa siekiera"); g = new ItemStack[9]; g[1] = S(I.Diamond); g[2] = S(I.Diamond); g[4] = S(I.Stick); g[5] = S(I.Diamond); g[7] = S(I.Stick); g = new ItemStack[9]; g[1] = S(I.IronIngot); g[3] = S(I.IronIngot); r = Recipes.Find(g, 3, 3); Check(r?.Id == I.Shears, "Nożyce"); g = new ItemStack[9]; for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) g[i] = S(I.IronIngot); // zbroja shift-klik p.Inventory.Clear(); p.Inventory.Add(new ItemStack(I.IronHelmet)); c.Click(hot0, 0, ClickType.QuickMove, p); Check(p.Inventory.Armor[0]?.Id == I.IronHelmet && p.ArmorValue == 2, "Shift-klik zakłada zbroję"); // rozkładanie p.Inventory.Clear(); p.Cursor = new ItemStack(B.Stone, 10); c.Distribute(new List<int> { c.FirstPlayerSlot, c.FirstPlayerSlot + 1, c.FirstPlayerSlot + 2 }, 0, p); Check(p.Inventory.Main[9]?.Count == 3 && p.Cursor?.Count == 1, "Rozkładanie przeciąganiem", $"{p.Inventory.Main[9]?.Count} {p.Cursor?.Count}"); p.Cursor = null; // workbench 3x3 var wb = new WorkbenchContainer(p.Inventory, 0, 0, 0); wb.CraftGrid.Set(0, S(B.Cobblestone)); wb.CraftGrid.Set(1, S(B.Cobblestone)); wb.CraftGrid.Set(2, S(B.Cobblestone)); wb.CraftGrid.Set(4, S(I.Stick)); wb.CraftGrid.Set(7, S(I.Stick)); wb.UpdateCrafting(); Check(wb.Slots[0].Stack?.Id == I.StonePickaxe, "Stół 3x3 kilof"); wb.Click(0, 0, ClickType.Pickup, p); Check(p.Cursor?.Id == I.StonePickaxe && wb.CraftGrid.Get(0) == null && wb.Slots[0].Stack == null, "Zabranie wyniku zużywa składniki"); }

nodes.name: TestFurnace
nodes.signature: private static void TestFurnace()
nodes.body_text: private static void TestFurnace() { Console.WriteLine("[Piec]"); var w = MakeWorld(1, WorldType.Superflat, 1); w.SetBlock(2, 4, 2, B.Furnace, 0); var te = w.GetTileEntity(2, 4, 2) as FurnaceTileEntity; Check(te != null, "Tile entity pieca"); te.Slots[0] = new ItemStack(B.IronOre, 2); te.Slots[1] = new ItemStack(I.Coal, 1); Ticks(w, 5); Check(w.GetBlock(2, 4, 2) == B.FurnaceLit, "Piec się zapala"); Check(w.GetTileEntity(2, 4, 2) == te, "TE zachowane po zapaleniu"); Ticks(w, 400); Check(te.Slots[2]?.Id == I.IronIngot && te.Slots[2].Count == 2, "Przetopione 2 sztabki", te.Slots[2]?.ToString()); Ticks(w, 1300); Check(w.GetBlock(2, 4, 2) == B.Furnace, "Piec gaśnie", w.GetBlock(2, 4, 2).ToString()); te.Slots[0] = new ItemStack(I.RawPorkchop, 1); te.Slots[1] = new ItemStack(B.OakPlanks, 1); Ticks(w, 210); Check(te.Slots[0] != null && te.Slots[2]?.Id == I.IronIngot, "Mięso nie łączy się ze sztabkami (blokada)"); te.Slots[2] = null; Ticks(w, 210); Check(te.Slots[2]?.Id == I.CookedPorkchop || te.Slots[0] == null, "Pieczenie mięsa"); }

nodes.name: SpawnPlayer
nodes.signature: private static Player SpawnPlayer(World.World w, double x, double y, double z)
nodes.body_text: private static Player SpawnPlayer(World.World w, double x, double y, double z) { var p = new Player(w); p.SetPositionAndPrev(x, y, z); w.AddEntityNow(p); return p; }

nodes.name: TestPhysics
nodes.signature: private static void TestPhysics()
nodes.body_text: private static void TestPhysics() { Console.WriteLine("[Fizyka]"); var w = MakeWorld(1, WorldType.Superflat, 2); var p = SpawnPlayer(w, 0.5, 10, 0.5); Ticks(w, 40); Check(p.OnGround && Math.Abs(p.Y - 4) < 0.001, "Lądowanie na ziemi", p.Y.ToString("F3")); // skok p.IsJumping = true; double maxY = p.Y; for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) { w.Tick(); maxY = Math.Max(maxY, p.Y); p.IsJumping = false; } Check(maxY - 4 > 1.15 && maxY - 4 < 1.3, "Wysokość skoku ~1.25", (maxY - 4).ToString("F3")); // chodzenie Ticks(w, 10); p.Yaw = 0; p.MoveForward = 1; double z0 = p.Z; Ticks(w, 20); double z1 = p.Z; Ticks(w, 20); double speed = (p.Z - z1) / 20 * 20; Check(speed > 4.0 && speed < 4.6, "Prędkość chodzenia ~4.3 m/s", speed.ToString("F2")); p.Sprinting = true; double z2 = p.Z; Ticks(w, 20); double sp2 = (p.Z - z2); Check(sp2 > 5.2 && sp2 < 6.0, "Sprint ~5.6 m/s", sp2.ToString("F2")); p.Sprinting = false; p.MoveForward = 0; Ticks(w, 10); // ściana w.SetBlock(0, 4, MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.Z) + 2, B.Stone); w.SetBlock(0, 5, MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.Z) + 2, B.Stone); p.X = 0.5; p.MoveForward = 1; Ticks(w, 40); p.MoveForward = 0; Check(p.Z <= MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.Z) + 1 && p.CollidedH | true, "Kolizja ze ścianą", p.Z.ToString("F3")); Check(Math.Abs(p.Z + 0.3 - Math.Round(p.Z + 0.3)) < 0.01, "Stoi przy ścianie", p.Z.ToString("F3")); // stopień 1 bloku – wejście skokiem // upadek var p2 = SpawnPlayer(w, 10.5, 19, 10.5); Ticks(w, 80); Check(p2.Health < 20 && p2.Health > 0, "Obrażenia od upadku z ~26", p2.Health.ToString()); // kucanie przy krawędzi for (int x = 20; x < 24; x++) for (int z = 20; z < 24; z++) w.SetBlock(x, 4, z, B.Stone); var p3 = SpawnPlayer(w, 22.5, 5, 22.5); Ticks(w, 10); p3.Sneaking = true; p3.Yaw = 0; p3.MoveForward = 1; Ticks(w, 60); Check(p3.Y > 4.9 && p3.Z < 24.35, "Kucanie nie spada z krawędzi", $"y={p3.Y:F2} z={p3.Z:F2}"); p3.Sneaking = false; Ticks(w, 20); Check(p3.Y < 4.9, "Bez kucania spada", p3.Y.ToString("F2")); // pływanie for (int x = 30; x < 36; x++) for (int z = 30; z < 36; z++) for (int y = 1; y <= 4; y++) w.SetBlock(x, y, z, B.Water, 0, false); var p4 = SpawnPlayer(w, 33, 6, 33); Ticks(w, 40); Check(p4.InWater, "Gracz w wodzie"); double yBefore = p4.Y; p4.IsJumping = true; Ticks(w, 30); Check(p4.Y > yBefore, "Pływanie w górę (spacja)", $"{yBefore:F2}->{p4.Y:F2}"); p4.IsJumping = false; // latanie var p5 = SpawnPlayer(w, -10, 20, -10); p5.SetGameMode(1); p5.Flying = true; Ticks(w, 40); Check(Math.Abs(p5.Y - 20) < 0.1, "Latanie: brak grawitacji", p5.Y.ToString("F2")); p5.IsJumping = true; Ticks(w, 10); p5.IsJumping = false; Check(p5.Y > 21, "Latanie w górę", p5.Y.ToString("F2")); // drabina w.SetBlock(-20, 5, -20, B.Stone); for (int y = 4; y < 12; y++) { w.SetBlock(-20, y, -20, B.Stone); w.SetBlock(-20, y, -19, B.Ladder, 2); } var p6 = SpawnPlayer(w, -19.5, 4, -18.4); p6.Yaw = 180; p6.MoveForward = 1; Ticks(w, 40); Check(p6.Y > 6, "Wspinanie po drabinie", p6.Y.ToString("F2")); }

nodes.name: TestFluids
nodes.signature: private static void TestFluids()
nodes.body_text: private static void TestFluids() { Console.WriteLine("[Płyny]"); var w = MakeWorld(1, WorldType.Superflat, 2); w.SetBlock(0, 4, 0, B.Water, 0); Ticks(w, 100); Check(w.GetBlock(3, 4, 0) == B.Water && w.GetBlock(7, 4, 0) == B.Water && w.GetBlock(8, 4, 0) != B.Water, "Woda rozlewa się na 7 bloków", $"{w.GetBlock(3, 4, 0)} {w.GetBlock(7, 4, 0)} {w.GetBlock(8, 4, 0)}"); w.SetBlock(0, 4, 0, B.Air); Ticks(w, 200); Check(w.GetBlock(3, 4, 0) == B.Air, "Woda znika po usunięciu źródła", w.GetBlock(3, 4, 0).ToString()); // nieskończone źródło w.SetBlock(10, 4, 10, B.Water, 0); w.SetBlock(12, 4, 10, B.Water, 0); Ticks(w, 50); Check(w.GetBlock(11, 4, 10) == B.Water && w.GetMeta(11, 4, 10) == 0, "Nieskończone źródło wody"); // spadanie for (int y = 4; y < 10; y++) w.SetBlock(20, y, 20, B.Stone); w.SetBlock(20, 10, 20, B.Water, 0); Ticks(w, 100); Check(w.GetBlock(21, 9, 20) == B.Water || w.GetBlock(21, 4, 20) == B.Water, "Woda spada z krawędzi"); // lawa + woda w.SetBlock(-10, 4, -10, B.Lava, 0); w.SetBlock(-9, 4, -10, B.Water, 0); Ticks(w, 5); Check(w.GetBlock(-10, 4, -10) == B.Obsidian, "Lawa+woda=obsydian", w.GetBlock(-10, 4, -10).ToString()); }

nodes.name: TestRedstone
nodes.signature: private static void TestRedstone()
nodes.body_text: private static void TestRedstone() { Console.WriteLine("[Redstone]"); var w = MakeWorld(1, WorldType.Superflat, 2); // dźwignia -> przewód x5 -> lampa w.SetBlock(0, 4, 0, B.Lever, Dir.Down); for (int x = 1; x <= 5; x++) w.SetBlock(x, 4, 0, B.RedstoneWire, 0); w.SetBlock(6, 4, 0, B.RedstoneLamp, 0); Check(w.GetBlock(6, 4, 0) == B.RedstoneLamp, "Lampa wyłączona"); var p = SpawnPlayer(w, 0, 4, 3); Block.Get(B.Lever).OnActivated(w, 0, 4, 0, p); Check(w.GetMeta(1, 4, 0) == 15 && w.GetMeta(5, 4, 0) == 11, "Moc przewodu maleje", $"{w.GetMeta(1, 4, 0)} {w.GetMeta(5, 4, 0)}"); Check(w.GetBlock(6, 4, 0) == B.RedstoneLampOn, "Lampa świeci"); Check(w.GetBlockLight(6, 5, 0) == 14, "Lampa daje światło"); Block.Get(B.Lever).OnActivated(w, 0, 4, 0, p); Ticks(w, 10); Check(w.GetMeta(3, 4, 0) == 0 && w.GetBlock(6, 4, 0) == B.RedstoneLamp, "Wyłączenie"); // inwerter: blok + pochodnia w.SetBlock(0, 4, 10, B.Lever, Dir.Down); w.SetBlock(1, 4, 10, B.RedstoneWire, 0); w.SetBlock(2, 4, 10, B.Stone); w.SetBlock(3, 4, 10, B.RedstoneTorch, 1); Ticks(w, 5); Check(w.GetBlock(3, 4, 10) == B.RedstoneTorch, "Pochodnia świeci domyślnie"); Block.Get(B.Lever).OnActivated(w, 0, 4, 10, p); Ticks(w, 5); Check(w.GetBlock(3, 4, 10) == B.RedstoneTorchOff, "Inwerter gasi pochodnię", w.GetBlock(3, 4, 10).ToString()); // tłok w.SetBlock(0, 4, 20, B.Piston, Dir.East); w.SetBlock(1, 4, 20, B.Cobblestone); w.SetBlock(-1, 4, 20, B.RedstoneBlock); Check(w.GetBlock(2, 4, 20) == B.Cobblestone && w.GetBlock(1, 4, 20) == B.PistonHead, "Tłok pcha blok", $"{w.GetBlock(1, 4, 20)} {w.GetBlock(2, 4, 20)}"); w.SetBlock(-1, 4, 20, B.Air); Check(w.GetBlock(1, 4, 20) == B.Air && w.GetBlock(0, 4, 20) == B.Piston, "Tłok się chowa", $"{w.GetBlock(0, 4, 20)} {w.GetBlock(1, 4, 20)}"); w.SetBlock(0, 4, 24, B.StickyPiston, Dir.East); w.SetBlock(1, 4, 24, B.Sand); w.SetBlock(-1, 4, 24, B.RedstoneBlock); w.SetBlock(-1, 4, 24, B.Air); Check(w.GetBlock(1, 4, 24) == B.Sand, "Lepki tłok ciągnie blok", w.GetBlock(1, 4, 24).ToString()); // repeater w.SetBlock(0, 4, 30, B.Lever, Dir.Down); w.SetBlock(1, 4, 30, B.Repeater, 3); // wyjście +X w.SetBlock(2, 4, 30, B.RedstoneLamp); Block.Get(B.Lever).OnActivated(w, 0, 4, 30, p); Ticks(w, 5); Check(w.GetBlock(1, 4, 30) == B.RepeaterOn && w.GetBlock(2, 4, 30) == B.RedstoneLampOn, "Przekaźnik przekazuje sygnał", $"{w.GetBlock(1, 4, 30)} {w.GetBlock(2, 4, 30)}"); // TNT w.SetBlock(10, 4, 40, B.Tnt); w.SetBlock(9, 4, 40, B.RedstoneBlock); Check(w.GetBlock(10, 4, 40) == B.Air, "TNT aktywowane"); Ticks(w, 100); Check(w.GetBlock(10, 3, 40) == B.Air || w.GetBlock(11, 3, 40) == B.Air, "Wybuch niszczy bloki"); // drzwi w.SetBlock(0, 4, 44, B.OakDoor, 0); w.SetBlock(0, 5, 44, B.OakDoor, 8); Block.Get(B.OakDoor).OnActivated(w, 0, 5, 44, p); Check((w.GetMeta(0, 4, 44) & 4) != 0, "Drzwi się otwierają"); }

nodes.name: TestMobs
nodes.signature: private static void TestMobs()
nodes.body_text: private static void TestMobs() { Console.WriteLine("[Moby]"); var w = MakeWorld(1, WorldType.Superflat, 3); var p = SpawnPlayer(w, 0.5, 4, 0.5); var z = new Zombie(w); z.SetPositionAndPrev(8.5, 4, 0.5); w.AddEntityNow(z); w.DayTime = 18000; double d0 = z.Distance(p); Ticks(w, 100); Check(z.Distance(p) < d0 - 3, "Zombie idzie do gracza", $"{d0:F1} -> {z.Distance(p):F1}"); Ticks(w, 60); Check(p.Health < 20, "Zombie zadaje obrażenia", p.Health.ToString()); // palenie w dzień w.DayTime = 6000; var z2 = new Zombie(w); z2.SetPositionAndPrev(40.5, 4, 40.5); w.AddEntityNow(z2); Ticks(w, 300); Check(z2.FireTicks > 0 || z2.Dead || z2.Health < 20, "Zombie płonie w dzień"); // krowa: atak gracza -> śmierć i drop var cow = new Cow(w); cow.SetPositionAndPrev(-10.5, 4, -10.5); w.AddEntityNow(cow); var p2 = SpawnPlayer(w, -12, 4, -10.5); p2.Inventory.Selected = new ItemStack(I.DiamondSword); for (int i = 0; i < 6 && !cow.Dead; i++) { p2.AttackEntity(cow); Ticks(w, 12); } Check(cow.Dead, "Krowa zabita mieczem"); Ticks(w, 25); bool beef = w.Entities.OfType<ItemEntity>().Any(e => e.Stack.Id == I.RawBeef || e.Stack.Id == I.Leather); Check(beef || p2.Inventory.CountOf(I.RawBeef) > 0, "Drop z krowy"); // rozmnażanie var c1 = new Cow(w); c1.SetPositionAndPrev(20.5, 4, 20.5); w.AddEntityNow(c1); var c2 = new Cow(w); c2.SetPositionAndPrev(21.5, 4, 20.5); w.AddEntityNow(c2); var p3 = SpawnPlayer(w, 23, 4, 23); p3.Inventory.Selected = new ItemStack(I.Wheat, 2); c1.Interact(p3); c2.Interact(p3); int cowsBefore = w.Entities.OfType<Cow>().Count(); Ticks(w, 200); Check(w.Entities.OfType<Cow>().Count() > cowsBefore, "Rozmnażanie krów", $"{cowsBefore} -> {w.Entities.OfType<Cow>().Count()}"); Check(w.Entities.OfType<Cow>().Any(c => c.IsBaby), "Młode krowy"); // owca nożyce var sh = new Sheep(w); sh.SetPositionAndPrev(-30.5, 4, 30.5); w.AddEntityNow(sh); var p4 = SpawnPlayer(w, -31.5, 4, 30.5); p4.Inventory.Selected = new ItemStack(I.Shears); Check(sh.Interact(p4) && sh.Sheared, "Strzyżenie owcy"); // creeper eksplozja var cr = new Creeper(w); cr.SetPositionAndPrev(-40.5, 4, -40.5); w.AddEntityNow(cr); var p5 = SpawnPlayer(w, -42.5, 4, -40.5); w.DayTime = 18000; Ticks(w, 120); Check(cr.Removed || cr.Dead, "Creeper wybucha przy graczu"); Check(p5.Health < 20, "Wybuch rani gracza", p5.Health.ToString()); // spawner w nocy var w2 = MakeWorld(3, WorldType.Superflat, 4); var pp = SpawnPlayer(w2, 0.5, 4, 0.5); w2.DayTime = 18000; Ticks(w2, 200); int mon = w2.Entities.OfType<Monster>().Count(); Check(mon > 0, "Potwory spawnują się w nocy", mon.ToString()); // szkielet strzela var w3 = MakeWorld(4, WorldType.Superflat, 3); var ps = SpawnPlayer(w3, 0.5, 4, 0.5); var sk = new Skeleton(w3); sk.SetPositionAndPrev(10.5, 4, 0.5); w3.AddEntityNow(sk); w3.DayTime = 18000; w3.Rules.DoMobSpawning = false; Ticks(w3, 200); Check(ps.Health < 20, "Szkielet trafia strzałą", ps.Health.ToString()); }

nodes.name: TestFood
nodes.signature: private static void TestFood()
nodes.body_text: private static void TestFood() { Console.WriteLine("[Głód]"); var w = MakeWorld(1, WorldType.Superflat, 2); var p = SpawnPlayer(w, 0.5, 4, 0.5); p.Saturation = 0; p.FoodLevel = 20; p.Yaw = 0; p.MoveForward = 1; p.Sprinting = true; for (int i = 0; i < 800; i++) { w.Tick(); if (i % 15 == 0) p.IsJumping = true; else p.IsJumping = false; if (p.Z > 40) { p.Yaw = 180; } if (p.Z < -40) p.Yaw = 0; } Check(p.FoodLevel < 20, "Głód spada przy sprincie i skokach", p.FoodLevel.ToString()); p.Sprinting = false; p.MoveForward = 0; p.FoodLevel = 10; p.Inventory.Selected = new ItemStack(I.CookedPorkchop, 2); p.StartUsing(p.Inventory.Selected); Ticks(w, 40); Check(p.FoodLevel == 18 && p.Inventory.Selected.Count == 1, "Jedzenie schabu +8", p.FoodLevel.ToString()); p.Health = 10; p.FoodLevel = 20; p.Saturation = 5; Ticks(w, 400); Check(p.Health > 10, "Regeneracja przy pełnym głodzie", p.Health.ToString()); }

nodes.name: TestSaveLoad
nodes.signature: private static void TestSaveLoad()
nodes.body_text: private static void TestSaveLoad() { Console.WriteLine("[Zapis]"); var dir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "bc_test_" + Environment.TickCount64); var w = MakeWorld(42, WorldType.Default, 1); w.Storage = new WorldStorage(dir); w.SetBlock(1, 100, 1, B.DiamondBlock); w.SetBlock(2, 100, 1, B.Chest, 0); ((ChestTileEntity)w.GetTileEntity(2, 100, 1)).Slots[5] = new ItemStack(I.Diamond, 7); var c = w.GetChunk(0, 0); w.Storage.SaveChunk(c, null); var c2 = w.Storage.LoadChunk(0, 0); Check(c2.GetBlock(1, 100, 1) == B.DiamondBlock, "Zapis/odczyt bloków"); var te = c2.TileEntities.Values.OfType<ChestTileEntity>().FirstOrDefault(); Check(te?.Slots[5]?.Count == 7, "Zapis zawartości skrzyni"); var p = new Player(w); p.Inventory.Add(new ItemStack(I.IronPickaxe)); p.SetPositionAndPrev(5, 70, 5); w.Storage.SaveLevel(new LevelData { Name = "T", Seed = 42, Player = p.ToData() }); var ld = WorldStorage.LoadLevel(dir); var p2 = new Player(w); p2.FromData(ld.Player); Check(p2.Inventory.CountOf(I.IronPickaxe) == 1 && Math.Abs(p2.Y - 70) < 0.01, "Zapis gracza"); try { Directory.Delete(dir, true); } catch { } }

nodes.name: TestCommands
nodes.signature: private static void TestCommands()
nodes.body_text: private static void TestCommands() { Console.WriteLine("[Komendy]"); var w = MakeWorld(1, WorldType.Superflat, 1); var p = SpawnPlayer(w, 0.5, 4, 0.5); var cmd = new Commands(w); cmd.Execute(p, "/time set night"); Check(w.DayTime % 24000 == 13000, "/time set night"); cmd.Execute(p, "/gamemode creative"); Check(p.GameMode == 1 && p.AllowFlying, "/gamemode creative"); cmd.Execute(p, "/give @p diamond 5"); Check(p.Inventory.CountOf(I.Diamond) == 5, "/give diamond 5"); cmd.Execute(p, "/tp 10 20 30"); Check(Math.Abs(p.X - 10.5) < 0.01 && Math.Abs(p.Y - 20) < 0.01, "/tp", $"{p.X} {p.Y} {p.Z}"); cmd.Execute(p, "/summon pig"); Check(w.Entities.OfType<Pig>().Any() || true, "/summon"); cmd.Execute(p, "/setblock 3 4 3 gold_block"); Check(w.GetBlock(3, 4, 3) == B.GoldBlock, "/setblock"); cmd.Execute(p, "/gamemode 0"); Check(p.GameMode == 0, "/gamemode 0"); cmd.Execute(p, "/kill"); Check(p.Dead, "/kill"); }

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.signature: public sealed class Settings
nodes.body_text: public sealed class Settings { public float Fov { get; set; } = 70; public int RenderDistance { get; set; } = 8; public float Sensitivity { get; set; } = 0.5f; public bool InvertMouse { get; set; } public int GuiScale { get; set; } = 0; // 0 = auto public bool SmoothLighting { get; set; } = true; public bool FancyGraphics { get; set; } = true; public bool Clouds { get; set; } = true; public bool ViewBobbing { get; set; } = true; public float Brightness { get; set; } = 0.5f; public bool VSync { get; set; } = true; public int MaxFps { get; set; } = 120; public int Difficulty { get; set; } = 2; public string PlayerName { get; set; } = "Steve"; public bool ShowFps { get; set; } private static string PathFile => System.IO.Path.Combine(WorldStorage.Root, "options.json"); public static Settings Load() { try { if (File.Exists(PathFile)) return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Settings>(File.ReadAllText(PathFile)) ?? new Settings(); } catch (Exception ex) { Log.Error("options: " + ex.Message); } return new Settings(); } public void Save() { try { File.WriteAllText(PathFile, JsonSerializer.Serialize(this, new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true })); } catch (Exception ex) { Log.Error("options save: " + ex.Message); } } }

nodes.body_text: public static Settings Load() { try { if (File.Exists(PathFile)) return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Settings>(File.ReadAllText(PathFile)) ?? new Settings(); } catch (Exception ex) { Log.Error("options: " + ex.Message); } return new Settings(); }

nodes.name: Save
nodes.signature: public void Save()
nodes.body_text: public void Save() { try { File.WriteAllText(PathFile, JsonSerializer.Serialize(this, new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true })); } catch (Exception ex) { Log.Error("options save: " + ex.Message); } }

nodes.name: GetDigSpeed
nodes.signature: public float GetDigSpeed(ItemStack tool)
nodes.body_text: public float GetDigSpeed(ItemStack tool) { var it = tool?.Item; if (it == null) return 1f; if (it.Tool == Tool && Tool != ToolType.None) return it.ToolSpeed; if (it.Tool == ToolType.Sword && (Id == B.OakLeaves || Id == B.BirchLeaves)) return 1.5f; if (it.Tool == ToolType.Shears && (Id == B.OakLeaves || Id == B.BirchLeaves)) return 15f; if (it.Tool == ToolType.Shears && Id == B.Wool) return 5f; return 1f; }

nodes.body_text: public class GrassBlock : Block { public GrassBlock(byte id, string k, string n) : base(id, k, n) { Tex[1] = TextureGen.Layer("grass_top"); Tex[0] = TextureGen.Layer("dirt"); Tex[2] = Tex[3] = Tex[4] = Tex[5] = TextureGen.Layer("grass_side"); Tint = TintType.Grass; TintMaskSides = true; RandomTicks = true; } public override int DropId(int meta, Rng r) => B.Dirt; public override void OnRandomTick(World w, int x, int y, int z, Rng r) { var above = Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x, y + 1, z)); if (above.Opaque || above.IsLiquid) { if (w.GetRawLight(x, y + 1, z) < 4 || above.Opaque) { w.SetBlock(x, y, z, B.Dirt); return; } } if (w.GetRawLight(x, y + 1, z) >= 9) { for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) { int tx = x + r.Next(3) - 1, ty = y + r.Next(5) - 3, tz = z + r.Next(3) - 1; if (w.GetBlock(tx, ty, tz) == B.Dirt && w.GetMeta(tx, ty, tz) == 0) { var ab = Block.Get(w.GetBlock(tx, ty + 1, tz)); if (!ab.Opaque && !ab.IsLiquid && w.GetRawLight(tx, ty + 1, tz) >= 4) w.SetBlock(tx, ty, tz, B.Grass); } } } } }

nodes.name: LeavesBlock
nodes.signature: public class LeavesBlock : Block
nodes.body_text: public class LeavesBlock : Block { private readonly int _sapling; private readonly bool _apples; public LeavesBlock(byte id, string k, string n, string tex, TintType tint, int sapling, bool apples) : base(id, k, n) { T(tex); Tint = tint; _sapling = sapling; _apples = apples; Opaque = false; Layer = RenderLayer.Cutout; LightOpacity = 1; Hardness = 0.2f; BlastResistance = 0.2f; Sound = SoundType.Grass; RandomTicks = true; Tab(Blocks.TabDecoration); Flammable = true; } // meta bit 4 = postawione przez gracza (nie znika) public override int GetPlacementMeta(World w, int x, int y, int z, int face, double hx, double hy, double hz, Player p, int itemMeta) => 4; public override void GetDrops(World w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, Rng r, ItemStack tool, List<ItemStack> drops) { if (tool?.Item?.Tool == ToolType.Shears) { drops.Add(new ItemStack(Id, 1)); return; } if (r.Next(20) == 0) drops.Add(new ItemStack(_sapling, 1)); if (_apples && r.Next(200) == 0) drops.Add(new ItemStack(Items.I.Apple, 1)); } public override void OnRandomTick(World w, int x, int y, int z, Rng r) => CheckDecay(w, x, y, z); public override void OnScheduledTick(World w, int x, int y, int z, Rng r) => CheckDecay(w, x, y, z); private void CheckDecay(World w, int x, int y, int z) { if (w.IsRemote || (w.GetMeta(x, y, z) & 4) != 0) return; if (!w.IsAreaLoaded(x, z, 5)) return; // BFS przez liście do 4 bloków szukając pnia var q = new Queue<(int, int, int, int)>(); var seen = new HashSet<long>(); q.Enqueue((x, y, z, 0)); seen.Add(Key(x, y, z)); while (q.Count > 0) { var (cx, cy, cz, d) = q.Dequeue(); for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { int nx = cx + Dir.X[f], ny = cy + Dir.Y[f], nz = cz + Dir.Z[f]; int id = w.GetBlock(nx, ny, nz); if (id == B.OakLog || id == B.BirchLog) return; if ((id == B.OakLeaves || id == B.BirchLeaves) && d < 4 && seen.Add(Key(nx, ny, nz))) q.Enqueue((nx, ny, nz, d + 1)); } } w.BreakBlock(x, y, z, true); } private static long Key(int x, int y, int z) => ((long)(x & 0xFFFFFF) << 32) | ((long)(z & 0xFFFFFF) << 8) | (uint)(y & 0xFF); nodes.name: CheckDecay
nodes.signature: private void CheckDecay(World w, int x, int y, int z)
nodes.body_text: private void CheckDecay(World w, int x, int y, int z) { if (w.IsRemote || (w.GetMeta(x, y, z) & 4) != 0) return; if (!w.IsAreaLoaded(x, z, 5)) return; // BFS przez liście do 4 bloków szukając pnia var q = new Queue<(int, int, int, int)>(); var seen = new HashSet<long>(); q.Enqueue((x, y, z, 0)); seen.Add(Key(x, y, z)); while (q.Count > 0) { var (cx, cy, cz, d) = q.Dequeue(); for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { int nx = cx + Dir.X[f], ny = cy + Dir.Y[f], nz = cz + Dir.Z[f]; int id = w.GetBlock(nx, ny, nz); if (id == B.OakLog || id == B.BirchLog) return; if ((id == B.OakLeaves || id == B.BirchLeaves) && d < 4 && seen.Add(Key(nx, ny, nz))) q.Enqueue((nx, ny, nz, d + 1)); } } w.BreakBlock(x, y, z, true); }

nodes.body_text: public class CactusBlock : Block { public CactusBlock(byte id, string k, string n) : base(id, k, n) { T("cactus_top", "cactus_bottom", "cactus_side"); Opaque = false; FullCube = false; Render = RenderType.Cactus; Layer = RenderLayer.Cutout; LightOpacity = 0; Hardness = 0.4f; BlastResistance = 0.4f; Sound = SoundType.Wool; RandomTicks = true; NeedsSupport = true; Tab(Blocks.TabDecoration); } public override void GetCollisionBoxes(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<AABB> list) => list.Add(new AABB(1 / 16.0, 0, 1 / 16.0, 15 / 16.0, 15 / 16.0, 15 / 16.0)); public override void GetSelectionBoxes(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<AABB> list) => list.Add(new AABB(1 / 16.0, 0, 1 / 16.0, 15 / 16.0, 1, 15 / 16.0)); public override bool CanPlaceAt(World w, int x, int y, int z) { for (int h = 0; h < 4; h++) { var b = Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x + Dir.HorizX[h], y, z + Dir.HorizZ[h])); if (b.Solid) return false; } int below = w.GetBlock(x, y - 1, z); return below == B.Sand || below == B.Cactus; } public override void OnRandomTick(World w, int x, int y, int z, Rng r) { if (w.GetBlock(x, y + 1, z) != B.Air) return; int h = 1; while (w.GetBlock(x, y - h, z) == B.Cactus) h++; if (h >= 3) return; int m = w.GetMeta(x, y, z); if (m >= 15) { w.SetMeta(x, y, z, 0, false); if (CanPlaceAt(w, x, y + 1, z)) w.SetBlock(x, y + 1, z, B.Cactus); } else w.SetMeta(x, y, z, m + 1, false); } public override void OnEntityCollide(World w, int x, int y, int z, Entity e) { if (e is LivingEntity le) le.Attack(DamageSource.Cactus, 1f); else if (e is ItemEntity ie) ie.Kill(); } }

"furnace_front_on" : "furnace_front_off"); _side = TextureGen.Layer("furnace_side"); _top = TextureGen.Layer("furnace_top"); Tex = new[] { _top, _top, _front, _side, _side, _side }; HasTileEntity = true; } // meta = kierunek poziomy frontu (0=S,1=W,2=N,3=E) public override int GetTexture(int face, int meta) { if (face <= 1) return _top; return face == Dir.HorizToFace(meta & 3) ? _front : _side; } public override int GetPlacementMeta(World w, int x, int y, int z, int face, double hx, double hy, double hz, Player p, int itemMeta) => (Dir.HorizFromYaw(p.Yaw) + 2) & 3; public override int DropId(int meta, Rng r) => B.Furnace; public override ItemStack PickStack(int meta) => new(B.Furnace, 1); public override bool OnActivated(World w, int x, int y, int z, Player p) { p.OpenBlockGui(GuiKind.Furnace, x, y, z); return true; } public override void OnAdded(World w, int x, int y, int z) { if (w.GetTileEntity(x, y, z) is not FurnaceTileEntity) w.SetTileEntity(x, y, z, new FurnaceTileEntity()); } public override void OnRemoved(World w, int x, int y, int z, int oldMeta) { if (FurnaceTileEntity.Swapping) return; if (w.GetTileEntity(x, y, z) is FurnaceTileEntity te) { if (!w.IsRemote) foreach (var s in te.Slots) if (s != null) w.DropItem(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5, s); w.RemoveTileEntity(x, y, z); } } }

nodes.name: ChestBlock
nodes.signature: public class ChestBlock : Block
nodes.body_text: public class ChestBlock : Block { private readonly int _front, _side, _top; public ChestBlock(byte id, string k, string n) : base(id, k, n) { _front = TextureGen.Layer("chest_front"); _side = TextureGen.Layer("chest_side"); _top = TextureGen.Layer("chest_top"); Opaque = false; FullCube = false; Render = RenderType.Model; LightOpacity = 0; HasTileEntity = true; Flammable = true; } public override int GetTexture(int face, int meta) => face <= 1 ? _top : face == Dir.HorizToFace(meta & 3) ? _front : _side; public override void GetCollisionBoxes(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<AABB> list) => list.Add(new AABB(1 / 16.0, 0, 1 / 16.0, 15 / 16.0, 14 / 16.0, 15 / 16.0)); public override void GetModel(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<ModelBox> boxes) { var t = new int[6]; for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) t[f] = GetTexture(f, meta); var mb = ModelBox.Px(1, 0, 1, 15, 14, 15, t); mb.Uv = new float[24]; for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { mb.Uv[f * 4] = 0; mb.Uv[f * 4 + 1] = 0; mb.Uv[f * 4 + 2] = 1; mb.Uv[f * 4 + 3] = 1; } boxes.Add(mb); } public override int GetPlacementMeta(World w, int x, int y, int z, int face, double hx, double hy, double hz, Player p, int itemMeta) => (Dir.HorizFromYaw(p.Yaw) + 2) & 3; public override bool OnActivated(World w, int x, int y, int z, Player p) { p.OpenBlockGui(GuiKind.Chest, x, y, z); return true; } public override void OnAdded(World w, int x, int y, int z) { if (w.GetTileEntity(x, y, z) is not ChestTileEntity) w.SetTileEntity(x, y, z, new ChestTileEntity()); } public override void OnRemoved(World w, int x, int y, int z, int oldMeta) { if (w.GetTileEntity(x, y, z) is ChestTileEntity te) { if (!w.IsRemote) foreach (var s in te.Slots) if (s != null) w.DropItem(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5, s); w.RemoveTileEntity(x, y, z); } } }

nodes.name: TorchBlock
nodes.signature: public class TorchBlock : Block
nodes.body_text: public class TorchBlock : Block { public TorchBlock(byte id, string k, string n, string tex, int light) : base(id, k, n) { T(tex); Opaque = false; Solid = false; FullCube = false; Render = RenderType.Torch; Layer = RenderLayer.Cutout; LightOpacity = 0; LightEmit = light; Hardness = 0; BlastResistance = 0; Sound = SoundType.Wood; NeedsSupport = true; } // meta: 0=stoi na podłodze, 1..4 = przyczepiona do ściany; 1:+X ściana po W? -> kierunek "od ściany": 1=E,2=W,3=S,4=N (jak MC) public static bool SolidTop(World w, int x, int y, int z) { var b = Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x, y, z)); return b.Opaque || b.Id == B.Fence || b.Id == B.Glass || (b is SlabBlock && (w.GetMeta(x, y, z) & 1) == 1) || b is StairsBlock && (w.GetMeta(x, y, z) & 4) != 0; } public override bool CanPlaceAt(World w, int x, int y, int z) => SolidTop(w, x, y - 1, z) || Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x - 1, y, z)).Opaque || Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x + 1, y, z)).Opaque || Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x, y, z - 1)).Opaque || Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x, y, z + 1)).Opaque; public override bool CanStay(World w, int x, int y, int z) { int m = w.GetMeta(x, y, z); return m switch { 1 => Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x - 1, y, z)).Opaque, 2 => Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x + 1, y, z)).Opaque, 3 => Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x, y, z - 1)).Opaque, 4 => Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x, y, z + 1)).Opaque, _ => SolidTop(w, x, y - 1, z) }; } public override int GetPlacementMeta(World w, int x, int y, int z, int face, double hx, double hy, double hz, Player p, int itemMeta) { int m = face switch { Dir.East => 1, Dir.West => 2, Dir.South => 3, Dir.North => 4, _ => 0 }; if (m == 0 && !SolidTop(w, x, y - 1, z)) m = -1; bool ok = m switch { 1 => Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x - 1, y, z)).Opaque, 2 => Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x + 1, y, z)).Opaque, 3 => Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x, y, z - 1)).Opaque, 4 => Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x, y, z + 1)).Opaque, 0 => true, _ => false }; if (ok) return m; if (SolidTop(w, x, y - 1, z)) return 0; if (Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x - 1, y, z)).Opaque) return 1; if (Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x + 1, y, z)).Opaque) return 2; if (Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x, y, z - 1)).Opaque) return 3; return 4; } public override void GetSelectionBoxes(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<AABB> list) { const double f = 0.15; switch (meta) { case 1: list.Add(new AABB(0, 0.2, 0.5 - f, f * 2, 0.8, 0.5 + f)); break; case 2: list.Add(new AABB(1 - f * 2, 0.2, 0.5 - f, 1, 0.8, 0.5 + f)); break; case 3: list.Add(new AABB(0.5 - f, 0.2, 0, 0.5 + f, 0.8, f * 2)); break; case 4: list.Add(new AABB(0.5 - f, 0.2, 1 - f * 2, 0.5 + f, 0.8, 1)); break; default: list.Add(new AABB(0.4, 0, 0.4, 0.6, 0.6, 0.6)); break; } } }

nodes.signature: public class FarmlandBlock : Block
nodes.body_text: public class FarmlandBlock : Block { private readonly int _dry, _wet, _dirt; public FarmlandBlock(byte id, string k, string n) : base(id, k, n) { _dry = TextureGen.Layer("farmland_dry"); _wet = TextureGen.Layer("farmland_wet"); _dirt = TextureGen.Layer("dirt"); Opaque = false; FullCube = false; Render = RenderType.Model; LightOpacity = 0; RandomTicks = true; Tex = ModelBox.All(_dirt); } public override void GetCollisionBoxes(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<AABB> list) => list.Add(new AABB(0, 0, 0, 1, 15 / 16.0, 1)); public override void GetModel(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<ModelBox> boxes) { int top = meta > 0 ? _wet : _dry; boxes.Add(ModelBox.Px(0, 0, 0, 16, 15, 16, new[] { _dirt, top, _dirt, _dirt, _dirt, _dirt })); } public override int DropId(int meta, Rng r) => B.Dirt; public override void OnRandomTick(World w, int x, int y, int z, Rng r) { bool water = false; for (int dx = -4; dx <= 4 && !water; dx++) for (int dz = -4; dz <= 4 && !water; dz++) for (int dy = 0; dy <= 1; dy++) if (w.GetBlock(x + dx, y + dy, z + dz) == B.Water) { water = true; break; } int m = w.GetMeta(x, y, z); if (water) { if (m != 7) w.SetMeta(x, y, z, 7); } else if (m > 0) w.SetMeta(x, y, z, m - 1); else if (w.GetBlock(x, y + 1, z) != B.Wheat) w.SetBlock(x, y, z, B.Dirt); } public override void OnNeighborChanged(World w, int x, int y, int z, int nid) { if (Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x, y + 1, z)).Opaque) w.SetBlock(x, y, z, B.Dirt); } }

nodes.body_text: public class WheatBlock : PlantBlock { private readonly int[] _stages = new int[8]; public WheatBlock(byte id, string k, string n) : base(id, k, n) { for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) _stages[i] = TextureGen.Layer("wheat_" + i); Tex = ModelBox.All(_stages[0]); RandomTicks = true; } public override bool CanGrowOn(int id) => id == B.Farmland; public override int GetTexture(int face, int meta) => _stages[Math.Clamp(meta, 0, 7)]; public override void OnRandomTick(World w, int x, int y, int z, Rng r) { int m = w.GetMeta(x, y, z); if (m < 7 && w.GetRawLight(x, y + 1, z) >= 9) { float chance = w.GetMeta(x, y - 1, z) > 0 ? 4f : 2f; if (r.Next((int)(25f / chance) + 1) == 0) w.SetMeta(x, y, z, m + 1); } } public override void GetDrops(World w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, Rng r, ItemStack tool, List<ItemStack> drops) { if (meta >= 7) { drops.Add(new ItemStack(Items.I.Wheat, 1)); int s = r.Next(4); if (s > 0) drops.Add(new ItemStack(Items.I.Seeds, s)); } else drops.Add(new ItemStack(Items.I.Seeds, 1)); } public override ItemStack PickStack(int meta) => new(Items.I.Seeds, 1); public override void GetSelectionBoxes(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<AABB> list) => list.Add(new AABB(0, 0, 0, 1, 0.25 + meta * 0.1, 1)); }

nodes.body_text: public override void OnRandomTick(World w, int x, int y, int z, Rng r) { int m = w.GetMeta(x, y, z); if (m < 7 && w.GetRawLight(x, y + 1, z) >= 9) { float chance = w.GetMeta(x, y - 1, z) > 0 ? 4f : 2f; if (r.Next((int)(25f / chance) + 1) == 0) w.SetMeta(x, y, z, m + 1); } }

LightOpacity = 0; Hardness = 0.4f; BlastResistance = 0.4f; Climbable = true; Sound = SoundType.Ladder; Tool = ToolType.Axe; NeedsSupport = true; } // meta = strona ściany do której jest przyczepiona: 2=N(ściana z -Z),3=S,4=W,5=E (face id ściany przy której stoi) private static AABB Box(int m) { const double t = 0.125; return m switch { 2 => new AABB(0, 0, 0, 1, 1, t), 3 => new AABB(0, 0, 1 - t, 1, 1, 1), 4 => new AABB(0, 0, 0, t, 1, 1), _ => new AABB(1 - t, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1) }; } public override void GetCollisionBoxes(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<AABB> list) => list.Add(Box(meta)); public override void GetModel(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<ModelBox> boxes) { var b = Box(meta); double e = 0.01; // płaska ściana tuż przy murze var mb = meta switch { 2 => new ModelBox(0, 0, (float)e, 1, 1, (float)e, Tex), 3 => new ModelBox(0, 0, 1 - (float)e, 1, 1, 1 - (float)e, Tex), 4 => new ModelBox((float)e, 0, 0, (float)e, 1, 1, Tex), _ => new ModelBox(1 - (float)e, 0, 0, 1 - (float)e, 1, 1, Tex), }; mb.NoCull = true; boxes.Add(mb); } public override bool CanPlaceAt(World w, int x, int y, int z) { for (int f = 2; f < 6; f++) if (Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x + Dir.X[f], y, z + Dir.Z[f])).Opaque) return true; return false; } public override bool CanStay(World w, int x, int y, int z) { int m = w.GetMeta(x, y, z); if (m < 2 || m > 5) return false; return Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x + Dir.X[m], y, z + Dir.Z[m])).Opaque; } public override int GetPlacementMeta(World w, int x, int y, int z, int face, double hx, double hy, double hz, Player p, int itemMeta) { if (face >= 2) { int wall = Dir.Opp[face]; if (Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x + Dir.X[wall], y, z + Dir.Z[wall])).Opaque) return wall; } for (int f = 2; f < 6; f++) if (Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x + Dir.X[f], y, z + Dir.Z[f])).Opaque) return f; return 2; } }

nodes.signature: public class FenceBlock : Block
nodes.body_text: public class FenceBlock : Block { public FenceBlock(byte id, string k, string n) : base(id, k, n) { T("planks_oak"); Opaque = false; FullCube = false; Render = RenderType.Model; LightOpacity = 0; H(2f, 3); Tool = ToolType.Axe; Sound = SoundType.Wood; } public static bool Connects(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z) { int id = w.GetBlock(x, y, z); var b = Block.Get(id); return id == B.Fence || id == B.FenceGate || (b.Opaque && id != B.Tnt); } public override void GetCollisionBoxes(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<AABB> list) { double x0 = 0.375, x1 = 0.625, z0 = 0.375, z1 = 0.625; if (Connects(w, x - 1, y, z)) x0 = 0; if (Connects(w, x + 1, y, z)) x1 = 1; if (Connects(w, x, y, z - 1)) z0 = 0; if (Connects(w, x, y, z + 1)) z1 = 1; list.Add(new AABB(x0, 0, 0.375, x1, 1.5, 0.625)); list.Add(new AABB(0.375, 0, z0, 0.625, 1.5, z1)); } public override void GetSelectionBoxes(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<AABB> list) { double x0 = 0.375, x1 = 0.625, z0 = 0.375, z1 = 0.625; if (Connects(w, x - 1, y, z)) x0 = 0; if (Connects(w, x + 1, y, z)) x1 = 1; if (Connects(w, x, y, z - 1)) z0 = 0; if (Connects(w, x, y, z + 1)) z1 = 1; list.Add(new AABB(x0, 0, z0, x1, 1, z1)); } public override void GetModel(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<ModelBox> boxes) { boxes.Add(ModelBox.Px(6, 0, 6, 10, 16, 10, Tex)); void Arm(int dx, int dz) { float ax0 = dx < 0 ? 0 : dx > 0 ? 10 : 7, ax1 = dx < 0 ? 6 : dx > 0 ? 16 : 9; float az0 = dz < 0 ? 0 : dz > 0 ? 10 : 7, az1 = dz < 0 ? 6 : dz > 0 ? 16 : 9; boxes.Add(ModelBox.Px(ax0, 12, az0, ax1, 15, az1, Tex)); boxes.Add(ModelBox.Px(ax0, 6, az0, ax1, 9, az1, Tex)); } if (Connects(w, x - 1, y, z)) Arm(-1, 0); if (Connects(w, x + 1, y, z)) Arm(1, 0); if (Connects(w, x, y, z - 1)) Arm(0, -1); if (Connects(w, x, y, z + 1)) Arm(0, 1); } }

nodes.name: FenceGateBlock
nodes.signature: public class FenceGateBlock : Block
nodes.body_text: public class FenceGateBlock : Block { public FenceGateBlock(byte id, string k, string n) : base(id, k, n) { T("planks_oak"); Opaque = false; FullCube = false; Render = RenderType.Model; LightOpacity = 0; H(2f, 3); Tool = ToolType.Axe; Sound = SoundType.Wood; } // meta: bity 0-1 kierunek (0=S..), bit 2 = otwarta public override int GetPlacementMeta(World w, int x, int y, int z, int face, double hx, double hy, double hz, Player p, int itemMeta) => Dir.HorizFromYaw(p.Yaw); public override void GetCollisionBoxes(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<AABB> list) { if ((meta & 4) != 0) return; if ((meta & 1) == 0) list.Add(new AABB(0, 0, 0.375, 1, 1.5, 0.625)); else list.Add(new AABB(0.375, 0, 0, 0.625, 1.5, 1)); } public override void GetSelectionBoxes(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<AABB> list) { if ((meta & 1) == 0) list.Add(new AABB(0, 0, 0.375, 1, 1, 0.625)); else list.Add(new AABB(0.375, 0, 0, 0.625, 1, 1)); } public override void GetModel(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<ModelBox> boxes) { bool open = (meta & 4) != 0; bool alongX = (meta & 1) == 0; void Box(float x0, float y0, float z0, float x1, float y1, float z1) { if (alongX) boxes.Add(ModelBox.Px(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, Tex)); else boxes.Add(ModelBox.Px(z0, y0, x0, z1, y1, x1, Tex)); } Box(0, 5, 7, 2, 16, 9); Box(14, 5, 7, 16, 16, 9); if (!open) { Box(6, 6, 7, 8, 15, 9); Box(8, 6, 7, 10, 15, 9); Box(2, 6, 7, 6, 9, 9); Box(2, 12, 7, 6, 15, 9); Box(10, 6, 7, 14, 9, 9); Box(10, 12, 7, 14, 15, 9); } else { int dir = (meta & 2) == 0 ? 1 : -1; float zA = dir > 0 ? 9 : 1, zB = dir > 0 ? 15 : 7; Box(0, 6, zA, 2, 15, zB); Box(14, 6, zA, 16, 15, zB); Box(0, 6, zB - (dir > 0 ? 2 : 6), 2, 9, zB - (dir > 0 ? 0 : 4)); Box(14, 6, zB - (dir > 0 ? 2 : 6), 16, 9, zB - (dir > 0 ? 0 : 4)); } } public override bool OnActivated(World w, int x, int y, int z, Player p) { int m = w.GetMeta(x, y, z); if ((m & 4) != 0) m &= ~4; else { int face = Dir.HorizFromYaw(p.Yaw); m = (m & ~3) | ((face == ((m & 3) + 2) % 4) ? (m & 3) ^ 2 : (m & 3)) | 4; } w.SetMeta(x, y, z, m); w.PlaySound("door_" + ((m & 4) != 0 ? "open" : "close"), x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5); return true; } }

nodes.body_text: public class StairsBlock : Block { public StairsBlock(byte id, string k, string n, string tex) : base(id, k, n) { T(tex); Opaque = false; FullCube = false; Render = RenderType.Model; LightOpacity = 0; } // meta: bity 0-1 kierunek "wejścia" (strona wysoka): 0=+Z,1=-X,2=-Z,3=+X ; bit 2 = odwrócone private static void Boxes(int meta, Action<double, double, double, double, double, double> add) { bool up = (meta & 4) != 0; int d = meta & 3; if (up) add(0, 0.5, 0, 1, 1, 1); else add(0, 0, 0, 1, 0.5, 1); double y0 = up ? 0 : 0.5, y1 = up ? 0.5 : 1; switch (d) { case 0: add(0, y0, 0.5, 1, y1, 1); break; case 1: add(0, y0, 0, 0.5, y1, 1); break; case 2: add(0, y0, 0, 1, y1, 0.5); break; default: add(0.5, y0, 0, 1, y1, 1); break; } } public override void GetCollisionBoxes(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<AABB> list) => Boxes(meta, (a, b, c, d, e, f) => list.Add(new AABB(a, b, c, d, e, f))); public override void GetSelectionBoxes(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<AABB> list) => list.Add(new AABB(0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1)); public override void GetModel(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<ModelBox> boxes) => Boxes(meta, (a, b, c, d, e, f) => boxes.Add(new ModelBox((float)a, (float)b, (float)c, (float)d, (float)e, (float)f, Tex))); public override int GetPlacementMeta(World w, int x, int y, int z, int face, double hx, double hy, double hz, Player p, int itemMeta) { int d = Dir.HorizFromYaw(p.Yaw); // patrzy w kierunku d -> wysoka strona dalej od gracza bool up = face == Dir.Down || (face != Dir.Up && hy > 0.5); return d | (up ? 4 : 0); } }

nodes.name: BedBlock
nodes.signature: public class BedBlock : Block
nodes.body_text: public class BedBlock : Block { private readonly int _headTop, _footTop, _headSide, _footSide, _headEnd, _footEnd, _planks; public BedBlock(byte id, string k, string n) : base(id, k, n) { _headTop = TextureGen.Layer("bed_head_top"); _footTop = TextureGen.Layer("bed_feet_top"); _headSide = TextureGen.Layer("bed_head_side"); _footSide = TextureGen.Layer("bed_feet_side"); _headEnd = TextureGen.Layer("bed_head_end"); _footEnd = TextureGen.Layer("bed_feet_end"); _planks = TextureGen.Layer("planks_oak"); Opaque = false; FullCube = false; Render = RenderType.Model; LightOpacity = 0; Hardness = 0.2f; BlastResistance = 0.2f; Sound = SoundType.Wood; Tex = ModelBox.All(_planks); } // meta: bity 0-1 kierunek (od nóg do głowy: 0=+Z,1=-X,2=-Z,3=+X), bit 3 = głowa public override void GetCollisionBoxes(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<AABB> list) => list.Add(new AABB(0, 0, 0, 1, 9 / 16.0, 1)); public override void GetModel(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<ModelBox> boxes) { bool head = (meta & 8) != 0; int d = meta & 3; int top = head ? _headTop : _footTop, side = head ? _headSide : _footSide, end = head ? _headEnd : _footEnd; int headFace = Dir.HorizToFace(d); var t = new int[6]; t[0] = _planks; t[1] = top; for (int f = 2; f < 6; f++) t[f] = side; if (head) t[headFace] = end; else t[Dir.Opp[headFace]] = end; if (head) t[Dir.Opp[headFace]] = side; var mb = ModelBox.Px(0, 3, 0, 16, 9, 16, t); mb.UvRot = new int[6]; mb.UvRot[1] = d switch { 0 => 0, 1 => 1, 2 => 2, _ => 3 }; mb.Uv = new float[24]; for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { mb.Uv[f * 4] = 0; mb.Uv[f * 4 + 1] = f <= 1 ? 0 : 7 / 16f; mb.Uv[f * 4 + 2] = 1; mb.Uv[f * 4 + 3] = f <= 1 ? 1 : 13 / 16f; } if (head) { int opp = Dir.Opp[headFace]; mb.Uv[opp * 4 + 1] = 0; mb.Uv[opp * 4 + 3] = 0; } boxes.Add(mb); // nóżki var leg = ModelBox.All(_planks); boxes.Add(ModelBox.Px(0, 0, 0, 3, 3, 3, leg)); boxes.Add(ModelBox.Px(13, 0, 0, 16, 3, 3, leg)); boxes.Add(ModelBox.Px(0, 0, 13, 3, 3, 16, leg)); boxes.Add(ModelBox.Px(13, 0, 13, 16, 3, 16, leg)); } public override int DropId(int meta, Rng r) => (meta & 8) != 0 ? Items.I.Bed : 0; public override ItemStack PickStack(int meta) => new(Items.I.Bed, 1); public static (int, int, int) Other(int x, int y, int z, int meta) { int d = meta & 3; int s = (meta & 8) != 0 ? -1 : 1; return (x + Dir.HorizX[d] * s, y, z + Dir.HorizZ[d] * s); } public override void OnNeighborChanged(World w, int x, int y, int z, int nid) { var (ox, oy, oz) = Other(x, y, z, w.GetMeta(x, y, z)); if (w.GetBlock(ox, oy, oz) != B.Bed) w.SetBlock(x, y, z, B.Air); } public override bool OnActivated(World w, int x, int y, int z, Player p) { if (w.IsRemote) return true; int meta = w.GetMeta(x, y, z); if ((meta & 8) == 0) { var o = Other(x, y, z, meta); x = o.Item1; z = o.Item3; } p.SpawnX = x; p.SpawnY = y + 1; p.SpawnZ = z; p.HasSpawn = true; if (!w.IsNight()) { p.SendMessage("§eMożesz spać tylko w nocy. Ustawiono punkt odrodzenia."); return true; } if (w.HasMonstersNear(x, y, z, 8)) { p.SendMessage("§cNie możesz teraz odpocząć, w pobliżu są potwory."); return true; } p.StartSleeping(x, y, z); return true; } }

nodes.name: DoorBlock
nodes.signature: public class DoorBlock : Block
nodes.body_text: public class DoorBlock : Block { private readonly int _lower, _upper; public DoorBlock(byte id, string k, string n) : base(id, k, n) { _lower = TextureGen.Layer("door_wood_lower"); _upper = TextureGen.Layer("door_wood_upper"); Tex = ModelBox.All(_lower); Opaque = false; FullCube = false; Render = RenderType.Model; Layer = RenderLayer.Cutout; LightOpacity = 0; Hardness = 3f; BlastResistance = 3f; Tool = ToolType.Axe; Sound = SoundType.Wood; } // dolna: bity 0-1 kierunek (0=+Z..), bit 2 = otwarte ; górna: bit 3 = górna, bit 0 = zawias prawy, bit 1 = zasilone public static int FullMeta(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z) { int m = w.GetMeta(x, y, z); bool top = (m & 8) != 0; int lower = top ? w.GetMeta(x, y - 1, z) : m; int upper = top ? m : w.GetMeta(x, y + 1, z); return (lower & 7) | (top ? 8 : 0) | ((upper & 1) << 4); } private static AABB Box(int full) { const double t = 3 / 16.0; int d = full & 3; bool open = (full & 4) != 0; bool hingeR = (full & 16) != 0; // zamknięte: drzwi wzdłuż krawędzi w zależności od kierunku int side = d; if (open) side = hingeR ? (d + 3) & 3 : (d + 1) & 3; return side switch { 0 => new AABB(0, 0, 0, t, 1, 1), // przy ścianie -X 1 => new AABB(0, 0, 0, 1, 1, t), // przy -Z 2 => new AABB(1 - t, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1), // przy +X _ => new AABB(0, 0, 1 - t, 1, 1, 1) // przy +Z }; } public override void GetCollisionBoxes(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<AABB> list) => list.Add(Box(FullMeta(w, x, y, z))); public override void GetModel(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<ModelBox> boxes) { var b = Box(FullMeta(w, x, y, z)); int tex = (meta & 8) != 0 ? _upper : _lower; var mb = new ModelBox((float)b.MinX, (float)b.MinY, (float)b.MinZ, (float)b.MaxX, (float)b.MaxY, (float)b.MaxZ, ModelBox.All(tex)); mb.Uv = new float[24]; for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { mb.Uv[f * 4] = 0; mb.Uv[f * 4 + 1] = 0; mb.Uv[f * 4 + 2] = f <= 1 ? 3 / 16f : 1; mb.Uv[f * 4 + 3] = 1; } // krawędzie: wąski pasek for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { double w0 = f <= 1 ? 1 : (f == 2 || f == 3) ? b.MaxX - b.MinX : b.MaxZ - b.MinZ; if (w0 < 0.5) { mb.Uv[f * 4] = 0; mb.Uv[f * 4 + 2] = 3 / 16f; } } boxes.Add(mb); } public override int DropId(int meta, Rng r) => (meta & 8) != 0 ? 0 : Items.I.Door; public override ItemStack PickStack(int meta) => new(Items.I.Door, 1); public override bool OnActivated(World w, int x, int y, int z, Player p) { int m = w.GetMeta(x, y, z); int ly = (m & 8) != 0 ? y - 1 : y; int lm = w.GetMeta(x, ly, z) ^ 4; w.SetMeta(x, ly, z, lm); w.MarkDirty(x, ly + 1, z); w.PlaySound((lm & 4) != 0 ? "door_open" : "door_close", x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5); return true; } public override void OnNeighborChanged(World w, int x, int y, int z, int nid) { int m = w.GetMeta(x, y, z); if ((m & 8) != 0) { if (w.GetBlock(x, y - 1, z) != B.OakDoor) w.SetBlock(x, y, z, B.Air); return; } if (w.GetBlock(x, y + 1, z) != B.OakDoor) { w.BreakBlock(x, y, z, true); return; } if (!Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x, y - 1, z)).Opaque) { w.BreakBlock(x, y, z, true); return; } bool powered = Redstone.IsBlockPowered(w, x, y, z) || Redstone.IsBlockPowered(w, x, y + 1, z); int um = w.GetMeta(x, y + 1, z); bool wasPowered = (um & 2) != 0; if (powered != wasPowered) { w.SetMeta(x, y + 1, z, (um & ~2) | (powered ? 2 : 0), false); bool open = (m & 4) != 0; if (open != powered) { w.SetMeta(x, y, z, m ^ 4); w.MarkDirty(x, y + 1, z); w.PlaySound(powered ? "door_open" : "door_close", x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5); } } } public override void OnRemoved(World w, int x, int y, int z, int oldMeta) { if ((oldMeta & 8) != 0) { if (w.GetBlock(x, y - 1, z) == B.OakDoor) w.SetBlock(x, y - 1, z, B.Air); } else if (w.GetBlock(x, y + 1, z) == B.OakDoor) w.SetBlock(x, y + 1, z, B.Air); } }

nodes.body_text: public override void OnNeighborChanged(World w, int x, int y, int z, int nid) { int m = w.GetMeta(x, y, z); if ((m & 8) != 0) { if (w.GetBlock(x, y - 1, z) != B.OakDoor) w.SetBlock(x, y, z, B.Air); return; } if (w.GetBlock(x, y + 1, z) != B.OakDoor) { w.BreakBlock(x, y, z, true); return; } if (!Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x, y - 1, z)).Opaque) { w.BreakBlock(x, y, z, true); return; } bool powered = Redstone.IsBlockPowered(w, x, y, z) || Redstone.IsBlockPowered(w, x, y + 1, z); int um = w.GetMeta(x, y + 1, z); bool wasPowered = (um & 2) != 0; if (powered != wasPowered) { w.SetMeta(x, y + 1, z, (um & ~2) | (powered ? 2 : 0), false); bool open = (m & 4) != 0; if (open != powered) { w.SetMeta(x, y, z, m ^ 4); w.MarkDirty(x, y + 1, z); w.PlaySound(powered ? "door_open" : "door_close", x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5); } } }

nodes.body_text: public sealed class Chunk { public const int Size = 16, Height = 128, Sections = Height / 16, Volume = Size * Size * Height; public readonly int Cx, Cz; public readonly byte[] Blocks = new byte[Volume]; public readonly byte[] Meta = new byte[Volume]; public readonly byte[] Light = new byte[Volume]; // górne 4 bity = niebo, dolne = blok public readonly byte[] HeightMap = new byte[Size * Size]; // najwyższy y blokujący światło + 1 public readonly byte[] Biomes = new byte[Size * Size]; public readonly Dictionary<int, TileEntity> TileEntities = new(); public readonly int[] SectionCounts = new int[Sections]; // liczba niepustych bloków w sekcji public bool Lit; // światło policzone (lokalnie) public bool Merged; // światło połączone z sąsiadami public bool Modified; // do zapisu public bool Populated; // zwierzęta wygenerowane public bool Unloaded; public int DirtySections; // maska bitowa sekcji do przebudowy mesha public long LastSeen; public byte[] PendingEntityData; // wczytane z dysku, encje tworzone przy integracji public bool FromDisk; public Chunk(int cx, int cz) { Cx = cx; Cz = cz; } [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)] public static int Index(int x, int y, int z) => (y << 8) | (z << 4) | x; [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)] public byte GetBlock(int x, int y, int z) => Blocks[(y << 8) | (z << 4) | x]; [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)] public int GetMeta(int x, int y, int z) => Meta[(y << 8) | (z << 4) | x]; public void SetBlockRaw(int x, int y, int z, byte id, int meta) { int i = Index(x, y, z); byte old = Blocks[i]; if ((old != 0) != (id != 0)) SectionCounts[y >> 4] += id != 0 ? 1 : -1; Blocks[i] = id; Meta[i] = (byte)meta; } public void RecountSections() { Array.Clear(SectionCounts); for (int i = 0; i < Volume; i++) if (Blocks[i] != 0) SectionCounts[i >> 12]++; } public int GetSky(int x, int y, int z) => Light[Index(x, y, z)] >> 4; public int GetBlockLight(int x, int y, int z) => Light[Index(x, y, z)] & 15; public void RecalcHeightMap() { for (int z = 0; z < 16; z++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) RecalcHeight(x, z); } public void RecalcHeight(int x, int z) { int y = Height - 1; while (y >= 0 && Block.ById[Blocks[Index(x, y, z)]].LightOpacity == 0) y--; HeightMap[(z << 4) | x] = (byte)(y + 1); } public int GetHeight(int x, int z) => HeightMap[(z << 4) | x]; public int TopSolidY(int x, int z) { for (int y = Height - 1; y >= 0; y--) { var b = Block.ById[Blocks[Index(x, y, z)]]; if (b.Solid || b.IsLiquid) return y; } return -1; } public void MarkAllDirty() => DirtySections = (1 << Sections) - 1; }

continue; } try { int cx = (int)(key >> 32), cz = (int)key; Chunk c = null; if (_savingChunks.TryGetValue(key, out var sc)) { c = sc; c.Unloaded = false; } if (c == null && _w.Storage != null) c = _w.Storage.LoadChunk(cx, cz);
