nodes.body_text: public static void InitChunkLocal(Chunk c) { InitTables(); var light = c.Light; var blocks = c.Blocks; Array.Clear(light); var q = new Queue<int>(4096); // niebo: kolumny for (int z = 0; z < 16; z++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { int level = 15; for (int y = Chunk.Height - 1; y >= 0; y--) { int i = Chunk.Index(x, y, z); int op = Opacity[blocks[i]]; if (op > 0) { level -= op; if (level < 0) level = 0; } light[i] = (byte)(level << 4); if (level == 0) break; } } // ziarna do rozprzestrzeniania w bok for (int z = 0; z < 16; z++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { int maxN = 0; for (int h = 0; h < 4; h++) { int nx = x + Dir.HorizX[h], nz = z + Dir.HorizZ[h]; if (nx < 0 || nx > 15 || nz < 0 || nz > 15) continue; maxN = Math.Max(maxN, c.HeightMap[(nz << 4) | nx]); } int top = Math.Min(Chunk.Height - 1, maxN); for (int y = top; y >= 0; y--) { int i = Chunk.Index(x, y, z); if ((light[i] >> 4) > 1) q.Enqueue(i); } } SpreadLocal(c, q, true); // światło bloków for (int i = 0; i < Chunk.Volume; i++) { int e = Emit[blocks[i]]; if (e > 0) { light[i] = (byte)((light[i] & 0xF0) | e); q.Enqueue(i); } } SpreadLocal(c, q, false); c.Lit = true; }

nodes.name: SpreadLocal
nodes.signature: private static void SpreadLocal(Chunk c, Queue<int> q, bool sky)
nodes.body_text: private static void SpreadLocal(Chunk c, Queue<int> q, bool sky) { var light = c.Light; var blocks = c.Blocks; while (q.Count > 0) { int i = q.Dequeue(); int x = i & 15, z = (i >> 4) & 15, y = i >> 8; int lvl = sky ? light[i] >> 4 : light[i] & 15; if (lvl <= 1) continue; for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { int nx = x + Dir.X[f], ny = y + Dir.Y[f], nz = z + Dir.Z[f]; if (nx < 0 || nx > 15 || nz < 0 || nz > 15 || ny < 0 || ny >= Chunk.Height) continue; int ni = Chunk.Index(nx, ny, nz); int op = Opacity[blocks[ni]]; if (op >= 15) continue; int nl = lvl - Math.Max(1, op); int cur = sky ? light[ni] >> 4 : light[ni] & 15; if (cur < nl) { light[ni] = sky ? (byte)((light[ni] & 0x0F) | (nl << 4)) : (byte)((light[ni] & 0xF0) | nl); q.Enqueue(ni); } } } }

nodes.name: GetL
nodes.signature: private int GetL(int x, int y, int z, bool sky, out Chunk c)
nodes.body_text: private int GetL(int x, int y, int z, bool sky, out Chunk c) { c = _w.GetChunkIfLit(x >> 4, z >> 4); if (c == null) return -1; if (y < 0) return 0; if (y >= Chunk.Height) return sky ? 15 : 0; byte v = c.Light[Chunk.Index(x & 15, y, z & 15)]; return sky ? v >> 4 : v & 15; }

nodes.name: SetL
nodes.signature: private void SetL(Chunk c, int x, int y, int z, bool sky, int lvl)
nodes.body_text: private void SetL(Chunk c, int x, int y, int z, bool sky, int lvl) { int i = Chunk.Index(x & 15, y, z & 15); byte v = c.Light[i]; c.Light[i] = sky ? (byte)((v & 0x0F) | (lvl << 4)) : (byte)((v & 0xF0) | lvl); _w.MarkLightDirty(c, x, y, z); }

nodes.name: Push
nodes.signature: private void Push(int x, int y, int z, int l)
nodes.body_text: private void Push(int x, int y, int z, int l) { if (_qt + 4 > _q.Length) { if (_qh > 0) { Array.Copy(_q, _qh, _q, 0, _qt - _qh); _qt -= _qh; _qh = 0; } if (_qt + 4 > _q.Length) Array.Resize(ref _q, _q.Length * 2); } _q[_qt++] = x; _q[_qt++] = y; _q[_qt++] = z; _q[_qt++] = l; }

nodes.name: PushR
nodes.signature: private void PushR(int x, int y, int z, int l)
nodes.body_text: private void PushR(int x, int y, int z, int l) { if (_rt + 4 > _rq.Length) { if (_rh > 0) { Array.Copy(_rq, _rh, _rq, 0, _rt - _rh); _rt -= _rh; _rh = 0; } if (_rt + 4 > _rq.Length) Array.Resize(ref _rq, _rq.Length * 2); } _rq[_rt++] = x; _rq[_rt++] = y; _rq[_rt++] = z; _rq[_rt++] = l; }

nodes.name: RunAdd
nodes.signature: private void RunAdd(bool sky)
nodes.body_text: private void RunAdd(bool sky) { while (_qh < _qt) { int x = _q[_qh++], y = _q[_qh++], z = _q[_qh++]; _qh++; int lvl = GetL(x, y, z, sky, out _); if (lvl <= 1) continue; for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { int nx = x + Dir.X[f], ny = y + Dir.Y[f], nz = z + Dir.Z[f]; if (ny < 0 || ny >= Chunk.Height) continue; int cur = GetL(nx, ny, nz, sky, out var c); if (cur < 0) continue; int op = Opacity[c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(nx & 15, ny, nz & 15)]]; if (op >= 15) continue; int nl = (sky && f == Dir.Down && lvl == 15 && op == 0) ? 15 : lvl - Math.Max(1, op); if (cur < nl) { SetL(c, nx, ny, nz, sky, nl); Push(nx, ny, nz, nl); } } } _qh = _qt = 0; }

nodes.name: RunRemove
nodes.signature: private void RunRemove(bool sky)
nodes.body_text: private void RunRemove(bool sky) { while (_rh < _rt) { int x = _rq[_rh++], y = _rq[_rh++], z = _rq[_rh++], lvl = _rq[_rh++]; for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { int nx = x + Dir.X[f], ny = y + Dir.Y[f], nz = z + Dir.Z[f]; if (ny < 0 || ny >= Chunk.Height) continue; int nl = GetL(nx, ny, nz, sky, out var c); if (nl <= 0) continue; bool downSky = sky && f == Dir.Down && lvl == 15 && nl == 15; if (nl < lvl || downSky) { SetL(c, nx, ny, nz, sky, 0); PushR(nx, ny, nz, nl); } else Push(nx, ny, nz, nl); } } _rh = _rt = 0; }

nodes.name: MergeChunk
nodes.signature: public void MergeChunk(Chunk c)
nodes.body_text: public void MergeChunk(Chunk c) { int bx = c.Cx * 16, bz = c.Cz * 16; for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) { bool sky = pass == 0; for (int h = 0; h < 4; h++) { var n = _w.GetChunkIfLit(c.Cx + Dir.HorizX[h], c.Cz + Dir.HorizZ[h]); if (n == null) continue; for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) { int ax, az, nx, nz; switch (h) { case 0: ax = k; az = 15; nx = k; nz = 0; break; // +Z case 1: ax = 0; az = k; nx = 15; nz = k; break; // -X case 2: ax = k; az = 0; nx = k; nz = 15; break; // -Z default: ax = 15; az = k; nx = 0; nz = k; break; // +X } for (int y = 0; y < Chunk.Height; y++) { int ia = Chunk.Index(ax, y, az), ib = Chunk.Index(nx, y, nz); int la = sky ? c.Light[ia] >> 4 : c.Light[ia] & 15; int lb = sky ? n.Light[ib] >> 4 : n.Light[ib] & 15; if (la > lb + 1) Push(bx + ax, y, bz + az, la); else if (lb > la + 1) Push(n.Cx * 16 + nx, y, n.Cz * 16 + nz, lb); } } } RunAdd(sky); } c.Merged = true; }

nodes.name: OnBlockChanged
nodes.signature: public void OnBlockChanged(int x, int y, int z, Block oldB, Block newB)
nodes.body_text: public void OnBlockChanged(int x, int y, int z, Block oldB, Block newB) { if (_w.GetChunkIfLit(x >> 4, z >> 4) == null) return; if (oldB.LightOpacity == newB.LightOpacity && oldB.LightEmit == newB.LightEmit) return; UpdateChannel(x, y, z, false, newB); UpdateChannel(x, y, z, true, newB); }

nodes.name: UpdateChannel
nodes.signature: private void UpdateChannel(int x, int y, int z, bool sky, Block newB)
nodes.body_text: private void UpdateChannel(int x, int y, int z, bool sky, Block newB) { int old = GetL(x, y, z, sky, out var c); if (old < 0) return; int emit = sky ? 0 : newB.LightEmit; // usuwanie if (old > 0) { SetL(c, x, y, z, sky, 0); PushR(x, y, z, old); RunRemove(sky); } // źródło if (sky) { // jeśli nad blokiem jest pełne niebo i blok przepuszcza int above = GetL(x, y + 1, z, true, out _); if (newB.LightOpacity < 15) { int l = above == 15 && newB.LightOpacity == 0 ? 15 : Math.Max(0, (above < 0 ? 0 : above) - Math.Max(1, newB.LightOpacity)); if (y + 1 >= Chunk.Height) l = 15; if (l > GetL(x, y, z, true, out _)) { SetL(c, x, y, z, true, l); } Push(x, y, z, l); } } else if (emit > 0) { if (emit > GetL(x, y, z, false, out _)) SetL(c, x, y, z, false, emit); Push(x, y, z, emit); } // sąsiedzi wlewają światło z powrotem if (newB.LightOpacity < 15) for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { int nx = x + Dir.X[f], ny = y + Dir.Y[f], nz = z + Dir.Z[f]; if (ny < 0 || ny >= Chunk.Height) continue; int nl = GetL(nx, ny, nz, sky, out _); if (nl > 0) Push(nx, ny, nz, nl); } RunAdd(sky); }

nodes.name: Redstone
nodes.signature: public static class Redstone
nodes.body_text: public static class Redstone { [ThreadStatic] private static bool _ignoreWires; /// <summary>Moc "silna" w bloku (sumarycznie od sąsiadów), używana dla pełnych bloków.</summary> public static int StrongPowerInto(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z) { int max = 0; for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { int nx = x + Dir.X[f], ny = y + Dir.Y[f], nz = z + Dir.Z[f]; int id = w.GetBlock(nx, ny, nz); if (id == 0) continue; if (_ignoreWires && id == B.RedstoneWire) continue; var b = Block.ById[id]; // side = kierunek od sąsiada do nas int p = b.GetStrongPower(w, nx, ny, nz, w.GetMeta(nx, ny, nz), Dir.Opp[f]); if (p > max) { max = p; if (max >= 15) return 15; } } return max; } /// <summary>Moc docierająca do (x,y,z) od sąsiada w kierunku f.</summary> public static int PowerFromSide(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int f) { int nx = x + Dir.X[f], ny = y + Dir.Y[f], nz = z + Dir.Z[f]; int id = w.GetBlock(nx, ny, nz); if (id == 0) return 0; if (_ignoreWires && id == B.RedstoneWire) return 0; var b = Block.ById[id]; if (b.Opaque && !b.IsPowerSource) return StrongPowerInto(w, nx, ny, nz); return b.GetWeakPower(w, nx, ny, nz, w.GetMeta(nx, ny, nz), Dir.Opp[f]); } public static int InputPower(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int exceptFace = -1) { int max = 0; for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { if (f == exceptFace) continue; int p = PowerFromSide(w, x, y, z, f); if (p > max) { max = p; if (max >= 15) return 15; } } return max; } public static bool IsBlockPowered(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z) => InputPower(w, x, y, z) > 0; /// <summary>Powiadom sąsiadów i sąsiadów sąsiadów (dla przekazywania mocy przez bloki).</summary> public static void NotifyAround(World w, int x, int y, int z, int sourceId) { w.NotifyNeighbors(x, y, z, sourceId); for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { int nx = x + Dir.X[f], ny = y + Dir.Y[f], nz = z + Dir.Z[f]; if (Block.Get(w.GetBlock(nx, ny, nz)).Opaque) w.NotifyNeighbors(nx, ny, nz, sourceId, Dir.Opp[f]); } } // ---------- Sieć przewodów ---------- private static bool _updatingWires; public static bool WireConnects(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int h, out int ty) { // h = kierunek poziomy (0..3), zwraca y celu jeśli jest tam przewód lub komponent int nx = x + Dir.HorizX[h], nz = z + Dir.HorizZ[h]; int id = w.GetBlock(nx, y, nz); ty = y; if (id == B.RedstoneWire) return true; var b = Block.Get(id); if (b.ConnectsToRedstone(w.GetMeta(nx, y, nz), Dir.Opp[Dir.HorizToFace(h)])) return true; if (!b.Opaque && w.GetBlock(nx, y - 1, nz) == B.RedstoneWire) { ty = y - 1; return true; } if (!Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x, y + 1, z)).Opaque && w.GetBlock(nx, y + 1, nz) == B.RedstoneWire) { ty = y + 1; return true; } return false; } public static void UpdateWireNetwork(World w, int sx, int sy, int sz) { if (_updatingWires || w.IsRemote) return; _updatingWires = true; try { var nodes = new Dictionary<long, (int x, int y, int z)>(); var q = new Queue<(int, int, int)>(); q.Enqueue((sx, sy, sz)); nodes[Key(sx, sy, sz)] = (sx, sy, sz); while (q.Count > 0 && nodes.Count < 2048) { var (x, y, z) = q.Dequeue(); for (int h = 0; h < 4; h++) { if (WireConnects(w, x, y, z, h, out int ty)) { int nx = x + Dir.HorizX[h], nz = z + Dir.HorizZ[h]; if (w.GetBlock(nx, ty, nz) == B.RedstoneWire && !nodes.ContainsKey(Key(nx, ty, nz))) { nodes[Key(nx, ty, nz)] = (nx, ty, nz); q.Enqueue((nx, ty, nz)); } } } } // moc zewnętrzna var power = new Dictionary<long, int>(); _ignoreWires = true; var pq = new PriorityQueue<long, int>(); foreach (var kv in nodes) { var (x, y, z) = kv.Value; int p = 0; for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { int nx = x + Dir.X[f], ny = y + Dir.Y[f], nz = z + Dir.Z[f]; int id = w.GetBlock(nx, ny, nz); if (id == B.RedstoneWire || id == 0) continue; int pp = PowerFromSide(w, x, y, z, f); if (pp > p) p = pp; } power[kv.Key] = p; if (p > 0) pq.Enqueue(kv.Key, -p); } _ignoreWires = false; while (pq.TryDequeue(out long k, out int negP)) { int p = -negP; if (power[k] != p) continue; if (p <= 1) continue; var (x, y, z) = nodes[k]; for (int h = 0; h < 4; h++) { if (!WireConnects(w, x, y, z, h, out int ty)) continue; int nx = x + Dir.HorizX[h], nz = z + Dir.HorizZ[h]; long nk = Key(nx, ty, nz); if (!nodes.ContainsKey(nk)) continue; if (power[nk] < p - 1) { power[nk] = p - 1; pq.Enqueue(nk, -(p - 1)); } } } var changed = new List<(int, int, int)>(); foreach (var kv in nodes) { var (x, y, z) = kv.Value; int np = power[kv.Key]; if (w.GetMeta(x, y, z) != np) { w.SetMeta(x, y, z, np, false); changed.Add((x, y, z)); } } foreach (var (x, y, z) in changed) { for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { int nx = x + Dir.X[f], ny = y + Dir.Y[f], nz = z + Dir.Z[f]; int id = w.GetBlock(nx, ny, nz); if (id == B.RedstoneWire) continue; w.NotifyBlock(nx, ny, nz, B.RedstoneWire); if (Block.Get(id).Opaque) w.NotifyNeighbors(nx, ny, nz, B.RedstoneWire, -1, true); } } } finally { _updatingWires = false; _ignoreWires = false; } } private static long Key(int x, int y, int z) => ((long)(x & 0x3FFFFFF) << 38) | ((long)(z & 0x3FFFFFF) << 12) | (uint)(y & 0xFFF); }

nodes.body_text: public static int StrongPowerInto(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z) { int max = 0; for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { int nx = x + Dir.X[f], ny = y + Dir.Y[f], nz = z + Dir.Z[f]; int id = w.GetBlock(nx, ny, nz); if (id == 0) continue; if (_ignoreWires && id == B.RedstoneWire) continue; var b = Block.ById[id]; // side = kierunek od sąsiada do nas int p = b.GetStrongPower(w, nx, ny, nz, w.GetMeta(nx, ny, nz), Dir.Opp[f]); if (p > max) { max = p; if (max >= 15) return 15; } } return max; }

nodes.name: PowerFromSide
nodes.signature: public static int PowerFromSide(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int f)
nodes.body_text: public static int PowerFromSide(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int f) { int nx = x + Dir.X[f], ny = y + Dir.Y[f], nz = z + Dir.Z[f]; int id = w.GetBlock(nx, ny, nz); if (id == 0) return 0; if (_ignoreWires && id == B.RedstoneWire) return 0; var b = Block.ById[id]; if (b.Opaque && !b.IsPowerSource) return StrongPowerInto(w, nx, ny, nz); return b.GetWeakPower(w, nx, ny, nz, w.GetMeta(nx, ny, nz), Dir.Opp[f]); }

nodes.signature: public static int InputPower(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int exceptFace = -1)

nodes.name: UpdateWireNetwork
nodes.signature: public static void UpdateWireNetwork(World w, int sx, int sy, int sz)
nodes.body_text: public static void UpdateWireNetwork(World w, int sx, int sy, int sz) { if (_updatingWires || w.IsRemote) return; _updatingWires = true; try { var nodes = new Dictionary<long, (int x, int y, int z)>(); var q = new Queue<(int, int, int)>(); q.Enqueue((sx, sy, sz)); nodes[Key(sx, sy, sz)] = (sx, sy, sz); while (q.Count > 0 && nodes.Count < 2048) { var (x, y, z) = q.Dequeue(); for (int h = 0; h < 4; h++) { if (WireConnects(w, x, y, z, h, out int ty)) { int nx = x + Dir.HorizX[h], nz = z + Dir.HorizZ[h]; if (w.GetBlock(nx, ty, nz) == B.RedstoneWire && !nodes.ContainsKey(Key(nx, ty, nz))) { nodes[Key(nx, ty, nz)] = (nx, ty, nz); q.Enqueue((nx, ty, nz)); } } } } // moc zewnętrzna var power = new Dictionary<long, int>(); _ignoreWires = true; var pq = new PriorityQueue<long, int>(); foreach (var kv in nodes) { var (x, y, z) = kv.Value; int p = 0; for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { int nx = x + Dir.X[f], ny = y + Dir.Y[f], nz = z + Dir.Z[f]; int id = w.GetBlock(nx, ny, nz); if (id == B.RedstoneWire || id == 0) continue; int pp = PowerFromSide(w, x, y, z, f); if (pp > p) p = pp; } power[kv.Key] = p; if (p > 0) pq.Enqueue(kv.Key, -p); } _ignoreWires = false; while (pq.TryDequeue(out long k, out int negP)) { int p = -negP; if (power[k] != p) continue; if (p <= 1) continue; var (x, y, z) = nodes[k]; for (int h = 0; h < 4; h++) { if (!WireConnects(w, x, y, z, h, out int ty)) continue; int nx = x + Dir.HorizX[h], nz = z + Dir.HorizZ[h]; long nk = Key(nx, ty, nz); if (!nodes.ContainsKey(nk)) continue; if (power[nk] < p - 1) { power[nk] = p - 1; pq.Enqueue(nk, -(p - 1)); } } } var changed = new List<(int, int, int)>(); foreach (var kv in nodes) { var (x, y, z) = kv.Value; int np = power[kv.Key]; if (w.GetMeta(x, y, z) != np) { w.SetMeta(x, y, z, np, false); changed.Add((x, y, z)); } } foreach (var (x, y, z) in changed) { for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { int nx = x + Dir.X[f], ny = y + Dir.Y[f], nz = z + Dir.Z[f]; int id = w.GetBlock(nx, ny, nz); if (id == B.RedstoneWire) continue; w.NotifyBlock(nx, ny, nz, B.RedstoneWire); if (Block.Get(id).Opaque) w.NotifyNeighbors(nx, ny, nz, B.RedstoneWire, -1, true); } } } finally { _updatingWires = false; _ignoreWires = false; } }

nodes.name: RedstoneWireBlock
nodes.signature: public class RedstoneWireBlock : Block
nodes.body_text: public class RedstoneWireBlock : Block { private readonly int _cross, _line; public RedstoneWireBlock(byte id, string k, string n) : base(id, k, n) { _cross = TextureGen.Layer("redstone_dust_cross"); _line = TextureGen.Layer("redstone_dust_line"); Tex = ModelBox.All(_cross); Opaque = false; Solid = false; FullCube = false; Render = RenderType.Wire; Layer = RenderLayer.Cutout; LightOpacity = 0; Hardness = 0; BlastResistance = 0; NeedsSupport = true; Tint = TintType.RedstoneWire; IsPowerSource = true; } public int CrossTex => _cross; public int LineTex => _line; public override bool CanPlaceAt(World w, int x, int y, int z) => TorchBlock.SolidTop(w, x, y - 1, z) || w.GetBlock(x, y - 1, z) == B.Glowstone; public override void GetSelectionBoxes(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<AABB> list) => list.Add(new AABB(0, 0, 0, 1, 1 / 16.0, 1)); public override int DropId(int meta, Rng r) => Items.I.Redstone; public override ItemStack PickStack(int meta) => new(Items.I.Redstone, 1); public override bool ConnectsToRedstone(int meta, int side) => true; public override void OnAdded(World w, int x, int y, int z) { Redstone.UpdateWireNetwork(w, x, y, z); Redstone.NotifyAround(w, x, y, z, Id); } public override void OnRemoved(World w, int x, int y, int z, int oldMeta) { for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { int nx = x + Dir.X[f], ny = y + Dir.Y[f], nz = z + Dir.Z[f]; if (w.GetBlock(nx, ny, nz) == B.RedstoneWire) Redstone.UpdateWireNetwork(w, nx, ny, nz); for (int h = 0; h < 4; h++) { int dx = nx + Dir.HorizX[h], dz = nz + Dir.HorizZ[h]; if (w.GetBlock(dx, ny, dz) == B.RedstoneWire) Redstone.UpdateWireNetwork(w, dx, ny, dz); } } Redstone.NotifyAround(w, x, y, z, Id); } public override void OnNeighborChanged(World w, int x, int y, int z, int nid) { if (!CanStay(w, x, y, z)) { w.BreakBlock(x, y, z, true); return; } Redstone.UpdateWireNetwork(w, x, y, z); } /// <summary>Maska połączeń: bit h = połączenie w kierunku h; zwraca też czy w górę.</summary> public static int Connections(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, out int upMask) { int mask = 0; upMask = 0; for (int h = 0; h < 4; h++) if (Redstone.WireConnects(w, x, y, z, h, out int ty)) { mask |= 1 << h; if (ty > y) upMask |= 1 << h; } return mask; } private static bool PointsTo(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int h) { int mask = Connections(w, x, y, z, out _); if (mask == 0) return true; // kropka – zasila wszystkie strony int opp = (h + 2) & 3; bool straight = (mask & ~((1 << h) | (1 << opp))) == 0; return (mask & (1 << h)) != 0 && straight || (mask == (1 << opp)); } public override int GetWeakPower(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, int side) { if (meta == 0) return 0; if (side == Dir.Down) return meta; if (side == Dir.Up) return 0; int h = Dir.FaceToHoriz(side); // przewód w kierunku h zasila jeśli tam jest komponent / blok int mask = Connections(w, x, y, z, out _); if ((mask & (1 << h)) != 0) return meta; return PointsTo(w, x, y, z, h) ? meta : 0; } public override int GetStrongPower(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, int side) { if (side == Dir.Up) return 0; if (side == Dir.Down) return meta; int h = Dir.FaceToHoriz(side); int nx = x + Dir.HorizX[h], nz = z + Dir.HorizZ[h]; if (!Block.Get(w.GetBlock(nx, y, nz)).Opaque) return 0; return PointsTo(w, x, y, z, h) ? meta : 0; } }

nodes.signature: public class RedstoneTorchBlock : TorchBlock
nodes.body_text: public class RedstoneTorchBlock : TorchBlock { public readonly bool On; public RedstoneTorchBlock(byte id, string k, string n, bool on) : base(id, k, n, on ? "redstone_torch_on" : "redstone_torch_off", on ? 7 : 0) { On = on; IsPowerSource = true; } public override int DropId(int meta, Rng r) => B.RedstoneTorch; public override ItemStack PickStack(int meta) => new(B.RedstoneTorch, 1); public static (int, int, int) Attached(int x, int y, int z, int meta) => meta switch { 1 => (x - 1, y, z), 2 => (x + 1, y, z), 3 => (x, y, z - 1), 4 => (x, y, z + 1), _ => (x, y - 1, z) }; private static int AttachedFace(int meta) => meta switch { 1 => Dir.West, 2 => Dir.East, 3 => Dir.North, 4 => Dir.South, _ => Dir.Down }; public override int GetWeakPower(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, int side) => On && side != AttachedFace(meta) ? 15 : 0; public override int GetStrongPower(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, int side) => On && side == Dir.Up ? 15 : 0; public override bool ConnectsToRedstone(int meta, int side) => true; private bool ShouldBeOff(World w, int x, int y, int z) { var (ax, ay, az) = Attached(x, y, z, w.GetMeta(x, y, z)); return Redstone.StrongPowerInto(w, ax, ay, az) > 0; } public override void OnAdded(World w, int x, int y, int z) { if (On) Redstone.NotifyAround(w, x, y, z, Id); w.ScheduleTick(x, y, z, Id, 2); } public override void OnRemoved(World w, int x, int y, int z, int oldMeta) { if (On) Redstone.NotifyAround(w, x, y, z, Id); } public override void OnNeighborChanged(World w, int x, int y, int z, int nid) { if (!CanStay(w, x, y, z)) { w.BreakBlock(x, y, z, true); return; } w.ScheduleTick(x, y, z, Id, 2); } public override void OnScheduledTick(World w, int x, int y, int z, Rng r) { bool off = ShouldBeOff(w, x, y, z); int meta = w.GetMeta(x, y, z); if (On && off) { w.SetBlock(x, y, z, B.RedstoneTorchOff, meta, false); Redstone.NotifyAround(w, x, y, z, Id); } else if (!On && !off) { w.SetBlock(x, y, z, B.RedstoneTorch, meta, false); Redstone.NotifyAround(w, x, y, z, Id); } } }

nodes.signature: public class LeverBlock : Block
nodes.body_text: public class LeverBlock : Block { public LeverBlock(byte id, string k, string n) : base(id, k, n) { T("lever"); Opaque = false; Solid = false; FullCube = false; Render = RenderType.Model; Layer = RenderLayer.Cutout; LightOpacity = 0; Hardness = 0.5f; BlastResistance = 0.5f; NeedsSupport = true; IsPowerSource = true; Sound = SoundType.Wood; } // meta: bity 0-2 = ściana do której przyczepiona (face id 0..5 bloku-nośnika względem dźwigni), bit 3 = włączona public static int AttachFace(int meta) => meta & 7; public override int GetPlacementMeta(World w, int x, int y, int z, int face, double hx, double hy, double hz, Player p, int itemMeta) { int attach = Dir.Opp[face]; if (Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x + Dir.X[attach], y + Dir.Y[attach], z + Dir.Z[attach])).Opaque) return attach; for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) if (Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x + Dir.X[f], y + Dir.Y[f], z + Dir.Z[f])).Opaque) return f; return 0; } public override bool CanPlaceAt(World w, int x, int y, int z) { for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) if (Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x + Dir.X[f], y + Dir.Y[f], z + Dir.Z[f])).Opaque) return true; return false; } public override bool CanStay(World w, int x, int y, int z) { int a = AttachFace(w.GetMeta(x, y, z)); return Block.Get(w.GetBlock(x + Dir.X[a], y + Dir.Y[a], z + Dir.Z[a])).Opaque; } public override bool OnActivated(World w, int x, int y, int z, Player p) { int m = w.GetMeta(x, y, z) ^ 8; w.SetMeta(x, y, z, m, false); w.PlaySound("click", x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5, 0.3f, (m & 8) != 0 ? 0.6f : 0.5f); Redstone.NotifyAround(w, x, y, z, Id); int a = AttachFace(m); Redstone.NotifyAround(w, x + Dir.X[a], y + Dir.Y[a], z + Dir.Z[a], Id); return true; } public override void OnRemoved(World w, int x, int y, int z, int oldMeta) { if ((oldMeta & 8) != 0) { Redstone.NotifyAround(w, x, y, z, Id); int a = AttachFace(oldMeta); Redstone.NotifyAround(w, x + Dir.X[a], y + Dir.Y[a], z + Dir.Z[a], Id); } } public override int GetWeakPower(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, int side) => (meta & 8) != 0 ? 15 : 0; public override int GetStrongPower(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, int side) => (meta & 8) != 0 && side == AttachFace(meta) ? 15 : 0; public override void GetSelectionBoxes(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<AABB> list) { var b = AttachBox(AttachFace(meta), 4, 3, 8); list.Add(new AABB(b.X0, b.Y0, b.Z0, b.X1, b.Y1, b.Z1).Grow(0.05)); } public static ModelBox AttachBox(int attach, float halfW, float halfH, float depth, int[] tex = null) { // box przylegający do ściany 'attach', wymiary w pikselach float c = 8, d = depth; return attach switch { Dir.Down => ModelBox.Px(c - halfW, 0, c - halfH, c + halfW, d / 2.67f, c + halfH, tex), Dir.Up => ModelBox.Px(c - halfW, 16 - d / 2.67f, c - halfH, c + halfW, 16, c + halfH, tex), Dir.North => ModelBox.Px(c - halfW, c - halfH, 0, c + halfW, c + halfH, d / 2.67f, tex), Dir.South => ModelBox.Px(c - halfW, c - halfH, 16 - d / 2.67f, c + halfW, c + halfH, 16, tex), Dir.West => ModelBox.Px(0, c - halfH, c - halfW, d / 2.67f, c + halfH, c + halfW, tex), _ => ModelBox.Px(16 - d / 2.67f, c - halfH, c - halfW, 16, c + halfH, c + halfW, tex), }; } public override void GetModel(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<ModelBox> boxes) { int a = AttachFace(meta); bool on = (meta & 8) != 0; int cob = TextureGen.Layer("cobblestone"); int stick = Tex[0]; boxes.Add(AttachBox(a, 4, 3, 8, ModelBox.All(cob))); // rączka: przesunięta w zależności od stanu float off = on ? 3 : -3; float ox = 0, oy = 0, oz = 0; float len = 8; ModelBox hb; switch (a) { case Dir.Down: hb = ModelBox.Px(7, 3, 7 + off, 9, 3 + len, 9 + off, ModelBox.All(stick)); break; case Dir.Up: hb = ModelBox.Px(7, 13 - len, 7 + off, 9, 13, 9 + off, ModelBox.All(stick)); break; case Dir.North: hb = ModelBox.Px(7, 7 + off, 3, 9, 9 + off, 3 + len, ModelBox.All(stick)); break; case Dir.South: hb = ModelBox.Px(7, 7 + off, 13 - len, 9, 9 + off, 13, ModelBox.All(stick)); break; case Dir.West: hb = ModelBox.Px(3, 7 + off, 7, 3 + len, 9 + off, 9, ModelBox.All(stick)); break; default: hb = ModelBox.Px(13 - len, 7 + off, 7, 13, 9 + off, 9, ModelBox.All(stick)); break; } hb.Uv = new float[24]; for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { hb.Uv[f * 4] = 7 / 16f; hb.Uv[f * 4 + 1] = 6 / 16f; hb.Uv[f * 4 + 2] = 9 / 16f; hb.Uv[f * 4 + 3] = 1; } boxes.Add(hb); } }

nodes.name: AttachBox
nodes.signature: public static ModelBox AttachBox(int attach, float halfW, float halfH, float depth, int[] tex = null)
nodes.body_text: public static ModelBox AttachBox(int attach, float halfW, float halfH, float depth, int[] tex = null) { // box przylegający do ściany 'attach', wymiary w pikselach float c = 8, d = depth; return attach switch { Dir.Down => ModelBox.Px(c - halfW, 0, c - halfH, c + halfW, d / 2.67f, c + halfH, tex), Dir.Up => ModelBox.Px(c - halfW, 16 - d / 2.67f, c - halfH, c + halfW, 16, c + halfH, tex), Dir.North => ModelBox.Px(c - halfW, c - halfH, 0, c + halfW, c + halfH, d / 2.67f, tex), Dir.South => ModelBox.Px(c - halfW, c - halfH, 16 - d / 2.67f, c + halfW, c + halfH, 16, tex), Dir.West => ModelBox.Px(0, c - halfH, c - halfW, d / 2.67f, c + halfH, c + halfW, tex), _ => ModelBox.Px(16 - d / 2.67f, c - halfH, c - halfW, 16, c + halfH, c + halfW, tex), }; }

nodes.signature: public override void GetModel(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<ModelBox> boxes)
nodes.body_text: public override void GetModel(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<ModelBox> boxes) { int a = AttachFace(meta); bool on = (meta & 8) != 0; int cob = TextureGen.Layer("cobblestone"); int stick = Tex[0]; boxes.Add(AttachBox(a, 4, 3, 8, ModelBox.All(cob))); // rączka: przesunięta w zależności od stanu float off = on ? 3 : -3; float ox = 0, oy = 0, oz = 0; float len = 8; ModelBox hb; switch (a) { case Dir.Down: hb = ModelBox.Px(7, 3, 7 + off, 9, 3 + len, 9 + off, ModelBox.All(stick)); break; case Dir.Up: hb = ModelBox.Px(7, 13 - len, 7 + off, 9, 13, 9 + off, ModelBox.All(stick)); break; case Dir.North: hb = ModelBox.Px(7, 7 + off, 3, 9, 9 + off, 3 + len, ModelBox.All(stick)); break; case Dir.South: hb = ModelBox.Px(7, 7 + off, 13 - len, 9, 9 + off, 13, ModelBox.All(stick)); break; case Dir.West: hb = ModelBox.Px(3, 7 + off, 7, 3 + len, 9 + off, 9, ModelBox.All(stick)); break; default: hb = ModelBox.Px(13 - len, 7 + off, 7, 13, 9 + off, 9, ModelBox.All(stick)); break; } hb.Uv = new float[24]; for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { hb.Uv[f * 4] = 7 / 16f; hb.Uv[f * 4 + 1] = 6 / 16f; hb.Uv[f * 4 + 2] = 9 / 16f; hb.Uv[f * 4 + 3] = 1; } boxes.Add(hb); }

nodes.name: RepeaterBlock
nodes.signature: public class RepeaterBlock : Block
nodes.body_text: public class RepeaterBlock : Block { private readonly bool _on; public RepeaterBlock(byte id, string k, string n, bool on) : base(id, k, n) { _on = on; T(on ? "repeater_on" : "repeater_off"); Opaque = false; FullCube = false; Render = RenderType.Model; Layer = RenderLayer.Cutout; LightOpacity = 0; Hardness = 0; BlastResistance = 0; IsPowerSource = true; NeedsSupport = true; Sound = SoundType.Wood; if (on) LightEmit = 0; } // meta: bity 0-1 kierunek WYJŚCIA (0=+Z,1=-X,2=-Z,3=+X), bity 2-3 opóźnienie (0..3) public override bool CanPlaceAt(World w, int x, int y, int z) => TorchBlock.SolidTop(w, x, y - 1, z); public override int GetPlacementMeta(World w, int x, int y, int z, int face, double hx, double hy, double hz, Player p, int itemMeta) => Dir.HorizFromYaw(p.Yaw); public override void GetCollisionBoxes(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<AABB> list) => list.Add(new AABB(0, 0, 0, 1, 0.125, 1)); public override int DropId(int meta, Rng r) => Items.I.RepeaterItem; public override ItemStack PickStack(int meta) => new(Items.I.RepeaterItem, 1); public override bool ConnectsToRedstone(int meta, int side) { int d = meta & 3; int outFace = Dir.HorizToFace(d); return side == outFace || side == Dir.Opp[outFace]; } public override int GetWeakPower(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, int side) => _on && side == Dir.HorizToFace(meta & 3) ? 15 : 0; public override int GetStrongPower(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, int side) => GetWeakPower(w, x, y, z, meta, side); private bool Input(World w, int x, int y, int z, int meta) { int inFace = Dir.Opp[Dir.HorizToFace(meta & 3)]; return Redstone.PowerFromSide(w, x, y, z, inFace) > 0; } public override void OnNeighborChanged(World w, int x, int y, int z, int nid) { if (!CanStay(w, x, y, z)) { w.BreakBlock(x, y, z, true); return; } int meta = w.GetMeta(x, y, z); bool inp = Input(w, x, y, z, meta); if (inp != _on) w.ScheduleTick(x, y, z, Id, ((meta >> 2) & 3) * 2 + 2); } public override void OnScheduledTick(World w, int x, int y, int z, Rng r) { int meta = w.GetMeta(x, y, z); bool inp = Input(w, x, y, z, meta); if (_on && !inp) Switch(w, x, y, z, B.Repeater, meta); else if (!_on) { Switch(w, x, y, z, B.RepeaterOn, meta); if (!inp) w.ScheduleTick(x, y, z, B.RepeaterOn, ((meta >> 2) & 3) * 2 + 2); } } private static void Switch(World w, int x, int y, int z, byte id, int meta) { w.SetBlock(x, y, z, id, meta, false); int f = Dir.HorizToFace(meta & 3); int fx = x + Dir.X[f], fz = z + Dir.Z[f]; w.NotifyBlock(fx, y, fz, id); Redstone.NotifyAround(w, fx, y, fz, id); } public override bool OnActivated(World w, int x, int y, int z, Player p) { int m = w.GetMeta(x, y, z); int d = ((m >> 2) + 1) & 3; w.SetMeta(x, y, z, (m & 3) | (d << 2), false); w.PlaySound("click", x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5, 0.3f, 0.55f); return true; } public override void OnRemoved(World w, int x, int y, int z, int oldMeta) { int f = Dir.HorizToFace(oldMeta & 3); Redstone.NotifyAround(w, x + Dir.X[f], y, z + Dir.Z[f], Id); } public override void GetModel(IBlockAccess w, int x, int y, int z, int meta, List<ModelBox> boxes) { int slabSide = TextureGen.Layer("stone_slab_top"); var t = new int[] { slabSide, Tex[1], slabSide, slabSide, slabSide, slabSide }; var b = ModelBox.Px(0, 0, 0, 16, 2, 16, t); b.UvRot = new int[6]; b.UvRot[1] = meta & 3; boxes.Add(b); int torch = TextureGen.Layer(_on ? "redstone_torch_on" : "redstone_torch_off"); int d = meta & 3; int delay = (meta >> 2) & 3; // pochodnie: przednia (stała) i tylna (ruchoma w zależności od opóźnienia) float[] posFront = { 0, 5 }; // przesunięcia wzdłuż osi od środka w pikselach void Torch(float along) { float cx = 8 + Dir.HorizX[d] * along, cz = 8 + Dir.HorizZ[d] * along; var tb = ModelBox.Px(cx - 1, 2, cz - 1, cx + 1, 7, cz + 1, ModelBox.All(torch)); tb.Uv = new float[24]; for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { tb.Uv[f * 4] = 7 / 16f; tb.Uv[f * 4 + 1] = 6 / 16f; tb.Uv[f * 4 + 2] = 9 / 16f; tb.Uv[f * 4 + 3] = 11 / 16f; } tb.Uv[4] = 7 / 16f; tb.Uv[5] = 6 / 16f; tb.Uv[6] = 9 / 16f; tb.Uv[7] = 8 / 16f; boxes.Add(tb); } Torch(5); Torch(-1 - delay * 2); } }

nodes.body_text: public sealed class WorldStorage { public readonly string Dir; public static string Root { get { var d = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.ApplicationData), ".blockcraft"); Directory.CreateDirectory(d); return d; } } public static string SavesRoot { get { var d = Path.Combine(Root, "saves"); Directory.CreateDirectory(d); return d; } } public WorldStorage(string dir) { Dir = dir; Directory.CreateDirectory(dir); Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(dir, "chunks")); Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(dir, "players")); } private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions JsonOpts = new() { WriteIndented = true }; public static string SafeFolderName(string name) { var invalid = Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars(); var s = new string(name.Select(c => invalid.Contains(c) ? '_' : c).ToArray()).Trim(); if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s)) s = "Swiat"; string baseS = s; int i = 1; while (Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(SavesRoot, s))) s = baseS + " (" + (++i) + ")"; return s; } public void SaveLevel(LevelData d) { d.LastPlayed = DateTime.Now; var tmp = Path.Combine(Dir, "level.json.tmp"); File.WriteAllText(tmp, JsonSerializer.Serialize(d, JsonOpts)); File.Move(tmp, Path.Combine(Dir, "level.json"), true); } public static LevelData LoadLevel(string dir) { var p = Path.Combine(dir, "level.json"); if (!File.Exists(p)) return null; try { return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<LevelData>(File.ReadAllText(p)); } catch (Exception ex) { Log.Error("level.json: " + ex.Message); return null; } } public void SavePlayer(PlayerData d) { File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(Dir, "players", SafeName(d.Name) + ".json"), JsonSerializer.Serialize(d, JsonOpts)); } public PlayerData LoadPlayer(string name) { var p = Path.Combine(Dir, "players", SafeName(name) + ".json"); if (!File.Exists(p)) return null; try { return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<PlayerData>(File.ReadAllText(p)); } catch { return null; } } private static string SafeName(string n) => new string(n.Where(char.IsLetterOrDigit).ToArray()); public static List<(string dir, LevelData data)> ListWorlds() { var res = new List<(string, LevelData)>(); foreach (var d in Directory.GetDirectories(SavesRoot)) { var ld = LoadLevel(d); if (ld != null) res.Add((d, ld)); } return res.OrderByDescending(x => x.Item2.LastPlayed).ToList(); } private string ChunkPath(int cx, int cz) => Path.Combine(Dir, "chunks", $"c.{cx}.{cz}.dat"); public void SaveChunk(Chunk c, byte[] entityData) { var path = ChunkPath(c.Cx, c.Cz); using var ms = new MemoryStream(); using (var ds = new DeflateStream(ms, CompressionLevel.Fastest, true)) using (var bw = new BinaryWriter(ds)) { bw.Write(2); // wersja bw.Write(c.Blocks); bw.Write(c.Meta); bw.Write(c.Biomes); bw.Write(c.Populated); bw.Write(c.TileEntities.Count); foreach (var te in c.TileEntities.Values.ToArray()) { bw.Write(te.TypeId); bw.Write(te.X); bw.Write(te.Y); bw.Write(te.Z); te.Save(bw); } if (entityData != null) { bw.Write(entityData.Length); bw.Write(entityData); } else bw.Write(0); } var tmp = path + ".tmp"; File.WriteAllBytes(tmp, ms.ToArray()); File.Move(tmp, path, true); c.Modified = false; } public Chunk LoadChunk(int cx, int cz) { var path = ChunkPath(cx, cz); if (!File.Exists(path)) return null; try { using var fs = File.OpenRead(path); using var ds = new DeflateStream(fs, CompressionMode.Decompress); using var br = new BinaryReader(ds); int ver = br.ReadInt32(); var c = new Chunk(cx, cz); Chunk.Volume.ReadFully(br, c.Blocks); Chunk.Volume.ReadFully(br, c.Meta); 256.ReadFully(br, c.Biomes); c.Populated = br.ReadBoolean(); int nte = br.ReadInt32(); for (int i = 0; i < nte; i++) { int type = br.ReadInt32(); int x = br.ReadInt32(), y = br.ReadInt32(), z = br.ReadInt32(); var te = TileEntity.Create(type); te.Load(br); te.X = x; te.Y = y; te.Z = z; c.TileEntities[Chunk.Index(x & 15, y, z & 15)] = te; } int elen = br.ReadInt32(); if (elen > 0) c.PendingEntityData = br.ReadBytes(elen); c.RecountSections(); c.RecalcHeightMap(); c.FromDisk = true; return c; } catch (Exception ex) { Log.Error($"Load chunk {cx},{cz}: {ex.Message}"); return null; } } }

nodes.body_text: public static class StreamExt { /// <summary>Czyta dokładnie n bajtów do bufora (DeflateStream może zwracać mniej).</summary> public static int ReadFully(this int n, BinaryReader br, byte[] buf) { int off = 0; while (off < n) { int r = br.Read(buf, off, n - off); if (r <= 0) throw new EndOfStreamException(); off += r; } return 0; } public static void WriteStack(this BinaryWriter bw, ItemStack s) { if (s == null) { bw.Write((short)-1); return; } bw.Write((short)s.Id); bw.Write((byte)s.Count); bw.Write((short)s.Damage); } public static ItemStack ReadStack(this BinaryReader br) { short id = br.ReadInt16(); if (id < 0) return null; int count = br.ReadByte(); int dmg = br.ReadInt16(); if (Item.ById[id] == null) return null; return new ItemStack(id, count, dmg); } }

nodes.body_text: public sealed partial class World : IBlockAccess { public readonly long Seed; public readonly WorldType Type; public readonly WorldGenerator Generator; public readonly bool IsRemote; public readonly ConcurrentDictionary<long, Chunk> Chunks = new(); public readonly LightEngine Light; public readonly Rng Rand = new(Environment.TickCount64); public readonly List<IWorldListener> Listeners = new(); public readonly GameRules Rules = new(); public Difficulty Difficulty = Difficulty.Normal; public long TotalTime; public long DayTime = 1000; public int SpawnX, SpawnY = 80, SpawnZ; public string Name = "Świat"; public bool AllowCheats = true; public bool Hardcore; public readonly List<Entity> Entities = new(); public readonly Dictionary<int, Entity> EntityById = new(); public readonly List<Player> Players = new(); private readonly List<Entity> _toAdd = new(); private int _nextEntityId = 1; public ChunkManager ChunkManager; public WorldStorage Storage; public MobSpawner Spawner; public World(long seed, WorldType type, bool remote) { Seed = seed; Type = type; IsRemote = remote; Generator = new WorldGenerator(seed, type); Light = new LightEngine(this); Spawner = new MobSpawner(this); } // ---------- dostęp do chunków ---------- public Chunk GetChunk(int cx, int cz) => Chunks.TryGetValue(MathUtil.ChunkKey(cx, cz), out var c) ? c : null; public Chunk GetChunkIfLit(int cx, int cz) => Chunks.TryGetValue(MathUtil.ChunkKey(cx, cz), out var c) && c.Lit ? c : null; public bool IsChunkLoaded(int cx, int cz) => Chunks.ContainsKey(MathUtil.ChunkKey(cx, cz)); public bool IsLoadedAt(int x, int z) => IsChunkLoaded(x >> 4, z >> 4); public bool IsAreaLoaded(int x, int z, int r) { for (int cx = (x - r) >> 4; cx <= (x + r) >> 4; cx++) for (int cz = (z - r) >> 4; cz <= (z + r) >> 4; cz++) if (!IsChunkLoaded(cx, cz)) return false; return true; } public byte GetBlock(int x, int y, int z) { if ((uint)y >= Chunk.Height) return 0; if (!Chunks.TryGetValue(MathUtil.ChunkKey(x >> 4, z >> 4), out var c)) return 0; return c.Blocks[(y << 8) | ((z & 15) << 4) | (x & 15)]; } public int GetMeta(int x, int y, int z) { if ((uint)y >= Chunk.Height) return 0; if (!Chunks.TryGetValue(MathUtil.ChunkKey(x >> 4, z >> 4), out var c)) return 0; return c.Meta[(y << 8) | ((z & 15) << 4) | (x & 15)]; } public int GetSkyLight(int x, int y, int z) { if (y >= Chunk.Height) return 15; if (y < 0) return 0; var c = GetChunk(x >> 4, z >> 4); if (c == null) return 15; return c.Light[Chunk.Index(x & 15, y, z & 15)] >> 4; } public int GetBlockLight(int x, int y, int z) { if ((uint)y >= Chunk.Height) return 0; var c = GetChunk(x >> 4, z >> 4); if (c == null) return 0; return c.Light[Chunk.Index(x & 15, y, z & 15)] & 15; } /// <summary>Surowe światło (max nieba i bloku, bez uwzględnienia pory dnia).</summary> public int GetRawLight(int x, int y, int z) => Math.Max(GetSkyLight(x, y, z), GetBlockLight(x, y, z)); /// <summary>Światło z uwzględnieniem pory dnia (jak MC getLightFromNeighbors).</summary> public int GetLight(int x, int y, int z) => Math.Max(GetSkyLight(x, y, z) - SkyLightSubtracted, GetBlockLight(x, y, z)); public int GetHeight(int x, int z) { var c = GetChunk(x >> 4, z >> 4); return c?.GetHeight(x & 15, z & 15) ?? 0; } public bool CanSeeSky(int x, int y, int z) => y >= GetHeight(x, z); public byte GetBiome(int x, int z) { var c = GetChunk(x >> 4, z >> 4); return c?.Biomes[((z & 15) << 4) | (x & 15)] ?? Generator.BiomeAt(x, z); } // ---------- modyfikacja ---------- private int _notifyDepth; public bool SetBlock(int x, int y, int z, byte id, int meta = 0, bool notify = true) { if ((uint)y >= Chunk.Height) return false; var c = GetChunk(x >> 4, z >> 4); if (c == null) return false; int lx = x & 15, lz = z & 15; int i = Chunk.Index(lx, y, lz); byte old = c.Blocks[i]; int oldMeta = c.Meta[i]; if (old == id && oldMeta == meta) return false; var ob = Block.ById[old]; var nb = Block.ById[id]; c.SetBlockRaw(lx, y, lz, id, meta); c.Modified = true; if (ob.LightOpacity != nb.LightOpacity) { int h = c.GetHeight(lx, lz); if (nb.LightOpacity > 0 && y >= h) c.HeightMap[(lz << 4) | lx] = (byte)(y + 1); else if (nb.LightOpacity == 0 && y == h - 1) c.RecalcHeight(lx, lz); } Light.OnBlockChanged(x, y, z, ob, nb); MarkDirty(x, y, z); foreach (var l in Listeners) l.OnBlockChanged(x, y, z, id, meta); if (!IsRemote) { if (old != id) { ob.OnRemoved(this, x, y, z, oldMeta); if (GetBlock(x, y, z) == id) nb.OnAdded(this, x, y, z); } if (notify) NotifyNeighbors(x, y, z, id); } return true; } public void SetMeta(int x, int y, int z, int meta, bool notify = true) { if ((uint)y >= Chunk.Height) return; var c = GetChunk(x >> 4, z >> 4); if (c == null) return; int i = Chunk.Index(x & 15, y, z & 15); if (c.Meta[i] == meta) return; c.Meta[i] = (byte)meta; c.Modified = true; MarkDirty(x, y, z); foreach (var l in Listeners) l.OnBlockChanged(x, y, z, c.Blocks[i], meta); if (notify && !IsRemote) NotifyNeighbors(x, y, z, c.Blocks[i]); } /// <summary>Ustawienie bez logiki (sieć – klient).</summary> public

nodes.name: SetBlock
nodes.signature: public bool SetBlock(int x, int y, int z, byte id, int meta = 0, bool notify = true)
nodes.body_text: public bool SetBlock(int x, int y, int z, byte id, int meta = 0, bool notify = true) { if ((uint)y >= Chunk.Height) return false; var c = GetChunk(x >> 4, z >> 4); if (c == null) return false; int lx = x & 15, lz = z & 15; int i = Chunk.Index(lx, y, lz); byte old = c.Blocks[i]; int oldMeta = c.Meta[i]; if (old == id && oldMeta == meta) return false; var ob = Block.ById[old]; var nb = Block.ById[id]; c.SetBlockRaw(lx, y, lz, id, meta); c.Modified = true; if (ob.LightOpacity != nb.LightOpacity) { int h = c.GetHeight(lx, lz); if (nb.LightOpacity > 0 && y >= h) c.HeightMap[(lz << 4) | lx] = (byte)(y + 1); else if (nb.LightOpacity == 0 && y == h - 1) c.RecalcHeight(lx, lz); } Light.OnBlockChanged(x, y, z, ob, nb); MarkDirty(x, y, z); foreach (var l in Listeners) l.OnBlockChanged(x, y, z, id, meta); if (!IsRemote) { if (old != id) { ob.OnRemoved(this, x, y, z, oldMeta); if (GetBlock(x, y, z) == id) nb.OnAdded(this, x, y, z); } if (notify) NotifyNeighbors(x, y, z, id); } return true; }

nodes.name: SetMeta
nodes.signature: public void SetMeta(int x, int y, int z, int meta, bool notify = true)
nodes.body_text: public void SetMeta(int x, int y, int z, int meta, bool notify = true) { if ((uint)y >= Chunk.Height) return; var c = GetChunk(x >> 4, z >> 4); if (c == null) return; int i = Chunk.Index(x & 15, y, z & 15); if (c.Meta[i] == meta) return; c.Meta[i] = (byte)meta; c.Modified = true; MarkDirty(x, y, z); foreach (var l in Listeners) l.OnBlockChanged(x, y, z, c.Blocks[i], meta); if (notify && !IsRemote) NotifyNeighbors(x, y, z, c.Blocks[i]); }

nodes.name: SetBlockRemote
nodes.signature: public void SetBlockRemote(int x, int y, int z, byte id, int meta)
nodes.body_text: public void SetBlockRemote(int x, int y, int z, byte id, int meta) { if ((uint)y >= Chunk.Height) return; var c = GetChunk(x >> 4, z >> 4); if (c == null) return; int lx = x & 15, lz = z & 15, i = Chunk.Index(lx, y, lz); byte old = c.Blocks[i]; if (old == id && c.Meta[i] == meta) return; var ob = Block.ById[old]; var nb = Block.ById[id]; c.SetBlockRaw(lx, y, lz, id, meta); if (ob.LightOpacity != nb.LightOpacity) c.RecalcHeight(lx, lz); Light.OnBlockChanged(x, y, z, ob, nb); if (old != id && ob.HasTileEntity && !nb.HasTileEntity) RemoveTileEntity(x, y, z); if (nb.HasTileEntity && GetTileEntity(x, y, z) == null) nb.OnAdded(this, x, y, z); MarkDirty(x, y, z); }

nodes.name: NotifyNeighbors
nodes.signature: public void NotifyNeighbors(int x, int y, int z, int sourceId, int exceptFace = -1, bool skipWires = false)
nodes.body_text: public void NotifyNeighbors(int x, int y, int z, int sourceId, int exceptFace = -1, bool skipWires = false) { if (IsRemote) return; for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { if (f == exceptFace) continue; int nx = x + Dir.X[f], ny = y + Dir.Y[f], nz = z + Dir.Z[f]; if (skipWires && GetBlock(nx, ny, nz) == B.RedstoneWire) continue; NotifyBlock(nx, ny, nz, sourceId); } }

nodes.name: NotifyBlock
nodes.signature: public void NotifyBlock(int x, int y, int z, int sourceId)
nodes.body_text: public void NotifyBlock(int x, int y, int z, int sourceId) { if (IsRemote || (uint)y >= Chunk.Height) return; int id = GetBlock(x, y, z); if (id == 0) return; if (_notifyDepth > 64) { ScheduleTick(x, y, z, (byte)id, 1, true); return; } _notifyDepth++; try { Block.ById[id].OnNeighborChanged(this, x, y, z, sourceId); } finally { _notifyDepth--; } }

nodes.name: BreakBlock
nodes.signature: public void BreakBlock(int x, int y, int z, bool drop, Player player = null, ItemStack tool = null)
nodes.body_text: public void BreakBlock(int x, int y, int z, bool drop, Player player = null, ItemStack tool = null) { byte id = GetBlock(x, y, z); if (id == 0) return; int meta = GetMeta(x, y, z); var b = Block.ById[id]; PlayEffectBreak(x, y, z, id, meta); if (drop && !IsRemote && !b.IsLiquid) { var list = new List<ItemStack>(); b.GetDrops(this, x, y, z, meta, Rand, tool, list); foreach (var s in list) if (s != null && s.Count > 0) DropItem(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5, s, true); } SetBlock(x, y, z, B.Air); }

nodes.body_text: public void PlayEffectBreak(int x, int y, int z, int id, int meta) { var b = Block.ById[id]; SpawnParticles(ParticleKind.BlockBreak, x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5, 1, id | (meta << 8)); PlaySound("dig_" + b.Sound.ToString().ToLowerInvariant(), x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5, 1f, 0.8f); }

nodes.name: MarkDirty
nodes.signature: public void MarkDirty(int x, int y, int z)
nodes.body_text: public void MarkDirty(int x, int y, int z) { int sx0 = (x - 1) >> 4, sx1 = (x + 1) >> 4, sz0 = (z - 1) >> 4, sz1 = (z + 1) >> 4; int sy0 = Math.Max(0, (y - 1) >> 4), sy1 = Math.Min(Chunk.Sections - 1, (y + 1) >> 4); for (int cx = sx0; cx <= sx1; cx++) for (int cz = sz0; cz <= sz1; cz++) { var c = GetChunk(cx, cz); if (c == null) continue; for (int sy = sy0; sy <= sy1; sy++) c.DirtySections |= 1 << sy; } }

nodes.name: MarkLightDirty
nodes.signature: public void MarkLightDirty(Chunk c, int x, int y, int z)
nodes.body_text: public void MarkLightDirty(Chunk c, int x, int y, int z) { int lx = x & 15, lz = z & 15, ly = y & 15; int sy = y >> 4; c.DirtySections |= 1 << sy; if (ly == 0 && sy > 0) c.DirtySections |= 1 << (sy - 1); if (ly == 15 && sy < Chunk.Sections - 1) c.DirtySections |= 1 << (sy + 1); if (lx == 0 || lx == 15 || lz == 0 || lz == 15) MarkDirty(x, y, z); }

nodes.name: ScheduleTick
nodes.signature: public void ScheduleTick(int x, int y, int z, byte id, int delay, bool force = false)
nodes.body_text: public void ScheduleTick(int x, int y, int z, byte id, int delay, bool force = false) { if (IsRemote) return; var key = (x, y, z, id); if (!force && _tickSet.Contains(key)) return; _tickSet.Add(key); _ticks.Enqueue((x, y, z, id), TotalTime + Math.Max(1, delay)); }

nodes.name: ProcessScheduledTicks
nodes.signature: private void ProcessScheduledTicks()
nodes.body_text: private void ProcessScheduledTicks() { int n = 0; while (n < 2000 && _ticks.TryPeek(out var t, out long due) && due <= TotalTime) { _ticks.Dequeue(); n++; _tickSet.Remove(t); if (!IsLoadedAt(t.x, t.z)) continue; if (GetBlock(t.x, t.y, t.z) != t.id) continue; Block.ById[t.id].OnScheduledTick(this, t.x, t.y, t.z, Rand); } }

nodes.name: PendingTicksSnapshot
nodes.signature: public List<(int x, int y, int z, byte id, long due)> PendingTicksSnapshot()
nodes.body_text: public List<(int x, int y, int z, byte id, long due)> PendingTicksSnapshot() { var l = new List<(int, int, int, byte, long)>(); foreach (var (e, p) in _ticks.UnorderedItems) l.Add((e.x, e.y, e.z, e.id, p - TotalTime)); return l; }

nodes.name: CelestialAngle
nodes.signature: public float CelestialAngle(float partial)
nodes.body_text: public float CelestialAngle(float partial) { int j = (int)(DayTime % 24000L); float f = (j + partial) / 24000f - 0.25f; if (f < 0) f += 1; if (f > 1) f -= 1; float f1 = f; f = 1f - (float)((Math.Cos(f * Math.PI) + 1.0) / 2.0); return f1 + (f - f1) / 3f; }

nodes.name: SkyDarken
nodes.signature: public float SkyDarken(float partial)
nodes.body_text: public float SkyDarken(float partial) { float a = CelestialAngle(partial); float f = 1f - (MathF.Cos(a * MathF.PI * 2f) * 2f + 0.5f); return Math.Clamp(f, 0f, 1f) * 11f; }

nodes.body_text: public int SkyLightSubtracted => (int)SkyDarken(0);

nodes.name: FlushAdds
nodes.signature: private void FlushAdds()
nodes.body_text: private void FlushAdds() { if (_toAdd.Count == 0) return; var list = _toAdd.ToArray(); _toAdd.Clear(); foreach (var e in list) { if (EntityById.ContainsKey(e.Id)) continue; Entities.Add(e); EntityById[e.Id] = e; if (e is Player p && !Players.Contains(p)) Players.Add(p); foreach (var l in Listeners) l.OnEntityAdded(e); } }

nodes.signature: public void AddEntityNow(Entity e) { SpawnEntity(e); FlushAdds(); }
nodes.body_text: public void AddEntityNow(Entity e) { SpawnEntity(e); FlushAdds(); }

nodes.signature: public void RemoveEntity(Entity e)
nodes.body_text: public void RemoveEntity(Entity e) { e.Removed = true; if (Entities.Remove(e)) { EntityById.Remove(e.Id); if (e is Player p) Players.Remove(p); foreach (var l in Listeners) l.OnEntityRemoved(e); } }

nodes.name: GetEntitiesInBox
nodes.signature: public List<Entity> GetEntitiesInBox(AABB box, Entity except = null)
nodes.body_text: public List<Entity> GetEntitiesInBox(AABB box, Entity except = null) { var res = new List<Entity>(); foreach (var e in Entities) if (e != except && !e.Removed && e.BoundingBox.Intersects(box)) res.Add(e); return res; }

nodes.name: DropItem
nodes.signature: public void DropItem(double x, double y, double z, ItemStack s, bool scatter = true)
nodes.body_text: public void DropItem(double x, double y, double z, ItemStack s, bool scatter = true) { if (IsRemote || s == null || s.Count <= 0) return; var e = new ItemEntity(this, x, y, z, s.Copy()); if (scatter) { e.MotionX = Rand.NextDouble() * 0.2 - 0.1; e.MotionY = 0.2; e.MotionZ = Rand.NextDouble() * 0.2 - 0.1; e.X += Rand.NextDouble() * 0.5 - 0.25; e.Z += Rand.NextDouble() * 0.5 - 0.25; e.Y -= 0.125; } e.PickupDelay = 10; SpawnEntity(e); }

nodes.name: SpawnXp
nodes.signature: public void SpawnXp(double x, double y, double z, int amount)
nodes.body_text: public void SpawnXp(double x, double y, double z, int amount) { if (IsRemote) return; while (amount > 0) { int v = amount >= 17 ? 17 : amount >= 7 ? 7 : amount >= 3 ? 3 : 1; amount -= v; var o = new XpOrbEntity(this, x, y, z, v); o.MotionX = Rand.NextDouble() * 0.2 - 0.1; o.MotionY = Rand.NextDouble() * 0.2; o.MotionZ = Rand.NextDouble() * 0.2 - 0.1; SpawnEntity(o); } }

nodes.signature: public bool HasMonstersNear(int x, int y, int z, double r)
nodes.body_text: public bool HasMonstersNear(int x, int y, int z, double r) { foreach (var e in Entities) if (e is Monster && Math.Abs(e.X - x) < r && Math.Abs(e.Y - y) < 5 && Math.Abs(e.Z - z) < r) return true; return false; }

nodes.name: Tick
nodes.signature: public void Tick()
nodes.body_text: public void Tick() { TotalTime++; if (Rules.DoDaylightCycle) DayTime++; FlushAdds(); if (!IsRemote) { ProcessScheduledTicks(); RandomTicks(); TickTileEntities(); if (Rules.DoMobSpawning) Spawner.Tick(); CheckSleeping(); } for (int i = 0; i < Entities.Count; i++) { var e = Entities[i]; if (e.Removed) continue; if (!IsLoadedAt(MathUtil.FloorToInt(e.X), MathUtil.FloorToInt(e.Z)) && e is not Player) continue; e.PrevTick(); e.Tick(); } for (int i = Entities.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--) { var e = Entities[i]; if (e.Removed || (e.Dead && e is not Player)) { Entities.RemoveAt(i); EntityById.Remove(e.Id); if (e is Player p) Players.Remove(p); e.Removed = true; foreach (var l in Listeners) l.OnEntityRemoved(e); } } FlushAdds(); }

nodes.name: CheckSleeping
nodes.signature: private void CheckSleeping()
nodes.body_text: private void CheckSleeping() { if (Players.Count == 0) return; bool all = true; foreach (var p in Players) if (!p.Sleeping || p.SleepTimer < 100) all = false; if (all) { DayTime = (DayTime / 24000 + 1) * 24000; foreach (var p in Players) p.WakeUp(); } }

nodes.name: RandomTicks
nodes.signature: private void RandomTicks()
nodes.body_text: private void RandomTicks() { foreach (var c in Chunks.Values) { if (!c.Merged) continue; bool near = false; foreach (var p in Players) { int pcx = MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.X) >> 4, pcz = MathUtil.FloorToInt(p.Z) >> 4; if (Math.Abs(pcx - c.Cx) <= 7 && Math.Abs(pcz - c.Cz) <= 7) { near = true; break; } } if (!near) continue; for (int s = 0; s < Chunk.Sections; s++) { if (c.SectionCounts[s] == 0) continue; for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) { int r = Rand.Next(4096); int lx = r & 15, lz = (r >> 4) & 15, ly = (r >> 8) + s * 16; byte id = c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, ly, lz)]; var b = Block.ById[id]; if (b.RandomTicks) b.OnRandomTick(this, c.Cx * 16 + lx, ly, c.Cz * 16 + lz, Rand); } } } }

nodes.name: TickTileEntities
nodes.signature: private void TickTileEntities()
nodes.body_text: private void TickTileEntities() { _teTmp.Clear(); foreach (var c in Chunks.Values) foreach (var te in c.TileEntities.Values) if (te is FurnaceTileEntity) _teTmp.Add(te); foreach (var te in _teTmp) te.Tick(this); }

nodes.body_text: public List<AABB> GetCollisionBoxes(AABB box, List<AABB> res) { res.Clear(); int x0 = MathUtil.FloorToInt(box.MinX), x1 = MathUtil.FloorToInt(box.MaxX); int y0 = MathUtil.FloorToInt(box.MinY) - 1, y1 = MathUtil.FloorToInt(box.MaxY); int z0 = MathUtil.FloorToInt(box.MinZ), z1 = MathUtil.FloorToInt(box.MaxZ); for (int x = x0; x <= x1; x++) for (int z = z0; z <= z1; z++) { if (!IsLoadedAt(x, z)) { res.Add(new AABB(x, -64, z, x + 1, 256, z + 1)); continue; } for (int y = y0; y <= y1; y++) { if (y < 0) { continue; } if (y >= Chunk.Height) continue; byte id = GetBlock(x, y, z); if (id == 0) continue; var b = Block.ById[id]; if (!b.Solid) continue; _boxTmp.Clear(); b.GetCollisionBoxes(this, x, y, z, GetMeta(x, y, z), _boxTmp); foreach (var bb in _boxTmp) { var wb = bb.Offset(x, y, z); if (wb.Intersects(box)) res.Add(wb); } } } return res; }

B.Lava : B.Water)) { double top = y + FluidBlock.HeightOf(GetMeta(x, y, z)); if (box.MinY < top) return true; } } return false; }

nodes.name: RayCast
nodes.signature: public HitResult RayCast(double ox, double oy, double oz, double dx, double dy, double dz, double maxDist, bool hitLiquids = false)
nodes.body_text: public HitResult RayCast(double ox, double oy, double oz, double dx, double dy, double dz, double maxDist, bool hitLiquids = false) { var res = new HitResult(); int x = MathUtil.FloorToInt(ox), y = MathUtil.FloorToInt(oy), z = MathUtil.FloorToInt(oz); int stepX = Math.Sign(dx), stepY = Math.Sign(dy), stepZ = Math.Sign(dz); double tMaxX = dx != 0 ? ((stepX > 0 ? x + 1 - ox : ox - x) / Math.Abs(dx)) : double.MaxValue; double tMaxY = dy != 0 ? ((stepY > 0 ? y + 1 - oy : oy - y) / Math.Abs(dy)) : double.MaxValue; double tMaxZ = dz != 0 ? ((stepZ > 0 ? z + 1 - oz : oz - z) / Math.Abs(dz)) : double.MaxValue; double tdX = dx != 0 ? 1 / Math.Abs(dx) : double.MaxValue, tdY = dy != 0 ? 1 / Math.Abs(dy) : double.MaxValue, tdZ = dz != 0 ? 1 / Math.Abs(dz) : double.MaxValue; var boxes = new List<AABB>(); for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++) { if (y >= 0 && y < Chunk.Height) { byte id = GetBlock(x, y, z); if (id != 0) { var b = Block.ById[id]; boxes.Clear(); int meta = GetMeta(x, y, z); if (b.IsLiquid) { if (hitLiquids && meta == 0) boxes.Add(new AABB(0, 0, 0, 1, FluidBlock.HeightOf(meta), 1)); } else b.GetSelectionBoxes(this, x, y, z, meta, boxes); double best = double.MaxValue; int bf = -1; foreach (var bb in boxes) { if (bb.Offset(x, y, z).RayIntersect(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, out double t, out int f) && t < best && f >= 0) { best = t; bf = f; } } if (bf >= 0 && best <= maxDist) { res.Hit = true; res.X = x; res.Y = y; res.Z = z; res.Face = bf; res.Distance = best; res.HitX = ox + dx * best; res.HitY = oy + dy * best; res.HitZ = oz + dz * best; return res; } } } double tNext = Math.Min(tMaxX, Math.Min(tMaxY, tMaxZ)); if (tNext > maxDist) break; if (tMaxX < tMaxY && tMaxX < tMaxZ) { x += stepX; tMaxX += tdX; } else if (tMaxY < tMaxZ) { y += stepY; tMaxY += tdY; } else { z += stepZ; tMaxZ += tdZ; } } return res; }

nodes.name: TreeGen
nodes.signature: public static class TreeGen
nodes.body_text: public static class TreeGen { private static bool CanReplace(int id) => id == B.Air || id == B.OakLeaves || id == B.BirchLeaves || id == B.TallGrass || id == B.Dandelion || id == B.Poppy || id == B.OakSapling || id == B.BirchSapling || id == B.Snow; /// <summary>type: 0 = dąb, 1 = brzoza, 2 = duży dąb. Zwraca false gdy brak miejsca.</summary> public static bool Generate(ITreeWriter w, int x, int y, int z, int type, Rng r, bool worldGen) { if (type == 0 && r.Next(10) == 0 && worldGen) type = 2; int ground = w.Get(x, y - 1, z); if (ground != B.Grass && ground != B.Dirt) return false; if (type == 2) return BigOak(w, x, y, z, r, worldGen); int height = type == 1 ? r.Next(3) + 5 : r.Next(3) + 4; if (y + height + 1 >= Chunk.Height) return false; if (!worldGen) { for (int yy = y; yy <= y + height + 1; yy++) { int rad = yy == y ? 0 : yy >= y + height - 1 ? 2 : 1; for (int dx = -rad; dx <= rad; dx++) for (int dz = -rad; dz <= rad; dz++) if (!CanReplace(w.Get(x + dx, yy, z + dz)) && !(dx == 0 && dz == 0 && yy == y)) return false; } } byte log = type == 1 ? B.BirchLog : B.OakLog; byte leaves = type == 1 ? B.BirchLeaves : B.OakLeaves; w.Set(x, y - 1, z, B.Dirt, 0); for (int yy = y + height - 3; yy <= y + height; yy++) { int dy = yy - (y + height); int rad = 1 - dy / 2; for (int dx = -rad; dx <= rad; dx++) for (int dz = -rad; dz <= rad; dz++) { if (Math.Abs(dx) == rad && Math.Abs(dz) == rad && (r.Next(2) == 0 || dy == 0)) continue; if (CanReplace(w.Get(x + dx, yy, z + dz)) && w.Get(x + dx, yy, z + dz) == B.Air || w.Get(x + dx, yy, z + dz) == B.TallGrass) w.Set(x + dx, yy, z + dz, leaves, 0); } } for (int i = 0; i < height; i++) { int id = w.Get(x, y + i, z); if (CanReplace(id) || i == 0) w.Set(x, y + i, z, log, 0); } return true; } private static bool BigOak(ITreeWriter w, int x, int y, int z, Rng r, bool worldGen) { int height = r.Next(5) + 8; if (y + height + 4 >= Chunk.Height) return false; if (!worldGen) for (int yy = y + 1; yy < y + height; yy++) if (!CanReplace(w.Get(x, yy, z))) return false; w.Set(x, y - 1, z, B.Dirt, 0); var nodes = new List<(int, int, int)>(); nodes.Add((x, y + height, z)); int branches = 2 + r.Next(3); for (int i = 0; i < branches; i++) { double ang = r.NextDouble() * Math.PI * 2; int by = y + (int)(height * (0.45 + r.NextDouble() * 0.4)); int len = 2 + r.Next(3); int ex = x + (int)Math.Round(Math.Cos(ang) * len), ez = z + (int)Math.Round(Math.Sin(ang) * len); int ey = by + len / 2 + 1; // gałąź z drewna int steps = Math.Max(Math.Abs(ex - x), Math.Max(Math.Abs(ez - z), Math.Abs(ey - by))); for (int s = 1; s <= steps; s++) { double t = (double)s / steps; int bx = (int)Math.Round(x + (ex - x) * t), bz = (int)Math.Round(z + (ez - z) * t), byy = (int)Math.Round(by + (ey - by) * t); int axis = Math.Abs(ex - x) > Math.Abs(ez - z) ? 1 : 2; if (Math.Abs(ey - by) >= Math.Max(Math.Abs(ex - x), Math.Abs(ez - z))) axis = 0; if (CanReplace(w.Get(bx, byy, bz))) w.Set(bx, byy, bz, B.OakLog, axis); } nodes.Add((ex, ey, ez)); } foreach (var (nx, ny, nz) in nodes) { for (int dy = -1; dy <= 2; dy++) { int rad = dy == -1 || dy == 2 ? 2 : 3; for (int dx = -rad; dx <= rad; dx++) for (int dz = -rad; dz <= rad; dz++) { double d = Math.Sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz); if (d > rad + 0.3 - (r.Next(3) == 0 ? 0.6 : 0)) continue; int id = w.Get(nx + dx, ny + dy, nz + dz); if (id == B.Air || id == B.TallGrass) w.Set(nx + dx, ny + dy, nz + dz, B.OakLeaves, 0); } } } for (int i = 0; i < height; i++) { int id = w.Get(x, y + i, z); if (CanReplace(id) || i == 0) w.Set(x, y + i, z, B.OakLog, 0); } return true; } }
