B.BirchLog : B.OakLog; byte leaves = type == 1 ? B.BirchLeaves : B.OakLeaves; w.Set(x, y - 1, z, B.Dirt, 0); for (int yy = y + height - 3; yy <= y + height; yy++) { int dy = yy - (y + height); int rad = 1 - dy / 2; for (int dx = -rad; dx <= rad; dx++) for (int dz = -rad; dz <= rad; dz++) { if (Math.Abs(dx) == rad && Math.Abs(dz) == rad && (r.Next(2) == 0 || dy == 0)) continue; if (CanReplace(w.Get(x + dx, yy, z + dz)) && w.Get(x + dx, yy, z + dz) == B.Air || w.Get(x + dx, yy, z + dz) == B.TallGrass) w.Set(x + dx, yy, z + dz, leaves, 0); } } for (int i = 0; i < height; i++) { int id = w.Get(x, y + i, z); if (CanReplace(id) || i == 0) w.Set(x, y + i, z, log, 0); } return true; }

nodes.name: BigOak
nodes.signature: private static bool BigOak(ITreeWriter w, int x, int y, int z, Rng r, bool worldGen)
nodes.body_text: private static bool BigOak(ITreeWriter w, int x, int y, int z, Rng r, bool worldGen) { int height = r.Next(5) + 8; if (y + height + 4 >= Chunk.Height) return false; if (!worldGen) for (int yy = y + 1; yy < y + height; yy++) if (!CanReplace(w.Get(x, yy, z))) return false; w.Set(x, y - 1, z, B.Dirt, 0); var nodes = new List<(int, int, int)>(); nodes.Add((x, y + height, z)); int branches = 2 + r.Next(3); for (int i = 0; i < branches; i++) { double ang = r.NextDouble() * Math.PI * 2; int by = y + (int)(height * (0.45 + r.NextDouble() * 0.4)); int len = 2 + r.Next(3); int ex = x + (int)Math.Round(Math.Cos(ang) * len), ez = z + (int)Math.Round(Math.Sin(ang) * len); int ey = by + len / 2 + 1; // gałąź z drewna int steps = Math.Max(Math.Abs(ex - x), Math.Max(Math.Abs(ez - z), Math.Abs(ey - by))); for (int s = 1; s <= steps; s++) { double t = (double)s / steps; int bx = (int)Math.Round(x + (ex - x) * t), bz = (int)Math.Round(z + (ez - z) * t), byy = (int)Math.Round(by + (ey - by) * t); int axis = Math.Abs(ex - x) > Math.Abs(ez - z) ? 1 : 2; if (Math.Abs(ey - by) >= Math.Max(Math.Abs(ex - x), Math.Abs(ez - z))) axis = 0; if (CanReplace(w.Get(bx, byy, bz))) w.Set(bx, byy, bz, B.OakLog, axis); } nodes.Add((ex, ey, ez)); } foreach (var (nx, ny, nz) in nodes) { for (int dy = -1; dy <= 2; dy++) { int rad = dy == -1 || dy == 2 ? 2 : 3; for (int dx = -rad; dx <= rad; dx++) for (int dz = -rad; dz <= rad; dz++) { double d = Math.Sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz); if (d > rad + 0.3 - (r.Next(3) == 0 ? 0.6 : 0)) continue; int id = w.Get(nx + dx, ny + dy, nz + dz); if (id == B.Air || id == B.TallGrass) w.Set(nx + dx, ny + dy, nz + dz, B.OakLeaves, 0); } } } for (int i = 0; i < height; i++) { int id = w.Get(x, y + i, z); if (CanReplace(id) || i == 0) w.Set(x, y + i, z, B.OakLog, 0); } return true; }

nodes.name: WorldGenerator
nodes.signature: public sealed class WorldGenerator
nodes.body_text: public sealed class WorldGenerator { public const int SeaLevel = 62; // najwyższy blok wody public readonly long Seed; public readonly WorldType Type; private readonly OctaveNoise _terrain3D, _hills, _continental, _temp, _forest, _detail, _surface, _beach; private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<long, (byte[] top, byte[] topBlock, byte[] biome)> _protoCache = new(); public WorldGenerator(long seed, WorldType type) { Seed = seed; Type = type; var r = new Rng(seed); _terrain3D = new OctaveNoise(r, 4); _hills = new OctaveNoise(r, 4); _continental = new OctaveNoise(r, 3); _temp = new OctaveNoise(r, 3); _forest = new OctaveNoise(r, 2); _detail = new OctaveNoise(r, 2); _surface = new OctaveNoise(r, 3); _beach = new OctaveNoise(r, 2); } public double Temperature(int x, int z) => _temp.Sample(x / 420.0, z / 420.0) * 1.6 + _detail.Sample(x / 40.0, 3.3, z / 40.0) * 0.04; public double DesertWeight(int x, int z) { double t = Temperature(x, z); return SmoothStep(0.12, 0.30, t); } public byte BiomeAt(int x, int z) { if (Type == WorldType.Superflat) return Biome.Plains; if (DesertWeight(x, z) > 0.5) return Biome.Desert; return _forest.Sample(x / 160.0, 7.7, z / 160.0) < -0.12 ? Biome.Plains : Biome.Forest; } private static double SmoothStep(double a, double b, double v) { double t = Math.Clamp((v - a) / (b - a), 0, 1); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); } private void ColumnParams(int x, int z, out double height, out double noiseAmp) { double dw = DesertWeight(x, z); double c = _continental.Sample(x / 600.0, z / 600.0) * 1.5; double h = _hills.Sample(x / 200.0, z / 200.0) * 1.4; double baseH = 67 + c * 12; if (c < -0.35) baseH -= (-0.35 - c) * 30; // oceany / jeziora double fh = baseH + h * 10 + Math.Pow(Math.Max(0, h), 2) * 40; double dh = 65 + c * 4 + h * 5; if (c < -0.35) dh -= (-0.35 - c) * 24; height = Math.Clamp(fh * (1 - dw) + dh * dw, 30, 112); noiseAmp = 9 * (1 - dw) + 3.5 * dw + Math.Max(0, h) * 6 * (1 - dw); } private double[] ComputeDensity(int cx, int cz) { // siatka 5x17x5 (co 4 w poziomie, co 8 w pionie) var d = new double[5 * 17 * 5]; for (int gx = 0; gx < 5; gx++) for (int gz = 0; gz < 5; gz++) { int wx = cx * 16 + gx * 4, wz = cz * 16 + gz * 4; ColumnParams(wx, wz, out double height, out double amp); for (int gy = 0; gy < 17; gy++) { int wy = gy * 8; double n = _terrain3D.Sample(wx / 56.0, wy / 40.0, wz / 56.0); double val = (height - wy) + n * amp * 2.2; if (wy <= 4) val += 50; if (wy >= 124) val -= 50; d[(gx * 5 + gz) * 17 + gy] = val; } } return d; } private void FillTerrain(int cx, int cz, byte[] blocks) { var d = ComputeDensity(cx, cz); for (int gx = 0; gx < 4; gx++) for (int gz = 0; gz < 4; gz++) for (int gy = 0; gy < 16; gy++) { double d000 = d[(gx * 5 + gz) * 17 + gy], d001 = d[(gx * 5 + gz + 1) * 17 + gy]; double d100 = d[((gx + 1) * 5 + gz) * 17 + gy], d101 = d[((gx + 1) * 5 + gz + 1) * 17 + gy]; double d010 = d[(gx * 5 + gz) * 17 + gy + 1], d011 = d[(gx * 5 + gz + 1) * 17 + gy + 1]; double d110 = d[((gx + 1) * 5 + gz) * 17 + gy + 1], d111 = d[((gx + 1) * 5 + gz + 1) * 17 + gy + 1]; for (int ly = 0; ly < 8; ly++) { double ty = ly / 8.0; double a00 = d000 + (d010 - d000) * ty, a01 = d001 + (d011 - d001) * ty; double a10 = d100 + (d110 - d100) * ty, a11 = d101 + (d111 - d101) * ty; int y = gy * 8 + ly; for (int lx = 0; lx < 4; lx++) { double tx = lx / 4.0; double b0 = a00 + (a10 - a00) * tx, b1 = a01 + (a11 - a01) * tx; for (int lz = 0; lz < 4; lz++) { double v = b0 + (b1 - b0) * (lz / 4.0); int x = gx * 4 + lx, z = gz * 4 + lz; byte id = v > 0 ? B.Stone : (y <= SeaLevel ? B.Water : B.Air); blocks[Chunk.Index(x, y, z)] = id; } } } } } private (byte[] top, byte[] topBlock, byte[] biome) Proto(int cx, int cz) { long key = MathUtil.ChunkKey(cx, cz); if (_protoCache.TryGetValue(key, out var p)) return p; var blocks = new byte[Chunk.Volume]; FillTerrain(cx, cz, blocks); var top = new byte[256]; var tb = new byte[256]; var bio = new byte[256]; for (int z = 0; z < 16; z++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { int y = Chunk.Height - 1; while (y > 0 && blocks[Chunk.Index(x, y, z)] == B.Air) y--; top[z * 16 + x] = (byte)y; tb[z * 16 + x] = blocks[Chunk.Index(x, y, z)]; bio[z * 16 + x] = BiomeAt(cx * 16 + x, cz * 16 + z); } p = (top, tb, bio); if (_protoCache.Count > 4000) _protoCache.Clear(); _protoCache[key] = p; return p; } public Chunk Generate(int cx, int cz) { var c = new Chunk(cx, cz); if (Type == WorldType.Superflat) { GenerateFlat(c); return c; } var blocks = c.Blocks; FillTerrain(cx, cz, blocks); var rng = new Rng(Seed ^ (cx * 341873128712L + cz * 132897987541L)); for (int z = 0; z < 16; z++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) c.Biomes[z * 16 + x] = BiomeAt(cx * 16 + x, cz * 16 + z); // powierzchnia for (int z = 0; z < 16; z++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { int wx = cx * 16 + x, wz = cz * 16 + z; byte bio = c.Biomes[z * 16 + x]; double sn = _surface.Sample(wx / 16.0, 0.3, wz / 16.0); int depthMax = (int)(3 + sn * 2 + rng.NextDouble()); bool beach = _beach.Sample(wx / 32.0, 1.7, wz / 32.0) > -0.1; bool gravelBeach =

nodes.name: WorldGenerator
nodes.signature: public WorldGenerator(long seed, WorldType type)
nodes.body_text: public WorldGenerator(long seed, WorldType type) { Seed = seed; Type = type; var r = new Rng(seed); _terrain3D = new OctaveNoise(r, 4); _hills = new OctaveNoise(r, 4); _continental = new OctaveNoise(r, 3); _temp = new OctaveNoise(r, 3); _forest = new OctaveNoise(r, 2); _detail = new OctaveNoise(r, 2); _surface = new OctaveNoise(r, 3); _beach = new OctaveNoise(r, 2); }

nodes.name: Temperature
nodes.signature: public double Temperature(int x, int z) => _temp.Sample(x / 420.0, z / 420.0) * 1.6 + _detail.Sample(x / 40.0, 3.3, z / 40.0) * 0.04;
nodes.body_text: public double Temperature(int x, int z) => _temp.Sample(x / 420.0, z / 420.0) * 1.6 + _detail.Sample(x / 40.0, 3.3, z / 40.0) * 0.04;

nodes.name: DesertWeight
nodes.signature: public double DesertWeight(int x, int z) { double t = Temperature(x, z); return SmoothStep(0.12, 0.30, t); }
nodes.body_text: public double DesertWeight(int x, int z) { double t = Temperature(x, z); return SmoothStep(0.12, 0.30, t); }

nodes.name: BiomeAt
nodes.signature: public byte BiomeAt(int x, int z)
nodes.body_text: public byte BiomeAt(int x, int z) { if (Type == WorldType.Superflat) return Biome.Plains; if (DesertWeight(x, z) > 0.5) return Biome.Desert; return _forest.Sample(x / 160.0, 7.7, z / 160.0) < -0.12 ? Biome.Plains : Biome.Forest; }

nodes.name: SmoothStep
nodes.signature: private static double SmoothStep(double a, double b, double v) { double t = Math.Clamp((v - a) / (b - a), 0, 1); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); }
nodes.body_text: private static double SmoothStep(double a, double b, double v) { double t = Math.Clamp((v - a) / (b - a), 0, 1); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); }

nodes.name: ColumnParams
nodes.signature: private void ColumnParams(int x, int z, out double height, out double noiseAmp)
nodes.body_text: private void ColumnParams(int x, int z, out double height, out double noiseAmp) { double dw = DesertWeight(x, z); double c = _continental.Sample(x / 600.0, z / 600.0) * 1.5; double h = _hills.Sample(x / 200.0, z / 200.0) * 1.4; double baseH = 67 + c * 12; if (c < -0.35) baseH -= (-0.35 - c) * 30; // oceany / jeziora double fh = baseH + h * 10 + Math.Pow(Math.Max(0, h), 2) * 40; double dh = 65 + c * 4 + h * 5; if (c < -0.35) dh -= (-0.35 - c) * 24; height = Math.Clamp(fh * (1 - dw) + dh * dw, 30, 112); noiseAmp = 9 * (1 - dw) + 3.5 * dw + Math.Max(0, h) * 6 * (1 - dw); }

nodes.name: ComputeDensity
nodes.signature: private double[] ComputeDensity(int cx, int cz)
nodes.body_text: private double[] ComputeDensity(int cx, int cz) { // siatka 5x17x5 (co 4 w poziomie, co 8 w pionie) var d = new double[5 * 17 * 5]; for (int gx = 0; gx < 5; gx++) for (int gz = 0; gz < 5; gz++) { int wx = cx * 16 + gx * 4, wz = cz * 16 + gz * 4; ColumnParams(wx, wz, out double height, out double amp); for (int gy = 0; gy < 17; gy++) { int wy = gy * 8; double n = _terrain3D.Sample(wx / 56.0, wy / 40.0, wz / 56.0); double val = (height - wy) + n * amp * 2.2; if (wy <= 4) val += 50; if (wy >= 124) val -= 50; d[(gx * 5 + gz) * 17 + gy] = val; } } return d; }

nodes.name: FillTerrain
nodes.signature: private void FillTerrain(int cx, int cz, byte[] blocks)
nodes.body_text: private void FillTerrain(int cx, int cz, byte[] blocks) { var d = ComputeDensity(cx, cz); for (int gx = 0; gx < 4; gx++) for (int gz = 0; gz < 4; gz++) for (int gy = 0; gy < 16; gy++) { double d000 = d[(gx * 5 + gz) * 17 + gy], d001 = d[(gx * 5 + gz + 1) * 17 + gy]; double d100 = d[((gx + 1) * 5 + gz) * 17 + gy], d101 = d[((gx + 1) * 5 + gz + 1) * 17 + gy]; double d010 = d[(gx * 5 + gz) * 17 + gy + 1], d011 = d[(gx * 5 + gz + 1) * 17 + gy + 1]; double d110 = d[((gx + 1) * 5 + gz) * 17 + gy + 1], d111 = d[((gx + 1) * 5 + gz + 1) * 17 + gy + 1]; for (int ly = 0; ly < 8; ly++) { double ty = ly / 8.0; double a00 = d000 + (d010 - d000) * ty, a01 = d001 + (d011 - d001) * ty; double a10 = d100 + (d110 - d100) * ty, a11 = d101 + (d111 - d101) * ty; int y = gy * 8 + ly; for (int lx = 0; lx < 4; lx++) { double tx = lx / 4.0; double b0 = a00 + (a10 - a00) * tx, b1 = a01 + (a11 - a01) * tx; for (int lz = 0; lz < 4; lz++) { double v = b0 + (b1 - b0) * (lz / 4.0); int x = gx * 4 + lx, z = gz * 4 + lz; byte id = v > 0 ? B.Stone : (y <= SeaLevel ? B.Water : B.Air); blocks[Chunk.Index(x, y, z)] = id; } } } } }

nodes.name: Proto
nodes.signature: private (byte[] top, byte[] topBlock, byte[] biome) Proto(int cx, int cz)
nodes.body_text: private (byte[] top, byte[] topBlock, byte[] biome) Proto(int cx, int cz) { long key = MathUtil.ChunkKey(cx, cz); if (_protoCache.TryGetValue(key, out var p)) return p; var blocks = new byte[Chunk.Volume]; FillTerrain(cx, cz, blocks); var top = new byte[256]; var tb = new byte[256]; var bio = new byte[256]; for (int z = 0; z < 16; z++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { int y = Chunk.Height - 1; while (y > 0 && blocks[Chunk.Index(x, y, z)] == B.Air) y--; top[z * 16 + x] = (byte)y; tb[z * 16 + x] = blocks[Chunk.Index(x, y, z)]; bio[z * 16 + x] = BiomeAt(cx * 16 + x, cz * 16 + z); } p = (top, tb, bio); if (_protoCache.Count > 4000) _protoCache.Clear(); _protoCache[key] = p; return p; }

nodes.name: Generate
nodes.signature: public Chunk Generate(int cx, int cz)
nodes.body_text: public Chunk Generate(int cx, int cz) { var c = new Chunk(cx, cz); if (Type == WorldType.Superflat) { GenerateFlat(c); return c; } var blocks = c.Blocks; FillTerrain(cx, cz, blocks); var rng = new Rng(Seed ^ (cx * 341873128712L + cz * 132897987541L)); for (int z = 0; z < 16; z++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) c.Biomes[z * 16 + x] = BiomeAt(cx * 16 + x, cz * 16 + z); // powierzchnia for (int z = 0; z < 16; z++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { int wx = cx * 16 + x, wz = cz * 16 + z; byte bio = c.Biomes[z * 16 + x]; double sn = _surface.Sample(wx / 16.0, 0.3, wz / 16.0); int depthMax = (int)(3 + sn * 2 + rng.NextDouble()); bool beach = _beach.Sample(wx / 32.0, 1.7, wz / 32.0) > -0.1; bool gravelBeach = _beach.Sample(wx / 32.0, 9.1, wz / 32.0) > 0.45; int depth = -1; byte top = bio == Biome.Desert ? B.Sand : B.Grass, filler = bio == Biome.Desert ? B.Sand : B.Dirt; for (int y = Chunk.Height - 1; y >= 0; y--) { int i = Chunk.Index(x, y, z); byte id = blocks[i]; if (id == B.Air) { depth = -1; continue; } if (id == B.Water) { depth = -1; continue; } if (id != B.Stone) continue; if (depth == -1) { // pierwszy blok stały od góry byte t = top, f = filler; if (depthMax <= 0) { t = B.Air; f = B.Stone; } if (y >= SeaLevel - 3 && y <= SeaLevel + 1 && bio != Biome.Desert) { if (gravelBeach) { t = B.Gravel; f = B.Gravel; } else if (beach) { t = B.Sand; f = B.Sand; } } if (y < SeaLevel && t == B.Grass) { t = B.Dirt; } if (y < SeaLevel - 1 && bio != Biome.Desert && (sn > 0.25)) { t = B.Gravel; f = B.Dirt; } depth = depthMax; blocks[i] = y >= SeaLevel ? (t == B.Air ? B.Stone : t) : (t == B.Air ? B.Stone : t); if (blocks[i] == B.Grass && y + 1 < Chunk.Height && blocks[Chunk.Index(x, y + 1, z)] == B.Water) blocks[i] = B.Dirt; filler = f; } else if (depth > 0) { depth--; blocks[i] = filler; if (depth == 0 && filler == B.Sand) { depth = rng.Next(4) + 2; filler = B.Sandstone; } } } // skała macierzysta blocks[Chunk.Index(x, 0, z)] = B.Bedrock; for (int y = 1; y < 5; y++) if (rng.Next(5) >= y) blocks[Chunk.Index(x, y, z)] = B.Bedrock; } CarveCaves(c); GenerateOres(c); Decorate(c, rng); c.RecountSections(); c.RecalcHeightMap(); return c; }

nodes.name: GenerateFlat
nodes.signature: private void GenerateFlat(Chunk c)
nodes.body_text: private void GenerateFlat(Chunk c) { for (int z = 0; z < 16; z++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(x, 0, z)] = B.Bedrock; c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(x, 1, z)] = B.Dirt; c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(x, 2, z)] = B.Dirt; c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(x, 3, z)] = B.Grass; c.Biomes[z * 16 + x] = Biome.Plains; } c.RecountSections(); c.RecalcHeightMap(); }

nodes.name: CarveCaves
nodes.signature: private void CarveCaves(Chunk c)
nodes.body_text: private void CarveCaves(Chunk c) { const int range = 8; for (int dx = -range; dx <= range; dx++) for (int dz = -range; dz <= range; dz++) { int sx = c.Cx + dx, sz = c.Cz + dz; var r = new Rng(Seed * 31 + sx * 341873128712L + sz * 132897987541L + 77); int count = r.Next(r.Next(r.Next(15) + 1) + 1); if (r.Next(7) != 0) count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) { double x = sx * 16 + r.Next(16), y = r.Next(r.Next(110) + 8), z = sz * 16 + r.Next(16); int tunnels = 1; if (r.Next(4) == 0) { Tunnel(c, r.NextLong(), x, y, z, 1 + r.NextFloat() * 6, 0, 0, -1, -1, 0.5); tunnels += r.Next(4); } for (int t = 0; t < tunnels; t++) { float yaw = r.NextFloat() * MathF.PI * 2, pitch = (r.NextFloat() - 0.5f) * 2f / 8f; float width = r.NextFloat() * 2 + r.NextFloat(); if (r.Next(10) == 0) width *= r.NextFloat() * r.NextFloat() * 3 + 1; Tunnel(c, r.NextLong(), x, y, z, width, yaw, pitch, 0, 0, 1.0); } } } }

nodes.name: Tunnel
nodes.signature: private void Tunnel(Chunk c, long seed, double x, double y, double z, float width, float yaw, float pitch, int step, int maxSteps, double yScale)
nodes.body_text: private void Tunnel(Chunk c, long seed, double x, double y, double z, float width, float yaw, float pitch, int step, int maxSteps, double yScale) { double cxw = c.Cx * 16 + 8, czw = c.Cz * 16 + 8; float yawV = 0, pitchV = 0; var r = new Rng(seed); if (maxSteps <= 0) { int rr = 8 * 16 - 16; maxSteps = rr - r.Next(rr / 4); } bool room = false; if (step == -1) { step = maxSteps / 2; room = true; } int branch = r.Next(Math.Max(1, maxSteps / 2)) + maxSteps / 4; bool steep = r.Next(6) == 0; for (; step < maxSteps; step++) { double radH = 1.5 + Math.Sin(step * Math.PI / maxSteps) * width; double radV = radH * yScale; float cp = MathF.Cos(pitch), sp = MathF.Sin(pitch); x += MathF.Cos(yaw) * cp; y += sp; z += MathF.Sin(yaw) * cp; pitch *= steep ? 0.92f : 0.7f; pitch += pitchV * 0.1f; yaw += yawV * 0.1f; pitchV *= 0.9f; yawV *= 0.75f; pitchV += (r.NextFloat() - r.NextFloat()) * r.NextFloat() * 2f; yawV += (r.NextFloat() - r.NextFloat()) * r.NextFloat() * 4f; if (!room && step == branch && width > 1f && maxSteps > 0) { Tunnel(c, r.NextLong(), x, y, z, r.NextFloat() * 0.5f + 0.5f, yaw - MathF.PI / 2, pitch / 3f, step, maxSteps, 1.0); Tunnel(c, r.NextLong(), x, y, z, r.NextFloat() * 0.5f + 0.5f, yaw + MathF.PI / 2, pitch / 3f, step, maxSteps, 1.0); return; } if (!room && r.Next(4) == 0) continue; double ddx = x - cxw, ddz = z - czw, rem = maxSteps - step, maxR = width + 2 + 16; if (ddx * ddx + ddz * ddz - rem * rem > maxR * maxR) return; if (x < cxw - 16 - radH * 2 || z < czw - 16 - radH * 2 || x > cxw + 16 + radH * 2 || z > czw + 16 + radH * 2) continue; Carve(c, x, y, z, radH, radV); if (room) break; } }

nodes.name: Carve
nodes.signature: private void Carve(Chunk c, double x, double y, double z, double rh, double rv)
nodes.body_text: private void Carve(Chunk c, double x, double y, double z, double rh, double rv) { int bx0 = c.Cx * 16, bz0 = c.Cz * 16; int x0 = Math.Max(0, MathUtil.FloorToInt(x - rh) - bx0 - 1), x1 = Math.Min(16, MathUtil.FloorToInt(x + rh) - bx0 + 1); int z0 = Math.Max(0, MathUtil.FloorToInt(z - rh) - bz0 - 1), z1 = Math.Min(16, MathUtil.FloorToInt(z + rh) - bz0 + 1); int y0 = Math.Max(1, MathUtil.FloorToInt(y - rv) - 1), y1 = Math.Min(Chunk.Height - 8, MathUtil.FloorToInt(y + rv) + 1); if (x0 >= x1 || z0 >= z1 || y0 >= y1) return; // brak wody w pobliżu for (int lx = x0; lx < x1; lx++) for (int lz = z0; lz < z1; lz++) for (int ly = y1 + 1; ly >= y0 - 1; ly--) { if (ly < 0 || ly >= Chunk.Height) continue; byte id = c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, ly, lz)]; if (id == B.Water) return; if (ly != y0 - 1 && lx != x0 && lx != x1 - 1 && lz != z0 && lz != z1 - 1) ly = y0; } for (int lx = x0; lx < x1; lx++) { double dx = (lx + bx0 + 0.5 - x) / rh; for (int lz = z0; lz < z1; lz++) { double dz = (lz + bz0 + 0.5 - z) / rh; if (dx * dx + dz * dz >= 1) continue; bool hitGrass = false; for (int ly = y1 - 1; ly >= y0; ly--) { double dy = (ly + 0.5 - y) / rv; if (dy > -0.7 && dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz < 1) { int i = Chunk.Index(lx, ly, lz); byte id = c.Blocks[i]; if (id == B.Grass) hitGrass = true; if (id == B.Stone || id == B.Dirt || id == B.Grass || id == B.Sand || id == B.Sandstone || id == B.Gravel) { if (id == B.Sand && ly + 1 < Chunk.Height && c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, ly + 1, lz)] == B.Water) continue; c.Blocks[i] = ly < 11 ? B.Lava : B.Air; if (hitGrass && ly > 0 && c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, ly - 1, lz)] == B.Dirt) c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, ly - 1, lz)] = B.Grass; } } } } } }

nodes.name: GenerateOres
nodes.signature: private void GenerateOres(Chunk c)
nodes.body_text: private void GenerateOres(Chunk c) { for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) for (int dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) { int sx = c.Cx + dx, sz = c.Cz + dz; var r = new Rng(Seed + sx * 1234567L + sz * 7654321L + 999); Veins(c, r, sx, sz, B.Dirt, 32, 8, 0, 128); Veins(c, r, sx, sz, B.Gravel, 32, 6, 0, 128); Veins(c, r, sx, sz, B.CoalOre, 17, 20, 0, 128); Veins(c, r, sx, sz, B.IronOre, 9, 20, 0, 64); Veins(c, r, sx, sz, B.GoldOre, 9, 2, 0, 32); Veins(c, r, sx, sz, B.RedstoneOre, 8, 8, 0, 16); Veins(c, r, sx, sz, B.DiamondOre, 8, 1, 0, 16); // lazuryt – rozkład trójkątny wokół y=16 for (int i = 0; i < 1; i++) { int x = sx * 16 + r.Next(16), z = sz * 16 + r.Next(16), y = r.Next(16) + r.Next(16); Vein(c, r, x, y, z, B.LapisOre, 7); } } }

nodes.name: Veins
nodes.signature: private void Veins(Chunk c, Rng r, int sx, int sz, byte ore, int size, int count, int minY, int maxY)
nodes.body_text: private void Veins(Chunk c, Rng r, int sx, int sz, byte ore, int size, int count, int minY, int maxY) { for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) { int x = sx * 16 + r.Next(16), y = r.Next(maxY - minY) + minY, z = sz * 16 + r.Next(16); Vein(c, r, x, y, z, ore, size); } }

nodes.name: Vein
nodes.signature: private void Vein(Chunk c, Rng r, int px, int py, int pz, byte ore, int n)
nodes.body_text: private void Vein(Chunk c, Rng r, int px, int py, int pz, byte ore, int n) { float f = r.NextFloat() * MathF.PI; double d0 = px + MathF.Sin(f) * n / 8f, d1 = px - MathF.Sin(f) * n / 8f; double d2 = pz + MathF.Cos(f) * n / 8f, d3 = pz - MathF.Cos(f) * n / 8f; double d4 = py + r.Next(3) - 2, d5 = py + r.Next(3) - 2; int bx0 = c.Cx * 16, bz0 = c.Cz * 16; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { float t = (float)i / n; double cx = d0 + (d1 - d0) * t, cy = d4 + (d5 - d4) * t, cz = d2 + (d3 - d2) * t; double d9 = r.NextDouble() * n / 16.0; double rad = ((MathF.Sin(MathF.PI * t) + 1f) * d9 + 1.0) / 2.0; int x0 = MathUtil.FloorToInt(cx - rad), x1 = MathUtil.FloorToInt(cx + rad); int y0 = MathUtil.FloorToInt(cy - rad), y1 = MathUtil.FloorToInt(cy + rad); int z0 = MathUtil.FloorToInt(cz - rad), z1 = MathUtil.FloorToInt(cz + rad); if (x1 < bx0 || x0 > bx0 + 15 || z1 < bz0 || z0 > bz0 + 15) continue; for (int x = x0; x <= x1; x++) { double ex = (x + 0.5 - cx) / rad; if (ex * ex >= 1) continue; if (x < bx0 || x > bx0 + 15) continue; for (int y = y0; y <= y1; y++) { double ey = (y + 0.5 - cy) / rad; if (ex * ex + ey * ey >= 1) continue; if (y < 1 || y >= Chunk.Height) continue; for (int z = z0; z <= z1; z++) { double ez = (z + 0.5 - cz) / rad; if (ex * ex + ey * ey + ez * ez >= 1) continue; if (z < bz0 || z > bz0 + 15) continue; int idx = Chunk.Index(x - bx0, y, z - bz0); if (c.Blocks[idx] == B.Stone) c.Blocks[idx] = ore; } } } } }

nodes.name: ChunkWriter
nodes.signature: private sealed class ChunkWriter : ITreeWriter
nodes.body_text: private sealed class ChunkWriter : ITreeWriter { private readonly Chunk _c; public ChunkWriter(Chunk c) { _c = c; } public int Get(int x, int y, int z) { int lx = x - _c.Cx * 16, lz = z - _c.Cz * 16; if (y < 0 || y >= Chunk.Height) return B.Stone; if (lx < 0 || lx > 15 || lz < 0 || lz > 15) return OutsideGround(x, y, z); return _c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, y, lz)]; } public Func<int, int, int, int> OutsideGround; public void Set(int x, int y, int z, byte id, int meta) { int lx = x - _c.Cx * 16, lz = z - _c.Cz * 16; if (lx < 0 || lx > 15 || lz < 0 || lz > 15 || y < 0 || y >= Chunk.Height) return; int i = Chunk.Index(lx, y, lz); byte old = _c.Blocks[i]; if (id == B.OakLeaves || id == B.BirchLeaves) { if (old != B.Air && old != B.TallGrass && old != B.Dandelion && old != B.Poppy) return; } _c.Blocks[i] = id; _c.Meta[i] = (byte)meta; } }

nodes.name: ChunkWriter
nodes.signature: public ChunkWriter(Chunk c) { _c = c; }
nodes.body_text: public ChunkWriter(Chunk c) { _c = c; }

nodes.name: Get
nodes.signature: public int Get(int x, int y, int z)
nodes.body_text: public int Get(int x, int y, int z) { int lx = x - _c.Cx * 16, lz = z - _c.Cz * 16; if (y < 0 || y >= Chunk.Height) return B.Stone; if (lx < 0 || lx > 15 || lz < 0 || lz > 15) return OutsideGround(x, y, z); return _c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, y, lz)]; }

nodes.name: Set
nodes.signature: public void Set(int x, int y, int z, byte id, int meta)
nodes.body_text: public void Set(int x, int y, int z, byte id, int meta) { int lx = x - _c.Cx * 16, lz = z - _c.Cz * 16; if (lx < 0 || lx > 15 || lz < 0 || lz > 15 || y < 0 || y >= Chunk.Height) return; int i = Chunk.Index(lx, y, lz); byte old = _c.Blocks[i]; if (id == B.OakLeaves || id == B.BirchLeaves) { if (old != B.Air && old != B.TallGrass && old != B.Dandelion && old != B.Poppy) return; } _c.Blocks[i] = id; _c.Meta[i] = (byte)meta; }

nodes.name: Decorate
nodes.signature: private void Decorate(Chunk c, Rng rng)
nodes.body_text: private void Decorate(Chunk c, Rng rng) { var writer = new ChunkWriter(c); // drzewa z sąsiednich chunków (deterministycznie) for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) for (int dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) { int sx = c.Cx + dx, sz = c.Cz + dz; var proto = Proto(sx, sz); writer.OutsideGround = (x, y, z) => { // dla pni sąsiadów – baza drzewa: zakładamy trawę pod pniem return B.Air; }; var r = new Rng(Seed ^ (sx * 98765431L + sz * 1234577L) ^ 0x5DEECE66DL); int bx = sx * 16 + 8, bz = sz * 16 + 8; byte bio = BiomeAt(bx, bz); double fd = _forest.Sample(bx / 160.0, 7.7, bz / 160.0); int trees; if (bio == Biome.Desert) trees = 0; else if (bio == Biome.Plains) trees = r.Next(10) == 0 ? 1 : 0; else trees = (int)(3 + Math.Clamp(fd + 0.12, 0, 1) * 9) + r.Next(3) - 1; for (int t = 0; t < trees; t++) { int lx = r.Next(16), lz = r.Next(16); int ty = proto.top[lz * 16 + lx]; byte tb = proto.topBlock[lz * 16 + lx]; int type = r.Next(5) == 0 ? 1 : 0; long treeSeed = r.NextLong(); if (proto.biome[lz * 16 + lx] == Biome.Desert || ty < SeaLevel) continue; if (tb != B.Stone) continue; int wx = sx * 16 + lx, wz = sz * 16 + lz; // pomiń jeśli pień w sąsiednim chunku i za daleko if (wx < c.Cx * 16 - 4 || wx > c.Cx * 16 + 19 || wz < c.Cz * 16 - 4 || wz > c.Cz * 16 + 19) continue; var tr = new Rng(treeSeed); // grunt: w naszym chunku sprawdzamy realnie bool own = dx == 0 && dz == 0; if (own) { int g = c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, ty, lz)]; if (g != B.Grass && g != B.Dirt) continue; if (c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, ty + 1, lz)] != B.Air) continue; } var gw = new GroundWriter(writer, wx, ty, wz); TreeGen.Generate(gw, wx, ty + 1, wz, type, tr, true); } } int cxw = c.Cx * 16, czw = c.Cz * 16; // trawa, kwiaty, kaktusy, krzaki, trzcina for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) { int lx = rng.Next(16), lz = rng.Next(16); byte bio = c.Biomes[lz * 16 + lx]; int y = c.TopSolidY(lx, lz); if (y <= 0 || y >= Chunk.Height - 4) continue; int ground = c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, y, lz)]; int above = c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, y + 1, lz)]; if (above != B.Air) continue; if (bio != Biome.Desert && ground == B.Grass) { int roll = rng.Next(100); int grassChance = bio == Biome.Plains ? 70 : 55; if (roll < grassChance) c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, y + 1, lz)] = B.TallGrass; } } // płaty kwiatów int patches = rng.Next(3); for (int p = 0; p < patches; p++) { int px = rng.Next(16), pz = rng.Next(16); byte flower = rng.Next(3) == 0 ? B.Dandelion : B.Poppy; for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) { int lx = px + rng.Next(5) - 2, lz = pz + rng.Next(5) - 2; if (lx < 0 || lx > 15 || lz < 0 || lz > 15) continue; int y = c.TopSolidY(lx, lz); if (y <= 0 || y >= Chunk.Height - 2) continue; if (c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, y, lz)] == B.Grass && c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, y + 1, lz)] is B.Air or B.TallGrass) c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, y + 1, lz)] = flower; } } // pustynia for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) { int lx = rng.Next(16), lz = rng.Next(16); if (c.Biomes[lz * 16 + lx] != Biome.Desert) continue; int y = c.TopSolidY(lx, lz); if (y <= SeaLevel - 1 || y >= Chunk.Height - 4) continue; if (c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, y, lz)] != B.Sand || c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, y + 1, lz)] != B.Air) continue; if (i < 3 && lx > 0 && lx < 15 && lz > 0 && lz < 15) { bool free = true; for (int h = 0; h < 4; h++) if (c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx + Dir.HorizX[h], y + 1, lz + Dir.HorizZ[h])] != B.Air) free = false; if (free) { int hgt = 1 + rng.Next(rng.Next(3) + 1); for (int k = 1; k <= hgt; k++) c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, y + k, lz)] = B.Cactus; } } else if (i < 6) c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, y + 1, lz)] = B.DeadBush; } // trzcina przy wodzie for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) { int lx = rng.Next(14) + 1, lz = rng.Next(14) + 1; int y = c.TopSolidY(lx, lz); if (y != SeaLevel) continue; int g = c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, y, lz)]; if (g != B.Grass && g != B.Sand && g != B.Dirt) continue; if (c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, y + 1, lz)] != B.Air) continue; bool water = false; for (int h = 0; h < 4; h++) if (c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx + Dir.HorizX[h], y, lz + Dir.HorizZ[h])] == B.Water) water = true; if (!water) continue; int hgt = 2 + rng.Next(rng.Next(3) + 1); for (int k = 1; k <= hgt && y + k < Chunk.Height; k++) c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, y + k, lz)] = B.SugarCane; } // glina pod wodą if (rng.Next(3) == 0) { int lx = rng.Next(16), lz = rng.Next(16); int y = c.TopSolidY(lx, lz); if (y > 0 && y < SeaLevel && c.Blocks[Chunk.Index(lx, y + 1, lz)] == B.Water) { int rad = 1 + rng.Next(2); for (int dx = -rad; dx <= rad; dx++) for (int dz = -rad; dz <= rad; dz++) for (int dy = -1; dy <= 0; dy++) { int x = lx + dx, z = lz + dz; if (x < 0 || x > 15 || z < 0 || z > 15 || dx * dx + dz * dz > rad * rad) continue; int idx = Chunk.Index(x, y + dy, z); if (c.Blocks[idx] is B.Dirt or B.Sand or B.Gravel) c.Blocks[idx] = B.Clay; } } } }

nodes.body_text: private sealed class GroundWriter : ITreeWriter { private readonly ITreeWriter _w; private readonly int _x, _y, _z; public GroundWriter(ITreeWriter w, int x, int y, int z) { _w = w; _x = x; _y = y; _z = z; } public int Get(int x, int y, int z) => x == _x && y == _y && z == _z ? B.Grass : _w.Get(x, y, z); public void Set(int x, int y, int z, byte id, int meta) => _w.Set(x, y, z, id, meta); }

nodes.name: FindSpawn
nodes.signature: public (int x, int y, int z) FindSpawn()
nodes.body_text: public (int x, int y, int z) FindSpawn() { if (Type == WorldType.Superflat) return (0, 4, 0); var r = new Rng(Seed); for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 2000; attempt++) { int x = attempt == 0 ? 0 : r.Next(attempt * 2 + 1) - attempt, z = attempt == 0 ? 0 : r.Next(attempt * 2 + 1) - attempt; int cx = x >> 4, cz = z >> 4; var p = Proto(cx, cz); int lx = x & 15, lz = z & 15; int y = p.top[lz * 16 + lx]; if (y >= SeaLevel && p.topBlock[lz * 16 + lx] == B.Stone) return (x, y + 1, z); } return (0, 100, 0); }

nodes.name: gifs.mjs
nodes.body_text: // node gifs.mjs <folderShowcase> <folderWyjściowy> [szerokość] [scena1,scena2,...] – składa klatki z --showcase w GIF-y import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; import { PNG } from 'pngjs'; import gifenc from 'gifenc'; const { GIFEncoder, quantize, applyPalette } = gifenc; const [src, out, widthArg, only] = process.argv.slice(2); const onlySet = only ? new Set(only.split(',')) : null; const W = Number(widthArg || 480); const perFramePalette = new Set(['daycycle', 'tnt', 'title']); fs.mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true }); for (const scene of fs.readdirSync(src).filter(d => fs.statSync(path.join(src, d)).isDirectory() && (!onlySet || onlySet.has(d))).sort()) { const dir = path.join(src, scene); const files = fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f => f.endsWith('.png')).sort(); const frames = files.map(f => resize(PNG.sync.read(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, f))), W)); const { width, height } = frames[0]; let shared = null; if (!perFramePalette.has(scene)) { const pick = frames.filter((_, i) => i % 6 === 0); const all = new Uint8Array(pick.length * width * height * 4); pick.forEach((f, i) => all.set(f.data, i * width * height * 4)); shared = quantize(all, 256); } const gif = GIFEncoder(); frames.forEach((f, i) => { const palette = shared || quantize(f.data, 256); const index = applyPalette(f.data, palette); gif.writeFrame(index, width, height, { palette, delay: 100, repeat: 0 }); }); gif.finish(); const file = path.join(out, scene + '.gif'); fs.writeFileSync(file, gif.bytes()); console.log(scene, frames.length, 'klatek', (fs.statSync(file).size / 1048576).toFixed(2), 'MB'); }

nodes.name: resize
nodes.signature: function resize(png, w)
nodes.body_text: function resize(png, w) { const h = Math.round(png.height * w / png.width); const sx = png.width / w, sy = png.height / h; const o = new Uint8Array(w * h * 4); for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) { const x0 = x * sx, x1 = x0 + sx, y0 = y * sy, y1 = y0 + sy; let r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, n = 0; for (let yy = Math.floor(y0); yy < Math.ceil(y1); yy++) for (let xx = Math.floor(x0); xx < Math.ceil(x1); xx++) { const wx = Math.min(xx + 1, x1) - Math.max(xx, x0), wy = Math.min(yy + 1, y1) - Math.max(yy, y0), wt = wx * wy; const i = (yy * png.width + xx) * 4; r += png.data[i] * wt; g += png.data[i + 1] * wt; b += png.data[i + 2] * wt; n += wt; } const k = (y * w + x) * 4; o[k] = r / n; o[k + 1] = g / n; o[k + 2] = b / n; o[k + 3] = 255; } return { data: o, width: w, height: h }; }

nodes.name: screens.mjs
nodes.body_text: // node screens.mjs <srcDir> <outDir> [width] – zmniejsza zrzuty screen_*.png import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; import { PNG } from 'pngjs'; const [src, out, widthArg] = process.argv.slice(2); const W = Number(widthArg || 960); fs.mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true }); for (const f of fs.readdirSync(src).filter(f => /^screen_.*\.png$/.test(f))) { const png = PNG.sync.read(fs.readFileSync(path.join(src, f))); const h = Math.round(png.height * W / png.width), sx = png.width / W, sy = png.height / h; const o = new PNG({ width: W, height: h }); for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) { const x0 = x * sx, x1 = x0 + sx, y0 = y * sy, y1 = y0 + sy; let r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, n = 0; for (let yy = Math.floor(y0); yy < Math.ceil(y1); yy++) for (let xx = Math.floor(x0); xx < Math.ceil(x1); xx++) { const wt = (Math.min(xx + 1, x1) - Math.max(xx, x0)) * (Math.min(yy + 1, y1) - Math.max(yy, y0)), i = (yy * png.width + xx) * 4; r += png.data[i] * wt; g += png.data[i + 1] * wt; b += png.data[i + 2] * wt; n += wt; } const k = (y * W + x) * 4; o.data[k] = r / n; o.data[k + 1] = g / n; o.data[k + 2] = b / n; o.data[k + 3] = 255; } const name = f.replace(/^screen_/, ''); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, name), PNG.sync.write(o, { colorType: 2 })); console.log(name, (fs.statSync(path.join(out, name)).size / 1024).toFixed(0), 'KB'); }
